name: BlockDrop: Block Puzzle
short: Free and open source block-stacking puzzle game. Arrange falling shapes to clear
description: Block Drop is a modern and engaging Tetris clone built with Flutter, offering a classic puzzle experience with a fresh twist. Test your skills by dropping, rotating, and clearing lines in this addictive game. Features: * Classic Tetris gameplay * Smooth and responsive controls * Clean and modern user interface * Hold and swap pieces * Upcoming pieces preview

name: DragTree
short: NHRA Pro Tree reaction timer — accelerometer launch detection, no internet
description: DragTree simulates a real NHRA Christmas Tree (drag strip starting lights) and uses your phone's accelerometer to measure reaction time to the millisecond — no tapping required. Mount your phone on the dash, stage up, watch the tree, and floor it. The app detects launch G-force automatically and records your RT. Fully offline — no internet, no account, no ads. TREE MODES • Pro Tree (.400s) — all three ambers fire simultaneously, green follows 0.400s later • Sportsman Tree (.500s) — ambers count down one at a time, green follows 0.500s after the last amber REACTION GRADING • Perfect: 0–0.049s • Pro: 0.050–0.099s • Great: 0.100–0.199s • Good: 0.200–0.349s • Late: over 0.349s • Red Light: launched before green FEATURES • Accelerometer launch detection — rolling baseline, no calibration step • Three sensitivity presets: Gentle (0.15g), Normal (0.25g), Hard (0.46g) plus custom dial • Session history — last 30 runs, personal best highlighted • Reaction time trend chart — bar chart of recent runs • Series mode — run 3, 5, or 10 back-to-back stages with avg RT, best/worst, and consistency score • Optional audio cues — amber click, green chirp, result ping, red-light buzz • Diagnostics screen — live G-force, sensor telemetry, last-launch breakdown • Browser / simulator mode — on-screen FLOOR IT button for desktop practice PERMISSIONS • HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS — required for 125 Hz accelerometer sampling. No other sensor or location permissions used. No internet connection required after install.

name: King Pong
short: Retro Pong campaign with multiplayer and a secret ending
description: King Pong is a retro arcade Pong game with an 18-level campaign, custom games, local and LAN multiplayer, progressive paddle shapes, save slots, multiple languages, touch controls, controller support, and a secret ending. Features: * 18 campaign levels across three leagues * Custom games and local two-player mode * Optional LAN multiplayer * Progressive paddle shapes and changing arenas * Touch, keyboard, and controller support * Multiple languages and three local save slots * Original programmatically generated music and sound * Secret boss battle and ending King Pong works offline and contains no advertising, analytics, accounts, tracking, or in-app purchases.

name: Sudoku
short: A clean Sudoku app with logic-based difficulty and helpful assists
description: A clean Sudoku app built with Flutter. Every puzzle is uniquely generated, and its difficulty is derived from the logical solving techniques required to complete it. Features: * Logic-based difficulty - difficulty is derived from the techniques needed to solve a puzzle (Hidden Single, Naked Pair, X-Wing, Swordfish, and more). * In-game assists - notes/pencil marks, auto-notes, undo, conflict highlighting, and validation. * Statistics & leaderboard - track your solve times per difficulty, with a top-10 board shown on the solved overlay. * Resume - your current game is saved locally so you can continue right where you left off. * Theming - light and dark modes plus custom color themes with a live preview. * Responsive layout - adapts the control placement for phones and larger screens. The app works fully offline, stores all data locally on your device.

name: Quiet Grid
short: Privacy-first logic puzzles. No ads, no internet, no account required.
description: Quiet Grid is a collection of logic puzzles for Android. No ads, no tracking, no internet connection required — everything runs entirely on your device. Puzzles included: Chimp Test — Tap the numbers in order before they disappear. Takuzu — Fill a grid with 0s and 1s: each row and column must have equal counts, no three in a row, and no two rows or columns may be identical. Nonogram — Deduce which cells to fill based on number clues along rows and columns. Minesweeper — Classic grid puzzle. Uncover all safe cells without triggering a mine. Sudoku — Place digits 1–9 so every row, column, and 3×3 box contains each digit exactly once. Word Search — Find hidden words in a grid of letters. Block Fill (Beta) — Drag pieces onto the grid and clear full lines. Word Guess — Guess the hidden word in six tries. Animal Doku — Place one animal in every row, column, and colored region, with no two animals touching, even diagonally. Arrow Escape (Beta) — Clear the board, one arrow at a time. 2048 — Slide and merge matching tiles until one of them reaches 2048. Star Battle — Place stars in every row, column, and region with no two touching. Guess by Numbers — Guess the hidden word in ten tries; two numbers show how close each guess was. N-Back (Beta) — Watch the grid and tap Match whenever the lit square repeats its position from N steps back. Theme Clear — Clear the grid by spelling words from one theme until every letter is used. Each puzzle type offers Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert difficulty levels. Privacy by design: Quiet Grid does not use the internet, request dangerous permissions, or collect any data. All progress and settings are stored locally on your device. Available in English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, and Polish.

name: Arrow Escape: Infinite Puzzle
short: Minimalist arrow puzzle game with infinite levels, zero ads, and total privacy
description: Unwind and challenge your brain with Arrow Escape, a clean, minimalist puzzle game built purely for the love of play. Navigate intricate mazes of arrows by finding the right sequence to clear the board. Simple to pick up, satisfying to master, and endlessly engaging, Arrow Escape offers a distraction-free gaming experience designed to respect your time, device, and privacy. KEY FEATURES Infinite Levels: Procedurally generated puzzles ensure you never run out of challenges. 100% Offline Play: Play anywhere, on a plane, underground, or off the grid, without needing an internet connection. Zero Ads and Trackers: No popup interruptions, banner ads, or background tracking scripts. Just pure gameplay. Complete Privacy: No account needed, no data collected, and no unnecessary permissions requested. Minimalist Design: Clean visuals and crisp effects designed to help you focus and relax. Whether you have two minutes to spare or want to zone out for an hour, Arrow Escape is the ultimate clean, privacy-respecting puzzle fix.

name: Block Blast
short: A minimal, privacy-focused block puzzle game
description: - 100% Free & Open Source - Zero Ads, No Trackers - Campaign & Procedurally Generated Infinite Levels - Full Offline

name: Jigsaw Solitaire
short: A beautifully tactile, relaxing jigsaw puzzle game
description: A beautifully tactile, relaxing jigsaw puzzle game. Features: - Levels & Campaign Progression: Scaled difficulty from 3x3 grids up to challenging 10x10 grids, with milestone Boss levels. - Random / Sandbox Mode: Customize your experience with any grid size (3x3 to 10x10) and choose specific images or let the game shuffle them. - Unified Image Pool: Pre-loaded with 20 curated images, plus the ability to import your own custom photos directly via system file picker (Android Storage Access Framework). - 100% Offline & Private: Zero analytics, zero tracking, zero remote servers, and zero cloud sync. All gameplay, progress, and custom assets stay exclusively on your local device.

name: Matrix Puzzle
short: A minimal, open-source matrix puzzle game also known as floor puzzle
description: Matrix Puzzle is a minimal, logic-based puzzle game. Features: • Infinite Levels: Procedurally generated puzzles for endless gameplay. • 100% Offline: Play anytime, anywhere without an internet connection. • No Ads & No Trackers: Privacy-friendly with zero advertisements and analytics. • Lightweight: Clean, distraction-free interface.

name: Cube Run
short: Dodge, jump and slam through a neon 3-lane gauntlet. One-thumb 3D runner.
description: Cube Run is a minimalist one-thumb 3D runner. The world rushes toward you down a neon three-lane track, and your cube has to dodge, jump, slide and slam its way through everything in the way. Swipe left or right to snap between lanes, swipe up to leap low walls, swipe down to slide under overhead bars — or swipe down in mid-air to slam back to the ground in a hurry. Pillars and wide bars leave just one survivable lane, and once you get going some obstacles slide sideways into the open lane as they approach — so read the track and commit at the last moment. Score a point for every row you clear, with a bonus for shaving past an obstacle by a hair. The track speeds up the longer you survive, the colours drift across the spectrum, and a single mistimed move ends the run in a burst of shards. Features: * One-thumb controls: swipe to switch lanes, jump, slide and slam. * An endless, procedurally generated track — no two runs are alike. * A relentless difficulty ramp that rewards nerve and near-misses. * Tight, tactile feedback with synchronised sound and haptics. * A local high score. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no network access. * Tiny download and fully playable offline. Cube Run is built with libGDX and is free and open-source software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

name: Chess Puzzles
short: Offline chess tactics from real Lichess puzzles. No account, ads, or tracking
description: Chess Puzzles is an offline tactics trainer built from real positions in the Lichess puzzle database. Find the best move, follow the tactical line, and improve at your own pace. Clear goals. Each puzzle tells you what to find, such as checkmate in two. Three difficulty bands. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard puzzles. Useful hints. Reveal the move to play when you need a nudge. Opening practice. Learn twenty common openings move by move, then play them back from memory against the most common replies. Saved progress. Track solved puzzles, hint-free solves, and streaks on your device. Light and dark themes. Use the board that suits your screen. Fully offline. Every puzzle is bundled with the app. The app needs no account and requests no permissions. It contains no ads, analytics, or tracking. Puzzles come from the Lichess Open Database under CC0 1.0, and opening names from Lichess's opening list, also CC0 1.0.

name: Open Patience
short: Free, open-source Klondike & FreeCell solitaire — no ads, no tracking
description: Open Patience is a relaxing, ad-free solitaire game — just you and the cards. Included classics: * Klondike (draw 1 and draw 3) * FreeCell Features: * No ads, no tracking, no network access * Undo and redo, with a timer and move counter * Tap or drag to play; double-tap to send a card to its foundation * Your game is saved automatically, so you can resume any time Free and open source, licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0). Built with Flutter.

name: Minesweeper
short: Beautiful Minesweeper. No ads, no trackers, no permissions.
description: Every other Minesweeper on Android is either a privacy nightmare stuffed with ads and trackers, or a bare-bones port that looks like it was built in 2009. This one is neither. No ads. No permissions. No analytics. No internet. Just the game. Built with Jetpack Compose and Material 3, it looks and feels like a first-party Google app. Material You dynamic colour adapts the entire palette to your wallpaper on Android 12+. The grid always fills the screen. Cells scale to any device. No zooming, no tiny tap targets. Three modes that are mechanically distinct, not just bigger grids • Easy , 9×9, classic rules, guaranteed safe first click, full chord support • Medium , 12×12, higher mine density, 5-minute countdown, only your clicked cell is safe at the start • Hard , 14×14, safe on the tapped cell only, chord disabled, 3-minute countdown, and fog of war : revealed cells fade out after 6 seconds and you must hold the entire mine map in your head Fog of war is a novel mechanic that does not exist in any other Minesweeper app. Polish • Ripple flood-fill, empty areas reveal outward in animated waves • Spring bounce on every cell open and flag placement • Screen shake on game over • LED-style mine counter and timer, blinks red under 30 seconds • Haptic feedback on every interaction • Deep-space dark theme with vibrant number colours • Best time and win count per preset, shown in the win/lose banner • Flag mode toggle, swaps tap and long-press so a tap flags a cell 100% free and open source , GPLv3, no ads, no tracking, no analytics.

name: GCompris
short: Multi-Activity Educational game for children 2 to 10
description: GCompris is a high quality educational software suite, including a large number of activities for children aged 2 to 10. Some of the activities are game orientated, but nonetheless still educational. Below you can find a list of categories with some of the activities available in that category. - computer discovery: keyboard, mouse, different mouse gestures, etc. - arithmetic: table memory, enumeration, mirror image, balance the scale, change giving, etc. - science: the canal lock, color mixing, gravity concept, etc. - games: memory, connect 4, tic tac toe, sudoku, hanoi tower, etc. - reading: reading practice, etc. - other: learn to tell time, the braille system, maze, music instruments, etc. Currently GCompris offers in excess of 100 activities and more are being developed. GCompris is free software, that means that you can adapt it to your own needs, improve it and, most importantly, share it with children everywhere.

name: TreasureHunt
short: Be active, go treasure hunting!
description: This is an outdoor app that will let you or somebody you like experience a treasure hunt. Define waypoints in your area, then explore those waypoints and solve riddles, until you reach the final stage. The map tiles are loaded online from the OpenStreetMap servers (tile.openstreetmap.org), so displaying the map requires an internet connection.

name: VRChat Android Assistant
short: VRChat Friend Management Application for Android devices.
description: VRChat Android Assistant offers a convenient solution for managing your VRChat experience on the go. With this tool, users can efficiently handle profile customization, friend interactions, and stay informed about the latest events, all from their Android device, without relying on the VRChat game client.

name: Braincup - Brain Training
short: Train your focus, memory and math skills.
description: Mini-games for memory, focus, logic and math, plus Learn Math lessons with certificates. Mental Calculation : Follow expressions; each result is the base for the next. Chain Calculation : Solve a formula step by step. Sherlock Calculation : Reach the goal with the given numbers and operators. Fraction Calculation : Solve the fractions. Value Comparison : Pick the expression with the highest value. Bubble Sum : Add the numbers on the floating bubbles. Quick Sum : Numbers flash one at a time; enter the total. Anomaly Puzzle : Find the figure that stands out. Pattern Sequence : Work out the rule along each row and complete the grid. Path Finder : Follow the arrows from the marked start. Visual Memory : Memorize the shapes, then identify the hidden one. Ghost Grid : Watch tiles light up; tap them back in order. Color Confusion : Tap the ink color, not the color the word names. Colored Shapes : Add the points from the correct statements. Orbit Tracker : Track the highlighted balls as they move. Flash Crowd : Tap the side that flashed more dots. Mini Sudoku : Each row, column and block once per digit. Mini Chess : Finish the scenario as white against the CPU. Solo Chess : Capture until only the king remains. Every move must capture. Mini Checkers : Find the winning combination as black on a 6x6 board. Lights Out : Turn off every light; taps toggle neighbours. Sliding Puzzle : Slide tiles into order. Shikaku : Divide the grid into rectangles matching their numbers. Nurikabe : Paint the sea around numbered islands, no 2x2 blocks. Cat Queens : One cat per row, column and color zone; none may touch. Knot : Connect colored pairs without crossing; cover every cell. Tower of Hanoi : Move the stack to the right peg. Schulte Table : Tap the numbers in order as fast as you can. Flags : Name the country; one wrong answer ends the run. Digit Memory : Memorize digits, solve a quick sum, then recall. Spot the New : Tap the animal you have not seen before. N-Back : Tap Match when a shape repeats the one N steps back. Wordle : Guess the five-letter word in six tries. Matchstick Riddles : Move matchsticks to fix equations. Peg Solitaire : Jump pegs until one remains. Sudoku : Classic full-size Sudoku, several difficulties. Chess : Full chess vs the CPU or pass-and-play. IQ Test : 30 matrix puzzles in 15 minutes, with an estimated IQ. Just for fun. Missing Operators : Find the operators (+, -, *, /) that make the equation true. Bulls & Cows : Guess the secret 4-digit number. Simo

name: Slitherlink: Logic Loop Puzzle
short: Connect the dots to form a single continuous loop. Pure, relaxing logic puzzle.
description: Challenge your brain with Slitherlink, the timeless Japanese logic puzzle where deductive reasoning meets minimalist design. Also known as Fences, Loop the Loop, Takegaki, or Suriza, this clean, grid-based puzzle offers endless hours of relaxing yet deeply satisfying mental exercise.

name: Unciv
short: Open source 4X civilization-building game
description: An open-source reimplementation of the most famous civilization-building game ever - fast, small, no ads, free forever! Build your civilization, research technologies, expand your cities and defeat your foes! Requests? Bugs? Want to help development? Todo list for the application is https://github.com/yairm210/Unciv/issues Questions? Comments? Join us on discord at https://discord.gg/bjrB4Xw ;) Want to help translating the game into your language? See https://yairm210.github.io/Unciv/Translating/Translating/ The world awaits! Will you build your civilization into an empire that will stand the test of time? The 'have full network access' permission is required for user-initiated downloads and the multiplayer feature. All other listed permissions are included automatically by the API used to implement multiplayer turn notifications. Network permissions are used to list mods, download mods, download music and to upload/download multiplayer games. No other internet communication is initiated by Unciv.

name: 99Managers Futsal Edition
short: A futsal management game with a 2D match engine and integrated editor.
description: 99Managers is a sports management game, and this is the Futsal Edition, the first in the series. Run real futsal matches with a real-time 2D match engine and take full control with the in-game editor. Customize players, teams, and competitions. And since it’s open source, you can get the full source code and make it yours. 2D match engine - Watch full matches or just the highlights - Influence outcomes by changing players and tactics - Simulate matches and get final results instantly Data pack editor - Create custom data packs and share them with others - Customize competitions, and build your own leagues and cups - Create teams, use logos, and edit player attributes Join the community - Because your feedback matters - Report bugs - Improve translations - Contribute fixes and features Made with Godot Engine 4 and much love.

name: Bati: Fitness RPG
short: Turn workouts into quests, boss fights and a village built by your training.
description: Train like a hero, build like a king. Bati turns strength training into a dark-fantasy RPG. A workout is a quest. Reps land as damage on a boss. The muscles you actually work raise the buildings of a village that grows out of what you lifted, not out of what you bought. SPORT FIRST, RPG SECOND The training logic leads and the game amplifies it. Nothing decorative gets between you and your next set: large tap targets, high-contrast text, and a screen designed for one hand in a noisy gym. WHAT YOU GET • Quests: guided sessions with targets that adapt to your level • Adventures: multi-session campaigns with a story between steps • Boss fights: reps become damage; weaknesses and criticals make the numbers mean something • Outings: walk, run or ride; the ground you cover raises the road out of the village • A village: buildings level up from the volume you actually logged • Oaths: pick one goal and let the app hold you to it • A journal: history, records, your flame, muscle balance YOUR TRAINING STAYS ON YOUR PHONE No account. No sign-up. No server of ours. No analytics, no ads, no tracking of any kind. Your sessions, your records and the GPS trace of an outing live in a database on your device and nowhere else. Uninstalling the app destroys every record it ever made. One exception, off by default: the map behind an outing's route. Switched on in Settings, the phone asks OpenFreeMap (OpenStreetMap data, served from tiles.openfreemap.org) for tiles, the square images a map is made of, covering the place where you went. That request tells the host roughly where you were, with your IP address and the time. Not the route to the metre, not the pace, not the training, not who you are, but the area, yes. Off, or switched off again with one tap, the route is drawn on a plain background and the app makes no network request at all. No other part of the app is allowed to open a connection: a lint rule fails the build if a network call appears anywhere in the code. Location is read only while an outing is running, by a GPS module written for this app against Android's own location service. No Google Play Services, no third-party SDK, nothing that phones home. The map is the one switch, and it starts off. Everything else above is the architecture, checked at build time. BODYWEIGHT FIRST The exercise catalogue is built around what you can do with no equipment, and adapts if you own some. Warm-ups are dynamic and scaled to the session in front of you, because a five-minute wa

name: Mental Math
short: Practice mental arithmetic solo or compete with friends.
description: "Mental Math" is a simple and clean Android app for mental arithmetic training. You can practice on your own or challenge friends to compete and improve your skills. The app is open source and respects your privacy. Customizable Training Select which arithmetic operations to include (+, −, ×, ÷). For each operation, choose from nine difficulty levels to customize your training precisely to your skill level. Two Game Modes • Practice Mode lets you complete a fixed number of problems (10, 20, 30, 40, or 50). • Timed Mode challenges you to solve as many problems as possible within a time limit (1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 minutes). Challenge your Friends You can share a game link to: 1. Replay a completed game with the exact same problems to compare scores with friends. 2. Start a new game with preset settings for a fair and fresh challenge for everyone. Difficulty Calculation Problem difficulty is determined using algorithms based on column addition, column subtraction, long multiplication, and long division, creating realistic and well-balanced exercises. Detailed Results After each game, view a detailed summary that includes your selected settings, your performance (accuracy, speed, and score), and a complete list of all your problems and answers for review. Personal Leaderboard Your top 10 results are displayed separately for each combination of settings, allowing you to easily track your progress. You can also review detailed summaries of your top games at any time. Game History Explore the complete history of all your scored games. You can sort the list by time or numerically to find specific games. Anytime, you can revisit any match to view a detailed summary of its results. Practice Reminders Set up periodic reminders to support regular mental math practice. Notifications are sent in the evening (around 6 p.m.) and can be scheduled daily, every three days, or weekly. Customizable Interface Choose your preferred keypad (numeric or phone-style), display math problems horizontally or vertically, and adjust the input direction (left-to-right or right-to-left) to suit your preferences. Sound & Vibration Choose sound and/or vibration as feedback during games for clearer, more immediate feedback. Both options can be enabled or disabled independently. Vibration may depend on your device or system settings. Clean Design A simple and minimalist app design with no unnecessary elements or distractions, designed to keep your focus fully on mental math training. Supports both

name: Colorgram
short: A free, open-source color logic puzzle game with no ads or tracking
description: Colorgram is a free and open-source picture logic puzzle game. Use numerical clues along the rows and columns to fill in grid tiles and reveal hidden colored pixel art images. Key Features: 100% Free and Open Source (FOSS) No advertisements, no microtransactions, and no tracking Multiple grid sizes and difficulty levels

name: Kakuro
short: Solve Kakuro puzzles! The addictive blend of Sudoku and crossword sums.
description: Master your mind with Kakuro, the ultimate fusion of classic crosswords and number logic puzzles! Often called Cross Sums, Kakuro delivers the satisfaction of a math brain teaser with the deep strategic flow of Sudoku. Whether you are a newcomer learning the basic combinations or a veteran grid solver, Kakuro provides endless hours of clean, distraction-free brain training.

name: Idle Fantasy
short: Idle RPG: train skills, fight dungeons, craft gear. No ads, no accounts.
description: Idle Fantasy is a free and open source offline idle RPG inspired by classic MMORPGs. Train skills, fight in dungeons, craft gear, and complete quests. No internet connection, account, or ads required. Features • 23 trainable skills : Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting, Farming, Thieving, Smithing, Cooking, Fletching, Crafting, Firemaking, Runecrafting, Herblore, Construction, Prayer, Mercantile, Agility, Slayer, Attack, Strength, Defense, Ranged, Magic, and Hitpoints • Session-based training : Start a session and close the app. Come back up to an hour later to collect your loot and XP. Agility reduces session time. • 33 dungeons : Fight solo bosses and enemies to earn combat XP, coins, and rare drops. Equip weapons and armour to deal more damage. • Crafting system : Smelt bars, cook fish, fletch bows and arrows, craft jewellery. Consume gathered materials and earn XP and items. • Prayer : Bury bones collected from combat to earn Prayer XP. • Equipment system : Equip weapons, armour, tools, and jewellery to boost stats and skill efficiency. • Quest system : 189 quests spanning all skills. Earn XP rewards on completion. • Pet system : Rare pets can drop while training skills. Each pet provides a permanent XP boost to their linked skill. • Achievements : Track milestones across levelling, combat, quests, and collections. • NPC Shop : Buy supplies and sell your gathered resources for coins. • No ads. No accounts. No internet required. Your save data stays on your device. • Translations : Partial and full translations available for 20 languages. Idle Fantasy is free software released under the GPL-3.0 licence. Source code is available on the project repository. Get updates faster Add the official Idle Fantasy repository to F-Droid to receive updates as soon as they are released, instead of waiting for the main F-Droid index to catch up. 1. Open F-Droid and go to Settings → Repositories 2. Tap + and paste: https://idlefantasy.tristinbaker.xyz/fdroid/repo 3. Search for Idle Fantasy, open the app page, and under Repositories set Idle Fantasy as the preferred source.

name: Mindustry
short: An open-ended factory management game with RTS and tower defense elements
description: Mindustry is a factory-building game with tower defense and RTS elements. Create elaborate supply chains to feed ammo into your turrets, produce materials to use for building, and construct units. Command units to capture enemy bases, and expand your production. Defend your core from waves of enemies. Gameplay Features - Use production blocks to create a wide variety of advanced materials - Defend your structures from waves of enemies - Play with your friends in cross-platform multiplayer co-op games, or challenge them in team-based PvP matches - Distribute liquids and fight constant challenges, like outbreaks of fire or enemy flier raids - Get the most out of your production by supplying optional coolant and lubricant - Produce a wide variety of units for automatic management of your base or assault on enemy bases - Set up assembly lines to construct armies of mechanized units - Use your units to square up against fully functional enemy bases Campaign - Conquer the planets Serpulo and Erekir as you advance through 35 hand-made maps and 250+ procedurally generated sectors - Capture territory and set up factories to produce resources while you play other sectors - Defend your sectors from periodic invasions - Coordinate resource distribution between sectors via launch pads - Research new blocks to fuel progress - Invite your friends to complete missions together - 250+ technology blocks to master - 50+ different types of drones, mechs and ships Custom Games & Cross-Platform Multiplayer - 16+ built in maps for custom games, in addition to two entire campaigns - Play co-op, PvP or sandbox - Join a public dedicated server, or invite friends to your own private session - Customizable game rules: Change block costs, enemy stats, starting items, wave timing and more - Full functional map editor with scripting support - Built-in mod browser & mod support

name: Chogan
short: Offline game collection: tower defence, sudoku, minesweeper, dots.
description: Chogan is a collection of small, finishable games in a single app. It ships with four games, and new ones arrive as updates to the same app. The games: * Tower Defence — four towers, three fixed maps plus a daily map, twenty waves and an endless mode * Sudoku — four difficulties with a guaranteed unique solution, notes, hints and a daily challenge * Minesweeper — no-guess generation, four sizes, chording and flags * Dots and Boxes — two players on one phone, or three levels of AI Around the games: * A daily challenge that is identical on every device, with no server at all * A weekly offline league with five tiers * Over thirty awards * Stats and a profile * Persian, English and Simplified Chinese interface with light and dark themes On privacy: * The only permission the app declares is vibration. Not even internet access * No ads, no in-app purchases, no analytics, no tracking * Every asset ships inside the package. Even the sound is generated with WebAudio, so there is not a single audio file in the build * Progress is stored on the device only, and Google auto-backup is turned off Free and open source under the MIT licence.

name: Gridle
short: Word game
description: Guess those words Move letters in the grid to make a gridle of words. It's a good idea to use a soft tipped stylus to see what you are doing, as it's difficult to see past stubby fingers. Letters which are in the word but in the wrong place will turn yellow. If they are in the right place they will turn green. If they are not in the word they will turn grey. Keep trying until you have guessed all the words. Tap the Refresh button in the toolbar to clear the display and generate another gridle of words. Words are chosen at random from a list, and are checked that they haven't been used recently. Use my Crossword or WordleSolver app to cheat.

name: Bubble Penetration
short: Fast arcade action: collect colors, chain combos, beat the highscore.
description: Bubble Penetration is a fast-paced arcade game built for quick sessions and serious highscore runs. Colorful bubbles and golden stars drift across the field - your job is to tap the right targets before time runs out. How it works: - Collect the currently required color to gain points and time. - Tap the wrong bubble and you lose precious seconds and the active combo. - Grab stars for bonus time and extra score. - Keep your streak alive to trigger combo multipliers up to x16. What you get: - Pure reaction-based gameplay with no fluff. - Increasing speed that keeps every round intense. - Highscores your way: compete worldwide, connect your own compatible leaderboard, or play completely offline. - Fully free and open source. Every run feels different, and every second matters - how long can you survive? Your score, your choice: The online leaderboard is ready whenever you want to compete with players from around the world. Got your own leaderboard? Just enter its address in the settings and make the competition yours. Or switch the online leaderboard off entirely: your best scores stay on your device and the bubble-popping fun keeps going without an internet connection.

name: Open Sudoku
short: Open Sudoku is an Open Source Sudoku game.
description: Open Sudoku is an Open Source Sudoku game. Features: • Without ads • Puzzles can be downloaded from web, entered by hand or generated on the project's homepage • Game stats (time spent, mistakes) • Next step hints with multiple strategies suggestions • Import to and export from a file • Visual themes including custom theme editor • Several input modes (finger-friendly numpad, popup, keyboard etc.) • Double pencil marks …and much more. More information (including how to report ideas and issues) can be found on the project's home page: http://opensudoku.moire.org.

name: MTG Familiar
short: MTG Familiar is a collection of utilities for playing "Magic: The Gathering"
description: "MTG Familiar" is a collection of utilities for the "Magic: The Gathering" trading card game, including a searchable offline database of magic cards, life, poison & mana counters, a set of virtual dice, card image downloads, deck, trade and wishlist management, comprehensive offline rules and judge documents, and a timer for competitive play. "Note:" Card price look-ups fail in the F-Droid APK due to a missing API key . IzzyOnDroid hosts an APK with the API key . This APK comes from the project’s GitHub releases page and is the same APK as on Google Play. Switching between APKs from different repositories requires you to uninstall MTG Familiar first because the APKs use different digital signatures. To preserve your data, export it with the "Save Data to SD" button at the bottom of the menu before uninstalling and import it with the "Load Data from SD" after installing.

name: Binary Puzzle
short: A minimalist binary placement logic puzzle game.
description: Features: No ads. No trackers, analytics, or telemetry. Offline first with zero internet permissions required. Infinite procedurally generated levels across multiple grid sizes.

name: Mobile Maia
short: Offline chess against Maia-3 with local Stockfish analysis
description: Mobile Maia is an offline-first chess app built around Maia-3, a human-like chess model developed by the University of Toronto Computational Social Science Lab. Play against Maia at a selected rating without creating an account or connecting to a server. The Maia-3 model and Stockfish are bundled with the app, so games and analysis remain on your device. Features include: Play as White, Black, or a random side Maia ratings from 800 to 2200, plus a custom rating Unlimited play, clock presets, and custom time controls Human-like move timing and adjustable Temperature and Top-P Single or multiple premoves, with an optional 100 ms penalty Takebacks, endgame draw offers, rematches, and automatic game restoration Experimental Chessnut Go play with LEDs, sounds, battery status, reconnect recovery, and phone continuation An analysis board with FEN and PGN import and export A graphical position editor and persistent analysis variations Offline Stockfish evaluation and Maia move comparison Fast, Balanced, or Thorough full-game analysis Full-game accuracy scores and a navigable evaluation graph Brilliant, Good, Interesting, Dubious, Mistake, and Blunder move classifications Two Stockfish suggestions and visible Maia/Stockfish agreement Lichess-style material difference beside each player Offline opening names and ECO codes from the Lichess opening database Historical clocks and timed PGN export with standard clock annotations PGN export with variations and game metadata Mobile Maia is independently developed free software. Its source code is available under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 only.

name: Learn Math
short: A modern, fast, and tactile mental math training game
description: Features 100% Offline & Private - Works entirely without an internet connection. - Zero analytics trackers, zero telemetry, zero data collection. - All your progress, streak stats, and mistake drills remain stored securely on your local device. No Ads, No Microtransactions - No pop-up ads, banner ads, or paywalled levels. - Pure, uninterrupted learning and math flow state. Game Modes - Level Progression: 60 structured levels spanning Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division, and Mixed Boss Fights. - Daily Challenge: Fresh daily math puzzles to build and maintain your streak. - Time Attack: 60-second high-speed arithmetic sprint. - Survival Mode: 3 lives, progressive difficulty, test how far you can go. - Target 24: The classic 4-number 24 puzzle with unlimited combinations and an integrated solver. - Local 2-Player Duel: Split-screen head-to-head math battle on a single device. - Targeted Practice: Custom sessions by category and difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard, Master).

name: Sudoku You
short: Offline Sudoku with logical hints, advanced notes and flexible import/export
description: Sudoku You is a free and open-source Sudoku app built for offline play and thoughtful solving. Generate classic 9×9 puzzles on your device, continue automatically saved games, or import a puzzle from text. Generated puzzles have a unique solution and come in Easy, Medium, Hard and Brutal difficulty levels. Imported puzzles are checked for a valid, unique solution. When you need help, the human-style solver provides a step-by-step logical trace with explanations and board markings. It covers basic techniques as well as advanced subsets, fish, wings, coloring, chains, unique rectangles and forcing chains. Optional checks can point out incorrect values or missing candidates before the solver continues. Features: • Pencil marks, automatic candidates, undo/redo and restart • Advanced annotations: color cells or candidates, highlight bivalue cells, frame cells, and draw solid or dashed links • Import puzzles and export the original or current grid in Susser, multiline, pencilmark, Sukaku, Excel/TSV, OpenSudoku and HoDoKu formats • Automatically saved recent and completed games • Statistics by difficulty for play time, best and average completion time, and games started or completed • Material 3 interface with system/light/dark modes, dynamic wallpaper colors, custom accents, palette styles, AMOLED black and board highlighting options • English and Simplified Chinese, selectable independently from the system language • Local crash history and third-party open-source license information Privacy: Sudoku You requests no network permission and includes no ads, accounts, analytics or tracking. Games and preferences are stored locally. Crash reports are retained locally for up to 30 days and are never uploaded automatically; you decide whether to copy or share them. Sudoku You is licensed under GNU GPL v3.0 or later and requires Android 11 or later.

name: Match 3
short: Minimal and open-source Match-3 puzzle game
description: Features & Key Perks - 100% Privacy Focused: No user data collection, no telemetry, and no registration required. - Zero Ads: Play with no commercial interruptions or pop-ups. - No Trackers: Completely free of analytics, advertising IDs, or third-party trackers. - Completely Offline: Fully functional offline. Ideal for commutes, travel, or areas with low connectivity. - Infinite Levels: Endless puzzle challenges with procedurally generated configurations.

name: Nonogram
short: A free, open-source picture logic puzzle game with no ads or tracking
description: Nonogram is a free and open-source picture logic puzzle game. Use numerical clues along the rows and columns to fill in grid tiles and reveal hidden pixel art images. Designed to be lightweight and user-friendly, Nonogram offers a clean, distraction-free environment for casual puzzle solving and brain training. Key Features: 100% Free and Open Source (FOSS) No advertisements, no microtransactions, and no tracking Multiple grid sizes and difficulty levels Intuitive controls for marking tiles and crossouts Offline play support Clean, responsive UI

name: Tangram
short: Make or solve Tangram puzzles
description: An implementation of the Tangram — a tiling puzzle consisting of seven polygons (five triangles in three sizes, a square, and a parallelogram) that can be put together to form shapes. Includes a number of puzzles that the player can try to solve, or the player can sketch out their own shapes. Runs on Android 6 (Marshmallow) through 17 (Cinnamon Bun) and up.

name: Fairy Mahjong
short: Clear a layered garden board with a four-slot matching hand
description: Match fairy portraits, characters and their belongings in a pixel-art meadow. Pick uncovered tiles with a free left or right side. Matching pictures clear from your four-slot hand. Clear the board before the hand fills. Includes hints, an illustrated guide, portrait and landscape layouts, haptic feedback and saved progress. Play offline without ads or accounts.

name: Mahjong Solitaire
short: Classic tile-matching puzzles without interruptions, tracking, or ads.
description: Key Features - No Ads & No Trackers: 100% private. Your data never leaves your device. - Infinite Levels: Procedurally generated Mahjong solitaire boards for unlimited gameplay. - Offline Play: Play anywhere, anytime without an internet connection.

name: The Battle for Wesnoth
short: A turn-based strategy game with a high fantasy theme
description: (Note: This is an alpha release of the 1.19 in-development branch, and works best on a Tablet with large screen space. Consider reaching out to us or file a bug report if you encounter an issue.) The Battle for Wesnoth is an open source, turn-based strategy game with a high fantasy theme. It features both singleplayer and online/hotseat multiplayer combat. Explore the world of Wesnoth and take part in its many adventures! Embark on a desperate quest to reclaim your rightful throne... Flee the Lich Lords to a new home across the sea... Delve into the darkest depths of the earth to craft a jewel of fire itself... Defend your kingdom against the ravaging hordes of a foul necromancer... Or lead a straggly band of survivors across the blazing sands to confront an unseen evil.

name: SuperSMP Companion
short: Vote, shop & explore SuperSMP anywhere! Companion app for server features
description: The Ultimate SuperSMP Companion App - Your Server, Everywhere! Enhance your SuperSMP Minecraft experience with the official companion app designed for players on the go! Access essential server features, stay connected with the community, and manage your server interactions right from your Android device. KEY FEATURES: SMART VOTING SYSTEM - Vote for the SuperSMP server directly from your phone - Quick access to all voting platforms - Track your voting history and rewards - Never miss daily vote rewards again INTEGRATED SHOP ACCESS - Browse the official SuperSMP shop catalog - View detailed item descriptions and pricing - Make secure purchases on-the-go - Real-time inventory updates INTERACTIVE SERVER MAP - Access the official SuperSMP world map - Real-time player locations and activity - Navigate spawn, warps, and key locations - Perfect for exploration and planning MODERN USER INTERFACE - Built with Jetpack Compose for smooth animations - Material Design 3 with Dynamic Color support (Android 12+) - OLED Black Mode for AMOLED screens - Intuitive navigation optimized for mobile - Responsive design for all screen sizes TECHNICAL EXCELLENCE - Kotlin-first development for performance - Privacy-focused WebView with tracker blocking - Modern architecture with MVVM pattern - Regular updates with new features - Optimized for battery life and performance MOBILE OPTIMIZATIONS - Fast loading times even on slower connections - Offline mode for cached content - Push notifications for server events (coming soon) - Designed for Android 7.0 and above WHY CHOOSE THIS APP? FREE & OPEN SOURCE - No hidden costs or subscriptions SECURE - Your data and accounts are protected REGULARLY UPDATED - New features and improvements monthly COMMUNITY DRIVEN - Features requested by players like you AD-FREE EXPERIENCE - Focus on what matters: your gameplay PERFECT FOR: Daily voters who want to maximize rewards Shop enthusiasts who browse items frequently Explorers who need map access on-the-go Community members who stay connected Players who want convenience without compromise IMPORTANT NOTE: This is an unofficial companion app created by fans for the SuperSMP community. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the SuperSMP Minecraft Server team. All server content and branding remain property of their respective owners. SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS: Android 7.0 (API 24) or higher 50MB free storage space Internet connection for real-time features UPCOMING FEATURES: Player statistics tracking In-ga

name: Ham Test
short: Prepare for and pass all three US Amateur Radio license exams
description: Prepare for your US Amateur Radio license exam with Ham Test. This app includes the question pools for Technician, General, and Extra, so you can study for all three exams with one app! Features: Study Mode helps you memorize the questions and correct answers for all the questions in any of the pools, repeating questions as necessary so you remember as much as possible. Practice Mode assesses how well you are doing on the actual test. It generates an exam the same way as official tests are created, making it easy to tell if you are ready to take the test yet. If you pass a practice test, the app will give you links to HamStudy.org to find an exam in person or online. In settings, you can enable a few other features, such as Auto select correct answers , which makes it so the answer is always the first option if you haven't seen the question before. Break the flow interrupts you every fifteen minutes in case you can't stop on your own. Daily notifications sends you a reminder if you haven't studied yet every day, 15 minutes before the last time you opened Ham Test. You can also import and export your progress so you can switch between devices. This app contains the Technician pool for 2026-2030, the General pool for 2023-2027, and the Amateur Extra pool for 2024-2028 so you can study completely offline.

name: Water Sort
short: Relaxing color-sorting puzzle. Infinite levels. Zero tracking. No ads.
description: Water Sort is a simple yet addictive puzzle game where you sort colored water in tubes until each tube contains only one color. How to play: - Tap a tube to pick up the top color, then tap another tube to pour it. - You can only pour the same color on top of another same color. - Sort all the tubes to win. Why you'll love it: 🚫 NO ADS, EVER No banners. No interstitials. No rewarded videos. Just pure, uninterrupted gameplay. 📊 ZERO TRACKERS No analytics. No data collection. No tracking of any kind. Your gameplay is yours alone. ♾️ INFINITE LEVELS Procedurally generated puzzles mean there's always a new challenge. No level caps, no energy bars, no waiting. 🔒 COMPLETELY OFFLINE No internet permission required. Your data never leaves your device. Play anywhere, anytime. 🎨 CLEAN DESIGN Minimalist interface with smooth animations and a calming color palette. Designed to relax, not to distract. Start sorting today. Your brain will thank you.

name: Social Deduction Game
short: Offline game-master assistant for Werewolf, Mafia and social deduction games
description: Social Deduction Game is a fully offline assistant for moderating Werewolf, Mafia, and other social deduction games. Prepare games Manage custom rule sets, teams, roles, and statuses Prepare players and the seating order Assign roles randomly, from a selected set, or manually Run games Keep track of the seating circle, roles, teams, and player status Show each player their role in a dedicated full-screen view Work through night actions in the correct order Manage day, night, life, death, and temporary statuses Games, templates, and rule sets can be saved, loaded, imported, and exported. Library backups make it easy to move your data to another device. All game and library data stays locally on the device. The app requires no account and contains no advertising or tracking. Social Deduction Game is free software licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3.

name: Lichess
short: The one open-source chess platform
description: Lichess is a free/libre, open-source chess application powered by volunteers and donations. Today, Lichess users play more than five million games every day. Lichess is one of the most popular chess websites in the world while remaining 100% free. Note: Push notifications are a work in progress and should not be expected to work correctly. To enable them, a Unified Push distributor such as https://f-droid.org/packages/org.unifiedpush.distributor.sunup/ needs to be installed. The following features are available right now: - play real time or correspondence chess - play arena tournaments - play against online bots - solve chess puzzles from a wide variety of themes, online or offline - race against the clock in Puzzle Storm - analyse your games with latest Stockfish locally or on the server - board editor - study chess with a collaborative and interactive study feature - learn board coordinates - play over the board with a friend - watch live chess broadcasts from all major chess tournaments - watch Lichess TV and online streamers - use a chess clock for your over the board games - many different board themes and piece sets - custom background themes - system colours on Android 12+ - translated into 55 languages

name: PlayHex
short: Play Hex board game online
description: Play online against other players, or vs AI. Blitz, live or correspondence games. Learn from game analysis to spot your blunders.

name: Egyptian Mouse Pounce
short: Play Egyptian Rat Screw against humans or cats.
description: Play Egyptian Rat Screw, a game of reflexes and luck where you win by playing face cards or slapping when pairs are played consecutively. You can play against another human or against computer-controlled cats at three difficulty levels.

name: Mahjong Scoring Compass
short: Automatic scoring compass for Riichi Mahjong
description: An automatic scoring compass for Riichi Mahjong that keeps track of points, player positions, and other aspects of the game state.

name: Breakout 71
short: Break colourful bricks, catch bouncing coins and select powerful upgrades !
description: This is a roguelike twist on the original Breakout formula: The goal is to catch as many coins as possible during 7 levels. Coins appear when you break bricks. They fly around, bounce and roll, and you need to catch them with your paddle. At the end of the level, you get to pick upgrades. There are 50+ different upgrades that impact the gameplay in various ways. Many upgrades will impact your combo, that's the number of coins spawned for each brick broken. Your "combo" is displayed on your paddle. Your score is displayed in the top right corner of the screen. Oh, and don't miss the ball, you don't have extra lives. The app should work offline and perform well even on low-end devices. It's very lean and does not take much storage space (Roughly 0.1MB). If the app runs slow, turn on "fast mode" in the settings. The in-game help will tell you more about how to play. Now go have some fun, and come share your best runs on our Discord.

name: Screw Jam
short: Unscrew plates, match colors with active toolboxes
description: Screw Jam is a clean, satisfying, and privacy-respecting screw puzzle game. Unscrew plates, match screw colors with active toolboxes, and solve intricate multi-layered mechanisms. Screw Jam respects your privacy: - Zero tracking, zero analytics, zero data collection. - Completely ad-free. No banners, popups, or rewarded ads. - 100 percent offline. Play anywhere without an internet connection.

name: Feudal Tactics
short: Strategy game with countless unique and challenging levels.
description: A medieval strategy game with countless unique and challenging levels. You play on a randomly generated island made of hexagons. Your goal is to conquer all of it. To do so, you attack the enemy with your units while trying to protect your own kingdoms.

name: Shikaku
short: A minimalist block logic puzzle game
description: Shikaku is a minimalist logic puzzle game. Divide the grid into rectangular or square blocks by dragging across cells. Every block must contain exactly one number, and the total area of the block must equal the number inside it. Blocks cannot overlap, and every cell on the grid must be covered. Features and Benefits: No ads. No trackers, analytics, or telemetry. Offline first with zero internet permissions required. Infinite procedurally generated levels across multiple grid sizes.

name: Janken (Rock Paper Scissors)
short: Modern offline Rock Paper Scissors with private Pass & Play, Bot AI and RPSLS.
description: Janken is a beautifully designed, modern, privacy-first Rock-Paper-Scissors and RPSLS game for Android, built natively with Jetpack Compose. Whether you are settling a debate with a friend or sharpening your mind against adaptive AI, Janken delivers an exquisite, fluid, and delightful experience. ✨ Key Features • 🤖 vs Computer (Smart Bot AI): Play against 3 distinct difficulties (Easy, Medium, Hard). The Hard AI analyzes your patterns with Markov chains to counter your tendencies! • 👥 Pass & Play (Local 2-Player): Play with a friend on a single phone with true privacy! Player 1 chooses a move which is instantly locked and shielded before handing the phone over to Player 2. • ⚡ Quick Decision Mode: Solve everyday dilemmas instantly — "Who gets the last slice of pizza?", "Who pays for coffee?", "Who takes out the trash?" • 🦎 Rock-Paper-Scissors-Lizard-Spock (RPSLS): Expand your battles with the classic 5-move variant! Includes an interactive visual rules cheat sheet. • 📊 In-Depth Statistics & Match Logs: Track your win rates, winning streaks, move distribution breakdown, and review detailed match histories. • 🎨 Material 3 Design & Micro-Animations: Fluid animations, dynamic color theming, dark/light modes, confetti celebrations, and tactile haptics. • 🔊 Synthesized Audio Effects: Enjoy custom offline synthesized sound chimes and cues with complete volume controls. 🔒 100% Privacy-First & Offline • Zero Permissions: Janken requires no internet permissions (INTERNET permission is completely omitted). • No Ads & No Tracking: Zero analytics, telemetry, or external SDKs. • Open Source: Free software licensed under GPL-3.0.

name: Hue Sort
short: A color sorting puzzle game. Swap tiles to reconstruct the hidden gradient.
description: A color sorting puzzle game. Swap tiles to reconstruct the hidden gradient. Features • 4x4 to 10x10 grids that scale with your level • Undo support • Random puzzle mode (Easy, Medium, Hard) • Progress saved automatically • No ads. No trackers. No data collection. Fully GDPR compliant.

name: Puzzle Games
short: 300+ minimalist brain games. Challenge your logic, memory & attention in game
description: Welcome to PUZZLE, the ultimate minimalist collection of brain training games and logic puzzles designed to challenge, stimulate, and improve your mind. Built with Flutter, this premium suite features over 304 unique games across 6 critical cognitive areas, all completely offline, ad-free, and open-source. Whether you want to play a quick game of Minesweeper, challenge yourself with 2048, solve a classic Sudoku, or boost your memory, PUZZLE has you covered. 6 COGNITIVE DOMAINS TO EXPLORE 1. ATTENTION AND FOCUS (54 Games) Enhance your mental focus, concentration, and speed. Play Schulte Table, Stroop Test, Color Match, Flanker Test, and visual search tasks to build elite attention. 2. LOGIC AND REASONING (44 Games) Challenge your logical thinking and deduction skills. Enjoy classic and modern brainteasers including Minesweeper, Sudoku, Akari, Nonograms, Einstein Riddle, Bridges, Nurikabe, Slitherlink, Lights Out, Shikaku, Masyu Loop, Kurodoko, Tapa, Heyawake, and Yajilin. 3. MATH AND NUMBERS (63 Games) Sharpen your mental arithmetic and mathematical reasoning with 2048, KenKen, Magic Squares, Sum Snake, Calculation Sprint, Fibonacci Merge, Exponent Tower, Dot Product, Pythagoras, Venn Sets, Matrix Rank, and more. 4. MEMORY TRAINING (54 Games) Improve your working memory, pattern recognition, and recall with Chimp Test, Corsi Blocks, N-Back, Double N-Back, Memory Palace, Pattern Recall, Associative Pairs, Corsi Backward, Word Pairs, Digit Probe, and spatial cabinet tasks. 5. SPATIAL AWARENESS (37 Games) Challenge your 3D rotation, mapping, and perspective skills with 3D Block Count, Gear Rotation, Mental Rotation, Classic Maze, Hue Sort, Klotski Escape, Tangram, Wireframe 3D, Polyomino, Gear Train, and paper folding simulations. 6. WORD AND LANGUAGE (51 Games) Expand your vocabulary, spelling, and linguistic speed with Cryptograms, Crosswords, Word Search, Word Snake, Typing Speed, Anagram Definitions, Conundrum, Word Ladders, Grammar Sort, Syllable Stack, and vocabulary builders. WHY CHOOSE PUZZLE 304 games in one app. No need to download dozens of apps. Get Sudoku, Minesweeper, 2048, and 300 other puzzles in a single download. 100% offline. Play anywhere, anytime during commutes, flights, or when you are completely off-grid. Clean and minimalist design. A beautiful, modern dark-themed interface built for focus with no distracting clutter. Open-source and privacy-friendly. Built with Flutter under GPL v3, ensuring total transparency and no data tracking. Su

name: Tents
short: A logic puzzle game where goal is to place tents in the grid
description: Tents is a logic puzzle game. The goal is to place tents in the grid so that every tree is paired with a tent according to grid constraints. Free and Open Source No Ads No Trackers or Telemetry No Data Collection Works Completely Offline

name: Accelerrace
short: Simple HTML5 racing game made just for fun.
description: Accelerrace is a simple HTML5 racing game made just for fun. It's a kind of a modern take on the retro microprocessor game from my childhood.

name: UniPatcher
short: Utility to apply patches to ROMs
description: UniPatcher allows you to apply patches to game ROMs. What is a patch? A file with the modified data of the game. For example, a game translated from Japanese to English. You download the patch containing the translation. It must be applied to the Japanese version to make an English version of it. This program will not help you hack native Android games, it was created for the old console games (SNES, PS1, GBA, N64, SMD\Genesis etc.) Features: * Supported formats of patches: IPS, IPS32, UPS, BPS, APS (GBA), APS (N64), PPF, DPS, EBP, XDelta3 * Create XDelta patches * Fix the checksum in SMD\Genesis ROMs * Remove the SMC header from SNES ROMs How to use? You have to select a ROM file, a patch and choose which file to save, then click on the red round button. Files are selected through the standard Files application (or through one of the file managers you have installed). The application will show a message when the file is patched. Do not close the application until the file is patched. Very important: If the game and patch is compressed (ZIP, RAR, 7z or other), they first need to be unzipped.

name: BlowTorch 2
short: BlowTorch 2 — a versatile mobile MUD client
description: The good BlowTorch client is back! Now more stable, with more functions. This app connects you to a MUD. MUD stands for Multi-User Dungeon: a multiplayer text game over telnet. Add a host and port, connect, and you are in. If you don't know where to look for MUDs, try these sites: MudStats MudVerse The Mud Connector There is a huge toolkit in this app. Daily play needs little of it. When you want the advanced features, open Help in the app or the user guide on GitHub . The app itself (menus, settings, and Help) is in English. Everyday play (some options might need to be turned on manually): • Convenient on-screen buttons that send commands, so you don't have to type the same things over and over • In-game suggestions from the text on the screen — you don't have to type every word by hand • Connect and stay connected with the screen off; the notification shows how long you have been on • A growable input bar, search in scrollback, two-finger copy • ANSI colours, optional session log to a file • In-app Help When you want more: • Eight-way swipe, hold, and accordion (MORE) on the same button; swap a whole set of buttons with a loadset • Logging to a text file, one file per day per world, that grows as you play • Protocols: telnet, GMCP, MCP, MXP, MSDP, MSSP, MCCP, MTTS. Colours and styles: ANSI, 256-colour, truecolour, bold, italic, underline, reverse, strike. OSC 8 tappable links • Triggers (with conditions), aliases, and timers — colour a line, hide it, notify you, send a command, run Lua; a lot of room to grow • Extra text windows and a chat drawer; words in the game text you can tap • Widgets: HP bars, rings, and countdowns you place on the screen and point at the world's numbers • Mapper: a map from room info the world sends, or from recorded steps (experimental) • Speedwalks, per-world settings, and Lua plugins — the classic BlowTorch toolkit • A trigger or timer can read a line aloud (the phone's own speech engine) But that's just the tip of the iceberg. There's much more inside. If you want the advanced side, I don't think you'll be disappointed! No ads, no analytics, no BlowTorch cloud account. Connects only to hosts you add. The F-Droid build does not contact GitHub on start. Lua plugins run with the app's privileges, so only load ones you trust. "All files access" is optional — only so settings, backups, and logs can live in a normal /BlowTorch/ folder. You can refuse it and still play; import and export go through the system file picker. Details O

name: Mines3D
short: Do you like challenges? Try two leveled mines.
description: Do you like challenges? Let's try one harder. The first task is to understand the rules of the game. The second one is to win it.

name: Infra Arcana
short: Infra Arcana - a Lovecraftian horror roguelike
description: Infra Arcana is a Roguelike set in the early 20th century. The goal is to explore the lair of a dreaded cult called The Church of Starry Wisdom. Buried deep beneath their hallowed grounds lies an artifact called The Shining Trapezohedron - a window to all secrets of the universe. Your ultimate goal is to unearth this artifact. This is an unofficial Android port prioritizing a mobile-friendly UI/UX.

name: Bubble Shooter
short: A modern 2D bubble shooter puzzle game
description: Bubble Shooter is a modern, colorful 2D bubble popping puzzle game. Aim, bounce off walls, and match 3 or more bubbles of the same color to clear the board and level up. Key Features: Classic Bubble Shooter Gameplay: Intuitive aiming and shooting physics. Match 3 or more bubbles to pop them. Campaign Mode: Advance through progressively challenging levels designed to test your strategy and precision. Zen Mode: Relax with endless, stress-free bubble popping without time or move pressure. Custom Themes and Skins: Personalize your visual experience with distinct color palettes and styles. Tactile Haptic Feedback: Feel satisfying response with every bubble pop and shot. Completely Offline: Play anywhere, anytime without requiring an internet connection. Progress is automatically saved on your device.

name: Ludo
short: Multiplayer Board Game
description: Zero analytics, zero tracking, zero remote servers, and zero cloud sync. All gameplay stay exclusively on your local device. Offline game.

name: TriPeaks NEUE
short: A simple Tri Peaks game.
description: A simple Tri Peaks patience (solitaire) game. This is a remake of tripeaks-gdx project, my previous implementation of the same game. Main Features: - Four board layouts - An option to show the values of face-down cards - An option to start with an empty discard pile, allowing the player to choose any starting card - An option to ensure the created games are solvable - Aggregated and per-layout statistics - Portrait and landscape orientation support

name: Dima Defense ⚔️
short: A simple Tower Defense game that was made in LibGDX
description: A simple Tower Defense game that was made in LibGDX

name: LetterBox
short: LetterBox is a simple kids game for learning letters
description: LetterBox is a game about animals and letters. It shows an animal and your task is to find the appropriate letter.

name: Jass board
short: Very flexible Jass board to write points at the Schieber, Coiffeur, Molotov.
description: Jass board to count the points while playing Jass simply with the Android smartphone or tablet. It is possible to write the points at the Schieber, Coiffeur, Differenzler, Molotov and other Jass types. ************************* For all boards it is possible to have several profiles. Settings and scores are stored independently. For example, you don't have to delete an unfinished round to be able to play Jass with other players. Even if different rules are used depending on the composition, this can easily be solved by a profile. The current profile can be shared by AndroidBeam (NFC) simply with another device. For this the board of one device has to be open and the devices have to be held back to back. This is helpful, for example, when the battery is empty or when complex profile settings have to be made. ************************* Schieber panel: - Write points individually (1/20/50/100) for Weis,... - Write complete rounds incl. multiplier (1x-7x) and opponent points - Input dialog can be rotated (for 1 or 2 writers) - Individual entries or complete rounds can be undone. - Different number of target points possible - Adjustable score per round (e.g. for double cards 314) - Extensive statistics - Backside to write down strokes for wins/matches,... Coiffeur board: - The types of jass can be chosen according to your preferences. - 16 predefined jass types + the possibility to enter your own (without picture). - The number of rounds played can be between 6 and 12. - It can be written for 2 or 3 teams. - Multipliers can be changed manually if desired. - Statistics about achievable points as well as conditions how a team becomes unreachable. - If a team is unreachable, this will be displayed. Differenzler board: - 2-8 players - Announcements remain hidden until the first points have been entered. - Points from the last outstanding player are automatically calculated. - Points from the last round can be changed afterwards (long press). Molotov board: - 2-8 players - Writing Weis in 3 clicks - When writing rounds, the outstanding points are calculated automatically. - Points can be edited later (long press) - Points can be written exactly or rounded. Score board: This is a general score board, which should allow you to write many more types of Jass. - 2-8 players - Target points / number of rounds can be set - In order to be able to write faster, the number of points per round can be set. (Outstanding points are calculated automatically). ***********************

name: CBG -- Clavierhaus BackGammon
short: The complete GNU Backgammon engine: play, coach, rollouts, career. Offline.
description: CBG Pro is the complete GNU Backgammon engine on Android -- and 1.0 is a major update that turns a strong backgammon app into the most capable analysis and training tool on the platform. It is not "based on" GNU Backgammon: it IS GNU Backgammon 1.08.003, vendored verbatim, with neural-net weights byte-identical to the desktop release. Every number on screen is the engine's own. Entirely offline -- the app does not even request the network permission. Free software, GPL-3.0, with reproducible builds verified by F-Droid's own pipeline against the developer's published binary. New in the 1.0 major update: * Regulation rollouts on your phone: 1296-trial, cubeful, variance-reduced, quasi-random -- the discipline desktop analysts use -- seed-reproducible, with the desktop-comparison harness published in the source repository. * The Coach: every move judged against the engine -- best, fine-but-not-best (with what beat it), or flagged with the equity it cost. Tap any better alternative and watch it play out on the board against your own move. Cube actions judged too. * Position set-up editor: build any position by hand, or paste a GNU BG ID, Match ID, or XGID from a forum or a book. Chequer rankings with dice on; double/take/drop equities with dice off. * Your Personal Stats: match statistics computed by gnubg's own analysis -- error rates, luck, cube handling -- with every number labeled by what it is. No invented metrics. * Your career, signed: finished matches enter a tamper-evident, cryptographically chained record. Your results, provable, in plain files you own. * A tournament match clock (delay clock), offered upstream to the GNU Backgammon project itself. The foundation, as always: * Full matches at any length, seven strength levels from Beginner to Grandmaster. * Complete cube play, Crawford, Jacoby, beavers, automatic doubles, and the canonical match-equity tables: Kazaross-XG2, Woolsey, Jacobs & Trice, Snowie, and the rest of gnubg's set. * Save and review matches as standard SGF -- step through what you played, what the engine preferred, and what it cost. Files open unchanged in desktop GNU Backgammon and Backgammon Studio. * Your matches and your career live in a folder you choose -- plain files, readable by anything, in twenty years too. Nothing is ever sent anywhere; there is no "anywhere" in this app. Requires Android 12 or newer and a 64-bit ARM device.

name: Orion Master
short: Native 1oom port of Master of Orion (1993). Requires your own LBX files
description: Orion Master is a native Android port of 1oom, the GPLv2 reimplementation of Master of Orion (1993). This app is the engine and a touch-friendly shell only. It does not include, download, or redistribute the original game's LBX data files. It cannot run without a legally owned Master of Orion v1.3 LBX set, which is proprietary. On first launch, tap Choose LBX folder. The system folder picker opens. Pick the folder that contains fonts.lbx. A complete v1.3 set also needs V11.LBX (the 1.3 patch). The app copies the files into its private storage. The classic 1993 interface is drawn letterboxed in landscape. Taps are mapped to mouse clicks. Extra on-screen controls appear for long lists, and the Android keyboard is shown when the game asks for text. The app is offline. It has no internet permission, no ads, and no analytics. This build is intended for F-Droid. It is not published on Google Play, because the APK cannot run as a complete game without user-supplied data. Source: the 1oom engine remains in the upstream src/ tree. Android-specific code lives under app/.

name: Freebloks
short: Strategy board game similar to the famous board game Blokus
description: This is the Android version of Freebloks 3D, an implementation of the famous board game Blokus. Try to place as many tiles on the board as possible, keeping in mind only two simple rules: your tiles must touch a corner of one of your previously placed tiles, but they must not share an edge. Can you play more tiles than your opponents? RULES Each player has 21 Tetris-like tiles: 12 tiles with 5 squares, 5 tiles with 4 squares, 2 tiles with 3 squares, 1 tile with 2 squares and 1 tile with 1 square. Players take turns in placing one tile onto the 20x20 board. The first tile for each player has to be placed in their corner of the board. Each following tile has to touch a corner of one of your previous tiles, but it must never share an edge. It may share edges with the opponents' tiles though. If a player has no more possible move, they have to pass. The game is over when no player can place a tile. For each player, the squares of all their tiles on the board are added up. The player with the most points wins. HOW TO PLAY - Swipe the list of available tiles with your finger. - Select and drag a tile onto the board. - Rotate or flip the tile using the 4 handles. - Place the tile in the desired position. The tile will appear green if the position is valid, and red otherwise. Possible corners are highlighted on the board for convenience. - Tap the tile in a valid position to place it. - You can rotate the board at any time to see the opponents' tiles. Quit the app at any time, your current game will be saved and restored on next start. FEATURES - Supports 2-player modes, with 2 colors (Original, Blokus Duo and Blokus Junior), 4 colors (2 each), - Customizable board sizes other than 20x20, - Play against the computer or humans on the same device, - Play online against your friends, - Play with friends via Bluetooth, - Hint and undo options, - Looks great on tablets, too! The game is network-compatible with Freebloks 3D for Windows and Linux: http://www.saschahlusiak.de/freebloks-3d/ PLEASE DONATE Freebloks 3D is absolutely free, open source and without advertisement! But free things are not worthless. You can decide how much Freebloks means to you by donating, or buying Freebloks VIP: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.saschahlusiak.freebloksvip The complete source code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/shlusiak/Freebloks-Android If you have any idea, feature request or wish concerning the game, just drop me an email: apps@saschahlusiak.de

name: Forkyz
short: Crossword puzzles application, download and play.
description: Forkyz is an unofficial fork of the Shortyz crossword puzzles app with several new features and compatible with recent Android versions. A variety of crossword puzzle types can be imported from files or downloaded and played. Imports support a variety of file formats, including AcrossLite (.puz), JPZ, and IPuz. A list of links to online puzzle creators is given. Puzzles can also be downloaded directly using the built-in downloaders.

name: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
short: A roguelike dungeon crawler RPG that's simple to get into but hard to master!
description: Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a traditional roguelike dungeon crawler RPG that's simple to get into but hard to master! Every game is a unique challenge, with six different heroes, randomized levels and enemies, and hundreds of items to collect and use. ShatteredPD is also updated with new content roughly every three months, so there's always something new. Choose Your Hero Each of ShatteredPD's six playable heroes has their own unique mechanics and gameplay style. Cut down foes as the durable Warrior or deadly Duelist, fry your enemies as the arcane Mage or divine Cleric, or use terrain to your advantage as the stealthy Rogue or the markswoman Huntress! As you progress through the dungeon you'll earn points to spend on talents, choose a subclass, and gain powerful lategame abilities. You can turn the Duelist into a dual-wielding Champion, the Cleric into a righteous Paladin, the Huntress into a precise Sniper, or explore loads of other possibilities! Explore the Dungeon ShatteredPD's dungeon is procedurally generated with random layouts, room types, items, traps, and enemies. In each game you'll find equipment and collect or craft consumable items to power you up or help you out in a pinch. There is a huge variety to what you might see from run to run and region to region. As you progress through the dungeon you'll find equipment that can be enchanted, upgraded, and augmented as you outfit your hero. Set foes ablaze with an enchanted weapon, wade through enemies with upgraded armor, or gain powerful damage, defensive, or utility benefits from one of the many magical wands, rings, artifacts, or trinkets. Succeed or Die Trying The Dungeon is filled with enemies, traps, hazards, and bosses intent on ending your run! Battle hostile wildlife in the sewers and caves, mad thieves and guards in the prison, occult servants in the fallen dwarven city, and maybe something even worse further down... All these hazards can make the game quite tough, but don't be discouraged! You probably won't win on your first try, but there are many tricks and strategies to discover and learn on the path to getting your first win. Afterward, there are optional challenges and achivements if you want to put your skills to the test! Over A Decade in the Making Shattered Pixel Dungeon is an open source game based on the source code of Pixel Dungeon by Watabou (first released in late 2012). It started in 2014 as a project to rebalance Pixel Dungeon but has steadily grown into its own game ov

name: Hue Spill
short: Fill the entire board with a single color.
description: A simple, relaxing, yet incredibly challenging puzzle game. Features - Endless Levels: The game gets progressively harder as you play. The board gets bigger, more colors are added, and you have fewer moves to spare! - Random Puzzles: Just want a quick challenge? Play a random puzzle on Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty. - Undo Move: Made a mistake? Use the undo button to go back a step. - Auto-Save: Your progress is automatically saved, so you can pick up exactly where you left off. - Privacy First: 100% ad-free, absolutely no trackers, and fully GDPR compliant. Play in total peace!

name: Queens
short: Challenging crown-placement logic puzzle. Infinite levels. No tracking & ads.
description: Queens is a challenging crown-placement logic puzzle game where you place queens on a grid of colored regions. How to play: - Place exactly one queen in each row. - Place exactly one queen in each column. - Place exactly one queen in each colored region. - Queens cannot touch each other, even diagonally (no adjacent placements). Why you'll love it: 🚫 NO ADS, EVER No banners. No interstitials. No rewarded videos. Just pure, uninterrupted gameplay. 📊 ZERO TRACKERS No analytics. No data collection. No tracking of any kind. Your gameplay is yours alone. ♾️ INFINITE LEVELS Procedurally generated random puzzle sizes from 5x5 up to 9x9, plus 150+ structured progression levels that scale all the way up to a massive 16x16 grid. 🔒 COMPLETELY OFFLINE No internet permission required. Your progress is saved locally using high-performance Hive persistence. Play anywhere, anytime.

name: TacticMaster
short: Chess tactic trainer based on https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles.
description: Tactic Trainer Tactic Trainer is an advanced chess training application designed to help players of all levels improve their tactical skills.
