With a comprehensive set of features, Tactic Trainer offers an engaging and effective way to practice and master chess tactics. Key Features: Interactive Chessboard: The app features an interactive chessboard that allows users to solve puzzles and practice moves directly on the board. Extensive Puzzle Library: Access a vast library (100k puzzles) of chess puzzles ranging from 1600 to 3000 levels. Each puzzle is designed to challenge and improve your tactical thinking. Puzzle Categories: Puzzles are categorized by themes such as openings, middlegame tactics, and endgames. Detailed Puzzle Information: Each puzzle comes with detailed information, including the position, moves, rating, and tags, providing context and helping users understand the tactical themes. Performance Tracking: Track your progress with detailed statistics and performance metrics. See how you improve over time and identify areas that need more practice. User-Friendly Interface: The app features a clean and intuitive interface, making it easy to navigate and use for players of all ages. Offline Access: Puzzles can be practiced offline, ensuring you can train your tactics anytime, anywhere. Regular Updates: The app is regularly updated with new puzzles and features, ensuring a fresh and engaging experience. Whether you are a beginner looking to learn the basics or an advanced player aiming to sharpen your skills, Tactic Trainer provides the tools and resources you need to become a better chess player. Download Tactic Trainer today and start your journey to mastering chess tactics!

name: Easter Eggs
short: Collections the Android release Easter Egg.
description: Collections the Android release Easter Egg. This project contains the complete code for all Android Easter eggs, aiming to organize and ensure compatibility with all Android Easter eggs. The goal is to enable most devices to experience different versions of the Easter eggs with minimal modifications to the Easter egg's code. GitHub： https://github.com/hushenghao/AndroidEasterEggs System source code: https://cs.android.com/android/platform/superproject/main

name: Cards With Cats
short: Play Hearts, Spades, and duplicate bridge with cat opponents and partners
description: Play card games with friendly cats including Hearts, Spades, Oh Hell, and duplicate bridge. In Hearts, pass your bad cards to opponents and avoid taking hearts and the queen of spades. In Spades, bid on how many tricks you can take, then work with your partner to make your bid and prevent your opponents from making theirs. In Oh Hell, decide how many tricks you'll take and take that amount exactly. In bridge, play a duplicate teams match of 1 to 8 rounds, scored by IMPs.

name: ScoreHub - Game Score Tracker
short: Track your board game scores easily
description: ScoreHub is a simple and intuitive application for tracking game scores across multiple players. Features: • Multi-game support • Player management with custom colors • Comprehensive statistics and rankings • Top 20 high scores leaderboard • Win/loss/draw tracking • Multi-language support • Fully offline Perfect for board game enthusiasts who want to keep detailed records of their gaming sessions! Currently supported games: - Akropolis - Cactus - Cribbage - Escoba - Farkle - Flip7 - Harmonies - Ligretto - Oh Hell - Qwixx - Skyjo - Tarot - Ticket to ride - Wingspan - Yahtzee - Free Game

name: Einstein's Riddle
short: Einstein's Riddle (also known as the Zebra Puzzle)
description: FEATURES: - 100% Privacy: Fully offline play. No data collection, tracking, or network requests required. - Completely Ad-free: No ads, no interruptions. - No Trackers: Zero analytics, zero telemetries, zero third-party SDKs. - Infinite Levels: Unlimited dynamically generated logic puzzles with guaranteed unique solutions. Daily Challenge is same for everyone.

name: Triple Match
short: A minimal, open-source 3D tile-matching puzzle game.
description: Triple Match is a minimal, open-source 3D tile-matching puzzle game. Privacy-First: Triple Match is designed to respect user privacy unconditionally. It collects no data, contains no trackers, and works 100% offline. - No Telemetry or Tracking: Zero analytics, crash reporters, tracking SDKs, or device identifiers. - No Accounts or Sign-ins: No account creation, email capture, or profile requirement. Just open and play. - 100% Offline Play: Operates entirely on-device without internet access. No server dependencies. - Zero Ads: No ad networks, tracking beacons, or cross-site fingerprinting scripts. - Local-Only Storage: Game progress and settings are stored locally on your device. Data never leaves your hardware. - Transparent and Open Source: Clean, inspectable codebase with minimal dependencies. No hidden data collection routines.

name: werewolves_game
short: Multiplayer server for Mafia party game Werewolves. Plays in webbrowser on WiFi.
description: werewolves_game will run a werewolves_game site right on your device where other players on the same WIFI can connect (no internet needed). The App will give you the webaddress (http, not https) were the game is running. First person to join the game site (code: "W") will be administrator and control the game settings (which roles to include, timers, etc.) Best of all, the app acts as the automated game engine, meaning no human Narrator is needed . Everyone gets to play! How to Install and Play: Download apk, it is only for arm64 v8a devices (see Github for linux x86 and arm v7 versions). Apk will ask if you are sure to install, say Yes (game information and all source code is here in repository and apk is automatically built on Github by github-actions). When running the apk for the first time it will ask if it is okay to run in background while using, say Yes (or else werewolves_game server will not respond when in background). You can choose any port, default is 5000 (recommend >= 5000). Apk server will give you game the webaddress and QR code, for example http://192.168.1.5:5000, type or copy and paste that into a webbrowser. First person to join the game lobby will be administrator, initial password is "w" OR Admin can use Initial Admin Code "BLM". You need at least 4 players (7+ is best) to enable "Start Game" button. Once started, the game secretly assigns roles and automatically cycles through "Night" and "Day" phases, handling all the complex death, voting, and win logic for you. I recommend disable timers the first time playing and have administrator Advance Phase manually. Enjoy! Core Features: Automated Game Loop: The server handles all phases, night actions, and win checks (Villagers win, Wolves win, or Solo wins). 📱 Pass-and-Play Mode: Only have one device? Play by passing a single phone around the room with a secure UI that guides players to confirm their identity before viewing their secret role. 👻 Ghost Mode: Keep eliminated players engaged! Ghosts have a small chance to participate during the accusation and lynch voting phases. 🎭 24 Unique Roles: Play with complex roles like the Alpha Werewolf, Prostitute, Lawyer, and Serial Killer. 🏆 Solo Win Conditions: Neutral roles like the Monster, Fool, or Demented Villager can win the game alone, ignoring traditional team allegiances. 🌍 Multiple Languages: Play a single game with the UI translated into multiple languages simultaneously. Robust Admin Controls: The lobby admin can adjust timer d

name: 500 - Multiplayer card game
short: Play 500, the Australian trick-taking card game — bots or friends online.
description: 500 is the classic trick-taking card game of Australia and New Zealand. Outbid the other side, call trumps, and steer your partnership to 500 points — with the Joker, both bowers, and the ever-tempting Misère along the way. New to 500? The interactive tutorial deals you a real hand and coaches you through every bid, discard and trick — the fastest way to learn the game that keeps families arguing (fondly) for generations. Features: * Full Australian rules: a 43-card deck with the Joker, both bowers, a 3-card kitty, bidding from 6 to 10 tricks across the suits and no-trumps, plus Misère and Open Misère. * Play offline against capable AI opponents — no account, no network required. * Play online with friends: create or join a room with a short code, with cross-play between Android and the web. Any empty seats fill with bots, and if someone drops out a bot plays their hand until they rejoin. No account needed, and you can point the app at your own server. * Four ways to play: the classic 4-player partnership game, 2-player head-to-head, or 6 players as two teams of three or three teams of two. * Interactive tutorial that teaches by playing, not by reading. * House rules: switch Misère or no-trumps bidding off to match how your table plays. * Learn to count cards: hold each finished trick on the table for as long as you like, and slow down or speed up the pace to taste. * A proper score sheet: every hand's contract and points, tallied at game end. * First side to 500 points wins. This app is free and open source. Source code at https://github.com/rotundtapir/500

name: Astro Loop
short: Open-source roguelike shooter. Simple to play, no ads, no tracking, offline.
description: A roguelike shooter caught in a loop you were never meant to escape. Signal acquired. One ship, one pilot, and a crew waiting to be recruited. Fly out into the dark, survive endless waves of asteroids and enemies, and see how far you get before the difficulty catches up with you. Every run you pick fresh weapons and upgrades. Recruit a crew of pilots, unlock a fleet of ships, and spend your salvage in the black market between runs. And somewhere in all of it, a story hides in plain sight. Simple to play. Steer with a single finger, and your guns fire on their own. Easy to pick up, hard to put down. Built with respect for you and your phone: * Open source. No black boxes. The whole game is open under GPLv3. * Free forever. No price, no in-app purchases, no pay-to-win. * No ads, no tracking. Zero internet permission. It collects nothing, so not one byte ever leaves your phone. * No sensitive permissions. No camera, mic, location, contacts, files or network. * Plays offline. Works with no signal at all. * No accounts. No sign-up, no login, no email. Open it and play. No game engine: everything is drawn as vectors on a Canvas in pure Kotlin.

name: The Last Carrot
short: A cheerful tower defence game with no ads, no trackers and no permissions
description: Hungry critters are marching down the garden path, and there is only one carrot left. Build towers, upgrade them, and hold the line. The Last Carrot is a small, self-contained lane tower defence game. It asks for no permissions at all, has no ads, no trackers, no analytics and no network access whatsoever. Everything it needs is in the app. Eight towers * Arrow - fast single target damage * Ice - a hard slow on one target at a time * Bomb - splash damage for tightly packed groups * Moon - a wide, gentle slow that catches whole groups at once * Poison - damage over time that ignores armour completely * Rocket - flies in a straight line and pierces everything on it * Tesla - chain lightning that jumps between nearby enemies * Sun - pulses damage in a ring all around itself Every tower upgrades three times, can be sold back for 65% of what you spent, and can be told which enemy to prefer: first along the path, strongest, or nearest. Five kinds of enemy Ordinary thieves, fragile sprinters, huge swarms, armoured ironhides that shrug off direct damage, and garden overlords that take a serious bite out of your carrot if they get through. Twenty levels across five chapters Garden Patch, Golden Fields, Night Woods, Frost Plains and Ember Crater — each chapter has its own palette, its own map layouts and its own new problem to solve. Pick a chapter, then follow a winding trail of levels, with your star rating on every stop you have already cleared. Towers unlock as you go rather than all at once, and each one arrives just before the enemy it answers: ice before the sprinters, bombs before the swarms, poison before the armoured units, chain lightning before the big waves. Each level is scored one to three stars based on how much carrot you have left. Breakable obstacles Rocks, trees, mushrooms, ice blocks and crates sit around the map. Tap one to mark it and your towers will chip away at it whenever no enemy is in range, so clearing never costs you a leak. Breaking one pays gold and frees the tile to build on. Crates take the longest and pay the most. Sun, Moon and Rocket damage obstacles on their own, without being told. Also included * Speed control - play at 1x, 2x or 3x * Call waves early for bonus gold * Drag to position a tower and see its range before you commit * Automatic save, so you can put it down mid-wave and come back later * Interface in English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese, switchable in game Free software, all the way down Released und

name: Guandan 掼蛋
short: Guandan card game for four players over local Wi-Fi. No server, no account.
description: Please note: the interface is currently available in Chinese only. An English translation is planned for a future release. Guandan (掼蛋) is a Chinese climbing card game for four players in two partnerships, played with two decks. Teams start at level 2 and work their way up to Ace, and the red hearts of the current level are wild — they can stand in for any card. Everything runs on your local Wi-Fi. There is no server, no account, no sign-up and no internet connection: devices find each other over mDNS and talk directly to one another over TCP. Nothing about your game leaves the room. Features * Four players in two teams, partners sitting opposite each other * A full match, not a single deal — both teams climb from level 2 to Ace, and a team wins only by taking first and second place together at Ace * The current level's red hearts are wild and can stand in for any card * Cross-platform: Android, iPhone and iPad players can share one table, and either platform can host * Bots fill any empty seat, so you can start a game on a single device * Drop out and a bot covers your seat, then hands it back the moment you rejoin — the host also keeps the table alive in the background, and clients reconnect on their own * A hint button when you are not sure what to play * Five colour themes, including a light mode, remembered between sessions All devices need to be on the same Wi-Fi network. Tribute (进贡) is not implemented.

name: SudoQ
short: Play many sudoku types, with many assistances, all offline.
description: Play many sudoku types such as 16x16, squiggly or Samurai. There are many assistances available, like back and forth, solve specific field ore back to last correct status. Also, every state of the game is recorded in the history. Also offers gesture input (draw number on the screen).

name: Chip Defense
short: A tower defense game with a microprocessor theme
description: Chip Defense is a casual game for Android devices of the tower defense genre. It centres around a design of electric circuits and logical chips, evoking the good ol' days of 8 bit micro-processors. The attackers in this game are represented as bits and bytes. To defend the cpu against them, the player builds chips in designated slots. These "towers" deal damage by operations such as subtraction, right shift, bitwise and, etc. As usual in these games, the chips can be upgraded in strength. The game features "heroes of the information age": persons that had great influence on the development of modern computers. They come with a short biography und provide global bonuses that make the game considerably easier. Currently, there are more than 25 heroes and heroines. The game comes with 32 predefined levels, but it has also an "endless" mode with randomly generated levels. Supported languages are English, French, and German. Supported operating system versions: From version 1.58 onwards, Android 6 or later is required. Devices running Android 5 (i.e. more than 10 years old) should use version 1.57.

name: Gauguin
short: A Sudoku-like logic game
description: Gauguin is a Sudoku-like game where you solve grids via calculation and logic. You can use it to relax or to solve difficult grids to your opinion. In classic mode, you solve a 9x9 grid by typing a value from 1 to 9 in each cell such as - Each row and column contains each digit exactly once. - Each cage meets its given mathematical problem. E.g. a group of cells labeled with '5+' must be filled such that the sum of all digits is 5. Via game options, you may alter the game to solve other digits, smaller or greater grids, hiding the operators. Slick and modern UI - No switching of 'pencil mode' or such thing is needed: To set a value of a cell, just use short-tap to alter a possible value and long-tap for a known value. - 'Fast Finishing Mode' enables to fill cell with exactly one pencil mark rapidly. To be activated in the preferences. - Uses colors from the painting 'The Siesta' from Paul Gauguin (guess where the app's name comes from…) Game options - grid sizes: 3x3 to 11x11 with classic 9x9 - includes rectangular grids, e.g. 7x9 - operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide) - digits (1 to n, prime numbers, Fibonacci sequence etc.) - difficulty (covering a increasing number of game variants) - usage of single cells - show or hide operators Things still to be done - not all grid variants get calculated in a reasonable time - on-boarding is missing a tutorial - not all game variants have been supplied with difficulty ratings yet - calculation of next grid is not bullet proof in some rare circumstances

name: Brick Blast
short: Turn-based brick breaker: aim, shoot, bounce and clear the bricks.
description: Brick Blast is a fast, offline brick-breaker built with Jetpack Compose. Drag to aim, release to launch a stream of balls, and bounce them off the walls to smash the descending bricks before they reach the bottom. Each round the bricks move down and a new row appears, so plan your angles carefully. Features: * Turn-based aim-and-shoot gameplay with a trajectory preview * Custom physics with realistic bouncing and a smooth 60 FPS game loop * Collectable extra balls that grow your arsenal every round * Power-ups: bomb, laser, multi-ball and double damage * Multiple modes: Classic, Challenge, Time Attack and Hardcore * Separate save slots per mode with full board restore on continue * English and Persian (Farsi) UI with Vazirmatn typography * Particle effects and satisfying brick-destruction animations * Light and dark themes * High-score tracking and statistics * Share your score as an image * Completely offline - no ads, no tracking, no internet permission Break. Bounce. Blast.

name: Boardgame Pal
short: Dice, score counter, starting-player draw & more – 100% free and ad-free!
description: Your trusty companion for every game night – simple, ad-free, free! Sound familiar? You want to start game night, but you don't have the right die, there's an argument about who goes first, and keeping score on paper is a hassle? Boardgame Pal solves all of these problems in a single, minimalist app. No registration, no loading times, no frills. Just open the app and start playing right away! The tools at a glance: * Randomly draw a starting player and turn order: Who goes first? Let the app decide instantly and completely fairly for you. * Smart team split: Need multiple teams? Split the group into evenly sized, fair teams in seconds. * Flexible dice cup: No dice on hand right now? Roll with a standard D6 or adjust the number of sides (D4, D8, D10, D12, D20) to perfectly fit your game. * Simple coin toss: Dice are too much hassle? For a simple yes/no decision, the coin toss is the right tool. * Random letter: Need a reliable way to pick a letter for a game of Scattergories? No problem with the built-in random letter tool, including a handover to the hourglass. * Digital scoreboard: Forgot the score pad again or don't have a pen handy? The simple scoreboard makes it easy to track numeric values for multiple players, and a total score across multiple rounds is also possible. * Life points counter: Missing the counter for your dungeon crawler? Far easier than a paper score pad, it keeps track of life points – or any other kind of points – for several players at once. * Classic countdown: Missing the hourglass again? The digital hourglass, built in and easy to use. Why Boardgame Pal? * 100% Ad-Free: No annoying banner ads, no video interruptions. * Completely Free: No in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no hidden costs. All features are fully available right away. * Minimalist & Battery-Friendly: A clean, clear design that's intuitive to use and easy on your phone's battery, even during long game nights. * Privacy First: The app doesn't request unnecessary permissions and doesn't collect any personal data.

name: Dart Checker
short: Dart scoreboard/counter for physical dart matches
description: Dart Checker takes care of your score, while you are playing darts alone or with friends. Its the better form of a scoreboard. No manual calculating is needed anymore. Just put in your hits, like you would tell or sum up three dart and put in that score. Games * single X01 (301, 501) * SET/LEG (play like the pros) * FREE training mode (variable score) * (CRAZY) CRICKET (CUT THROAT) * ELIMINATION * HALVE IT (Random / Crazy) * AROUND THE CLOCK Features * 1-8 player (except SET/LEG mode) * master, double and single out * master, double and single in * checkout suggestions (all reasonably possible) * unlimited undo in a row of wrong inputs * statistics (about as many matches and player as you like) including possibility to export and import * two input variants (dart by dart or total score of three darts) * random game selection and random player order * power saving dark theme or light one * language: german / english / spanish / french * offline - absolutely no internet connection is needed or used, beside app download ;-)

name: I Keep Having This Dream
short: Build a path of tiles to escape each cycle of a dangerous recurring dream
description: In this strategy-roguelike, build a path of tiles to escape each successive cycle of your dreamscape. A cycle grows more dangerous the longer you stay, so plan your route carefully and make the most of the challenges and opportunities you meet along the way. Place tiles to boost your attack and defence, defeat enemies to level up, and choose the right perks to stay safe as your ever-present pursuer grows stronger. Take a detour off the direct path to find items that give you an edge, but beware the powerful special enemies that grow more frequent as you near the exit; left untended, their abilities will quickly spell your doom. Features: * 25+ upgradeable perks to augment and focus your strategy * 150+ items to collect and boost your stats * 100+ special enemies to encounter and overcome * 80+ one-off events for a temporary boost * 50 achievements to earn * Unlock more enemies, events, and cosmetics across playthroughs

name: auth's RNG
short: roll for rarities, sell them, buy upgrades. an incremental RNG game.
description: auth's RNG is a web-based incremental RNG game. roll for rarities, sell them out, buy upgrades, wish upon the wishing well, and collect as many rarities as possible! roll > sell > upgrade > unlock deeper systems > repeat! this is the official android client, featuring: - offline caching so the game loads without an internet connection - a dedicated offline mode screen when you're fully disconnected - haptic feedback on rolls - performance improvements baked into the app layer - a privacy-respecting build of the game (no third-party scripts) inspired by roblox RNG games like sol's RNG and juke's RNG, but to be clear, this is not a roblox game! disgustingly customizable. new customization features ship every update. check out the wiki for how to play and how everything works: https://github.com/authsrng-game/auths-RNG/wiki

name: Wortmühle
short: Daily German word puzzle — 9 letters, one pangram, fully offline
description: Wortmühle ("word mill") is a daily German word puzzle: build as many German words as you can from the nine letters on the 3×3 mill board. Every word must use the center letter, and every puzzle contains at least one pangram — a word using all nine letters. Features: • One new puzzle every day, with the last seven days replayable • 2500 puzzles built in — one a day for almost seven years, fully offline • Scoring based on German Scrabble letter values, with a pangram bonus • Tap a found word for its definition — bundled, no network needed • Light/dark mode selectable (follows the system otherwise) • No permissions, no tracking, no ads, no accounts, no Google services The app requests no permissions at all and never touches the network. The definitions ship with it: they come from de.wiktionary.org, are licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 and are shortened to the first two senses. Each definition carries a link to its Wiktionary page — tapping it opens your browser. Note: the game and its vocabulary are entirely in German. The word list is derived from free sources (igerman98 word list, de.wiktionary, OpenSubtitles frequency data).

name: Doors of Doom
short: Adventure into the dungeon of infinite doors! Behind each, a monster awaits!
description: A simple RPG where you open doors and fight the monsters behind! They drop loot, you get stronger! You know the drill! Over 27 monsters, 64 items, crafts and stuff! Sounds by: Juhani Junkala https://juhanijunkala.com/ Game Music by: RandomMind https://www.youtube.com/@randommynd Win Music by: Vincent Fasano https://www.vincentfasano.com/

name: Principia
short: Physics-based sandbox building game
description: Principia is a physics-based sandbox building game. Build and play advanced contraptions, circuiting, minigames, robot adventures and more. The sandbox contains 200+ different objects ranging from basic wooden building blocks to circuitry, electrical and mechanical components, small robots you can control and fight against, and a LuaScript object featuring Lua scripting that can interact with the world. Build a controllable car, a calculator or make your own game with circuitry or in Lua. The Principia community site contains tens of thousands of creative levels made by players like you, from impressive contraptions to amusing games all for you to browse through and play. If something really peaks your interest, open the level in the sandbox to see how it ticks. What will you create in the sandbox? Principia started out as a paid proprietary game developed during 2013-2014 before being abandoned due to financial issues. Now the game is an open source project since 2022 developed by the same community who fell in love with it back in the day, free for anyone to play well into the future. In addition to being available on Android, Principia is also available on Linux, Windows as well as experimental ports to other platforms. (By default Principia makes connections to the main community site at principia-web.se. You can change or disable this by creating a file called community_host.txt in the app's scoped storage containing a domain name. If you have the main community site disabled you can still play levels by going via your web browser.)

name: Backgammon Clock
short: A flexible two-player backgammon match clock and scorekeeper.
description: A backgammon clock and scorekeeper for two players sharing one phone between them. The app asks for no permissions at all. There is no network access, no analytics, no accounts, no ads, and nothing to configure before you can use it. The whole clock is a single HTML file inside the app. Features - Large area with the remaining total time/delay time for this move. Tap on your half to end your turn and start your opponent's clock. - Set the number of points to play for (1, 3, 5, 7, …, 29). - Set the reserve time per point (e.g. 2 minutes or 3 minutes), in 15-second increments. - Set the delay (free seconds every turn which don't carry over to the next turn), in 1 second increments. - Choose 1 of 5 colour schemes. - Turn sounds (for the turn change, when the delay runs out, and when the time runs out) on or off. - Pause/play the clocks. - Number of moves for this game and current score (when playing a multi-point match) are always shown. - Once a game is done, click the score icon in the middle to set the score. The clocks stay at their current time. - Adjust the clocks from the score sheet, if necessary. - Press the reset button twice (within 2 seconds, so you can't press it accidentally) to reset the clock and scores and start a new match. - Keeps running in the background, returns to the last known clock timings and scores after a crash or forced quit. - The screen stays awake while you play. Functional design is by Hans de Zwart, partially inspired by the open sourced Chess.com clock. Code is by Claude Opus.

name: Diadem
short: Connect to any Diadem Map
description: 🌠 Diadem Diadem is a next-gen GO Map. Use this app to connect to any Diadem Map covering your area. Features: • Connect to any Diadem Map • Modern UI • Great performance • Easy to use • 100% open-source This app is purely a client, you will connect to a backend hosted by third-parties. They will be responsible for how they collect and store your data. Diadem is free software, licensed under the GNU AGPL-3.0. Source code: https://github.com/ccev/diadem

name: Tutto Counter
short: A simple score counter for the dice game "Tutto".
description: Tutto Counter is the perfect companion for your "Tutto" game nights. With this app, you can easily track and manage the scores for multiple players. Features: * Add or remove any number of players. * Customize player names and colors. * Simple score entry with predefined values (e.g., for a street) and free input. * Game history is saved, so you can always see who got how many points and when. * Random player names from different categories (animals, cities, etc.). The app is completely open source and respects your privacy. License: GPLv3 Source Code: https://gitlab.com/gJsas/tutto-counter

name: Octo8
short: An app for checking current Splatoon 3 map schedules
description: An app for checking all this schedules from Splatoon 3: - Regular Battles - Anarchy Battles (Series/Open) - X Battles - Salmon Run - Splatfest - Challenges This app is not affiliated with Nintendo. All product names, logos, and brands are property of their respective owners.

name: Brogue CE Android
short: Brogue CE Android - a classic dungeon crawling roguelike
description: Brogue CE is the community-maintained edition of Brogue, a single-player dungeon crawling roguelike. Descend into the Dungeons of Doom, retrieve the Amulet of Yendor, and return to the surface. Every run is procedurally generated with rich tactical gameplay, beautiful ASCII-art lighting, and an elegant interface. This is the Android port with native touch controls and a mobile-first inventory and menu system.

name: Dooz
short: A Tic-Tac-Tao clone, a simple pen-and-paper game
description: I created this implementation using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android devices. Features Technical Jetpack Compose Material3 and Dynamic Color Game Variable game board grid size from three-by-three to nine-by-nine (Larger than nine-by-nine is simply ridiculous and unplayable in mobile phones) Variable game ai difficulty (easy, medium, hard) Variations Simple Game The Simple game is the most simple variation of Tic-tac-tao with a three-by-three grid with two players. The player who succeeds in placing three of their marks in horizontal, vertical, or diagonal is the winner. Simple Game AI Currently, in hard mode, AI uses a strategy rather than an AI search algorithm like MinMax. This strategy consists of these steps: Win, Block, Fork, Block Fork, Center Play, Corner Play, and Side Play. In Easy difficulty, AI plays a random empty cell in the grid. In Medium difficulty, AI chooses between Easy difficulty and Hard difficulty for each move based on a 50/50 chance. Strategy's source Flexible Strategy Use in Young Children's Tic-Tac-Toe by Kevin Crowley, Robert S. Siegler

name: Ricochlime
short: Satisfying monster shooter
description: Ricochlime is a game where you attack the advancing monsters with your ricocheting projectiles. The game is made with the Flame game engine and Flutter.

name: Eve Game Tracker
short: Track card game results.
description: Eve Game Tracker is a tracker for card games. (It's a fancy table) You WILL make an issue on github to add YOUR favorite game to the Eve Game Tracker. Currently supported games: Skat, Poker, Durak, Gambio, Uno. You can add custom games in a very intuitive way. Features: * Stat View * Persistent player names and stats * Disable games you don't play * Export and import all data.

name: FaFa Runner
short: Enjoy smooth gameplay, stunning graphics, and endless fun
description: Step into the enchanting world of FaFa Runner: Dawn Legends, where an epic adventure awaits! Developed using Flutter and the Flame engine, this RPG delivers a seamless gaming experience with stunning visual effects. Embark on your journey as a brave adventurer, explore mysterious lands, uncover hidden secrets, and face endless challenges. With rich story-driven quests and diverse character progression systems, every battle offers a unique sense of achievement. Key Features: 1. Dynamic Combat System: Enjoy intuitive controls and fluid action as you take on powerful enemies and formidable bosses. 2. Gorgeous Visuals: Experience vivid graphics and captivating animations, thanks to the powerful Flutter and Flame engine. 3. Rich Quest System: Engage in main quests and side stories, with each adventure offering surprises and challenges. 4. Customizable Character Growth: Tailor your hero with various skills and equipment to build the ultimate warrior. 5. Interactive World Exploration: Discover hidden treasures and secret locations across a fantastical map. Join FaFa Runner: Dawn Legends and create your own legendary tale in this magical world. Download now and begin your epic adventure! Supported languages： 1. English 2. Simplified Chinese

name: Futoshiki
short: A clean, modern Futoshiki logic puzzle game
description: Simple Futoshiki is a clean, modern take on the classic Futoshiki logic puzzle. Fill the grid with numbers so that no digit repeats in any row or column, while satisfying the "greater than" / "less than" inequality constraints between cells. Features: * Three grid sizes (4x4, 5x5, 6x6) with Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty * Smooth, modern Material 3 interface built with Jetpack Compose * Puzzle generator with unique-solution guarantee * Animated ninja vs dragon chase scene powered by KorGE * Custom theming system with 4 color themes and multiple theme modes * Pause and resume with timer and ranking system * No ads, no tracking, no network permissions required 100% free and open source under Apache 2.0.

name: Classic Tic Tac Toe
short: Fun with emoji naughts and crosses
description: Classic Emoji Tic Tac Toe: * Open, Select, Play * Fully offline capability without internet hassle * Classic pastime with friends and family * Quick support and regular updates

name: Planes Android
short: Planes Android is a variant of the Battleships game for Android
description: Position your planes on your game board and guess where the computer has hidden its before it guesses where you have hidden yours. Starting with version 0.4.0 a multiplayer module is available as well. The open-source app is also available for Windows and Linux.

name: MA Alchemist
short: Start with the four basic elements and create anything!
description: Start with the four basic elements and create anything! Inspired by other games from the alchemy genre, but this one is open source.

name: MA Pipes
short: A numberlink-style game
description: A numberlink-style game Connect the colors to fill up the board.

name: MA Solitaire
short: An open source solitaire game
description: An open source solitaire game Supports Klondike, Freecell, and Spider solitaire variants, with more to come.

name: Nian
short: Collection of word games in Swedish
description: Collection of a few different dictionary games, in Swedish. Ad and tracking free and open source.

name: AAAAXY
short: A nonlinear 2D puzzle platformer taking place in impossible spaces.
description: Although your general goal is reaching the surprising end of the game, you are encouraged to set your own goals while playing. Exploration will be rewarded, and secrets await you! So jump and run around, and enjoy losing your sense of orientation in this World of Wicked Weirdness. Find out what Van Vlijmen will make you do. Pick a path, get inside a Klein Bottle, recognize some memes, and by all means: don't look up. And beware of a minor amount of trolling. To reach the end, a new player will take about 4 to 6 hours, a full playthrough can be finished in about 1 hour and the end can be reached in about 15 minutes. This game is licensed under the Apache 2.0 License. It is written in Go, using the Ebitengine game library. More info, source code and versions for Windows, Linux and macOS are available at https://divVerent.github.io/aaaaxy/

name: Tubester
short: Scan Hitster cards and play their songs on YouTube
description: Tubester lets you play the Hitster music board game using YouTube instead of a Spotify subscription. Point it at the QR code on a card and it opens the matching song in an external player of your choice, such as NewPipe or the YouTube app. A Hitster QR code contains only the card's identity, not the song. Tubester reads the language and card number, looks the card up in the community "songseeker-hitster-playlists" dataset to find the exact track, and hands the YouTube link to your external player. To keep the round fair, Tubester shows a "turn the phone upside down" hint and a short countdown before playback starts, because the external player displays the video title. The answer (year, title and artist) stays hidden behind a Reveal button. For a fully spoiler-free experience, set NewPipe to open links in the background so no title is ever shown. Features: * Scans Hitster QR cards with a fast, on-device, fully open-source scanner. * Plays songs through an external player (NewPipe recommended, or YouTube). * Spoiler-safe game flow with a flip-the-phone hint and hidden answer. * Supports many sets and expansions via the community mapping dataset. * Caches mapping data on device. Privacy: no accounts, no ads, and no analytics or tracking. Tubester needs only the Camera permission (to scan) and Internet (to fetch mappings and open links). Note: Tubester is not affiliated with Hitster or its publishers, Spotify, Google or YouTube. It relies on YouTube, a non-free network service.

name: Subster
short: Music timeline party game that plays songs from your own Subsonic library
description: Subster is a pass-and-play music party game for your own music collection. A mystery song plays blind — no title, no artist, no year. Your job: place it on your timeline by guessing whether it came out before or after the songs you already hold. Guess right and you keep the card. First to 10 cards wins. It works like the card game Hitster, but with no physical cards, no accounts, and no backend: the app talks directly to your Subsonic-compatible music server (Navidrome, Airsonic, Gonic, …). Features Plays your music — connects to any Subsonic-compatible server Save several servers and switch between them; each remembers its own library and playlist Smart deck building: songs are ranked by real-world recognizability (Deezer popularity + a bundled canon of chart hits), so the deck feels fair instead of obscure Original release years via MusicBrainz and Wikidata — a remaster from 2015 still counts as its original year Tokens: skip a song, bet against another player's placement and steal the card, or earn a bonus for naming title and artist Difficulty presets, year range and genre filters, clip length options Keeps playing with the screen off (lock-screen media controls) English and German UI Privacy No accounts, no ads, no analytics. To rank songs and resolve years, only artist/title of library songs are sent to the public Deezer, MusicBrainz and Wikidata APIs — nothing about you or your server. The "Online metadata" setting has three levels: full, "No Deezer" (drops the only proprietary service but keeps MusicBrainz/Wikidata years), and offline, where only your own server is contacted. You need a Subsonic-compatible music server to play. Your server credentials never leave the device, and are stored as a salted token rather than the password itself — except for servers that only accept legacy authentication, where the app tells you that the password has to be kept.

name: MA Chess
short: An open-source chess app.
description: An open-source chess app. Supports local 2-player mode and local AI using stockfish with configurable difficulty

name: MA Unblock Jam
short: A private and open source version of the classic board game "Rush Hour"
description: A private and open source version of the classic board game "Rush Hour" 250 levels for you to play through increasing in difficulty. Try and find the optimal solution for each of them!

name: MA Word Maker
short: A fun word puzzle game, completely private and offline
description: A fun word puzzle game, completely private and offline Over 850 levels with more to come

name: Navy Fleet Battle
short: The classic Russian sea battle game, for one player or two
description: Navy Fleet Battle is an Android version of Морской бой, the sea battle game played on squared paper across Russia for generations. It follows the classic Russian rules exactly, with no variants and nothing to configure. Two ways to play: - Against the computer - Two players, passing one device between them The rules: - A field of 10 by 10 cells, ten ships, twenty cells of fleet - Ships stand in straight lines and may not touch each other, not even at the corners - A hit earns another shot, and the turn passes only on a miss - Sinking a ship marks the water around it automatically, because no ship can stand there Made to be handed to a child: - Large boards and touch targets a small finger cannot miss - Every shot is aimed first and fired second, so a stray tap costs nothing - The outcome of a shot is revealed by its animation and never before it, on both sides of the board - A sinking plays as two beats: the hit lands first, then the hull goes down - The end of a game is shown as a picture as well as in words, so a child who cannot yet read still knows who won - A hand-off screen between turns leads with a large player number, so the device changes hands without anyone reading anything - Sound throughout, with a mute button on every screen that remembers its setting Russian and English, changed with a button in the corner at any moment, including in the middle of a battle. The board is lettered in the alphabet of the language in use: А Б В Г Д Е Ж З И К in Russian, A to J in English. Navy Fleet Battle is free and open source under the MIT licence. Every sound in it is a public domain recording. There are no adverts, no trackers, no accounts and no network access of any kind, and the app asks nothing of the system: no storage, no location, no camera, no microphone.

name: Flowit — Block Puzzle
short: Fill all boxes with the color of their border
description: Easy to learn, hard to master. Play the addicting puzzle game Flowit now and to think outside the box. There are already over 100 levels available and even more to come. The game features a clean and elegant design - you will be amazed by the simplicity and complexity at the same time. Fill all boxes with the color of their border by using the special boxes. Those, for example, fill surrounding boxes in only one direction with their color. Discover various types of special boxes in the provided level packs. Have fun!

name: Free Klondike
short: A unique solitaire game combining FreeCell and Klondike with strategic gameplay.
description: Free Klondike is a unique solitaire game that combines the best elements of FreeCell and classic Klondike Solitaire. Created by Matt Stephen and developed by a dedicated team, this game offers a fresh twist on traditional solitaire gameplay. KEY FEATURES: • 1 or 3 Card Draw modes • Saved Statistics tracking your win rate and streaks • 3 Chooseable Card Backs • 3 Chooseable Backgrounds • Easy to Learn, Easy to Play interface • Helpful Hints for when you're stuck • Undo All Moves back to original layout • Cross-platform compatibility with Java • Celebratory Win Animation with fireworks and inspiring music • Save Game on Exit to continue later • Automatic Update Checks • 3 Difficulty Levels (Easy, Medium, and Hard) • Top 10 Times Scoreboard UNIQUE GAMEPLAY: This innovative game blends features from both FreeCell and traditional Solitaire: FreeCell Similarities: - All cards in columns are always visible - Four individual cells at the top for strategic card placement Solitaire Similarities: - Deck and discard pile for drawing cards - Only Kings can be placed at the top of empty columns - Cards can be removed from Ace piles and returned to the playing field - Multiple cards can be moved in one move (when properly stacked) Exclusive Features: - Four individual cells start with cards already placed - Limited deck passes: twice on draw one, three times on draw three - Compact layout with only four columns (vs 7 in Solitaire, 8 in FreeCell) Free Klondike is published by Velbazhd Software LLC and is licensed under GPL v3.0, meaning you can modify the code in accordance with the license. The game features beautiful card designs from jfitz.com and original graphics by our talented art team. Download Free Klondike today and experience a new dimension of solitaire gaming!

name: L5RCM Companion
short: Play-at-the-table sheet viewer for L5R 4E characters
description: A companion app for L5RCM, the Legend of the Five Rings 4th Edition character manager. It is a play-at-the-table tool for players, not a character builder: advancement and editing are out of scope. It imports a character saved by the desktop L5R Character Manager — either from a '.l5r' file or by scanning the animated multi-frame QR code the desktop app shows — downloads the matching community data packs, and renders a read-only character sheet with every derived value (traits, rings, void, skills, insight, wounds, TN, initiative, XP) computed on the device. Network access is used only to download the community data packs from the project's data-pack repository on GitHub.

name: PySolFC
short: PySolFC is a collection of solitaire card games
description: PySolFC is a collection of solitaire games written in Python. PySolFC is a desktop application that runs on Linux, Windows and Mac. It offers more than 1000 solitaire games such as Patience, Mahjongg, Shishensho, Memory and others and is published on https://pysolfc.sourceforge.io . If you are looking for a desktop version, take a look. The Android app is based on this work and provides a subset of the desktop functions. It is created and published from selected snapshots out of the sources.

name: Simply Scored
short: Track your game scores easily.
description: Track your game scores easily. Keep track of scores quickly and clearly with Simply Scored. Features: - Multiple players and turns support - Editable scores with instant totals - Save and load score sheets (JSON) - Lightweight, offline-first UI Created with flutter. Currently the only tested versions are: Linux, Android, Web.

name: 2048 Open Fun Game
short: 2048 game with AI, Replay, History and other fun features, Open Source, no ads
description: "2048 Open Fun Game" is 2048 game with AI, Bookmarks, Auto Replay, History and other fun features, Open Source, no ads. How to play. Swipe the game board to move all tiles left, right, up, or down. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one with a double number, i.e. 2+2 merge into 4, 4+4 merge into 8 and so on. The goal is to create a tile with the highest number. Number 2048 is a good first win… Features of "2048 Open Fun Game" that are not present in the original game: * Unlimited and animated Undo and Redo. * Retries counter. When you make a move after Undo (no matter if it is the same move as before or another move), number of Retries increases. The counter shows total number of retries done during the game and allows comparing different results more fairly. * Select theme for the app: Device default (for Android 9+), Dark or Light. Dark theme for Android 9+ is turned on by default when system-wide "Dark theme" is turned on in device settings. * Different portrait and landscape screen layouts. Portrait layout is more or less classic for the 2048 game, and landscape layout allows using screen space better and have larger board. * Turn on AI (Artificial Intelligence) mode and let the AI play for you. Increase or decrease AI player speed. Stop it and continue playing yourself. Choose one of several AI algorithms, see how they play and compare them. * Bookmarks at the interesting game positions. Return to a bookmark and play again from that place. * Move number and game duration shown. The time starts when you make a move. It stops when you tap Undo or Pause button. * "Watch" mode. Auto replay current game forward and backwards at any speed, stop at any position. Switch to "Play" mode from that place and continue playing, overriding history. * Recent games with all their moves, bookmarks and scores are stored in a history and can be watched. Or you can play them again from any position / bookmark. * Game menu allows you to delete current game from history, to restart a game ("Try again") or to open recent game from a list. * When you tap "Try again" button or open recent game, current game is automatically saved to the history, so you can review or continue to play it later. * Share a game as a file, so it can be loaded, watched and even played on any other device. * The app is multilingual. Please add new translations at https://crowdin.com/project/2048-open-fun-game For Android v.7.0+ devices.

name: Paper Loop 2
short: Grow your turf and slice other sneks' tails — a free-movement territory game.
description: You are a snek. 🐍 Loop out from your turf, draw a shape, and close it to swallow everything inside — the more ground you claim, the bigger you get. Your tail is your weak spot: slice a rival snek's tail to knock them out, and never let anyone slice yours. There is no grid here — your head carries a real heading and banks into smooth, continuous curves as you steer, so carving a daring arc around a rival and sealing it off feels like drawing, not stepping. The arena is a circle — drift too steeply into the wall and you are gone. Your opponents are neural bots: a small reinforcement-learning network trained by self-play, running entirely on your device. Pick AI HARD to face the trained net, EASY SCRIPTED for a gentler hand-written bot, or NO BOTS to paint in peace. Inference runs off the render thread, so it stays smooth even on modest phones. Features: * Free, continuous movement — smooth curves, not four-direction steps. * On-device neural self-play bots (no network needed) plus a scripted fallback. * Three opponent modes and an optional respawn toggle. * A circular arena with smooth, rounded territories and a clean ribbon trail. * A local high score per mode. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no network access. * Tiny download and fully playable offline. Paper Loop 2 is built with libGDX and is free and open-source software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

name: Plutonic
short: Suika physics-based planet shooter
description: Plutonic is a suika-like / sputnika-like planet combiner with gravity-based physics. Drag and launch planets to combine them into larger celestial bodies. The game ends if a planet hits another planet, and goes out of the field for 2.5 seconds. Try to not touch with force (only collisions)! Features multiple planets from Pluto to ... (Find the last planet(?) yourself!)

name: Battle for Burgers 🍔🍔🍔
short: An Online-Multiplayer game. Collect so much more burgers as you can.
description: This is an Online-Multiplayer game where you will need to collect so much more burgers 🍔🍔🍔 as you can. Here will won the who one, who collect more burgers than others. You have 30 seconds to do that ⏳. The game doesn't need an Anti-Cheat system because it has the architecture that doesn't let anybody to cheat.

name: LunaChron
short: Companion app for the Moonstone tabletop miniatures game
description: Lunachron is a free, open-source companion app for the Moonstone tabletop miniatures game by Goblin King Games. Track everything during a game: • Health pips with chunked groups for fast reading • Energy counters, moonstone tallies, and once-per-turn ability markers • Two layout modes — compact grid for a quick overview, detailed list for full card info • Low-detail mode for players who prefer to track resources physically Build and manage your collection: • Full character compendium with stats, abilities, and faction info • Upgrade card library with search and filtering • Troupe builder with QR code sharing — scan a code to instantly import a friend's roster • Campaign cards reference Play modes: • Solo mode for only tracking a single troupe • Casual local multiplayer over Wi-Fi (no internet or cloud account required) to auto sync troupes • Local tournament bracket management Campaigns: • Track ongoing campaign progress, standings, and game history All game data is bundled with the app and works fully offline. Optional portrait images and data updates can be downloaded from the open data repository — you are always prompted before any download. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no proprietary services required. Source code: https://github.com/Garemat/lunachron Game data: https://github.com/Garemat/lunachron-data

name: Edge Roll
short: Tumble a cube across a crumbling tile bridge. One-thumb 3D arcade.
description: Edge Roll is a minimalist one-thumb arcade game. Swipe to tumble a cube end over end along a narrow bridge of floating tiles suspended over an abyss. Every tile you step off begins to crumble and drops away a second or two later — and that grace period shrinks the higher you climb, so hesitation is fatal. The bridge wanders left and right, splits into branches, and is dotted with gem spurs worth bonus points and gaps that end the run if you roll into them. Score one point for every new tile you reach; gems are worth three. The whole world drifts through the colour spectrum as you progress, and a single misjudged roll sends the cube spinning off into the dark. Features: * One-thumb controls: swipe to roll, tap to roll forward. * A procedurally generated bridge — no two runs are alike. * Tight, tactile feedback with synchronised sound and haptics. * A local high score. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no network access. * Tiny download and fully playable offline. Edge Roll is built with libGDX and is free and open-source software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

name: LCDPet
short: Tiny offline LCD-style virtual pet for Android
description: LCDPet is a tiny offline LCD-style virtual pet for Android. Feed your pet, bathe it, let it nap, take it outside, handle random Wants, and keep an eye on its care status. The app is designed around a simple handheld digital-pet feel with local progress, toy-like interactions, and a low-pressure care loop. Features: * Starter pet templates * Offline/local-first virtual pet * LCD-style toy-inspired interface * Care actions including feed, bathe, nap, walk, potty, pet, and talk * Random Wants and care reminders * Optional Android notifications for local pet care alerts * No ads * No tracking * No internet permission * No gameplay purchases or pay-to-win mechanics LCDPet stores pet data locally on your device. It does not use accounts, analytics, advertising SDKs, trackers, cloud sync, or external servers.

name: Live Wallpaper Dino Game
short: A fully playable, retro Chrome Dino runner game on your home screen.
description: A fully functional, retro-style Chrome Dino runner game implemented as an Android Live Wallpaper. Just press on the dinosaur and the game will start immediately! Features Playable Live Wallpaper: Tap the screen to make the Dino jump and avoid obstacles! Authentic Retro Aesthetics: Features classic monochrome sprites, scrolling clouds, and ground obstacles. Dynamic Theme Engine: Switch between Light, Plain Dark, and Alt Dark modes. The Dark theme features a fully animated night sky with twinkling stars and shooting stars. Smooth Animations: 60 FPS game loop rendering using Android's Canvas APIs. Downshifts CPU/GPU usage by 75% when idle to save battery. Universal Scaling: Hardcoded pixels are gone. Touch hitboxes, sizes, and spacing are percentage-based for a pixel-perfect experience on any device.

name: Phase10Counter
short: Small App to keep track of your Phase10 game! Optimised for Phones and Tablets.
description: Anyone who likes to play Phase 10 probably knows the problem of counting. This simple app will help you keep track of your game. Add a few players and you are ready to go. When a round is over, it can be checked off. The rounds do not have to be checked off in the correct order. Features: - Add as many games as you like, with as many players as you want - Write down the points and edit them afterwards if you made a typo - Mark completed phases - Dark/Light Theme - UI for Phone and Tablet - Keep track of High Scores - Import/Export your data - Phases for Flip and Masters

name: Mobapp Game
short: Minimalist physics arcade: speed, flips, built-in editor
description: A cross-platform minimalist arcade game powered by Emini physics engine. Android, desktop Java, and J2ME are supported. Two game modes: - Endless mode: the track is procedurally generated on the fly, randomly connecting various structures (both built-in and custom). - Levels: completely predefined tracks with obstacles, where the main goal is to reach the finish plate. Built-in editor: The game offers complete creative freedom. You can create your own levels and structure blocks for endless mode. Examples: The editor allows you to open the game's built-in structures and levels - they are highlighted and displayed at the end. Built-in structures can be overridden by naming a custom one with the same name (but don't forget to load the structures from the main menu). Tools: Create tracks of any difficulty by combining various objects and adjusting their length, thickness, and other parameters: - Surfaces: Lines, Circles (arcs with adjustable radius and scaling), and Sinusoids for smooth transitions. - Interactive Platforms: Trampolines with adjustable springiness, deadly "Lava," and "Broken Lines" (slabs that begin to fall when driven over). - Accelerators (can also slow down): Plates that change the engine's power and direction. - Physics Bodies: Round and Square objects. These are fully-fledged physical entities. You can adjust their mass, friction, elasticity, gravity, and color. Make them static (with a fall timer, like the "Broken Line") or turn them into moving "lava"! - Auxiliary elements: Finish, Spawn point for levels and "Link", which copies another element with an offset.

name: Endless Sky
short: Android port of endless-sky space trading game.
description: This is a port of the endless-sky space trading game available at https://endless-sky.github.io/ Explore other star systems. Earn money by trading, carrying passengers, or completing missions. Use your earnings to buy a better ship or to upgrade the weapons and engines on your current one. Blow up pirates. Take sides in a civil war. Or leave human space behind and hope to find some friendly aliens whose culture is more civilized than your own... Endless Sky is a sandbox-style space exploration game similar to Elite, Escape Velocity, or Star Control. You start out as the captain of a tiny space ship and can choose what to do from there. The game includes a major plot line and many minor missions, but you can choose whether you want to play through the plot or strike out on your own as a merchant or bounty hunter or explorer. This port only supports english for now.

name: Paper Loop
short: Grow your turf and slice rival sneks' tails — an offline territory game.
description: You are a snek. 🐍 Slip out of your home turf, trace a path across the grid, and close it back into your own territory to claim everything you enclosed — the more ground you take, the bigger you get. But the trail you leave behind is your weak spot: run over a rival snek's trail to knock them out, and never let anyone touch yours. Movement is clean and grid-based — you step square by square in four directions, and every turn folds the trail like a ribbon of paper. Seal a rival's trail inside one of your captures and they are eliminated on the spot. Corner a bot, close the loop, and watch the whole region flip to your colour. Your opponents are neural bots: a small reinforcement-learning network trained by self-play, running entirely on your device — no network needed. There is also a hand-written scripted bot for a lighter, cleaner challenge. Switch between a light "paper" theme and a dark one from the start screen, and your own colour is drawn fresh every game. Features: * Classic grid-based territory capture — step, draw, and close the loop to claim ground. * On-device neural self-play bots (no network) plus a scripted fallback. * A folded-ribbon trail, smooth "virus" death dissolves, and a live minimap. * Light and dark themes, and a random player colour each game. * A local high score. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no network access. * Tiny download and fully playable offline. Paper Loop is built with libGDX and is free and open-source software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

name: Vector Pinball
short: Pinball game
description: Pinball game with simple vector graphics and seven table layouts, using a physics library for accurate simulation. See the GitHub project page at https://github.com/dozingcat/Vector-Pinball if you'd like to help with coding or designing tables.

name: SuperShopaholic
short: An infinite shopping cart in an infinite mall: a satire on consumerism
description: SuperShopaholic is a tiny game that is really a sociopolitical statement about the pointlessness of consumerism. You steer an infinite shopping cart through an infinite mall, frantically swooping goods off the shelves into a cart that never fills. There is no finish line. There never was. The "rewards" are the joke: you grind to unlock the ability to consume faster, and the prizes are absurd status symbols that, once bought, change nothing. Mechanics: * Grab everything. Emoji products fall down the mall; catch them for cash. * Power-ups are the fantasy. Grab a GOLD card or a rarer BLACK card to shop faster with a 2x / 4x money multiplier. The reward for consuming is the ability to consume harder. * Status symbols. Periodic BUY NOW events offer a Ferrari, Yacht, Mansion or Private Jet. Buy it and it joins your trophy shelf, and then absolutely nothing changes. You keep shopping. * A STATUS meter fills up and, as the game helpfully notes, it doesn't do anything. * No win state. The speed only ever increases. Controls: tap or drag to move the cart. A hardware keyboard works too (left/right or A/D, P to pause). Technical notes: * Fully offline. The app requests no permissions and makes no network connections. The whole game is a single self-contained HTML page bundled in the app and rendered in a WebView (HTML5 canvas, vanilla JavaScript, Web Audio for synthesized sound effects; no audio assets, no tracking, no ads). This game critiques the enclosure of things; its license resists the enclosure of itself. SuperShopaholic is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0-or-later). The AGPL's network clause means anyone who hosts a modified version must also share their source with players. Source is always one click away: https://gitlab.com/jave/supershopaholic

name: RealmScore
short: Score keeper for the Fantasy Realms card game
description: RealmScore is a simple, fast score keeper for the card game Fantasy Realms. Features: - Track scores for 2 to 6 players - Automatic calculation of all bonuses, penalties and wild-card effects - Suspense mode: scores are revealed together at the end of a round - Sandbox for freely experimenting with card combinations - Detailed statistics about players and cards - Fully offline, no ads, no trackers RealmScore is an unofficial fan app and is not affiliated with the publishers of the game.

name: Bluke
short: Use your phone as a Bluetooth mechanical keyboard, gamepad, and trackpad
description: Bluke lets you use your Android phone as a wireless keyboard, mouse trackpad, and game controller. It utilizes your phone's built-in Bluetooth HID profile and acts like how a typical input device would work. No installing server apps or background clients, just pair, connect and it works. Features: * Keyboard mode with real mechanical keyboard feel (Holy Panda, Alpaca, Gateron Black Ink, Cherry MX, Topre, Blue Alps, and more). * Trackpad mode along with numpad to control your devices. * Gamepad mode with customizable layouts and toggles for Xbox and PS5 button styles. * Material You Dynamic Theme, Customizations and much more. Bluke is 100% offline, everything stays local, no tracking, and it is fully open source. Source code can be accessed at: https://github.com/arnav-kr/Bluke

name: Stack Tower 3D
short: Stack sliding blocks into the tallest tower you can. One-tap 3D arcade.
description: There are slides and you click to stack the slides and try to stack them perfectly. Bright colors. Gameplay: * A block slides back and forth above the tower — tap to drop it. * Whatever hangs over the edge is sliced off and tumbles away. Whatever remains is all the next block has to land on. * Miss the tower entirely and the run is over. * Frame perfect: land within one frame of travel of dead centre and the block keeps its full size, and the placement scores double. * The slide speed ramps up as the tower grows, and consecutive frame perfects raise the chime pitch. Stack Tower 3D is free and open-source software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. Built with libGDX.

name: Golden Ticket
short: Lottery simulation game - explore strategies without spending money
description: Golden Ticket is a free and open source lottery simulation game built for experimentation, probability practice, and play. It lets you explore draw-based number strategy without buying tickets or spending money. Key Features: • Simulate draw participation without real-money gambling • Explore number selection strategies through game-style systems • Progress through the prospector, smelter, forge, vault, anvil, and results flow • Track outcomes and scorecards across supported draws • Privacy-focused F-Droid build with no Firebase, analytics, or Google Play services • 100% FOSS gameplay build, with Chen-specific premium access handled outside Play billing How It Works: 1. Choose a supported draw game 2. Prospect for number combinations as ore 3. Refine them through the goldsmith workflow 4. Lock your picks before the draw cutoff 5. Return after results are posted to reveal outcomes and review statistics Educational and Risk-Free: Golden Ticket is designed for testing ideas, learning about odds, and comparing approaches. It does not purchase real tickets, submit entries to any lottery, or award real-world prizes. Privacy First: This F-Droid release removes Firebase, Google Play services, and Play billing. Core gameplay remains available without those platform dependencies.

name: TheXTech
short: 2D-platformer game engine
description: This is a game engine for platforming games. This is a complete and extended port of source code of the SMBX 1.3 game engine originally writtein in MS Visual Basic 6, and its direct unofficial continuation after development of original halted in the 2011th year. This engine preserves full compatibility with levels and episodes made for the original SMBX game, including its repacks. And it's allowed to create brand-new Levels, Episodes, and content packs. Unlike the original SMBX game that depends on Windows and x86, TheXTech can work on many operating systems (including Linux distros, macOS, xBSD, Android, Haiku, etc.) and processor architectures (including x86_64, ARM, PowerPC, MIPS, etc.). **NOTE:** This is a runtime engine only. It requires game packages to be downloaded and unpacked properly. Please follow this instruction in order to get any game work: https://github.com/TheXTech/TheXTech/wiki/Running-game-assets-on-Android

name: Mill
short: A Mill Game which supports many rule variants, written in Flutter
description: A Classic Nine Men's Morris Experience Rediscover the strategy of Nine Men's Morris, also known as the Mill game, with this digital version. Whether you are an experienced player or new to the game, this app offers a way to learn and enjoy this timeless board game. Explore the game's features, which are designed for learning, practice, and customization. You can play the game your way, track your progress, and sharpen your skills with the help of an analysis engine. KEY FEATURES CLASSIC & VARIANT GAMEPLAY Enjoy the experience of this traditional board game. * Multiple Game Modes: Play Classic Nine Men’s Morris, along with variants like Twelve Men’s Morris, Lasker Morris, and the South African variant, Morabaraba. * Capable AI Opponent: Challenge a computer opponent with 30 different difficulty levels, designed to provide a suitable match for players of various skill levels. * Play with a Friend: Challenge a friend locally on a single device, or connect two devices over the same WLAN. CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS Adjust the game to your preferences with a range of settings. * Flexible Rules: You can enable or disable the "flying" endgame rule or toggle other common house rules to match the version you are familiar with. * Visual Themes: Personalize your playing area with a selection of board backgrounds and piece designs. * Custom Color Picker: Adjust the colors of the pieces and the board for better contrast and visibility. * Sound Packs: Choose from different audio themes, for audio feedback during your game. * Dark Mode & Haptics: A dark mode is available for comfortable play in low light. You can also adjust the haptic feedback for moves. TRAINING & ANALYSIS SUITE Improve your gameplay with some helpful tools. * AI-Powered Positional Analysis: Use the AI to get feedback on your game. The engine provides positional evaluations to help you identify opportunities and understand mistakes. * Unlimited Undo/Redo & Move List: You can take back moves to explore different scenarios. A clear, scrollable move list allows you to review the entire game sequence. * Import, Export & Share Games: Share your matches using flexible import and export options. Copy games to and from your clipboard, or use the standard PGN file format. The app can directly open PGN files from your device. You can also share a quick visual by taking a screenshot and adding tactical annotations to the board. TRACK YOUR PROGRESS Monitor your improvement with the statistics module. * Detailed Game Sta

name: Flang
short: A board game similar to chess
description: Flang is a board game similar to chess or shogi but differs in some special rules. If you like chess or other board games, you might want to try this one. The unique thing about flang is the freeze mechanic. Once you move one of your pieces, it cannot be moved in your next turn because it is freezed except for the king. App features: - Play Flang: offline and online - Flang TV: see other people play Flang - Profile: watch played games - Analysis board: reinvestigate your games, optionally with computer hints

name: Roboyard
short: Problem-solving game - find the optimal moves to move one robot to its target
description: An Android-based application like the board game "Ricochet Robots ©". It includes an artificial intelligence capable of solving the puzzles. A simple but challenging puzzle game. You control four robots in a yard full of hedges, that block their way. The goal is to guide a particular robot to its destination. The robots move until they either hit a hedge or another robot. The special feature of this app is the automatic solution finding algorithm, which can show you hints and also the optimal solution. Can you find the solution with the fewest moves? This game is open source and shipped without adds. Source code: https://roboyard.z11.de/ Supported languages: English, German (Deutsch), French (Français), Spanish (Español), Chinese (中文), Korean (한국어), Japanese (日本語) and Portuguese (Português do Brasil) Full accessibility: The game is fully playable for blind players and supports all accessibility features with TalkBack.

name: HyleX (Entropy / Hyle 7)
short: Chaos against Order: An Entropy / Hyle 7 like board game
description: This is an Entropy / Hyle 7 - like board game clone for Android. Play alone or with friends! The original game “Entropy” by Eric Solomon requires two game rounds with a swap of roles in between. With HyleX, you can compete yourself with just one round by choosing a role. You can also play against friends. Note that there is no central game server. You and your opponent must share your moves via regular messaging apps or QR codes. Features: * Single Play: Compete the computer * Multiplayer: play against a remote opponent * Privacy: No central server, no personalised data, no ads, no tracking * It’s FOSS More information at hylex.jepfa.de If you like the app, please star it on GitHub

name: Tessel – A tile game
short: Place tiles with matching colors to make shapes and fill the board.
description: Tessel is a colorful tile placement game. Place tiles with matching colors to make shapes and fill the board. The larger the shape, the higher the points. Features: • Play an easy square game, or choose a more challenging pattern. • Customize your game settings to change the rules. • Create your own tiling patterns in the drawing tool. Choose from a wide range of tiling patterns to form endlessly varied tesselations: • Square • Triangular • Rhombille • Cairo pentagonal • Hexagonal • Deltoidal-trihexagonal • Penrose P3 • Snub square • Ammann-Beenker

name: Block'Buster
short: Simple HTML5 arkanoid-type game
description: Block'Buster is a simple HTML5 arkanoid-type game to spend some free time. Break all the blocks without losing the ball.

name: Pictionary Generator
short: A Pictionary-ish Word Generator
description: A Pictionary-ish Word Generator app so that you can take the game wherever you go. Chose from Easy, Medium or Hard words so its fun for all ages. Includes a stopwatch, so that you can play by your own rules. Though a whiteboard is recommended, Pictionary Generator comes with a simple canvas for you to draw on for when you only have your phone.

name: Impostor MX
short: Classic multiplayer party game, now digital and open source
description: Impostor MX is the digital version of the classic party game everyone loves. Gather your friends, pass the phone around, and discover who's lying in rounds full of laughter and strategic debates. This project was born to offer a completely free, no-compromise, and open-source alternative to traditional party games. What makes Impostor MX special? No Ads: Zero interruptions. Just pure fun. 100% Free: No in-app purchases or hidden subscriptions. Fully Offline: Perfect for trips, meetings without internet, or parties without worrying about data. Customizable: Create your own themed categories and adjust the game rules. Punishment Wheel: An exclusive mechanic that adds more excitement at the end of each round. How to Play: Choose Your Category: Select a themed category or create your own. Set Up the Game: Pass the phone so each player can set their name and PIN. Define how many Impostors there will be, debate time, and punishments. Discover Your Role: Each player enters their PIN privately to reveal a secret word. Everyone will see the word... except the Impostor. The Debate: Ask strategic questions. Civilians try to identify the Impostor, while they try to go unnoticed and deduce the secret word. Voting and Punishment: Vote for who you think is the Impostor. The loser must spin the punishment wheel! Ideal For: Parties and family gatherings Game nights with friends Long trips without connection School or corporate activities Any occasion where you want to have a good time Technical Features: 100% open source (GPL-3.0) No invasive permissions No tracking or data collection Works completely offline Multi-language support

name: Cat a shooter 😼
short: Fly in the space by the cat 😼, and shoots off from enemies 🛸
description: This is a simple game that was made in Love2D where you will need to play by the cat 😼, and shoots off from enemies 🛸 for earning so mush score as you can.

name: Tri PeaksSolitaire for Android
short: TriPeaks Solitaire for Android is a card game.
description: TriPeaks Solitaire for Android is a card game in which you remove cards that are adjacent (by value) to the current card. Implementation was done by Valera Trubachev, Christian d'Heureuse and Todor Balabanov.

name: Collective Club Maze
short: A game similar to the board game ricochet robots.
description: Are you a fan of the captivating board game ricochet robots? If so, we're excited to introduce its digital counterpart! In this game, your objective mirrors the icy puzzle challenges found in Pokémon gyms: navigate your player across the board, moving in straight lines until you encounter a wall. The key is to reach the designated goal, ideally in the fewest possible moves for those seeking an extra challenge. Currently, the game features an endless loop where you can attempt to achieve goals without a move limit.

name: Blichess
short: Play lichess games over Bluetooth
description: Fork of lichess.org mobile application with Bluetooth e-boards support

name: Turns of War
short: A pixelart styled turn based strategy game
description: A turn based strategy game with a pixel art style! Over 30 levels and 30 unit types! Sound and music by Fubuki Most graphics by: Stavros

name: Tile Match
short: Match, tap, and clear your way to victory!
description: Tile Match offers a fresh and calming take on the classic tile-matching genre. Your goal is simple: find three tiles of the same kind and tap them to move them to the bar below. The real challenge? The bar has limited space, so every move counts! Strategy is key as you must clear lower tiles to unlock those on top and avoid filling the bar.

name: FLARE
short: An action RPG with gameplay alike to the games in the Diablo series
description: Flare (Free Libre Action Roleplaying Engine) is a simple game engine built to handle a very specific kind of game: single-player 2D action RPGs. Flare is not a reimplementation of an existing game or engine. It is a tribute to and exploration of the action RPG genre. Android version of Flare requires manual installation of engine data files. Instructions on how to install default game called 'The Empyrean Campaign' can be found here: https://github.com/flareteam/flare-engine/wiki/Android-Port

name: Frogue
short: 3D FPS with Boss Fights and Randomized Weapons
