optional weekly reminder you can turn off • Material You — dynamic color theming on Android 12+ • Crash reports — optional anonymous Sentry reports (off by default; opt in via Settings) • Diagnostic log — optional AI connection log you can export from Settings for support (no meals, photos, or keys) AI providers (configured at runtime in Settings): • OpenRouter — free vision models, automatic model dropdown • Google Gemini — AI Studio key, OpenAI-compatible endpoint • Ollama — local or cloud • OpenAI-compatible — OpenAI itself or

name: Pixiv for Muzei 3
short: Best Pixiv plugin for Muzei 3
description: Plugin for the new Muzei 3, to display Pixiv artworks as your wallpaper Features: * Can pull artworks from a variety of sources: - Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Rookie, Original, Male, or Female Rankings - User's followed artists - User's bookmarked artworks - Artwork's from user's recommended feed - A specified artist ID - A specified tag * Can filter against multiple criteria: - Four levels of granular NSFW filtering - Aspect ratio - View count - Manga or illustration * Suports Oauth2 authentication * Option to automatically clear images everyday * Option to save artwork to user storage * Works in China, SNI bypass Privacy respecting * No tracking or collection of user information * No advertisements

name: DailyLog
short: A quick-logging notes app with customizable shortcut buttons.
description: dailyLog is a distraction-free notepad with customizable shortcut buttons. Tired of trying to log workouts on your phone? Want to build a custom habit tracker? Do you follow a template for every journal entry? dailyLog can help. dailyLog works by accessing a single text file of your choosing: keeping your data on your device and accessible in any app you choose. But unlike a blank text file, dailyLog lets you define custom shortcut buttons. Imagine a workout log where tapping the "chest" button pastes "chest press: reps, lbs", allowing you to log your workouts with ease. Or imagine a journal where the "📝" button pastes a list of questions you want to answer every day. Initially designed as a rapid logging system for journaling, dailyLog allows you to quickly add info to a text file with customizable button shortcuts. See the detailed walkthrough with screenshots on the project homepage.

name: Liseur
short: EPUB reader in sync with your own calibre-web, Komga or OPDS book server.
description: Liseur is a free, open-source ebook reader for Android. It reads EPUB books from a folder on your phone, and it connects to your own calibre-web, Komga or liseur-sync server so your whole library lives on one shelf. No ads, no trackers, no analytics, no Liseur account. Network access is limited to the book servers and dictionary sources you choose, plus Project Gutenberg when you add free books. YOUR LIBRARY, ONE SHELF * Folders on your phone or SD card, indexed with covers * calibre-web, Komga, liseur-sync and OPDS catalogs merged into the same shelf, with a cloud badge on server books * Series grouped in reading order, with progress and missing volumes at a glance * Free books from Project Gutenberg to start you off, before you connect anything READ YOUR WAY * Pages or continuous scrolling, per book or library-wide * Bundled open typefaces (Literata, Vollkorn, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter) or the publisher's own * Margins, line spacing, brightness and four reading themes: light, sepia, dark, and black for OLED screens * Auto-scroll at your pace, carrying on across chapters * A footer with the current page, what is left in the chapter, and time remaining * A refresh mode tuned for Onyx e-ink displays YOUR PLACE FOLLOWS YOU * Your reading position syncs across devices through calibre-web, Komga or liseur-sync, down to the exact sentence * Pair any OPDS catalog with any kosync server as a single Custom connection * Settings sync and reading statistics across devices when you connect liseur-sync * Close the book on your phone and pick it up on your tablet HIGHLIGHTS, NOTES, DICTIONARY * Highlights in four colours, notes and bookmarks, gathered in a per-book notebook you can export as Markdown * Search the whole book and jump straight to the passage * Footnotes open as a card over the page instead of sending you to the back * Definitions from Wiktionary or an offline dictionary app; online lookups stay off until you turn them on, and you pick the source FREE SOFTWARE, BY DESIGN Liseur is built on the open Readium toolkit, with no proprietary dependencies and no Google Play services. Source code, issue tracker and documentation: https://github.com/chmouel/liseur

name: CubeTimer
short: Offline 3×3 speedcubing timer with TNoodle scrambles
description: CubeTimer is a focused offline timer for 3×3 speedcubing. It generates random-state scrambles with a local port of TNoodle-lib, the WCA scramble program. The cube map updates to match every scramble, so you can inspect the state before starting. Features: - Tap-to-start and tap-to-stop timer. - Random-state 3×3 scrambles generated offline. - Cube map synchronized with the displayed scramble. - Local history of up to 200 solves. - Best, worst, mean, ao5, ao12, best ao5, and best ao12 statistics. - Delete a solve with undo, or clear the history with confirmation. - Solve detail card and PNG sharing. - Light and dark themes. CubeTimer has no account, ads, analytics, or Internet permission. Solves remain on the device. A shareable PNG is created only when you request sharing through Android's share sheet.

name: Defang
short: Launcher that puts speed bumps between you and the apps engineered against you
description: Defang is an Android launcher with an anti-dark-pattern friction layer. It is a speed bump, not a wall: you can still open Instagram, you can still override the timer. Nothing here is impossible to bypass — that is deliberate. A wall breeds circumvention; a speed bump breeds pause. What it does: • Intent gate — tapping a watched app shows a full-screen pause with a countdown before "Open anyway" activates. Declare what you came for, or go back. • Session timer — a small overlay counts down your own preset limit. At zero, the end card appears. Extending costs friction: a 30-second wait, a written reason, and it works once per day. No "15 more minutes" button to tap into oblivion. • Cool-down — after a session ends, reopening is locked for a period you chose in advance. • Per-app grayscale — watched apps render colorless while your camera, maps, and photos keep their colors. • Notification batching — pings from watched apps arrive as a muted summary at times you pick, not when an engagement model predicts you're vulnerable. Real contacts always come through. • Awareness tidbits — short, specific, sourced facts about the machinery: variable reward schedules, notification timing optimization, what the algorithm selects for. They did this to you; the least you can do is know how. • Offline prompts — when a session ends, a small physical suggestion. "Tidy the coffee table" is not a joke; it's a completable task with honest dopamine. • Usage report — weekly time per app, per day, and how often "just checking a DM" became a 20-minute scroll. Evidence, not guilt. Utility apps — camera, calculator, phone, maps — open instantly, always. The launcher never gets in the way of your life; it gets in the way of the loop. No telemetry. All data stays on the device. English and Norwegian. Requires the accessibility service (foreground app detection), notification access (batching), and display-over-apps permission (overlays). Per-app grayscale needs a one-time adb grant of WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS — the app works without it, minus that feature.

name: Lune
short: Modern open source local music player for Android
description: Lune is a minimalist and elegant music player for Android, designed with a focus on aesthetics and a premium user experience. It features a modern Jetpack Compose UI, dynamic color support, and a unique high-quality dark defocus widget system. - Modern UI - Widget - Live Lyrics - Dynamic Themes - Queue Control - Playlist - Automix and Crossfade - Timer playback - Equalize - Vizulizer - Sample button theme - HI-FI audio - Customizations - Support Android Auto - haptic vibration Built with privacy as a core principle: - Zero Internet Access: The app does not hold the `INTERNET` permission. It never connects to any network, server, or service. - No Trackers: Zero analytics SDKs, no telemetry, no crash reporters, no ads — nothing phones home. - 100% Offline: All audio is played from your device's local storage. No streaming, no account required, no cloud dependency. - No Data Collection: Lune does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. Everything stays on your device. - Open Source: The entire source code is publicly available for audit. What you see is what you get. - Minimal Permissions: Only the permissions strictly necessary for local music playback and audio visualization are requested.

name: Fast N Fitness
short: Track fitness workouts
description: Fast N Fitness allows you to track your workouts quickly and easily. It is highly customizable and supports cardio and power lifting workouts. You can create as many machines as you want with the names you want. Multiple graphics will show your progress and your body evolution. Don't leave the app to get your music; a music player is integrated into the app!

name: Meshtastic
short: The official app for Meshtastic, an open-source, off-grid, mesh radio.
description: Meshtastic is a tool for using Android devices with open-source, off-grid mesh radios. This app is the main client for the Meshtastic project, allowing you to manage your mesh devices and communicate with other users. For more information about the Meshtastic project, please visit our website: meshtastic.org . The firmware that runs on the radio devices is a separate open-source project, which you can find here: https://github.com/meshtastic/Meshtastic-device . Community and Support This project is currently in beta. We would love to hear from you! If you have questions, feedback, or encounter any problems, please join our friendly and active community: • Discussion Forum: https://github.com/orgs/meshtastic/discussions • Discord: https://discord.gg/meshtastic • Report an Issue: https://github.com/meshtastic/Meshtastic-Android/issues Documentation To learn more about the features and capabilities of this app and Meshtastic, please view our official documentation: View Documentation Translations You can help translate the app into your native language using Crowdin: https://crowdin.meshtastic.org/android

name: KabelWacht
short: A simple, free WireGuard VPN client: scan, import, and manage tunnels.
description: KabelWacht is a minimal, fully free-software WireGuard® client for Android. It does one thing well: manage WireGuard tunnels and connect. Features: * Create, list, search, edit and delete WireGuard profiles. * Import a configuration by scanning a QR code or opening a .conf file. * Export a tunnel back to a standard wg-quick .conf file, protected by device authentication — the file contains your private key. * One-tap connect/disconnect with a per-tunnel switch. * Toggle a tunnel from outside the app: launcher shortcuts, a home-screen widget, or a Quick Settings tile. * Run conditions: let a tunnel connect and disconnect by itself depending on the network — only on Wi-Fi, every Wi-Fi except the ones you list, only on chosen networks, never on mobile data or while roaming, or on unmetered connections only. * Always-on VPN support, including reconnecting after a reboot. * A structured editor with Interface and Peer sections, with the complete wg-quick file one tap away. * Userspace WireGuard backend — no root required. Privacy and freedom: * 100% free and open-source software (AGPL-3.0-or-later). * No trackers, no analytics, no advertising. * No Google Play Services or other proprietary dependencies. * The only network connection made is your own WireGuard tunnel. * Location permission is optional and asked for only if you set up Wi-Fi network-name rules, because Android requires it to read Wi-Fi names. Your location is never used or stored. * Release builds are reproducible: anyone can rebuild the published APK from source and get the same bytes. Built on the official WireGuard tunnel library and the ZXing QR decoder. WireGuard is a registered trademark of Jason A. Donenfeld. This project is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by the WireGuard project.

name: GraphHopper Maps
short: Online route planner and experimental GPS navigation
description: GraphHopper Maps is an online route planner based on OpenStreetMap data and open source software. It calculates routes and alternatives very fast. It supports several modes of transport like car, bike, cargo bike, hiking, walking and more. You can add multiple stops to your route and view the road attributes like elevation, surface or max speed along the route and summarized in the statistics panel. Read more: https://www.graphhopper.com/maps-route-planner/ After you calculated the route and your GPS location is enabled you can start the GPS navigation which guides you to your destination. Note, that you are using this free application at your own risk and it comes WITHOUT WARRANTIES. See the Apache license 2.0 for more details. The provided instructions might be illegal or dangerous. Please always follow the local rules and regulations. As GraphHopper is open source you can host the complete stack on your own servers. See github.com/graphhopper/graphhopper for the routing engine, github.com/onthegomap/planetiler for the map tiles, github.com/komoot/photon for the geocoding and github.com/boldtrn/graphhopper-maps-capacitor for the front end. If there is an issue please use the issue tracker of the front end or send us an email: navi-feedback@graphhopper.com. Please include the version and if possible use the most recent application version and include the log information.

name: Mobile Harness
short: AI coding, Linux terminal, files, diffs, and previews on Android
description: Mobile Harness is a local-first AI development workspace built for ARM64 Android phones. Create persistent projects or start a Quick Project, chat with a coding agent, inspect files, run Linux commands, review changes, and preview local web apps—without installing Termux or rooting your phone. Features: • Persistent projects and friendly, instantly created Quick Projects • Streaming AI chat with visible tool activity and multiple sessions • Project-scoped and global Linux terminals • Collapsible file browser with locally stored attachments • File diffs, task checkpoints, and rollback controls • Browser-style preview for local web servers • Guided Ubuntu 20.04 ARM64 runtime setup with live progress • Anthropic API and experimental Anthropic-compatible gateways • API-key encryption backed by Android Keystore Important: Mobile Harness is experimental alpha software. PRoot is not a hardened security sandbox. Open only projects and dependencies you trust. Provider capabilities vary, and some models may not support every Claude Code tool or streaming event.

name: Prog Metronome
short: Metronome for practicing complex rhythmic ideas.
description: Metronome for musicians who wish to practice to complex rhythmic ideas without fiddling around in DAWs. Features: - Polyrhythm and polymeter - Metric modulations and BPM changes - Any tuplet and subdivision - Nested pattern groupings and repeats - Per-beat volume and sound - Project save and export - Custom sound import - Custom color themes

name: LibreFind - Find FOSS Alternatives
short: Discover and replace proprietary apps with FOSS alternatives
description: LibreFind is a free and lightweight Android app that scans your installed packages locally and queries our database to identify proprietary software and find FOSS alternatives. Core Features • Scan installed apps to detect proprietary software • Get FOSS alternative recommendations • View sovereignty scores showing FOSS vs proprietary ratio • Community-driven database Community Contributions • Propose new FOSS alternatives for review • Submit pros and cons for existing alternatives • Vote on app recommendations • Help build a comprehensive alternative database The app only queries the database for FOSS alternatives when proprietary apps are detected. LibreFind is fully open source under the GPL-3.0-or-later License. Contribute at: https://github.com/jksalcedo/librefind

name: MainTask
short: Reminders for your recurring tasks: filters, plants, backups, car checks…
description: MainTask helps you never forget your recurring tasks: filter changes, watering plants, backups, car checks… Set each task with its interval (every X days, weekly or monthly) and MainTask reminds you before it's due. Features: * Recurring tasks: fixed intervals, weekly or monthly * One-shot tasks, with or without a target date * Completion history for each task * Customizable notifications (3 days or 1 day before, at the time you choose) * "Done" and "Snooze" buttons right inside notifications * Scrollable home screen widget * Quick Settings tile * 5 color themes + dark mode * Backup export / import (history included) * Available in English and French Privacy-friendly: no ads, no trackers, no account. Everything stays on your device.

name: Tusky
short: A multi account client for the social network Mastodon
description: Tusky is a lightweight client for Mastodon, a free and open-source social network server. • Material Design • Most Mastodon APIs implemented • Multi-Account support • Dark and light theme with the possibility to auto-switch based on the time of day • Drafts - compose toots and save them for later • Choose between different emoji styles • Optimized for all screen sizes • Completely open-source - no non-free dependencies like Google services To learn more about Mastodon, visit https://joinmastodon.org/

name: Markleaf
short: Local-first Markdown notes with tags, search, and file export
description: Markleaf is a local-first Markdown note app for Android. Write plain Markdown, organize with inline tags, search instantly, and keep your notes under your control. Markleaf stores notes in a local Room database and does not declare the INTERNET permission. Writing and preview: * Live Markdown preview with live syntax coloring * GFM tables, checkboxes, blockquotes, callouts (> [!NOTE] …) * Code block syntax highlighting for 10 languages * Footnote ref ↔ def jump, wikilinks and backlinks * Smart formatting to wrap a selection or word in bold/italic/strikethrough/code * Focus mode, word and reading-time stats, find and replace within a note Organizing and navigating: * Just write #tags in the body for automatic indexing (no folders) * Quick switcher and SQLite FTS full-text search * Pin, archive, trash, and restore flows Sync and import (No-Cloud): * Mirror each note as a .md file to a folder you pick via SAF * Import external .md / .txt files by opening or sharing them in * Single-note and all-notes Markdown export, plus system share Design and accessibility: * Home screen widget, biometric lock, screenshot blocking option * Light / dark / Material You, tablet two-pane layout * UI in 11 languages (Korean, English, Spanish, Japanese, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Croatian, Russian, Vietnamese, Slovak) Privacy and distribution: * No account, no Markleaf server * No analytics, ads, tracking, Firebase, or proprietary crash reporting SDK * No INTERNET permission, Android Auto Backup disabled * User data leaves the device only through explicit OS-mediated actions such as export, share, external link opening, or a user-selected SAF folder

name: MetroMusic
short: A music player in the Windows Phone 8 idiom, for the music on your phone.
description: MetroMusic looks and moves like the Music + Videos hub of Windows Phone 8, and it plays what is already on the phone. No account, no feed, no recommendations. The collection is the start screen. The panorama you land on is the library — artists, albums, songs, genres, playlists, history and settings, in whatever order you put them. It is circular, so settings sit one swipe to the left of where you start and nothing is more than a swipe away. Getting around a big library. Long lists group alphabetically and open the WP8 jump grid over both Latin and Cyrillic. Tapping a section header searches inside that section. A long press on an album, artist or genre plays it, queues it after what you queued before, or hides it — and hiding takes effect in every list at once. Album metadata is written into the tags inside the files, which is the only level where an edit sticks. Playlists, favourites, play counts and history stay on the device. Playing. Media3 in a media session: notification, lock screen, headset and Bluetooth, and playback that outlives the screen. The queue and the current track come back after the app is closed, paused and at the start of the track. Apple Lossless is decoded inside the app, because Android ships no ALAC decoder and such files otherwise play as silence with nothing on screen to say so. Equalizer over the device's own bands, sleep timer, and a WP8 volume banner in place of the system panel. Last.fm, if you want it. A play is written to disk with the second it started and sent when a validated network appears, so an hour underground turns up in the right order rather than as a burst on reconnection. Favourites can be kept the same as your loved tracks, in both directions. Albums whose files carry no artwork can be asked about once, and lyrics come from Genius. All of that is optional, switchable off, and none of it is needed to play the music on the device. Twenty accent colours, light and dark, gestures that can each be turned off, and every string in strings.xml so a translation is one folder. The whole interface is MangoTile, a Compose UI kit for building in the WP8 idiom: https://github.com/Diffechento/MangoTile Not affiliated with Microsoft, Last.fm or Genius. "Windows Phone" and "Metro" are Microsoft's; this is an homage to a design language, written from scratch.

name: Encly: Encrypted Offline Notes
short: Private notes & tasks with a PIN lock. No account, no internet, no ads.
description: Encly is an encrypted notes app for private notes and tasks that never leave your phone. Offline notes with a PIN lock: no account, no cloud, no ads, and no internet permission at all. Most note apps want an account and a server. Encly has neither. Your encrypted notes live in one place: your phone. PRIVATE BY DESIGN • No account, no sign-up, no analytics, no ads, no in-app purchases. • Truly offline: Encly does not request the INTERNET permission, so it cannot send your notes anywhere. • Encrypted notes at rest: a SQLCipher (AES-256) database under a random 256-bit key. • PIN lock: a 6-digit PIN tied to your phone's secure hardware, plus optional fingerprint or face unlock (strong biometrics only). • Locks itself: after you leave (15 seconds by default, or immediately) or the moment the screen turns off, the database is closed and the key is wiped from memory. • Screenshots, screen recording and recent-apps previews are blocked. Android cloud backup is off. RECOVERY PHRASE AND ENCRYPTED BACKUPS • Optional 12-word recovery phrase: forgot your PIN? The phrase unlocks your vault and lets you set a new one. • Export all notes, tasks and tags to one encrypted file (AES-256-GCM) and save it wherever you choose: a folder, a USB stick, your own cloud drive. Encly never uploads it. • Restore on a new phone with the same 12 words, or merge a backup into an existing vault. • Nobody can recover your notes for you, not even the developer. Keep the words on paper. A SECURE NOTEPAD THAT IS PLEASANT TO WRITE IN • Block editor: text, headings, quotes, checklists, bulleted and numbered lists, links and separators. • Tags, search, list or grid view, several sort orders. • Tasks with priorities, right next to your notes. • Trash with restore. • Five themes (Paper, Forest, Ocean, Graphite, Midnight), light, dark or system mode, dynamic color on Android 12+, and three font sets bundled in the app. OPEN SOURCE • Encly is open source (Apache-2.0): anyone can check what it does. • Works without Google Play Services. Android 8.0 or newer. • 9 languages: English, Ukrainian, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Portuguese and Dutch. Pick one for Encly alone in Settings → Language. Encly: encrypted notes that stay yours. Privacy policy: https://pasichdev.xyz/apps/encly/privacy-policy/

name: PebbleRecorder
short: Turn a Pebble watch button into a remote start/stop trigger for audio recording.
description: PebbleRecorder turns your Pebble watch into a remote start/stop trigger for audio recording on your phone. Press a button on the watch, and this app records straight to a folder you choose - no need to touch your phone. The watch has no microphone logic of its own - it just sends a start/stop command over Pebble's AppMessage protocol (relayed through the Pebble/Core companion app) and displays whatever status comes back, with a mic/record/stop icon and a live elapsed-time timer. All recording happens here, on the phone, via MediaRecorder, writing AAC/M4A files into a folder you pick through the standard Android folder picker (Storage Access Framework) - the app only ever writes inside that folder. Optional features, both off by default: * Location tagging: attaches a reverse-geocoded location line to each recording's transcript. * Gemini transcription: sends a finished recording to Google's Gemini API (using your own API key) and saves the returned speaker-labeled transcript alongside the recording. This talks to a non-free cloud service and is entirely opt-in - the app works fully without it. Requires a Pebble smartwatch, paired via a Pebble/Core companion app (e.g. Core Devices' official app), and the matching PebbleRecorder watchapp installed on the watch (see the project's source repository for the watch app and its own installation instructions).

name: Pix-EzViewer
short: A third-party Pixiv Android client. (Android 5.0+)
description: !!this app requires an existing Pixiv account (No registration in app). A third-party Pixiv.net Android client. (Android 5.0+) with: * Multilingual support (zh-cn, zh-tw, ja-jp, en-us) * Material 2/3 UI, dark mode, custom theme color * Custom UI, horizontal view, top/bottom navbar * image filter, batch download * original size image preview, zoom in/out * view history, download history * one-click collection mode * multi-user support * multi thread downloader * anti dns-pollution&DoH support * custom API endpoint config * custom file naming (save the information such as tags) * local image pid detection & batch rename * enhanced search * GIF play & save * translation for content desc * view, add, reply comments * Pixivision support *auto private bookmark for restricted content, seperate download folder *and other enhancements for you to explore~

name: ProcrastiLearn
short: Block distracting apps until you review a spaced-repetition flashcard
description: There's Anki on your phone, there's Duolingo, and you do mean to get around to them. Then you pick the phone up, and twenty minutes later you're somewhere in TikTok, not really sure how you got there. ProcrastiLearn steps in right at that moment. It catches you just as you're about to disappear into another time sink, and asks you for one word first. That's how mindless app-opening turns into vocabulary practice. Choose which apps you tend to open out of habit — social media, browsers, games — and whenever you launch one, a full-screen flashcard overlay appears. Reveal the translation, rate how well you remembered it, and the app you wanted opens immediately. No subscription, no ads, no accounts. HOW IT WORKS Pick the apps you want to gate in the Apps tab. From that point on, opening any of those apps shows a flashcard first. You rate your answer (Again / Hard / Good / Easy) and the FSRS spaced-repetition algorithm schedules the next review automatically. Daily caps prevent you from being overwhelmed. If you tend to lose track of time once you're inside a gated app, the optional recurring reminder has you covered: set an interval (e.g. every 3 minutes) and the overlay reappears as long as you stay in that app, turning each lingering session into extra review reps. VOCABULARY Add words manually or use the optional AI translation feature: paste a word, tap Generate, and the app drafts a translation using OpenAI. The AI prompt is fully editable so you can control tone, context, or target language. You can also import existing Anki decks (.apkg files) to get started immediately with a vocabulary set you already trust. After that you can be sure that you'll learn it eventually, while watching tiktok or your favourite YouTuber. Come across a word somewhere else — an article, a chat, another app? Select it and tap "ProcrastiLearn this" from the menu to add it right away, no need to switch apps first. LANGUAGE SUPPORT The AI prompt automatically adapts to whatever native and target languages you choose in Settings: explanations appear in your native language, and examples in the language you're learning. Any language pair works out of the box — no manual prompt editing needed. Further language-related improvements will keep arriving, especially based on user requests in GitHub issues or via email. PRIVACY All data — vocabulary, blocked apps list, review history, and settings — is stored entirely on your device. There are no analytics, no crash reporters, and no ad

name: Filester
short: Temporary cloud storage for fast, private file sharing
description: Filester is the cloud storage solution that respects your privacy and puts you in control. No more intrusive ads or sneaky data collection. Just one tap and you're ready to store, share, and access your files from anywhere in the world. With support for a wide range of devices and multiple languages, Filester works seamlessly across your Android ecosystem. So whether you're rocking a classic or a cutting-edge phone, your files are always within reach. Features * Privacy-first: We do NOT process, inspect, or share your files with others. * Ad-free experience: Focus on what matters without annoying interruptions. * No account required: Get started instantly, no sign-ups or commitments. * Universal compatibility: Available on a wide range of devices. Disclaimer This app relies on first-party, as well as third-party file hosting services and does not function otherwise.

name: Rowtine
short: Knitting and crochet app: patterns, stash, counters. Offline and free.
description: Rowtine is a knitting and crochet app. It keeps in one place what is usually scattered across a project: yarn stash, PDF patterns, row counters and project notes. Features: * Track every project from cast-on to finished piece. Between sessions the app remembers where you left off. * Import a PDF pattern: sections, rows and sizes are rebuilt automatically, entirely on the device. Patterns in English, French, German and Spanish are supported. * Read a pattern with a size selector: every number in the text is filtered down to the chosen size. * Follow a chart row by row, with a movable marker and an abbreviations sheet always at hand. On a tablet, the chart and the text can be shown side by side. * Manage a yarn stash: what is reserved for a project, what is still free, with a warning when there isn't enough left to finish a piece, including multicoloured yarns (gradient, self-striping, speckled, hand-dyed). * Track the cost of every project; purchases and gifts are recorded separately. * Look up a needle or hook size from a yarn's ball band and a pattern's gauge. * Two standalone tools: an increase/decrease distribution calculator and a free-standing counter. * Metric or imperial units, five currencies. * Interface, in-app guide and pattern import in English, French, German and Spanish. The app works offline and keeps all data on the device: no account, no data collection, no server.

name: Look4Sat: Satellite tracker
short: Satellite tracker and pass predictor for Android
description: Track satellite passes with ease! Thanks to Celestrak and SatNOGS you have access to over 9000 active satellites. You can search the entire database by NORAD Catalog Number or the satellite's name. Orbital positions and passes are calculated relative to your location. To get reliable data make sure to set the station position via the app Settings. The application is built using Kotlin, Coroutines, Jetpack Compose and Navigation. It is now and always will be completely ad-free and open-source. Main features: Predicting satellite positions and passes for up to 10 days Showing the list of currently active and upcoming satellite passes Showing the active pass progress, polar trajectory and transceivers info Showing the satellite positional data, footprint and ground track on the map Custom TLE satellite data import is available via Three Line Element .txt files Offline first: calculations are made offline. Weekly TLE data update is recommended.

name: Atmo Engine
short: Animated wallpapers with Atmosphere, Glass, Canvas Sketch and playlists.
description: Atmo Engine turns your images into customizable live wallpapers, with optional lock-screen-to-home-screen transitions. Atmo Engine is an open-source wallpaper studio inspired by the Atmosphere effect in Nothing OS. Choose an image, preview and fine-tune the effect, then apply it through Android's live wallpaper screen. EFFECTS • Atmosphere and Reverse Atmosphere, with optional reeded glass • Glass and Reverse Glass • Color Fill and Reverse Color Fill • Canvas Sketch and Reverse Canvas Sketch • Simple Frosted and Reverse Frosted • Halftone Print and Reverse Halftone Previews use the same image, settings, and graphics API as the live wallpaper. TRANSITIONS OR ALWAYS-APPLIED EFFECTS Fine tuning > Timing lets you disable transitions and keep the final effect visible on Home, Lock, or Both. Atmo remains a live wallpaper, so playlists, theme playlists, Fine Tune controls, subject isolation, and supported launcher scrolling continue to work. Keep Atmo selected for both Home and Lock in Android's wallpaper picker. When transitions are off: • Home screen: effect on Home, original image on Lock • Lock screen: original image on Home, effect on Lock • Both: effect on both screens This mode does not install a baked static image. WALLPAPER MODES • Single Image • Playlist with automatic rotation • Theme Playlists with separate Light and Dark collections Theme Playlists follow device appearance and rotate within the active collection. Every image keeps its crop, zoom, fit, and scrolling position. FINE TUNING Customize animation duration, dimness, Glass rib count, thickness and transition style, blur, grain, Atmosphere contrast and saturation, Halftone detail, Canvas Sketch lines, fingerprint position, image fit, experimental wallpaper scrolling, and playlist timing. Glass and Halftone can apply their effect to the background only. Atmosphere can optionally use the same reeded-glass treatment on its clear state, including line and background-only controls. MATERIAL 3 INTERFACE Material Expressive styling can follow the system palette or use fixed colors. Choose System, Light, or Dark appearance, with an optional pitch-black background. Controls include meaning-aware motion and haptics. VULKAN OR OPENGL ES Fine tuning > Display offers: • Automatic (recommended): Vulkan when compatible, with safe OpenGL ES fallback • Vulkan: requests Vulkan while retaining compatibility checks and fallback • OpenGL ES: skips Vulkan and always uses OpenGL ES The choice applies immediately to

name: Streak
short: A minimal, private, ad-free habit tracker. One tap to log, watch streaks grow.
description: Streak is a habit tracker that respects you. Create as many habits as you like, log them with a single tap, and follow your progress through a GitHub-style activity grid, streak counters and a statistics dashboard. It is fast, offline, and built to feel calm rather than demanding. Yours, completely. No accounts, no subscriptions, no ads, no tracking. Every habit and setting stays on your device, and the full source is open. ✅ TRACKING • One-tap logging from the home screen, a widget or the reminder • Three kinds of habit: normal, avoid with relapses, and amount with your own unit and daily goal • Checklists that split a habit into steps • Flexible schedules: daily, X times a week or month, chosen weekdays, or every N days • Fill in the past by tapping any day, and the streaks catch up • Day notes with photos, vacation mode and weekly rest days 🎯 FOCUS • A timer, free or tied to a habit and its goal • Pomodoro rounds, three clock styles and calm scenes • Built-in sounds, or your own tracks and photo • A daily focus goal and a history of every session 📊 PROGRESS • Activity grid by week, month or year, plus a month calendar • Completions per month, streak evolution and the hours you are most consistent • Habit strength based on recent consistency • A shareable progress card, exported as a polished image 🎨 MAKE IT YOURS • Classic or Minimal style • Minimalist icons or any emoji, and your own accent colour • Light and dark themes, five backgrounds including true-black OLED • Categories, reordering, cover photos, profile name and photo 💾 YOUR DATA • Import from Loop Habit Tracker, HabitKit, Habitica, HabitBull or a plain CSV • Backup and restore as a single file, plus automatic backups • App lock with a PIN or your fingerprint • Four home-screen widgets: habit, today, stats and activity grid • Archive habits without losing their history • Fully offline 🔒 PRIVACY Streak has no analytics, no advertising SDK and no network backend. The app never sends your data anywhere; it stays on your device. The only outbound actions are links you choose to open yourself.

name: Tideo Auto Brightness
short: A glass-box replacement for Android's adaptive brightness
description: You taught Android your brightness preferences and it is still wrong. Tideo replaces the opaque on-device ML of stock adaptive brightness with deterministic, inspectable math: a tunable lux-to-brightness curve you can see and shape, smooth animated transitions, circadian (time-of-day) scaling, per-context overrides, and an optional privileged "super dimming" mode that takes the screen below the system minimum. To use it, first disable the system's stock Adaptive/Auto Brightness (Settings > Display), then launch Tideo, complete onboarding, and toggle the main service on from the Dashboard. Features: * Three-zone perceptual brightness curve with a live, editable graph. * Automatic curve fitting: adjust brightness by hand during normal use and, after a handful of points across varied lighting, the wizard suggests a fitted curve. * Reactivity control: per-range dead zones that kill sensor jitter without making the screen sluggish. * Smooth animated transitions with override detection: drag the system slider and Tideo steps aside, then resumes per your rules. * Circadian scaling synced to local sunrise/sunset, shifting the whole curve across the day. * Super dimming (privileged): drives Android's Reduce Bright Colors below the hardware floor, plus a PWM-flicker-aware software-dimming mode. * Context automation: load profiles automatically by foreground app, time window, location, charging state, Wi-Fi SSID, or day of week. * Profiles: five built-in presets plus save / overwrite / factory-restore and JSON import/export. * Live Debug scene: a glass-box readout of every runtime variable and decision. * Emergency recovery: flip the phone upside-down and shake to force brightness to max with an SOS vibration. * Surfaces: foreground-service notification with actions, a Quick Settings tile, a home-screen widget, and boot-start. Privilege tiers: The core pipeline is fully functional at the BASIC tier, which uses only the user-grantable WRITE_SETTINGS permission. The optional ELEVATED tier unlocks super dimming and requires a one-time WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS grant that YOU perform via adb, Shizuku, or root. It is never granted automatically. About the permissions Tideo requests: * Background location and location: used only by the optional location-aware context rules and the once-a-day sunrise/sunset refresh for circadian scaling. * Usage access (PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS): used only by per-app context rules to read the foreground app; granted from a Settings screen, not a run

name: 5G Proxy Pro
short: Share your phone's 5G/4G over Wi-Fi via SOCKS5 proxy. No root, TCP/UDP, LAN-only
description: Turn your 5G phone into a private SOCKS5 proxy for your laptop, tablet and other devices. Share your unlimited 5G/4G data over Wi-Fi, hotspot or USB tethering — no root required. Perfect for: sharing 5G to a laptop on the go, bypassing hotel/café Wi-Fi limits, giving IoT or dev boards cellular access, or getting a real mobile IP for testing. Features: - No root, native C engine (epoll) — fast, stable, up to 1000 concurrent connections - TCP (CONNECT) + UDP (ASSOCIATE and UDP-in-TCP 0x04) with IPv4, IPv6 and domain names - All traffic forced over cellular via Network.bindSocket(); Wi-Fi is LAN only - LAN-only listener (Wi-Fi / hotspot / USB + loopback health check) — never exposed on cellular - Optional username/password auth (RFC 1929): set both to enable, empty = open proxy (use on trusted LAN only) - Auto heartbeat & health check (every 10s) with auto-restart, real status callback, foreground notification with POST_NOTIFICATIONS on Android 13+ - Display of Wi-Fi / hotspot / USB / cellular IPs How to use: 1. Set port (default 1080) and optional auth, tap Start 2. App shows proxy address for Wi-Fi / hotspot / USB 3. On your other device set SOCKS5 proxy to that address:port Security: - Listener binds only to LAN interfaces, never to cellular - Credentials excluded from cloud / device transfer / adb backup Network usage (only when stated): - connectivitycheck.gstatic.com/generate_204 — cellular health check - api.ipify.org — show cellular public IP on Refresh Open source (MIT), reproducible builds.

name: XPENC
short: Offline expense tracker — accounts, budgets, dues and insights, all on-device
description: XPENC is a personal finance app that keeps every rupee on your phone. There is no server, no account to create and no ads — your transactions live in a private database on your device and never leave it. Release builds do not even request the INTERNET permission, so transmitting your data is technically impossible. Honest numbers. Most expense apps blur where money sits with what it was for. XPENC keeps them apart and enforces one rule everywhere: net worth equals the sum of your account balances. A transfer between your own accounts leaves it unchanged, income raises it, expense lowers it. Accounts — Cash, Bank and Card with real balances. Debit cards and UPI are linked instruments that spend their bank's money, so a payment is never counted twice. Credit cards carry their own balance. Income, Expense, Transfer — three transaction types kept strictly apart. Transfers never pollute budgets or reports. Budgets — per-category budgets with period windows, live progress, and alerts at 80% and on overspend. Dues and loans — track what people owe you and what you owe them, with partial settlements and running balances. Lending is not spending, so dues stay out of your budgets. Calendar — a day-wise money-in / money-out grid, plus EMI and bill reminders that post nothing until you confirm them. Insights — category breakdown, income vs expense, net-worth trend and per-account reports. Backup and export — one-tap JSON backup and restore, plus CSV export shaped for accountants. True-black design — a clean, monochrome Material 3 interface that is easy on AMOLED screens and on the eyes. Private by architecture. Fully offline, no sign-up, no cloud, no analytics, no trackers, no ads. Every runtime permission is optional and asked only when you use the feature that needs it: notifications for budget alerts and reminders, camera for "Take photo" on a receipt, and contacts only if you tap "Pick from contacts" when adding a person — and even then, only the one contact you pick is ever read. Backups are files you create and keep — you decide where they go. Accurate by design. All money math is done in whole paise, never floating point, so totals are always exact. XPENC is free software under the MIT license.

name: TRIfA
short: TRIfA Tox Client
description: TRIfA - A New Kind of Instant Messaging Whether it's corporations or governments, digital surveillance today is widespread. Tox is easy-to-use software that connects you with friends and family without anyone else listening in. While other big-name services require you to pay for features, Tox is completely free and comes without advertising — forever. Encrypted: Everything you do with Tox is encrypted using open-source libraries. The only people who can see your conversations are the people you're talking with. Distributed: Tox has no central servers that can be raided, shut down, or forced to turn over data — the network is made up of its users. Say goodbye to server outages! Free: Tox is free software. That's free as in freedom, as well as in price. This means Tox is yours — to use, modify, and share — because Tox is developed by and for the users. new Features: * Persistent Group Peer List: Your peers and friends are persistently saved and always available when you reconnect. * Tox Profiler: Your peers and friends are persistently saved and always available when you reconnect. * App Exit: See the reason why the App stopped last time (in the Maintenance screen). More Information: * about Tox: https://tox.zoff.cc * Join the TRIfA Tox Groupchat: https://trifagrp.tox.zoff.cc/ * Join discussion on Matrix: https://matrix.to/#/#trifa:matrix.org Have a look at the desktop version: https://github.com/Zoxcore/trifa_material

name: Nonius
short: Ten measuring instruments. No ads, no trackers, no network.
description: Your phone has a gravity sensor, a magnetometer, a barometer, a light sensor and a microphone. Android gives you none of them. The apps that fill the gap are mostly a banner ad with a bubble drawn on top. Nonius is the other kind. Every face is drawn as an instrument rather than assembled from stock components, and every reading that depends on hardware has a calibration you can set, because no sensor is perfect and no screen reports its own size honestly. The instruments • Level , a round vial and a tube at once, with a zero point stored for your device, in degrees, percent or millimetres per metre • Compass , heading and field strength, true north from a declination you set since there is no location permission to find it for you, and the same face doubles as a metal detector for finding a nail behind plaster • Ruler , millimetres and inches, calibrated against a bank card rather than against the pixel density the panel claims • Sound level , in dB(A) or dB(Z), with peak and minimum hold, asking the device for the unprocessed microphone so that gain control cannot rewrite the number • Tuner , note and cents by YIN pitch detection, concert pitch adjustable from 415 to 466 Hz • Counter , a tally you tap anywhere or raise with the volume keys, which survives closing the app • Altimeter , height above a mark you set, exact enough to measure a staircase, with the pressure trend • Light meter , lux across six decades, from moonlight to direct sun • Metronome , BPM 30 to 250 and beats per bar 1 to 12 with the first beat accented, sample-accurate clicks • G-force , the magnitude of the three accelerometer axes against standard gravity, with peak hold Instruments your device has no sensor for are shown greyed out with the reason, instead of opening and then apologising. What it does not do There is no INTERNET permission in the manifest, so the app cannot send anything anywhere even by accident. The single permission is the microphone, requested when you open the sound level meter or the tuner. Nothing is recorded: each frame of audio becomes one number and is discarded. The only thing stored is the handful of calibration values for your device. Free software, GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: Victoria Launcher
short: A minimal, list-based home screen and open source Niagara Launcher alternative
description: Victoria Launcher is a minimal, list-based Android home screen, and an open source alternative to Niagara Launcher. The home screen keeps a short list of favorites under a clock and weather widget. Everything else lives in an alphabetical app list you reach by swiping the edge of the screen, with an A-Z scrubber for jumping straight to a letter. Layout, alignment, icon pack, icon and text size, spacing, font and colors are all adjustable. Widgets, an optional search box, an optional Now Playing block, and work profiles and private space are all supported. No ads, no tracking, no network access.

name: DuressUltimate
short: Robust implementation of the Duress Password trigger
description: Duress Ultimate - A tool for digital self-defense, implementing a data wipe on sending any code of a specific length into the system screen unlock password input field. The wipe is performed by setting an attempts limit. There is also an upper ceiling, you can set it from 1 to 5. Requirements: Your screen lock type — password. You must not have other unlocking methods, in particular biometrics and trust agents must be disabled. The length for the wipe must differ from the length of the main password. An incorrect attempt is counted only if more than 4 characters are entered. Requested permissions: Device Admin, Accessibility permissions Optional: Device Owner permissions for additional features to work, you can grant it via the command: adb shell dpm set-device-owner duress.ultimate/.MyDeviceAdminReceiver *Before execution, remove all accounts and profiles from the device, or simply factory reset it to achieve the same result. Advantage: in the time free from input, as well as when entering the length for the wipe, the attempts limit is set to 1, which keeps the protection active in case the process stops or switches to safe mode. While entering a password of a different length, this limit temporarily becomes +2 from the current attempts up to the attempts ceiling. This moment lasts until the window state changes. What is the difference between DuressUltimate and the Duress project? The original Duress project does not set an attempts limit in the free time, but reacts post-factum. In case of a sudden process stop, the protection is completely lost. What is the difference between DuressUltimate and the Sentry project? Sentry does not have a dynamic limit. It does not change when entering a specific length and is set as fixed. For example if you set a limit of 3 attempts, this is not the upper ceiling, but the limit itself. You need to make a mistake 3 times to wipe the data. Here, you only need to enter a code of a specific length, and you don't need to lower the upper ceiling. What is the DuressUltimate project for? To protect data from access by third parties demanding you to enter the password. Before going outside if you take your phone it is recommended to turn on this app. Generally something bad happens when you do not expect it. It is necessary to always have the ability to fight back. Wherever you live and whoever you are, it is necessary to protect personal data. It can be used against you even if your range of interests is limited to watching th

name: Bike Radar
short: Overlay and audio alerts for BLE bike radars. Offline, no account, no cloud.
description: Bike Radar shows and sounds what your rear bike radar sees, on top of whatever app you are already running. A thin strip down the edge of the screen shows each approaching vehicle's distance, closing speed and lateral position. Tiered beeps rise as the closest vehicle gets nearer, and a distinct urgent tone fires when an impact looks imminent - including while you are rolling slowly toward a junction with a fast vehicle behind. A clear chime sounds when the radar no longer sees vehicles behind. Everything runs on your phone: no account, no cloud, no analytics. The optional Home Assistant integration publishes ride stats to your own server and nowhere else. Another app on your phone can ask to use your radar, and nothing reaches it until you allow it on a screen naming the app; that handover happens on the device, app to app. Features: - Live overlay with per-vehicle distance, closing speed and lateral position - Tiered proximity beeps, urgent imminent-impact tone, all-clear chime - Post-ride summary notification: overtakes, close passes, distance, tightest pass - Front camera/light auto mode by local sunset (one coarse location read per ride) - Bosch Smart System eBike telemetry, strictly read-only - Walk-away and forgot-to-lock reminders - Optional Home Assistant publishing: batteries, close passes, ride summaries - Sharing with another app on your phone (with your permission): the radar feed, and if you also allow it control of your tail light and hiding the overlay - Optional on-device capture log for diagnostics, off by default and never uploaded - English and Spanish Requires a supported rear radar paired over Bluetooth (pair it once in system Settings) and Android 12 or newer. There is no standard Bluetooth profile for bike radars, so support is per model; the compatibility list on the project's source page says which units work, and the list is short. A radar that reports distance only is expected to get the approach beeps, the all-clear and an overlay coloured by distance; the per-vehicle speed and side readouts, the urgent tone and close-pass counting need one that also reports closing speed and lateral position. The radar, camera and eBike integrations degrade gracefully: each works without the others. Bike Radar is a riding aid, not a safety guarantee. It supplements your own attention and mirrors - it never replaces them. This is an independent open-source project (GPL-3.0-or-later), not affiliated with or endorsed by any radar or eBike manufac

name: Conversations
short: Encrypted, easy-to-use XMPP instant messenger for your mobile device
description: A free and open source Jabber/XMPP client for Android. Easy to use, reliable, battery friendly. With built-in support for images, group chats and location sharing. End-to-end encrypted by default. Connects to all modern Jabber, XMPP and Snikket servers. Features • End-to-end encryption with OMEMO or OpenPGP • Send and receive images and other kinds of files • Encrypted audio and video calls (DTLS-SRTP) • Advanced machine-in-the-middle detection via channel binding (requires opt-in) • Share your location • Send voice messages • Emoji reactions • Indication when your contact has read your message • Intuitive UI that follows Android design guidelines (Material Design 3 with Dynamic Colors) • High-resolution contact photos (avatars) • Synchronizes with desktop clients (Gajim and Dino) • Private group chats and public conferences (with support for bookmarks) • Message moderation for admins in public conferences • Address book integration • Multiple accounts (unified inbox) • Deliver push notifications to other compatible apps like Tusky, Ltt.rs, DAVx⁵ and Fennec via UnifiedPush • Very low impact on battery life Note: Some of these features require server support. Go to account details and select 'Server Info' from the overflow menu to see if your server has all necessary extensions. Design principles • Be as beautiful and easy to use as possible without sacrificing security or privacy • Rely on existing, well-established protocols • Do not require a Google account or specifically Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) • Require as few permissions as possible

name: FirTube
short: FirTube — simple webView browser for YouTube

name: Tallybook
short: Private, offline-first expense and budget tracker, no account required
description: Tallybook is a private, offline-first expense and budget manager for Android. Track your spending across multiple wallets, set budgets, plan recurring transactions, and see where your money goes, all on your device, with no account and no sign-up. Tallybook is a maintained, community fork of MoneyWallet by AndreAle94, a GPL-licensed expense manager whose last release was in 2021. This fork modernizes the open-source build for current Android, fixes the startup crash that stopped the original launching for many users, and continues maintenance under a new name. Tallybook is a separate app from MoneyWallet. It uses its own application id, so it installs side by side with the original and does not replace it or read its data automatically. You can move your data across manually with the built-in backup and restore. See the migration guide in the project for the verified steps. Features: * Multiple wallets, each with its own balance, which you can put in named groups * Income and expense transactions with categories and notes * Select several transactions and delete them together or move them to another wallet or category * Automatic categories, so a rule fills the category in from what you type * Budgets to keep categories on track * Recurring transactions for bills and regular income * Multi-currency with exchange rates * Debts and credits * Saving goals * Overview charts and reports * Calendar view of your activity * A home screen widget showing one wallet's balance * Transaction templates and scheduled events * Local backup and restore, with a local-folder option you can sync using your own tools * Backup to your own WebDAV server, such as Nextcloud, ownCloud or a NAS, with no third party account * Export to CSV, Excel, and PDF, plus CSV import * Optional place attachments using OpenStreetMap, with no proprietary services Privacy and offline first: * Optional app lock with a PIN, a pattern, or your fingerprint * No account, no sign-up, and no ads * Your data stays on your device unless you back it up, export it, or leave Android's own backup on * The open-source build uses OpenStreetMap and no Google services Tallybook is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

name: Magpie
short: Tamper-evident incident journal with encrypted, self-proving exports
description: People document disputes with a camera roll and a notes app, and months later it proves nothing: files re-save, dates shift, entries vanish. Magpie is an incident journal with receipts: * Every entry (photo, note, file) is hash-chained to the one before it. Edit, reorder, or delete anything and the chain breaks visibly. * Everything is encrypted on your device with your passphrase. Locked means unreadable, including to the app. * Exports are plain zips carrying your files, the chain manifest, and a small python script anyone can run to verify the record without Magpie. * Share the one-line head hash early (email it to yourself, send it to someone you trust) and the whole record is pinned to that moment. This app requests no permissions. Photos come through the system camera, and the operating system refuses every network connection. No accounts, no analytics, no dependencies. GPL-3.0-or-later licensed. Honest limits: tamper-evident is not court-admissible by itself, device timestamps are claims until anchored, and there is no passphrase recovery on purpose.

name: RiPlay
short: Multiplatform Music Player
description: 🎵 About RiPlay RiPlay is a powerful, open-source music player designed for music lovers who want complete control over their listening experience. With support for both online and offline content, extensive customization options, and a beautiful interface, RiPlay transforms how you interact with your music collection. ⚠️ Important Notice 🛡️ RiPlay respects your privacy and operates transparently No data collection, your data stays on your device For playing online content, it uses the YouTube Player library as a wrapper around the official [IFrame Player API](https://developers.google.com/youtube/iframe_api_reference) inside a WebView ✨ Key Features 🎧 Music Experience Play songs, videos, artists, albums, playlists, and podcasts Smart queues (audio/video mixed) Listening statistics Lyrics support: fetch, display, edit, translate Listener level ranking with personal monthly and annual badge Blacklist, can ignore artist, album, Song, Playlist, Device folder Rewind, your year in music ⏰ Smart Features Music Recognize (title & artist) Sleep timer Visualizer (microphone permission required) Fast Share (direct sharing with installed apps) Cast to another Android device / TV via [RiLink](https://github.com/fast4x/RiLink) (experimental) Self-closing app scheduling Events daily/weekly, new releases from your artists, auto backup and check update Android Auto support Android TV support (experimental) Widget support (experimental) Visit it on Github https://github.com/fast4x/RiPlay Made with ❤️ by Fast4x

name: Meron
short: Mail app that sparks joy
description: Features Unified Inbox, kanban and chat views IMAP/SMTP email and RSS/Atom feeds Threaded conversations with rich-text composing and media galleries Easy setup with OAuth or automatic mailbox discovery Encrypted local storage with credentials kept in the OS keyring Themes and 20+ languages How it works Meron syncs your mail and feeds through a shared Rust core for speed and reliability. Your accounts and messages are stored encrypted on your device. When you enable sender images, Meron sends a SHA-256 hash of each sender's email address to Gravatar and, as a fallback, the sender's domain (and, if needed, its parent domain) to DuckDuckGo.

name: Flash Deck
short: A simple and easy to use flash card to help you study
description: A simple and easy to use flash card app to help you study smarter and learn faster! Create & Manage Easily add decks and flash cards Reversible cards — swap question and answer during tests Copy and move cards between decks Save & Add Another button for quick consecutive card creation Record voices and attach images for your cards Study & Test Test mode with shuffle and progress tracking Test state persistence — resume your test after app restart Flash bot to smartly suggest cards to test you based on your behavior Reminders Notification timer to periodically quiz you Notification time window — set start and end times for reminders Voice playback directly from notifications Create shortcut to show random card from deck for casual study (Android 8+) Import & Export Easily export & share your decks to your friends Import and export decks in Anki .apkg format (supports Basic cards with images and audio) AI-Powered Generate flash card decks from any topic using Google Gemini AI Transform existing decks with AI — translate, expand, create harder questions, and more AI model selection — choose from available Gemini models Appearance Support dark mode and light mode

name: Catima — Loyalty Card Wallet
short: For your barcodes, memberships, loyalty programs, coupons and tickets.
description: Stop the search for plastic reward cards during store or webshop checkout. Scan barcodes to your device using its camera, forget about cards. Forget your wallet, or keep it ultralight for valuables. With this essential everyday carry (EDC) tool you can replace useless plastic with cash. - Avoid spying with very few permissions. No Internet access and no ads. - Add cards or codes with names and customizable colours. - Manual code entry if there is no barcode to store, or it can't be used. - Import cards and codes from files, Catima, FidMe, Loyalty Card Keychain and Voucher Vault. - Make a backup of all your cards and transfer them to a new device if you want. - Share coupons, exclusive offers, promo codes, or cards and codes using any app. - Sync with supported Gadgetbridge or Wear OS smartwatches. - Dark theme and accessibility options for vision impaired users. - Made for everyone by the libre software community. - Localized hand-made translations for 40+ languages. - Gratis, supported by community contributions. - Use, study, change and share it as you wish; with all . - Not only Free Software / Open Source. Copylefted libre software (GPLv3+) card management. Simplify your life and shopping, and never lose a paper receipt, in-store payment gift card or airplane ticket again. Take all your rewards and bonuses with you, and save as you go.

name: Nightbell
short: Uptime monitoring that runs on your phone. No server, no account.
description: Point Nightbell at anything that answers over HTTP, or at one element on a rendered web page, and it watches it, charts it, and gets loud when it breaks. There is no server and no account. The phone in your pocket does the checking, and your API tokens and target URLs never leave the device. Three kinds of monitor: - Status check: hit a URL, assert on the status code. - Request and response: pick the method, set headers and a body, assert on what comes back (contains, equals, regex, or a JSON field by path). - Page element: load the real page in an embedded browser and watch DOM nodes you picked by tapping them. Urgent alerts arrive as a full-screen red page with a looping alarm that keeps going until you acknowledge it, and it wakes the screen even if the phone is locked. A first-launch screen walks through the four Android grants a paging app actually needs (notifications, unrestricted battery, full-screen intent, Do Not Disturb access), because two of them have no system dialog and have to be opened by hand. A home-screen widget shows the worst monitor first. Settings let you shape the alert policy: what counts as down, sound, haptics, escalation, and quiet hours. Signed with the developer's own key. No Play Store listing.

name: OsmAnd~
short: Global Mobile Map Viewing & Navigation for Offline and Online OSM Maps
description: OsmAnd is an offline world map application based on OpenStreetMap (OSM), which allows you to navigate taking into account the preferred roads and vehicle dimensions. Plan routes based on inclines and record GPX tracks without an internet connection. OsmAnd is an open source app. We do not collect user data and you decide what data the app will have access to. Main features: Map view • Choice of places to be displayed on the map: attractions, food, health and more; • Search for places by address, name, coordinates, or category; • Map styles for the convenience of different activities: touring view, nautical map, winter and ski, topographic, desert, off-road, and others; • Shading relief and plug-in contour lines; • Ability to overlay different sources of maps on top of each other; GPS Navigation • Plotting a route to a place without an Internet connection; • Customizable navigation profiles for different vehicles: cars, motorcycles, bicycles, 4x4, pedestrians, boats, public transport, and more; • Change the constructed route, taking into account the exclusion of certain roads or road surfaces; • Customizable information widgets about the route: distance, speed, remaining travel time, distance to turn, and more; Route Planning and Recording • Plotting a route point by point using one or multiple navigation profiles; • Route recording using GPX tracks; • Manage GPX tracks: displaying your own or imported GPX tracks on the map, navigating through them; • Visual data about the route - descents/ascents, distances; • Ability to share GPX track in OpenStreetMap; Creation of points with different functionality • Favourites; • Markers; • Audio/video notes; OpenStreetMap • Making edits to OSM; • Updating maps with a frequency of up to one hour; Additional features • Compass and radius ruler; • Mapillary interface; • Night theme; • Wikipedia; • Large community of users around the world, documentation, and support; Extra Features: Maps+ • Unlimited map downloads; • Topo data (Contour lines and Terrain); • Nautical depths; • Offline Wikipedia; • Offline Wikivoyage - Travel guides. name: Yumi Co. Radio

Its official Android app brings the station to your phone with a native player and a distinctive retro Windows 9x look. Listen in the background or from your lock screen, control playback from notifications, headsets and Bluetooth devices, and follow the current track with its artwork, artist and title. Browse recently played songs, check the station schedule, choose your preferred stream quality, use the ten-band equalizer, set a sleep timer or share what is playing. Join the live chat to talk with other listeners and the hosts, send private messages, use emotes, and share images or files. On the road, Android Auto lets you start the stream and see what is playing directly from your dashboard. No ads. No account required. No analytics or tracking. Free and open source under GPLv3.

name: Aster Mail: Encrypted Email
short: Private email app with end-to-end encryption, aliases, and custom domains
description: Aster Mail is a private, encrypted email app for astermail.org accounts. Your messages are encrypted on your device before they leave it. The server stores ciphertext and nothing else, so nobody at Aster can read your mail, scan it, or sell what is in it. There are no ads, no trackers, and no analytics anywhere in the app. Private by design - End-to-end encryption between Aster users, using a post-quantum ratchet protocol - Zero-access architecture: the server holds only encrypted content - No ads, no tracking, no telemetry, no profiling - Open source under AGPL-3.0, so anyone can audit what the app does Email aliases - Create an alias for each site you sign up for, and turn one off when it starts getting spam - See which alias a message arrived on, right in the message list - Import and export your aliases Your own domain - Send and receive on a custom domain, with DKIM signing handled for you - Buy a domain from inside the app Everyday mail - Folders, labels, categories, and search across your whole mailbox - Swipe actions and a toolbar you can customize - Templates, signatures, scheduled send, and auto-forwarding - Blocked senders, sender filters, and an allow list - Encrypted offline storage, so your mail is there without a connection Security - Biometric lock - Two-factor authentication and a recovery key - Active session management, so you can sign out a device you no longer have Notifications - Private mode hides the sender and subject on your lock screen - Quiet hours schedule when notifications arrive - Per-folder muting This F-Droid build contains no Firebase or Google Play Services dependencies. Push notifications are delivered through any UnifiedPush-compatible distributor, such as ntfy. Background polling takes over when no distributor is installed. Aster Mail is free to use. Paid plans add storage, larger attachments, more aliases, and custom domains. Source code: https://github.com/Aster-Privacy/Aster-Android

name: Quicall

It targets Android 13 and can do unattended updates without privileged extension or root. F-Droid is an installable catalogue of libre software apps for Android. The F-Droid client app makes it easy to browse, install, and keep track of updates on your device. It connects to any F-Droid compatible repositories. The default repo is hosted at f-droid.org, which contains only bona fide libre software. Android itself is open in the sense that you are free to install APKs from anywhere you wish, but there are many good reasons for using F-Droid as your libre software app manager: * Get notified when updates are available * Optionally download and install updates automatically * Keep track of older and beta versions * Filter out apps incompatible with the device * Find apps via categories and searchable descriptions * Access associated URLs for donations, source code etc. * Stay safe by checking repo index signatures and APK hashes

name: keepIT

When you want the same notes on your other devices, run the free and open-source keepIT server and they sync in real time. You can start without one and connect a server later - your notes come with you. Notes and checklists, with Markdown as you type Voice notes - record one and play it back, straight from your list Photos from your camera or gallery Reminders that fire on time, offline and with the app closed Colors, pins, lists, archive and search to keep it findable Share a note with someone to view or edit (needs a server) Home-screen widget, and text shared in from other apps No ads, no analytics, no tracking.

name: KashCal
short: All your calendars in one app. iCloud, CalDAV, device, ICS. Private.
description: Your calendars are everywhere. Family on iCloud. Holidays from some website. Birthdays buried in your contacts. Work on the phone calendar. KashCal pulls them into one app on Android. Learn more at https://kashcal.onekash.org • iCloud: switched to Android but your family is still on Apple? Sync iCloud calendars directly. No bridge, no workaround. • CalDAV: Nextcloud, Fastmail, Radicale, Baikal, Zoho, Mailbox, Stalwart, SOGo, and more. Native two-way sync, no middleware. Your phone's Google and Outlook calendars show up too. • Seven views: month, full-height month, agenda, day, 3-day, week, and year. Pinch to zoom the timeline, drag an event to reschedule it. • Smart Add: type "Coffee with Kash tomorrow 3pm" and it's added to your calendar. Understands dates, times, recurrence, and locations. • Scheduling: invite people, send meeting invitations, and RSVP to invites others send you. • Insights: see where your time goes. Busiest days, back-to-back streaks, free blocks. Computed on-device. • Widgets: keep your day on the home screen without opening the app. Agenda, date, week, month, and upcoming. • ICS subscriptions: follow any calendar feed. Public holidays, school terms, sports seasons. • Birthdays & anniversaries: pulled from your contacts automatically. • Per-event colors: from a curated palette or a full color wheel, so your week reads at a glance. • Make it yours: light, dark, or system theme, plus a KashCal Teal palette. Supporters can switch to a special app icon. • Accessibility: full screen-reader (TalkBack) support, and set the app's language right from Android settings, in 67 languages. • Works fully offline out of the box. Private by default No analytics. No telemetry. No KashCal account. We have no servers, so there is nothing to collect. • Credentials encrypted with the Android Keystore • App lock: hide your events behind your fingerprint, face, or screen lock Free as in speech. Also free as in beer.
