Bring your own cloud AI key (Google AI Studio, OpenRouter, etc.) or use optional on-device Gemma 4 inference. Nothing is sent to a server unless you choose a cloud provider. Food logging • Multi-photo capture, share-into-app, voice, barcode, manual entry, saved meals and recipes • Barcode scan with Open Food Facts lookup (4.6M+ products, cached for offline use); photo analysis can read codes from the image • Optional on-device AI (Gemma 4 via LiteRT-LM): one-time model download, opt-in, arm64 with 6 GB+ RAM Progress & health • Live calorie budget: the home ring grows your daily goal with the day's burn, measured via Health Connect, added manually, or estimated from your 14-day active average • Weight, body fat, calorie history, goals, steps and exercise • Health Connect sync (two-way): write meals, weight, body fat, height; read sleep, heart rate, hydration, steps, energy • Optional local water tracking and home-screen widgets Privacy • No ads, no analytics SDKs, no accounts • Local-first storage; encrypted API keys on device • Diary and body-metrics export (JSON, Markdown, CSV) MIT licensed. Source: https://codeberg.org/fitguy/chompass

name: Peristyle
short: Simple wallpaper manager app with Auto Wallpaper and Multi Folder support.
description: Peristyle is created to be extremely simple and sophisticated wallpaper manager and browser app for Android. It solves the problem of having too many features and bloated apps and having very minimal support for locally stored wallpapers. What if you just wanted an app that allows you to browse and select your own locally stored wallpapers and lets you manage and set wallpapers from there? then Peristyle is for you :) Features: - Simple architecture, browse wallpapers and use system wallpaper manager to set them as wallpaper. - Multiple folders support. - Ability to assign Tags to any wallpaper. - Can scan .nomedia directories, useful if you want to keep your wallpapers away from gallery. - Apply blur and color filters dynamically on any wallpaper before applying. - Simple yet pretty animations with proper optimizations. - Compress or reduce images on the fly. - No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no internet permissions, no unnecessary permissions. - Auto wallpaper change support with dedicated folders and tags for each screens. - Change wallpaper using app's live wallpaper - Edit and apply filters on wallpapers losslessly in realtime. - Built-in live wallpaper picker. - Dark mode support. - Glassmorphic UI based on realtime blur effects and caustic shadows. - Material You color theme. - Fully reproducible build. - Zero loading software architecture. - Built-in WallHaven client to browse and download wallpapers.

name: Reverb
short: Rolling audio recorder for Android
description: Reverb lets you capture audio, keep a rolling history and save the parts you need. Capture Independent One-shot and Looping buffers Disk-backed audio history that restores across app restarts Configurable retention limits by time or size Hardware-aware audio format, sample rate, source, route and channel options Save and listen Select a range on the waveform and export it as WAV Listen while fine-tuning your selection Play saved recordings directly in the Library Trim into a new recording while preserving the original Rename, move and delete saved recordings Privacy No ads, trackers or accounts. Reverb does not request network permission. Battery use Continuous microphone capture consumes power even though Reverb reduces work when its capture screen is not visible. Battery use varies by device and recording settings.

name: Petals: Cannabis Use Tracker
short: Weed tracker to quit, cut down or understand your cannabis use. Open source.
description: Petals is a free and open source cannabis tracker that helps you understand your habit — and change it at your own pace. Whether you want to quit weed, take a tolerance break, cut down gradually, or simply know how much you actually use, Petals gives you the numbers. No account, no sign-up, and your data never leaves your phone. TRACK YOUR USE - Log every session: amount in grams, cost per gram, date and time - Record the consumption method: smoked, vaporized, edible or other - See the time since your last use, down to the second - Track how much you spend on weed, today, this week and overall - Add a use in one tap from the home screen widget UNDERSTAND YOUR PATTERNS - Statistics and graphs of your cannabis usage over time - Usage by hour of day and by day of week, so you can see when the urge really hits - Filter your history and spot the trends you would never notice from memory - Watch the real cost of the habit add up CUT DOWN AT YOUR OWN PACE - Time-gate your sessions: set a minimum interval between uses and let the timer hold you to it - Register pause periods for a tolerance break or a full stop - No streak shaming, no pressure: the app shows you the data, you set the pace WITHDRAWAL AND DRUG TESTS - Track withdrawal symptoms over time: irritability, anger, restlessness, sleep difficulty, anxiety, decreased appetite and discomfort - Estimated THC concentration after your last use - Estimates of when urine, blood, saliva and hair tests may come back clean, with the sources cited PRIVACY BY DESIGN - All of your data stays on your device - No account, no cloud, no analytics - Lock the app behind a personal PIN - Export and import everything as plain CSV files — your data belongs to you HARM REDUCTION - Built-in harm reduction information, because using less safely beats using blindly FREE AND OPEN SOURCE Petals is free and licensed under the AGPL-3.0. The full source code is public, contributions are welcome, and the app is translated by its own community of users.

name: ETH & UZH mensa Zürich
short: Menus of the mensas at ETH and UZH
description: Get an overview of today's, this week's or next week's menus. Find pictures and details such as allergy information in the details. Customise the display to suit your needs: sort locations, favourite mensas, hide them, and more in the settings.

name: Vault Explorer
short: Encrypted container explorer: VeraCrypt, LUKS, BitLocker, Cryptomator, gocryptfs
description: Vault Explorer opens and browses encrypted containers and vaults directly on your device -- VeraCrypt/TrueCrypt, LUKS, BitLocker, Cryptomator, gocryptfs, and CryFS, plus VHD/VHDX images -- without exporting your files unencrypted to shared storage. Features: * Read/write NTFS, FAT/exFAT, and ext2/3/4 filesystems inside a container * VeraCrypt/LUKS/BitLocker unlock, including cascaded ciphers and hidden volumes * Cryptomator, gocryptfs, and CryFS directory-vault support * Built-in viewers and editors for photos, video/audio, PDF, HTML, Markdown, and text/code, plus an image editor and archive browser (ZIP, 7-Zip, RAR, TAR and more) * Vault camera -- shoot photos and video straight into a container, with background recording and a Quick Settings tile/shortcut * Item Vault -- an encrypted password manager built into your container * Create new encrypted containers and USB volumes, up to 8 mounted at once * Password, PIN, pattern, or biometric unlock * Storage locations for device storage, SD cards, and cloud document providers, plus auto-sync between a vault and a folder * Emergency panic and duress unlock -- lock vaults, wipe credentials, or wipe the app's own data * Mask Mode -- optionally disguise the app as a real, working local file manager on the home screen; hold the title for 2 seconds to reach your real vault * Optional local automation for Tasker/MacroDroid (Beta) -- no network involved * Tools: keyfile/passphrase generator, file encryptor, hash verifier, vault sync, storage analyzer, duplicate finder, split & join, header backup, and container repair Vault Explorer does not collect or transmit any data -- it has no INTERNET permission at all. All decryption happens locally on your device, in memory wherever possible. The few operations that need a scratch file keep it in private app storage and wipe it afterwards. Files only leave a vault when you (or an automation you enabled) export, share, or sync them. Mask Mode only changes the app's home-screen name, icon, and front screen for situations where someone else may pick up your device. The disguised file manager is a genuine, working browser for your device's own storage, not a way to hide activity from other people.

name: Messages
short: Simple, private SMS messaging. Offline-first, no ads, no tracking.
description: Messages is a simple SMS app for Android built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose (Material 3). It is fully offline: the manifest declares no INTERNET permission , so your messages never leave your device except through your carrier. Features * Clean Material 3 interface with light / dark / system themes * Conversations list with search, unread badges and avatars * Pin, archive, trash (+ undo) and delete conversations; swipe actions * Drafts auto-saved per conversation * Scheduled messages and optional delayed sending * Message forwarding and tappable links * MMS image send/receive (when set as default SMS app) * Dual-SIM support with per-message SIM selection * Sent / delivered / failed status per message with retry * Number blocking and report-spam style contact actions * Database backup & restore * No ads, no analytics, no trackers Permissions SMS and contacts permissions are used only to send/receive messages and show contact names. The app requests no network access at all.

name: AWAGAM TLD and Domain Blocker
short: Block TLDs and domains at the DNS level using your own blocklists
description: AWAGAM blocks access to top-level domains and domains at the DNS level, using blocklists you configure yourself. It runs a local VPN that intercepts DNS queries. Blocked lookups resolve to 0.0.0.0; everything else is forwarded to the DNS-over-HTTPS resolver of your choice. Your ordinary Internet traffic is never routed through the VPN. The app ships with no blocking rules of its own. What gets blocked is entirely up to you. Features: * Block TLDs and domains at the DNS level * DNS-over-HTTPS upstream (DNS4EU, Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, OpenDNS, AdGuard) * Add, edit, and manage as many blocklist URLs as you like * Compatible with the AWAGAM browser extension blocklist format, including bundles * Temporarily disable protection (5 minutes, 15 minutes, 1 hour) with automatic restart * DNS query statistics: queries, blocked requests, cache performance * Export your configuration to Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, or hosts format * Background blocklist updates every 6 hours * Watchdog that restarts filtering if the system stops it * Auto-start on boot Privacy: AWAGAM collects no personal data. All processing happens on your device. There is no analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting, and no DNS query logging. The only network connections are DNS queries to the upstream resolver you select and blocklist fetches from URLs you configure. The app opts out of Android backup and device-to-device transfer, so your blocklist subscriptions are never copied into your Google account. Use the export function to move your configuration yourself. Limitations: * DNS sees domain names, not full URLs, so URL-level blocking is not possible. Use the browser extension for that. * Android permits one VPN at a time, so AWAGAM cannot run alongside another VPN app. * Apps that use their own DNS-over-HTTPS resolver bypass system DNS filtering.

name: Launcher314
short: Launcher with deep customization on a single screen
description: I built this launcher for people to be able to easily access settings and customization all from one screen without having to go on a scavenger hunt to change something simple like row count or font size. I built this app to help me move to a more secure OS and thought oh, other people can use this too! All your data is stored locally on the device, no exuberant permissions required such as internet connection or any data collection libraries (you can check with apps like TrackerControl or apps that will scan libraries for trackers). One screen customization with preview windows to view your changes prior to even going into the launcher. Just like most launchers, icons, folders, and everything in the preview areas use bitmaps; while widgets are the only item using Live AndroidView. In the preview section you will see we have multiple ways to customize the launcher with columns & rows being independent of each-other in the Home Screen / App Drawer sections but only being bound by a universal icon size indicator making sure apps and text don't go out of bounds on each-other. In the app drawer you will also see a square check mark box next to the app drawer rows; this selection will switch you between the scroll mode & paged mode drawers and if you scroll further down to the scroll bar/ navigation drop down, you can customize both navigation indicators to you liking. Just above that you will notice an icon text dropdown where you can choose rom various fonts (most popular ones from other Launcher3 forks) & a way to adjust the text size. Using this app is pretty straight forward and everything is contained in a few screens or less so you spend less time trying to figure out what a selection does or where to find a specific setting and instead just jump right in to customization and setting up the launcher; a feature I felt that most other launchers didn't do well. Anyways who reads these descriptions anyways. Get in there buddy. This app is free and open source software (FOSS) licensed under the GPL-3.0 License.

name: Clock
short: Alarm, clock, timer and stopwatch mode
description: Clock is a privacy-conscious open-source clock, based on AOSP. Does not use internet permission, and thus is 100% offline. Features: Set the alarms to a specific date; Flip and shake action to dismiss/postpone alarm; Turn off/postpone the alarm with the power button or volume buttons; For some Snapdragon devices only, the alarm is triggered when they are switched off Unfortunately, this feature may not work on some devices despite the presence of the "com.qualcomm.qti.poweroffalarm" system app. Swipe to delete an alarm; Duplicate alarms; Customizable alarm title; Customizable ringtone; Ability to play ringtones randomly; Light, dark or system theme; AMOLED mode for dark theme; Customizable interface; Digital or analog clock style; Display home time when traveling; Display the time in many cities around the world; Timer and stopwatch included; Possibility of sharing your stopwatch with your contacts; Customizable screensaver; Modern widgets; Customizable widgets; Support for tiles in quick settings (for Android 7+); Backup and restore application data (except custom ringtones); Material design; Dynamic colors for Android 12+;

name: BLACKBOX
short: File Encryption & Vault
description: BLACKBOX is a clean, lightweight, offline-first security hub built for developers, creators, and anyone who values digital privacy. All data is encrypted with AES-256-GCM and stored on your device — nothing ever leaves without your explicit consent. Core Modules: - Secrets Manager: Store API keys, passwords, and tokens in categorized, encrypted vaults. Tap-to-reveal and one-tap copy. - Encrypted Journal: Timestamped entries with category tags, all encrypted locally with your master PIN. - 2FA / Authenticator: TOTP code generator with live countdown and manual secret entry. No cloud sync, no accounts needed. - Privacy Tools: Permission audit, tracker URL cleaner, browser fingerprint viewer, and malicious URL scanner. - Settings: Master PIN change, auto-lock timer, biometric unlock, panic mode with decoy calculator, screenshot blocking. Security Features: - AES-256-GCM encryption via Web Crypto API - PBKDF2-SHA256 key derivation with 150,000 iterations - FLAG_SECURE screenshot and screen recording blocking - Biometric unlock (fingerprint / face) via Android BiometricPrompt - Panic mode: calculator decoy triggered by PIN prefix - Auto-lock on inactivity or app switch - 100% offline — no network calls, no analytics, no tracking BLACKBOX is free, open-source, and built with Capacitor for Android. No proprietary dependencies. No cloud. No compromises.

name: GPG Key Manager
short: GPG Tool for Android
description: GPG Key Manager is a complete OpenPGP / GPG toolkit for Android, designed for everyone who cares about privacy and secure communication. Everything runs entirely on your device — no accounts, no servers, no internet connection required. EASY KEY MANAGEMENT Create strong PGP key pairs in seconds. Choose the modern Ed25519 (sign) + X25519 (encrypt) combination for fast, short and secure keys, or stick with classic RSA keys up to 4096 bits for maximum compatibility. Manage all your keys in one place: list, view, import and export ASCII-armored public and private keys. ENCRYPT AND DECRYPT MESSAGES Encrypt any text with a recipient's public key and only they — using their private key — can read it. Decrypt incoming messages with your own private key, protected by your passphrase. Text encryption uses AES-256 with a fresh session key, and each message carries an integrity check. SIGN AND VERIFY Prove authorship and protect against tampering by signing text with your private key. Verify signatures with the corresponding public key to confirm that a message really came from its sender. FULLY OFFLINE AND PRIVATE All cryptographic operations are performed locally using the open-source Bouncy Castle library. Your private keys are stored encrypted at rest with AES-256 inside the app's private storage, and your passphrase is never saved. The app requests no permissions and makes no network calls — your secrets never leave your phone. BEAUTIFUL AND ACCESSIBLE A modern Material 3 interface with light and dark themes and Android 12+ Dynamic Color support. Text fields, dialogs and every action are designed to be simple and intuitive, and the whole app is available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese and Thai. F-DROID FRIENDLY The app is built to meet F-Droid's strict reproducibility guidelines, so you can install and build it from source with confidence. Requirements: Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher.

name: hwloc lstopo
short: Display the topology of your hardware using the hwloc library and lstopo tool
description: The Portable Hardware Locality (hwloc) software package provides a portable abstraction (across OS, versions, architectures, ...) of the hierarchical topology of modern architectures, including NUMA memory nodes, sockets, shared caches, cores and simultaneous multithreading. It also gathers various system attributes such as cache and memory information as well as the locality of I/O devices such as network interfaces, InfiniBand HCAs or GPUs. hwloc primarily aims at helping applications with gathering information about increasingly complex parallel computing platforms so as to exploit them accordingly and efficiently. For instance, two tasks that tightly cooperate should probably be placed onto cores sharing a cache. However, two independent memory-intensive tasks should better be spread out onto different sockets so as to maximize their memory throughput.

name: Libre Camera
short: Modern camera app to take pictures and record videos
description: Libre Camera is a free and open source camera app to take pictures and record videos written in Flutter and Dart. If you are in need of an open source camera app with several features, this app should be for you. From flashlight, focus and exposure controls to changing themes, languages and the compression amount – this app should have you covered. And if not, feel free to open an issue on GitHub and request a feature. Below you can see a list of the features, with more coming in the future! Features * Take pictures and record videos with your rear and front camera * Privacy: No EXIF Metadata saved by default when taking pictures (enable optionally in settings) – without ads, tracking, or unnecessary permissions * Themes: Material Design with a Dark, Light or system theme * Multiple languages supported – Contribute translating your language! * Zoom: Zoom with 2 fingers or with an optional slider * Timer/Delay: Select a photo capture timer to get ready for your photo * Flashlight modes: On at capture, Off, Auto, Always on * Focus: Auto focus, locked focus and manual focus by touching the screen * Exposure: Auto exposure, locked exposure and manual exposure with an optional slider * Image compression: Set the compression amount in the settings * Formats: Switch between 3 camera formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP) * Resolutions: Switch between different camera resolutions * Save location: Choose your preferred save location * Small size of about 21MB * Customizable: Open the settings to customize the app to your liking! Contact Check out the GitHub repository, which includes the Roadmap: https://github.com/iakdis/librecamera In case you found a bug or have a feature request, feel free to file an issue on GitHub: https://github.com/iakdis/librecamera/issues

name: Sumire Japanese Keyboard Lite F-Droid
short: Private offline Japanese keyboard with user dictionary and snippets
description: Sumire is a Japanese keyboard for people who want local-first input and predictable behavior. Typing, conversion, personalization, and learning data stay on the device. The Lite F-Droid build focuses on the core keyboard experience: - kana and romaji input with Japanese candidate conversion - user dictionary and reusable text snippets - clipboard-based helpers and customizable keyboard layouts - emoji and symbol keyboards This flavor excludes the optional Zenz and Gemma model features so it can be distributed on F-Droid with the free-software components needed for everyday typing. The app does not request Internet access. Voice input uses the microphone permission only when you choose to use speech recognition provided by your device.

name: KeePassDX Passkey Vault
short: Manage Passkey / Password in a local and open-source vault
description: KeePassDX is an open source passkey, password safe and manager allows editing encrypted data in a single file in the open KeePass format and fill in the forms in a secure way , requires no Internet connection and integrates Android design standards. The app is open source, with no advertising . Features - Passkeys for authentication and local storage of private keys. - Biometric recognition for fast unlocking (fingerprint / face unlock / …). - One-time password management (HOTP / TOTP) for two-factor authentication (2FA). - Autofill for easy form filling with passwords. - Magikeyboard to efficiently fill in any field. - Create encrypted database files. - Organisation of credentials by entry and in group trees. - Allows opening and copying URI / URL fields quickly. - Dynamic templates for each type of entry. - History of each entry. - Precise management of settings. - Material design with themes. - Support for .kdb and .kdbx files (version 1 to 4) with AES - Twofish - ChaCha20 - Argon2 algorithm. - Compatible with the majority of alternative programs (KeePass, KeePassXC, KeeWeb, …). - Code written in native languages (Kotlin / Java / JNI / C). You can donate or buy the pro version for better service and a quick development of features you want: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kunzisoft.keepass.pro The project is constantly evolving. Do not hesitate to check the development status of the next updates: https://github.com/Kunzisoft/KeePassDX/projects Send issues to: https://github.com/Kunzisoft/KeePassDX/issues

name: NekoVideo
short: Open-source local video player with folders, private content and DLNA cast
description: NekoVideo is an open-source local video player for Android focused on privacy and folder-based organization. Features: * Browse videos by folders and subfolders * Support for common formats like MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WMV, M4V, 3GP and FLV * Private folders with password protection and biometric unlock support * Background playback, media notification and mini player * Double-tap seek, subtitle selection and audio track selection * Folder shuffle playback and "Open with" support * Picture-in-Picture (PiP) * DLNA/UPnP casting on the local network * MP4 metadata repair by remuxing without re-encoding * No ads and no tracking

name: Noty - Notes in Notification
short: Pin your notes to notifications — always visible, never forgotten.
description: Never forget a task again. Noty keeps your notes exactly where you look dozens of times a day — your notification shade. Write a note, and it instantly appears as a persistent notification in your status bar. It stays there until you're done with it. No need to open any app, set a reminder, or remember to check a list. KEY FEATURES 📌 Persistent Notifications Every note you create appears as a notification that stays in your status bar. Your notes are always one swipe away. 🔄 Survives Everything Notes are restored automatically after a phone restart. The app runs a lightweight background service to keep your notifications alive even after you close the app. ✏️ Add, Edit, Delete — Instantly Create notes with a title and optional description. Edit or delete any note with a tap. A confirmation step prevents accidental deletions. 📌 Pin or Unpin Anytime Choose which notes appear as notifications. Pin a note and it shows up in your status bar, locked in place until you remove it. Unpin it and it quietly moves back to the app — no notification, no clutter. Switch between pinned and unpinned at any time, directly from the notification or from the app. ⚡ Quick Settings Tile Add a "Quick Note" tile to your Quick Settings panel. Tap it to open the add-note screen without unlocking your phone or navigating to the app. 🎨 Material You Design Noty uses Material 3 with dynamic color — on Android 12 and above, the app automatically matches your wallpaper's color palette. Light, Dark, and System themes are all supported and persist across sessions. ⚙️ Make It Yours Open Settings to switch themes, toggle wallpaper-based dynamic color on Android 12 and above, and choose whether new notes start out pinned. Your choices are remembered between launches. 🔍 Search Your Notes Quickly filter your notes by title or description with the built-in search bar. ⏰ Reminders Set a one-time reminder on any note with a date and time picker. Noty fires a notification right on time using exact alarms, so you never miss it. 🔒 100% Private Noty is entirely local. No accounts, no cloud, no network access. Your notes never leave your device. PERMISSIONS EXPLAINED • Notifications — required to show your notes as persistent notifications • Run at Startup — used to restore your notes and reschedule reminders after your phone restarts • Foreground Service — allows Noty to keep notifications active in the background • Exact Alarms — used to deliver note reminders at the exact time you set No ads. N

name: NovaDial
short: Unlock a secure, open-source calling experience with NovaDialer
description: 📞 SMARTER CALLING, DESIGNED FOR CLARITY NovaDial is a privacy-focused phone application built for users who want a clean, reliable, and efficient calling experience. Based on Fossify Phone and developed as an independent fork, NovaDial introduces significant improvements to call management, usability, and performance while remaining completely free and open source. 🔒 PRIVACY FIRST Your phone app should work for you, not track you. NovaDial contains no ads, no trackers, no purchases, and no unnecessary data collection. Your call history, contacts, and communication remain under your control. 📋 REIMAGINED CALL HISTORY NovaDial introduces a redesigned call history system focused on speed and usability. Traditional call logs can become cluttered over time, displaying thousands of duplicate entries from the same contacts. NovaDial takes a different approach by organizing recent calls around unique callers instead of loading every historical call record at once. Benefits include: • Faster startup and smoother navigation • Cleaner recent calls interface • Reduced clutter from repeated call entries • Dedicated call details page for each contact • Complete call history available when needed Instead of displaying hundreds of repeated entries from the same caller in the main recent calls view, NovaDial shows a concise overview of your communication history. Detailed call records remain accessible through the dedicated call details screen. 🎨 MODERN AND USER-FRIENDLY DESIGN NovaDial introduces UI refinements focused on usability and clarity. The interface is designed to feel familiar while providing a more streamlined experience for daily phone usage. ⚡ FAST AND LIGHTWEIGHT Built to be efficient and responsive, NovaDial minimizes unnecessary data processing in the dialer and recent calls screens, helping maintain a smooth experience even for users with large call histories. 🌍 FULLY OPEN SOURCE NovaDial is open source software. Anyone can inspect the source code, contribute improvements, or help shape the future of the project. ❤️ COMMUNITY-DRIVEN DEVELOPMENT NovaDial is an independent fork of Fossify Phone, created to improve the calling experience through focused development and user-driven enhancements. Download NovaDial and enjoy a cleaner, faster, and more privacy-respecting phone experience. Open-Source Code: https://www.github.com/dhilipmpms/NovaDial

name: Open Recorder
short: Open-source screen recorder with internal audio and no internet access
description: Open Recorder is a simple, open-source screen recorder for Android with internal audio and a modern interface. No ads, no trackers, and no internet access: the app does not request the internet permission, so it cannot connect to the network. Your recordings stay on your device. Recording • Record your screen to MP4 files saved in Movies/Open Recorder • Audio: none, internal audio, microphone, or microphone and internal audio mixed together • Audio sample rate: 44.1 kHz or 48 kHz • Video codec: H.264 or H.265 • Resolution: native, 1080p, 720p, or 480p • Frame rate: automatic, 120, 90, 60, or 30 fps • Video bitrate: automatic, 4, 8, 16, or 24 Mbps • Orientation: automatic, portrait, or landscape • Optional 16:9 letterboxing that fits the full capture without cropping • Countdown before recording: off, 3, 5, or 10 seconds • Customizable file naming pattern Controls • Pause, resume, and stop from the notification • Quick Settings tile to start and stop recording • Keeps recording if you close the app • After saving, watch, share, or delete the video from the notification Recordings tab • Browse the videos recorded by Open Recorder • Sort by date, size, or duration • Select one, several, or all recordings and delete them Appearance • Light, dark, or follow-system themes • Dynamic color (Monet) variants of each theme Privacy • No internet permission • No ads, no analytics, no crash reporting, no tracking • Backups are disabled • Other apps are not allowed to capture Open Recorder's audio Limitations These come from Android itself, not from this app: • Android asks for your confirmation every time you start a recording • Apps that block capture (DRM video, banking apps, anything using FLAG_SECURE) can appear black or silent • Internal audio only includes apps that allow playback capture Requires Android 10 or later.

name: PGPony
short: OpenPGP encryption with hardware security keys and password-store support
description: PGPony is an OpenPGP app for Android. Encrypt, decrypt, sign, and verify messages and files, manage your keyring, and use a hardware security key over NFC, all on device. Features: - Encrypt, decrypt, sign, and verify text and files - Post-quantum encryption: ML-KEM-768 + X25519 (Kyber) composite keys, in both the IETF draft (v6) and LibrePGP / GnuPG 2.5 (v5) formats - OpenPGP provider service: use PGPony as the crypto engine for Thunderbird for Android, K-9 Mail, and Password Store (OpenKeychain-compatible API) - Generate modern keys, including RFC 9580 (OpenPGP v6) Ed25519 and X25519, with Argon2id passphrase protection - Hardware security keys over NFC, including YubiKey 5 NFC and Token2, with on-card key generation, decrypt, sign, PIN management, and factory reset - Read your password-store (pass) entries, including those protected by a hardware key - Encrypted keyring backup and restore, including OpenKeychain backup import - PGP/MIME email: decrypt messages with attachments, compose encrypted .eml - Key discovery through WKD and the keys.openpgp.org verifying keyserver; optional Tor routing via Orbot - Optional contact integration for choosing recipients - QR import and scanning for keys - Default signing key, biometric lock, and secure-screen protection Post-quantum limitations: Post-quantum OpenPGP is still being standardized, so cross-tool support is limited: - LibrePGP-format (v5) keys interoperate with GnuPG 2.5+ today: messages encrypt and decrypt in both directions, and public keys import cleanly. GnuPG cannot yet import post-quantum PRIVATE keys from any app — it stores them in a proprietary internal format. - IETF-format (v6) keys implement draft-ietf-openpgp-pqc and are verified against the draft's official test vectors, but current Sequoia (sq) preview builds implement a different draft revision and cannot read them yet, and GnuPG does not support this format at all. - Classical keys (RSA, Ed25519, v4 and v6) are unaffected. PGPony does not use accounts, ads, analytics, or tracking. The F-Droid build contains no Google services and runs fully on de-Googled devices. The cryptographic core is published separately as open source (PGPonyCore-Kotlin), and the full app source is available under the Apache-2.0 license.

name: Markdown Reader — PilcrowMD
short: Read & edit Markdown beautifully. No ads, no account, open source.
description: PilcrowMD is a beautiful, distraction-free Markdown reader and editor for Android. Open a .md file and read it the way it was meant to look - clean serif typography, a warm dark theme, and generous spacing that make long documents a pleasure to read on a phone. Built for the Markdown people actually deal with every day: answers from AI assistants, README files, technical docs, notes, and specs. If you save output from AI chat tools as Markdown, PilcrowMD renders it perfectly - headings, lists, tables, code, and math - instead of showing you raw symbols. WHY PILCROWMD - Beautiful reading first - premium serif type, a low-contrast dark theme, and layout tuned for real reading, not a cramped IDE. - Read AND edit - switch between a clean rendered preview and a real source editor with syntax highlighting, line numbers, and undo/redo. - Never loses your work - saving writes back exactly what you wrote, with no silent reformatting and no half-written files. Your file is safe. - Free, no ads, no account, no tracking - nothing to sign up for, nothing watching you. Fully open source (GPL-3.0). - Fast and offline - native Android, no browser engine, opens large files smoothly and works with no connection. Only Mermaid diagram rendering uses the internet. EVERYTHING MARKDOWN - Full CommonMark + GitHub Flavored Markdown - Tables, task lists, strikethrough, and links - Syntax-highlighted code blocks - LaTeX math ($$…$$) - YAML front matter - Wide tables and code scroll sideways without breaking the page READER TOOLS - In-document search with highlighted matches and next/previous - Auto-generated table of contents from your headings - Remembers your scroll position per file - Open .md straight from your file manager, share sheet, or email attachment - Adjustable text size and selectable reading fonts PERFECT FOR - Reading and saving answers from AI assistants and large language models - README files and project documentation on the go - Technical specs, notes, and meeting docs - Anyone who works with .md / .markdown files PilcrowMD opens .md, .markdown, and .txt files. No sign-up, no ads, no nonsense - just the cleanest way to read and edit Markdown on Android.

name: Resonance
short: Stream music from your Subsonic or Navidrome server
description: Resonance is a music player for self-hosted, Subsonic-compatible servers such as Navidrome. Connect to your server and stream your own library. Features Stream music from any Subsonic or Navidrome server Browse artists, albums, playlists, and genres A home screen of recently played, newest, most played, and random albums Play, pause, skip, seek, shuffle, and repeat Edit the play queue by adding, removing, and reordering tracks Download original song files to Music/Resonance/Artist/Album for use in a local music player Background playback with a notification and lock-screen controls Search artists, albums, and songs Star artists, albums, and songs and browse your favorites Artist pages with albums, tracks, a biography, and similar artists Synced and plain-text lyrics with auto-scroll Scrobble played tracks back to your server Several color themes Privacy No analytics, tracking, or advertising Network connections are initiated to the server you configure Fully open source under the GNU GPLv3

name: Vanilla
short: A cute and elegant calculator app for Android
description: Vanilla is a cute an elegant calculator app for Android!

name: Tsacdop - Podcast Player
short: Enjoy podcasts with Tsacdop! An open source podcast player built with flutter.
description: Tsacdop is a clean, simply beautiful and friendly podcast app. which is also free and open source. Why Tsacdop? Unique Design With Tsacdop, you will get a totally different experience with any other podcast players. Tsacdop has a unique layout and good-looking material design. Group management You can manage your podcasts with groups easily. Privacy Friendly Tsacdop is a free and open sourced application, which won't upload your data to the server. Easy Search The podcast is powered by ListenNotes(unavailable in fdroid version) and PodcastIndex, so you can search from more than 1 million podcasts. Features: * Podcasts group management * Playlist support * Sleep timer * OPML file export and import * Auto syncing in background * Listening and subscription history data * Dark theme / accent color * Download for offline play * Auto download / auto delete downloaded episodes * Change play speed * Skip silence * Boost volume More to come... License All this for FREE, and NO ADS. Tsacdop is an open source project licensed under GPL v3.0, you can star or fork it on GitHub: https://github.com/stonega/tsacdop Contact Tsacdop is still in the development stage, I am working hard on new features, if you have any issue or request any feature, please let me know by email or visit GitHub page.

name: MeshCore Signal Tester
short: Real-time mesh signal monitor for MeshCore companion radios & repeaters
description: MeshCore Signal Tester monitors mesh traffic from a MeshCore companion radio (over Bluetooth, USB-C, or Wi-Fi) or a MeshCore repeater (USB serial CLI) in real time. The connected device type is auto-detected. It is built for field signal testing: it keeps capturing received packets and your GPS position while the phone is in your pocket with the screen off. A foreground service holds the connection and location alive — something a normal mobile browser cannot do, because it freezes the page and drops the link when the screen turns off. Features: * Connect to a MeshCore companion over Bluetooth, USB-C serial, or Wi-Fi (a raw TCP link to the Wi-Fi firmware), or to a repeater over USB. * Group every reception by message, so you can see which repeaters forwarded the same packet and compare their signal side by side. * Seen-repeaters table with per-repeater RX count and max/last RSSI and SNR. * Scrolling SNR and RSSI history charts with a noise-floor estimate; zoom and pan the time axis. * Signal 3D map: each received packet is placed at your GPS location, with height encoding SNR; many map styles, or none. * Discover nearby nodes and read the SNR they measured for your uplink. * Received-packets table with full decoded detail and raw hex. * CSV export and re-import for offline review. * Persistent on-disk capture that survives a reload or restart. * Optional beep on each packet, auto-remove of old data, adjustable display window, repeater filter, keep-screen-on, device battery readout, and a light/dark theme. All captured data stays on your device. The app has no ads and uses no analytics and no tracking. Map tiles are fetched from third-party tile servers only while online. Free and open source (MIT). Source code: https://github.com/kybl/meshcore-signal-tester

name: AdaptKey
short: Privacy-first Android keyboard that learns your typing style. Fully offline.
description: AdaptKey is an adaptive Android keyboard (IME) that learns how you type - built for privacy first. Provably offline. No phoning home. AdaptKey has no internet permission at all. This is not a promise you have to take on faith - it is enforced by Android and verifiable by anyone: there is no INTERNET permission in the app manifest, so the operating system makes it impossible for the app to open a network connection. No telemetry, no analytics, no "anonymous usage statistics", no ads, no cloud sync. * No internet permission - kernel-enforced, not a checkbox you trust. * No storage permission - the optional local AI model is imported through the system file picker, which grants access to just that one file. * Everything runs on-device. Dictionaries, autocorrect, language detection and the optional mini-LLM all execute locally. * Free software, licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later - audit every line yourself. Features * Gboard-style QWERTZ/QWERTY layout with freely configurable key proportions (space bar, comma, full stop, backspace), a persistent number row, and per-key long-press secondary symbols. * Learns your touch pattern. A per-key personal offset model adapts hit detection to how you actually tap; an optional calibration step seeds it. * Smart suggestions and autocorrect from a personal on-device dictionary, with a stabilised suggestion bar, a "keep as typed" escape hatch, and one-tap post-commit undo. * Real multilingual dictionaries as optional downloadable language packs (German, English and Greek bundled to start with, more to follow), with on-device language detection that switches the whole lexicon per language. * Greek input with its own layout and accent long-press. * German capitalisation done right: sentence starts, nouns vs. proper nouns, hyphen segments, the e-mail-salutation comma rule, abbreviations, and a configurable shift-grace window. * Retroactive fixes: missed-space word split and spurious-space merge, driven by touch ambiguity. * Gestures: swipe to delete a whole word, swipe down to dismiss, drag a suggestion to trash to blacklist it, word-end shift for casing/camelCase. * Emoji panel with recents and a live keyword search (English and German). * Optional on-device mini-LLM (opt-in, work in progress): when the on-device dictionary is uncertain, a small local language model can improve predictions. It is never bundled or downloaded by the app - you import it yourself via the system file picker, and it stays fully offline afterwards. * Ba

name: MapFlip - Apple to Google
short: Redirect Apple Maps links to Google Maps. Fast Apple map redirect & converter.
description: Your friends send you Apple Maps links – but you use Google Maps? MapFlip is the ultimate Apple Maps converter, fast Apple map redirect, and link converter for Android. Set it up once, and everything works automatically as a seamless Google Maps redirect: Every Apple Map link, Apple Maps URL, or location opens directly in Google Maps. No copying, no pasting, no browser detours. Whether you need an Apple Maps for Android solution, an Apple to Google converter, or an automatic Apple to Google Maps converter, MapFlip handles all Apple Maps URLs in the background. Open Apple Maps links directly in your favorite navigation app. 🔧 How it works: 1. Open MapFlip 2. Tap "Open Settings" 3. Enable link forwarding for maps.apple.com 4. Done! Apple Maps links now open directly in Google Maps. ✨ Features & Privacy: • 🚗 Turn-by-Turn Navigation & Android Auto – Instantly launches native routing in Google Maps • 🧭 Choose Your Navigation App – Open destinations in Google Maps, Waze, Organic Maps, OsmAnd, or system picker • 🔄 Automatic Apple to Google redirect – Instant on-device link converter & map converter • 🔒 100% Offline & Private – Zero internet permissions (no android.permission.INTERNET), zero tracking, zero ads • ⏸️ Pause Mode & Quick Settings Tile – Suspend redirect anytime directly from your notification shade • 💬 Universal App Compatibility – Works seamlessly with WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, SMS, Slack, and email • 👻 Invisible Background Operation – No extra screens or battery drain 🗺️ Supported link formats & services: • Apple Maps URLs & search queries (maps.apple.com) • OpenStreetMap (osm.org), Bing Maps & Yandex Maps • GPS coordinates & shared locations • Addresses, place markers & navigation routes MapFlip was built for Android users who regularly receive Apple Maps links from iPhone users.

name: KeepADB
short: Keep Wireless Debugging active and toggle it from a tile or widget
description: KeepADB helps keep Android Wireless Debugging available across device restarts, Wi-Fi reconnects, access-point changes, and idle periods. Toggle Wireless Debugging from the main screen, a Quick Settings tile, or a home-screen widget. An optional foreground service monitors the connection and attempts recovery when Android disables it. Android may ask you to approve Wireless Debugging on a Wi-Fi network. If Android does not confirm an automatic enable, KeepADB backs off instead of retrying rapidly. Features: * Quick Settings tile, home-screen widget, and main app controls * Optional Keep-Alive service across restarts and network changes * Endpoint discovery through Android NSD/mDNS (_adb-tls-connect._tcp); timing depends on network conditions * Optional HTTP(S) webhook, disabled by default, for verified WLAN-ADB endpoints * Configurable status notification, endpoint display, and privacy mode to hide addresses in the app * Network (Beta) Wi-Fi and access-point tools, plus an optional trusted-network restriction * 19 interface languages and right-to-left layout support * No advertising, analytics, tracking, or third-party runtime libraries On fresh installs, trusted-network filtering is off, so Keep-Alive may use any connected Wi-Fi network. Enabling the restriction requires Android location access to identify networks. Android may mask that identity in the background, which can pause automatic recovery. KeepADB uses location access only to identify the Wi-Fi network; it does not read or store your location. When USB debugging is connected, KeepADB can show a USB notification and associate it with an editable host profile stored on the device. It can optionally offer or perform a USB-to-WLAN handover. USB profile data is not sent through the current webhook contract. KeepADB does not require root. Android protects Wireless Debugging with the WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission, so initial setup requires granting it once from a trusted computer with ADB: adb shell pm grant de.hohnepeople.keepadb android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS Wireless Debugging exposes an authenticated development service on the connected network. Use Keep-Alive on networks you trust, turn Wireless Debugging off on public hotspots, and reject unexpected Android approval or pairing prompts.

name: Squeeze Client
short: Client application for Squeezebox players on the Lyrion music server
description: Squeeze Client is an Android client/controller application for the Lyrion music server (formerly known as Logitech media server or Squeezebox server) with Material Design 3 UI. Features Music library browser Music library search quick access Playback and volume control Playlist management Multi-player management Music download Support for Light and dark theme as well as following system theme Full integration with system media controls

name: Fossy Protokoll
short: Document rental defects and build protocols — offline, no tracking.
description: Fossy Protokoll helps tenants in Germany keep a verifiable record of defects in their flat: noise disturbance, mould, heating failures and more. From the recorded occurrences it builds a protocol covering a chosen period, and a factual defect notification addressed to the landlord. Both can be saved and shared as PDF or Markdown. Note: the app is in German The interface and all generated documents are written in German, because they follow German residential tenancy practice. Not legal advice The app documents, it does not advise. The generated texts cite no statutes, claim no rent reduction and set no deadline of their own. A response date only appears when you enter one yourself. Everything stays on the device Data lives in a local database, photos in the app's private directory. The app requests no permission that touches your data or the device, never accesses the network, and contains no tracking or analytics. When you export something, you choose the destination yourself. Android's automatic backup is switched off as well, so your defects and photos never reach a cloud account. Instead you can create a full backup as a ZIP file at any time and restore it later, for instance when moving to a new phone. Without such a backup the data is lost if the device is. Features * Manage tenant profile, rental units and landlords * Record defects by category: noise, mould, heating, hot water, damp, sanitary, electrics, windows and doors, pests, other * Document individual occurrences with period, category, affected room, severity, impact, witnesses and notes * Attach photos to defects and to individual occurrences, with captions * Assemble protocols over a period and refresh them later * Generate a defect notification for the landlord * Export as PDF with embedded photos, or as Markdown * Full backup and restore as a ZIP file Free and open source The source code is available under GPL-3.0-or-later. The app uses no proprietary libraries.

name: Language Dex
short: Create custom dictionaries and retain words with puzzles.
description: Keep track of your growing vocabulary through custom dictionaries. Every word is defined by you! Each definition can be adapted over time as your understanding improves. Features: Specify part of speech, definitions, examples, and pronunciation for every word. Paste excerpts into the reader to see existing definitions and easily add new words. Practice with puzzles that test your knowledge, spelling, and ability to recall words. Specify your confidence level to affect how often a word appears in practice games. View language stats and share with friends.

name: VaultPony
short: Encrypted vaults you control, compatible with VeraCrypt.
description: VaultPony creates and opens encrypted containers on Android. A vault is a single encrypted file that holds a private filesystem, and only your password opens it. The containers are compatible with VeraCrypt, so you can open the same vaults on the desktop and back. There is no account, no cloud, and no network access. Your vaults are just files, kept wherever you choose. Features: * Create and open VeraCrypt-compatible containers, with a choice of cipher, hash (including Argon2id), and filesystem (FAT or exFAT). * Hidden volumes: conceal a second vault inside the first. Two passwords, and the outer one gives no sign the hidden one exists. The outer volume can be write-protected so normal use will not overwrite the hidden data. * Header backup and recovery, in-place password change, and keyfiles. * Biometric unlock, auto-lock when the app leaves the foreground, a hidden-screen mode that blocks screenshots, and a no-trace mode that remembers nothing. * Localized in English, German, Spanish, French, Russian, and Brazilian Portuguese, with live in-app switching. VaultPony is free and open source, built on a shared Rust core you can inspect. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by IDRIX; VeraCrypt is a registered trademark of IDRIX.

name: Tumblr Downloader
short: Download images and videos from Tumblr posts
description: Tumblr Downloader is an Android app that lets you download images and videos from Tumblr posts. Features: • Download media from Tumblr posts with a single link • Automatic clipboard detection for Tumblr URLs • Share from other apps to start downloading • Built-in WebView login to access private/restricted posts • Persistent cookies for session reuse across restarts • Download queue with pause/resume/retry support • Download history with Room database persistence • Built-in media viewer for images and videos • Custom save directory via Storage Access Framework • Multi-language support (English and Chinese) • Material Design 3 UI with dark mode support • Network-aware: auto-pauses on connection loss • Adult content detection and filtering Privacy: • Login credentials are stored locally using Android Keystore • No analytics or tracking • No ads • WebView blocks known third-party tracking domains during login • Fully open source under MIT license Support: • If you find this app useful, consider buying me a coffee: https://ko-fi.com/E0C822IGF6 Requires Android 11 or later.

name: SPRAWL//RUN
short: Cyberpunk story missions that chase you while you run. Offline, no trackers.
description: Your running app should not be a spreadsheet. It should be chasing you. SPRAWL//RUN is a gamified running tracker wrapped around two ten-mission cyberpunk campaigns. In Sprawl Prime you are a courier in a rain-slick megacity: a job on the Ninsei strip turns into carrying something that will not stop transmitting, and ends forty floors up a corporate arcology with an intelligence that has spent nineteen years counting a heartbeat that was not there. In Null Tide the southern districts are under water, something in a pump house has been apologising for nine seconds a night, and a salvage broker needs a piece of paper carried across the Drowned Mile before the sea comes home. YOUR MUSIC, INTERRUPTED Bring whatever you normally listen to. Every few minutes the app takes over the audio: a radio squelch, your music drops out, and your handler talks. Then it hands your music back. Nine characters across the two campaigns, each with a distinct synthesised voice, so you know who is speaking with the phone in your pocket. SOMEBODY IS CHASING YOU A drone tags your gait. Collections kick in a clinic door. A corporate trace walks the cooling loop toward you. To escape you have to beat your own pace from the last three minutes — never an arbitrary number, so a pursuit is a genuine effort whether you run 4:00/km or 7:00/km, and impossible at neither. Switch them off if you would rather just run. YOU SET THE TARGET Before each mission, choose a time or a distance. Twelve minutes or twenty-one kilometres — the story paces itself to fit. Reach the target and the operation succeeds; stop short and it stays open for another attempt. Overshoot freely, it all counts. TRACK EVERYTHING, SHARE NOTHING Distance, time, calories and cleared missions for the last week and month, with per-day bars and your full run log. Calories use the ACSM metabolic equations and your body mass, not an invented multiplier. Every run keeps its GPS trace. 60 achievements across six categories, and a weekly streak you define yourself in minutes, kilometres or missions. A week still in progress never breaks a streak — only a finished week that fell short does. The long view is there when you want it: step back through earlier weeks and months, see distance per month since your first run, and every day you ran laid out as a dot calendar. Any run replays its route at the pace you actually ran it, and exports as a GPX track for OsmAnd or anything else that reads a map. Everything is yours to take with you.

name: Pulse
short: Plan your own weekly workouts and keep every exercise offline
description: Pulse is a private, offline workout planner built around your training rules. Create custom workouts and assign them to any of the seven weekdays. Pulse uses your device's local date to show the correct workout for today, with a clear checklist for the exercises you complete. Build a reusable exercise library with custom muscle groups, equipment, tags, notes, cached reference images, and guide links. Images are fetched only after you expand an exercise, then kept on the device for offline viewing. Add exercises to a workout, set their sets, reps, weight, and rest targets, then drag them into the order you want. Your programme stays on your device. There are no accounts, ads, analytics, or trackers. Export the complete ledger as JSON whenever you want a portable backup, and import it again on another device. Pulse also includes all four Catppuccin flavours and their accent colours.

name: PlayOnDlna
short: Play your media ad-free on DLNA players in your local network!
description: Play your media ad-free on DLNA players such as Kodi and Smart TVs in your local network! Simply share a supported media link with PlayOnDlna. The app prepares compatible video or audio and streams it directly to your selected player. Supported sources include YouTube, YMusic, PeerTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, and media.ccc.de. 🌍 More Choice Enjoy media from your favorite platforms in one simple app. 🎧 Video and Audio PlayOnDlna prepares compatible media, cover artwork, and subtitles for your DLNA player. 🎶 Playlists That Just Work Enjoy continuous playback even when your player has no native playlist support. 📚 Your Media Library Keep prepared videos and audio ready to play again whenever you like. 📡 Simple Automatic discovery finds compatible players on your local network. Choose a player and control playback directly from the app. 💝 Ad-Free Enjoy your media without advertising interruptions. 👐 Transparent and Local Media is served directly from your Android device over your local network. The publicly available source code lets anyone verify the app's quality, privacy, and security. If the app serves you well, consider a 🎁 donation to support continued development. Kodi Setup To stream media to Kodi, make sure Kodi can be found as a DLNA player in your local network. 1. Go to ⚙ Settings > Services > UPnP DLNA 2. Enable Enable UPnP support 3. Enable Allow remote control via UPnP ❤️ Happy streaming! ❤️

name: oxproxion
short: Chat with OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio and llama.cpp AI models
description: Android chat application designed to interact with various Large Language Models (LLMs) 🤖 Multi-Model Support: Switch between different LLM bots and models. 🤖 Chat with OpenRouter models or locally served models using Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp or MLX LM. 💬 Chat Interface: A clean and intuitive interface for conversing with AI models. 💾 Save & Load Chats: Save your chat sessions and load them later to continue the conversation. 📤📥 Import & Export: Easily import and export your chat histories. ⚡ Streaming or Non-Streaming Responses: You choose! 🖼️ Chat with Images: With models that support it! 🖼️ Image Generation**: With models that support it! ✍️ System Message Customization: Create, edit, and manage a library of system messages to guide the AI's behavior and persona. 🔗 OpenRouter Integration: Long-press the model name to open the OpenRouter models list in your browser. Long-press the API key icon to view your remaining OpenRouter credits. 📋 Effortless Copying: Press any avatar to copy the corresponding response to the clipboard. oxproxion app does not have trackers, analytics, nor ads. 📄 On-Device PDF Export: Generate a PDF of that specific response. Or use menu PDF button for full chat PDF. PDFs created locally using Android's native tools. ✨And Much More! Download and check it out. See Help section in the app for the complete guide. 🛠️ Built with Modern Tech: 100 % Kotlin, leveraging Jetpack libraries, Coroutines for asynchronous tasks, and Ktor for networking. If you find this app useful, please consider supporting its developer: [Buy Me a Coffee](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/oxproxion) ☕

name: boxorg
short: Declutter meditatively — photograph, frame, pack, find it again.
description: Take a photo of your stuff, frame each item with your finger, put it in the box, type in the number. With every frame your head gets a little clearer. And you get to rethink: your boxes don't need themes anymore. Instead of a tool box, a toy box and "miscellaneous" there are just numbers — you pack what fits into the box, not necessarily what belongs together thematically. That way you use every box down to the last corner. boxorg remembers where things are. Looking for something? Type a term or a box number — boxorg shows you the photo and the box it is in. FIND IT AGAIN • Search by label: TOOLS, DECOR, CHARGER • Or by box: #12 shows everything in box 12 • Every match comes with a picture — you recognize your things at a glance YOUR DATA IS YOURS • Everything stays on your device: no cloud, no account, no tracking • Works completely offline • No data is collected FREE FOREVER boxorg is open source — no ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases. PERFECT FOR • Moving: pack boxes and still get to everything • Basement, attic and storage room • Seasonal stuff: decorations, ski gear, camping equipment • Collections and workshop supplies THE STORY BEHIND BOXORG Release video on YouTube (German): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CQMRFCfodpo

name: SlimSocial for Facebook
short: Browse Facebook
description: Wrapper around Facebook's mobile website and APIs. * It is lightweight: it weighs less than 100 Kb * It has simple, modern design: there is only what you need * It is Open source: the code of this app is online on GitHub, anyone can verify the authenticity of the app and contribute to its development. * It is free and without ads * it is not intrusive * It respect your privacy: this app doesn't require special permits. Without consensus Facebook can not access to any data of your mobile phone

name: Lissen: Audiobookshelf client
short: Clean Audiobookshelf Player
description: Listen to your favorite audiobooks through a minimalist app designed for one task Sync your listened books between devices and other Audiobookshelf players and download books to listen to them without the Internet

name: KDE Connect
short: KDE Connect integrates your smartphone and computer
description: KDE Connect provides a set of features to integrate your workflow across devices: - Transfer files between your devices. - Access files on your phone from your computer, without wires. - Shared clipboard: copy and paste between your devices. - Get notifications for incoming calls and messages on your computer. - Virtual touchpad: Use your phone screen as your computer's touchpad. - Notifications sync: Access your phone notifications from your computer and reply to messages. - Multimedia remote control: Use your phone as a remote for Linux media players. - WiFi connection: no USB wire or bluetooth needed. - End-to-end TLS encryption: your information is safe. Please note you will need to install KDE Connect on your computer for this app to work, and keep the desktop version up-to-date with the Android version for the latest features to work. Sensitive permissions information: * Accessibility permission: Required to receive input from another device to control your Android phone, if you use the Remote Input feature. * Background location permission: Required to know to which WiFi network you are connected to, if you use the Trusted Networks feature. KDE Connect never sends any information to KDE nor to any third party. KDE Connect sends data from one device to the other directly using the local network, never through the internet, and using end to end encryption. This app is part of an open source project and it exists thanks to all the people who contributed to it. Visit the website to grab the source code.

name: yadaw
short: A multiplatform sfx creator with no plugin GUI
description: A basic DAW for sound effects and music production. Would recommend using it with a connected keyboard and/or mouse, as drag and keyboard shortcuts play a major role here. Uses CLAP and LV2 (not on fdroid) plugins - no built-in effects to keep it minimal and lightweight. Features: - Multi-track audio recording and editing - MIDI input with piano roll editor - Plugin hosting (CLAP/LV2 instruments and effects) - Automation lanes for parameter control - Timeline-based arrangement - Mixer with track controls - WAV/Ogg/Flac import/export - Cross-platform: Linux, Windows, macOS, Android - Lightweight, is under 20MB in apk size.

name: Fairphone Moments
short: Fairphone Moments a minimalist way to use your phone with less distraction.
description: Fairphone Moments is a brand new minimalist experience to use your Fairphone with fewer distractions. This gives you the freedom to disconnect when you want and stay fully present in real life or customize moments fitted to your own experiences, such as focus and travel modes.

name: My Expenses
short: Easy to use personal finance manager: rich functionality and Open Source
description: My Expenses is your ultimate tool for effortless expense tracking and financial management, right at your fingertips! Key Features: • Effortless Expense Tracking : Keep tabs on your expenses and income seamlessly, whether you're on your smartphone or tablet. • Flexible Account Management : Effortlessly manage multiple accounts, including transfers between different currencies. • Streamlined Financial Planning : Easily set up plans for recurring transactions. • Seamless Data Management : Export and import data with ease using QIF and CSV formats. • Enhanced Security : Protect your data with password or device lock screen security. • Customizable Experience : Tailor the app to your preferences with customizable themes and font sizes. • Bank Statement Reconciliation : Easily compare transaction status with your bank statements for accurate financial tracking. • Quick Data Entry : Enjoy convenient access with homescreen widgets and shortcuts. • Powerful Data Analysis : Filter your data based on various criteria and visualize distribution and historical trends with dynamic graphs. Unlock Premium Features: • Contrib Key : Unlock unlimited accounts, recurring transaction plans, and more. • Extended Key : Enjoy cloud synchronization, automated backups, and sophisticated CSV imports. • Professional Key : Take your financial management to the next level with budgeting tools, receipt scanning, and email support. My Expenses requires the following permissions : • Calendar : Plans for future and recurrent transactions are stored either in a special local calendar or in any other calendar you assign. • Internet : Anonymous usage tracking, Crash reports, Cloud synchronization. • Accounts : Synchronization across devices via cloud services. Take control of your finances like never before using My Expenses !

name: GeoShare: Jump Between Maps
short: Open map links in other map apps and copy coordinates
description: Share a map link with GeoShare and the app will open it in another installed map app. Supported map links - Google Maps - Apple Maps - 2GIS - Amap (AutoNavi) - Baidu Map (beta) - Cartes IGN - CoMaps - HERE WeGo - Magic Earth - Maps.me - Mapy.com - OpenStreetMap - Organic Maps - OsmAnd - Plus Codes (global only) - Urbi - Waze - Yandex Maps - coordinates Example use cases When someone sends you a Google Maps link, but you prefer using OpenStreetMap, you can quickly open the same location in OsmAnd or Organic Maps. When you like Google Maps for finding places, but you prefer a different app for navigation, you can easily switch from Google Maps to your favorite navigation app . Other features - Shows the geographic coordinates of a map link and allows copying them to clipboard in various formats, for example as a geo: link. - Shows all points of a place list link. - Allows performing an action automatically when a map link is processed. - Allows launching navigation in all apps that support it, including TomTom. - Allows opening a location in web maps , pre-installed ones or your own. - Allows saving a location as a GPX file . - Allows sending a location via a messaging app . - Allows saving a location to a contact . - Retries on patchy internet connection . - Allows pasting map links directly into the app, instead of sharing them with it. - Interface adapts to tablets . How it works and privacy considerations GeoShare converts map links (e.g. https://maps.app.goo.gl/...) into geo: links that can be opened by other map apps. To create a geo: link, geographic coordinates are required. GeoShare extracts them from the map URL. However, not all map URLs include coordinates. In such cases, GeoShare will prompt you for permission to connect to the map service (Google Maps, Apple Maps etc.) and retrieve the coordinates from either HTTP headers or the HTML document of the link. For more detailed information, check the app’s FAQ screen.

name: FlickBoard
short: The Predictable Keyboard
description: FlickBoard is a keyboard for Android that doesn’t try to correct or predict you. It doesn’t have an opinion on the correct spelling or tone. It certainly doesn’t use any AI. Because it trusts you to write what you meant to write. Instead, FlickBoard uses swipes to get away with using vastly fewer (and larger!) buttons than a traditional QWERTY keyboard, helping you build muscle memory, minimize typos, and touch type faster. Type the letters in the center of a key by tapping it. Type the keys in the corners by swiping in that direction. It’s that simple! FlickBoard is inspired by MessagEase and Thumb-Key .

name: Haven SSH Client
short: SSH terminal, Wayland desktop, VNC/RDP, cloud storage & SFTP for Android
description: Haven is an open-source SSH, VNC, RDP, and SFTP client for Android with a native Wayland desktop and cloud storage. Terminal: - Full VT100/xterm emulator with Unicode, multiple tabs, and 6 color schemes - Session persistence via tmux, zellij, screen, or byobu - Mouse mode for TUI apps (vim, htop, mc) - Configurable keyboard toolbar with Esc, Ctrl, Alt, arrows, function keys, and custom macros - Text selection with word expansion, copy, and clickable URL detection - Voice input and autocomplete mode - Mosh and Eternal Terminal for roaming and persistent connections Native Wayland Desktop: - GPU-accelerated labwc compositor running directly on your device - Waybar panel, fuzzel app launcher, thunar file manager, mousepad editor - Starter Pack addon with Firefox, calculator, image viewer - XWayland for X11 app compatibility - Multi-desktop management — run multiple desktops simultaneously - No root required (PRoot with Alpine Linux) VNC Remote Desktop: - VNC viewer with pinch-to-zoom, pan, and fullscreen mode - SSH tunnel support for encrypted connections - Touch-to-click with drag gesture support RDP Remote Desktop: - Connect to Windows Remote Desktop, xrdp, and GNOME Remote Desktop - Pinch-to-zoom, keyboard with scancode mapping - SSH tunnel with auto-connect through saved profiles Cloud Storage: - 60+ providers via rclone — Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, S3, and more - OAuth authentication with browser flow - Folder sync with filters, bandwidth limits, and dry-run preview - Media streaming to VLC via local HTTP server - DLNA server for smart TVs and Chromecast File Transfer: - SFTP browser with upload, download, rename, delete, and folder transfer - SMB/Windows file share browsing with optional SSH tunnel - Cross-filesystem copy between any backends Networking: - SSH with auto-reconnect, port forwarding, and ProxyJump multi-hop - Tailscale peer auto-discovery - Reticulum mesh network support via rnsh - Network discovery for SSH hosts on local network Security: - SSH key generation (Ed25519, RSA, ECDSA) with encrypted storage - FIDO2 hardware key support (ed25519-sk, ecdsa-sk) via NFC or USB - Biometric app lock with configurable timeout - Connection audit log - No ads, no tracking, no data collection Haven is free and open source (AGPLv3).

name: Trailence
short: Your hiking companion and GPS track manager. Open source, no trackers.
description: Your hiking companion and GPS track manager. Open to all your outdoor activities: hiking, trail running, cycling, ski touring, walking… Free and open source, no ads, no trackers — your data stays yours. On Android and the Web. Plan, record, organize, analyze and share your trails: • Offline maps • IGN, OSM basemaps, … • Import / export GPX • Trail printing • Geotagged photos • Elevation profile • Tags & collections • Search & filters • Live group tracking • Waypoints • Web ↔ Android sync • Sharing & links • Estimated walking time • Path waymarking • Trail markers • Path surfaces & types • Distance & time remaining • Trail creation • Map rotation • Track editor • and much more… And an open trail database, documented and verified, to build together.

name: Knit
short: Encrypted mesh chat over Wi-Fi Aware & Bluetooth — no internet, no servers.
description: Knit is a messenger that works with no internet, no cell service, and no accounts. It connects directly to the phones around you over Wi-Fi Aware and Bluetooth, passing messages device to device. When you send a message, nearby phones receive it and pass it onward to the phones around them — so your words hop across a crowd, a building, or a campsite, far past your own range. The more people using Knit nearby, the further it travels. WHY KNIT • No internet or mobile data required • No account, phone number, or email to sign up • No central server — nothing to shut down, monitor, or leak • No ads, tracking, analytics, or Google Play Services • Free software — anyone can read what the app does PERFECT FOR • Festivals and crowded venues where signal dies • Travel, flights, ships, camping, and the backcountry • Power outages and emergencies when networks fail PRIVATE BY DESIGN Direct and group chats are end-to-end encrypted. Each message is sealed so only the people in it can read it — every phone that carries it onward, and every relay, sees only ciphertext. Keys are generated on your device, protected by hardware-backed Android security. Confirm who you're talking to with a safety number or a QR scan. ABOUT THE PERMISSIONS Knit asks for nearby-devices (location before Android 13) as Android needs it to find peers over Wi-Fi Aware and Bluetooth LE and reach a paired radio. Location is read only when you tap Send location. INTERNET is declared because Android counts the local Wi-Fi Aware socket as network access, and because relays and link previews use it once switched on. No account, no backend: a fresh install makes no network calls. FREE SOFTWARE Knit is released under the GNU General Public License v3 or later; the full source is at github.com/getknit/knit. FEATURES • Public "Nearby" room to broadcast to everyone in range • Private 1:1 messages (end-to-end encrypted) • Multi-member groups (end-to-end encrypted) • Quoted replies, emoji reactions, and @-mentions • Image sharing, including GIFs • Voice notes, files of any type, and big files phone to phone over Wi-Fi • Search every chat, contact, and message • Encrypted backup for a new phone • Store-and-forward: messages wait until someone is back in range • Add a contact from a link when you're too far apart to scan • Optional Meshtastic LoRa radio for far longer range (see below) • Optional Internet relays, off until you turn them on (see below) • Share the app itself to a nearby phone, no app store neede

name: Maskan — Private AI Chat
short: Private BYOK AI chat. 11 providers, voice, image, export. 3 languages.
description: Maskan (مسكن) — Private multi-provider AI chat for Android. Bring your own API key from OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, Mistral, OpenRouter, Together AI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint including local models (Ollama, LM Studio). Your conversations stay on your device. Your API keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM via Android Keystore. The app's network access is locked to only the providers you've enabled. Features: • 11 AI providers supported (cloud and local) • Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) — no subscriptions, no proxy server • Image input — send photos to vision-capable models (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini) • Voice input — speech-to-text in Arabic, English, and Thai • Voice narration — hear AI responses read aloud • Export conversations as plain text or markdown • Search conversations by title and message content • Stop generation — cancel AI responses mid-stream • 3 languages — English, Arabic, Thai • All API keys encrypted on device • Conversation history stored locally only • 12 system prompt presets • Dialect-aware Arabic translation (MSA, Levantine, Egyptian, Gulf, Maghrebi) • English↔Thai translation presets • Classical Arabic literary helper • Folder organization with custom pastel colors • Full Arabic UI with RTL layout • No Google Play Services dependency • No analytics, no trackers, no telemetry • FOSS — GPL-3.0

name: Password Store (Passkey Edition)
short: Manage your passwords
description: Pass-compatible password manager that stores passwords as encrypted (OpenPGP) text files. A community continuation of the original pass: project (GPL-3.0-only). This app can also act as an Android WebAuthn/passkey Credential Provider, allowing stored credentials to satisfy passkey requests from other apps. Features: Clone an existing pass repository or start a new one Create and organize password files Sync with a remote Git repository Decrypt and copy passwords Automatically fill and save credentials in apps and supported browsers Supports time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) for two-step authentication Provides WebAuthn/passkey authentication to other apps

name: Sterna Mail
short: Private email client for JMAP and IMAP/SMTP. No Google services, no tracking.
description: Sterna Mail is a free, private email client for Android. It is built for JMAP, the modern successor to IMAP, and works just as well with any IMAP/SMTP provider. No tracking, no ads, no Google services. The code is GPLv3, and F-Droid checks that the app it ships is byte for byte the one built from the published source. Reading: * Several accounts, JMAP and IMAP side by side, with a unified inbox that works offline * Conversations, search as you type and snooze Writing: * Several identities, each with its own signature * Undo send and scheduled send Privacy and security: * OpenPGP encryption through an app such as OpenKeychain * Remote images and tracking pixels blocked by default, app lock with fingerprint or PIN Setup and notifications: * Setup from your email address alone, or a manual form when the domain publishes nothing * Push notifications without Google, over JMAP, IMAP IDLE or UnifiedPush * Available in ten languages

name: OpenDocument Reader
short: Document reader & file editor for Libreoffice & OpenOffice | ODF: ODT, ODS +more
description: View and modify documents created using LibreOffice or OpenOffice on the go using the Document Reader & Document Editor! 📄🚶 The file reader & document editor allows you to open files like ODF (Open Document Format) documents created using LibreOffice or OpenOffice wherever you are. In the bus on your way to school wanting to look at your notes before the big exam? No problem! With the Document Reader you can open files wherever you like and read & search through your documents to go in a clean and simple way.
