name: SOS Ring
short: Make VIP calls and messages audible even in Silent/DND
description: SOS Ring makes calls and supported direct messages from VIP contacts audible even if your phone is in Silent, Vibrate, or Do Not Disturb mode. Perfect for families where someone always keeps their phone on silent but needs to be reachable in emergencies. HOW IT WORKS: • Add your VIP contacts (family, partner, etc.) • Enable the monitoring service • When a VIP contact calls, SOS Ring overrides Silent/DND mode, plays the ringtone at your chosen volume (25-100%), and vibrates • Optionally pair their direct WhatsApp, SMS/RCS, or Telegram conversation and choose a separate message volume (5-100%) and sound • After the alert ends, your phone is restored to its original state — silent mode, DND, volumes, everything WHY THIS APP EXISTS: Android 14+ removed per-contact DND exceptions. No built-in way exists to let specific contacts bypass silent mode. Google restricts READ_CALL_LOG on the Play Store, so this type of app can't be published there. SOS Ring is free, open source, and works where others can't. FEATURES: • Pick VIP contacts from your phonebook or enter manually; select any or all numbers for contacts with multiple numbers • Configurable call override volume (25-100%) • Sound from the first VIP call or the second within 3, 5 or 10 minutes, with per-number exceptions • Optional volume doubling between successive calls when the base volume is below 50%, capped at 100% • Optional VIP message alerts for WhatsApp, Google Messages (SMS/RCS), and Telegram • Separate message sound toggle, volume (5-100%), and Android default or VIP contact sound • Works in Silent, Vibrate, AND Do Not Disturb mode • Full state restore after call (including alarm volume) • Quiet Hours and the temporary mute timer stop both call and message overrides • Survives phone reboots (auto-start) • Minimal battery usage (event-driven, no polling) • Dark mode support • No ads or tracking REPEATED CALLS: The default remains the first call. Choose the mode in Settings, Home or each VIP's menu. Only distinct cellular calls from the same number count; answering or pausing resets the sequence. The window does not slide. Messages do not count and stay silent during cellular calls. Pending counts use local hashed identifiers, expire within the window and are excluded from exports. See the README for details. LOCATION SHARING (optional, peer-to-peer): • No SOS Ring server required — you pick a UnifiedPush distributor app (e.g. ntfy on F-Droid); it relays only encrypted data • End-to-end encrypted usi

name: Hermes Mobile
short: Remote control for your Hermes AI agent
description: A native Android companion app for Hermes Agent — the open-source, multi-platform AI assistant by Nous Research. Manage your Hermes agent directly from your phone over your trusted LAN, without needing to pull out a laptop or switch to another messaging platform. Features: • Real-time chat via WebSocket with markdown rendering • Switch between AI models and providers on the fly • Monitor system logs with filtering • Manage profiles and settings • Pull-to-refresh for live updates • Notification support for incoming messages • Material You dynamic theming (Android 12+) • Works entirely on your trusted LAN — no internet required All network communication uses cleartext HTTP/WebSocket by design, since the app is intended for trusted local networks only.

name: Nextcloud Talk
short: Have private video calls and chat using your own server.
description: Use Nextcloud Talk to have one-on-one or group audio or video calls, create or join web conferences and send chat messages. All communication is fully encrypted and mediated by your own server, providing the highest degree of privacy possible. Nextcloud Talk is easy to use and will always be completely free! Nextcloud Talk supports: * HD (H.265) audio/video calls * Group and one-on-one calls * Webinars & public web meetings * Individual and group chat * Easy screen sharing * Mobile apps for Android and iOS * Mobile call & chat push notifications (only if installed from Google Play) * Integration in Nextcloud Files and Nextcloud Groupware * Fully on-premise, completely open source * End-to-end Encrypted calls * Scaling to millions of users * SIP gate: dial in by phone The Nextcloud Talk app requires a Nextcloud Talk server to function. Nextcloud is a private, self-hosted file sync and communication platform, designed to put you back in control over your data. It runs on a server of your choice, be it at home, at a service provider or in your enterprise, and gives you access to your documents, calendars, contacts, email and other data. You can share with others even across different Nextcloud servers and work together on documents. Nextcloud is fully open source, giving you the option to extend them for your own use, participate in their development or simply verify they do what we promise. Millions of users use Nextcloud daily at businesses and homes around the world. Business users rely on the professional support of Nextcloud GmbH, making sure they have a fully supported, enterprise-ready platform for productivity and collaboration, fully under control of their IT department. Learn more on https://nextcloud.com/talk Find Nextcloud on https://nextcloud.com

name: reReminder
short: Open-source recurring reminders, many timers, own schedules, no tracking.
description: reReminder keeps you in the loop. Set up as many recurring reminders as you need — a nudge to correct your posture, a break every hour, water, medication, a Pomodoro timer, and let each one run on its own schedule. Several reminders, side by side Run "Take a walk" every 50 minutes and "Sit or stand" every 20 minutes at the same time. Every reminder has its own interval, name, message and color, and counts down independently, changing one never disturbs the others. One master switch pauses everything and shows you which reminder is up next. Reminders that fit your day Limit a reminder to certain weekdays and to a time window, for example Monday to Friday between 08:00 and 17:00. Windows may cross midnight for night shifts. Outside its window a reminder stays quiet and tells you when it starts again. Schedules are optional, a new reminder simply runs at any time. Notification text that writes itself Drop values into your message, and they are filled at the moment the reminder fires: the current time, the date, the weekday, the reminder's name, its interval, or when the next one is due. A live preview shows the result while you type. Made to actually fire reReminder uses exact alarms that survive Doze, reboots, app updates and timezone changes, and it arms the next alarm before it even shows the current one, so the loop cannot break. A reliability check in the settings tells you whether the system is holding your reminders back, and takes you straight to the setting that fixes it. Features: Unlimited reminders: each with its own interval, from one minute to many hours. Schedules: pick weekdays and a daily time window per reminder. Dynamic text: insert time, date, weekday, name, interval or next due time. Text-to-Speech: have your reminder read aloud, in your device language. Personalized alerts: choose a notification sound or vibration pattern, and mute either one per reminder. Master switch: pause everything at once without losing your setup. Material 3 design: dynamic colors on Android 12+, full dark mode. English and German , with per-app language support. Private by design: no ads, no tracking, no accounts, no network access. Everything stays on your device. reReminder is free and open source. 🇪🇺 Made with passion in Europe.

name: Pagan
short: A Mobile Music Sequencer
description: Pagan is a music sequencer tailored to mobile devices. It uses a simplistic but self-evident notation scheme to save vertical space. Pagan was created with the intent of being able to quickly jot down a tune then come back and work on it at your own pace rather than getting out your instruments or booting up an entire DAW. * No staffs, No piano-roll, No keyboard * Use your own soundfonts (.sf2) and use multiple at once * Import, reorchestrate and export .mid files * Connect to and playback through Midi devices * Variable step sizes for intuitive polyrhythms * Adjustable tone count and tuning * Export .wav files ==== Made without genAI. ==== Music is an expression of human experience. Our instruments should be too.

name: Flac-R
short: Perfect your collection.
description: Whether you're organizing a massive local music library, fixing messy metadata, or curating your perfect playlist, Flac-R helps you to keep your local music collection top-notch. With support for .mp3 .flac .m4a .ogg .opus & .aac Flac-R will seamlessly edit tags, manage embedded album art, & help organize your audio files with a clean, intuitive tool, giving you complete and total control over your local music library.

name: Dosezy
short: Track your medications, get timely reminders, and manage your health with ease.
description: Dosezy is an accessible, offline-first medication tracking and reminder app designed for stress-free prescription management. Input your medicines, dosages, and schedules, and Dosezy handles the rest—keeping your health on track with zero privacy compromises. ✨ KEY FEATURES: • 🔔 Critical Full-Screen Alarms – High-visibility alarm screen rings reliably even in deep sleep or silent mode. Intercept with hardware volume keys to instantly silence audio, or use the back gesture to safely snooze. • 🎵 Customizable Sound & Duration – Choose custom ringtones or built-in alert tones with in-app audio previews, dedicated alarm volume controls, and adjustable alarm durations (30 seconds to 5 minutes or continuous looping). • ⏰ Dynamic Snooze & Time Windows – Flexible snooze presets (5, 10, 15, 20, or 30 minutes). Configure custom "Consider Late After" (1–3h) and "Consider Missed After" (3–9h) thresholds with live countdown badges. • 📝 Clinical Dose Skipping – Opt-in dose skipping with mandatory clinical reasons (doctor advised, adverse reactions, fasting, illness). Skipped doses do not penalize your adherence streak and can be undone at any time. • ↩️ Instant Intake Undo – Accidental taps can be reversed immediately with a 5-second undo snackbar or directly from the dose card, restoring deducted stock automatically. • 📦 Pill Stock Inventory & Refill Warnings – Real-time stock tracking with automatic deduction on intake. Configurable low-stock alerts notify you when it is time to refill prescriptions. • 🛒 Pharmacy Refill Order Generator – Instantly compile prescription refill orders from your active inventory and low-stock medicines. Calculate required supplies for 15, 30, 60, or 90 days, preview the formatted order, and share directly via chat or copy to clipboard. • 📅 Interactive Schedule Calendar – Week and month calendar views with color-coded compliance dots and complete TalkBack screen reader accessibility announcing dose statuses. • 📊 Adherence Analytics – Comprehensive compliance tracking across Today, 7 Days, 30 Days, 90 Days, and All-Time. Multi-ring breakdowns and individual medication adherence rates. • 🔍 Real-Time Medicine Search – Quickly filter large medication rosters by name or instruction with instant empty-state feedback. • 👥 Multi-Family Profiles – Manage medicines for multiple family members on one device. Each profile keeps separate medicines, schedules, inventory, and doctor contacts. • 🔒 Full ZIP Backup & Selective Restore – Export comp

name: Quotes.app
short: A minimalistic quotes app
description: A minimalistic quotes app with Tinder-like swipeable cards, delivering inspiration & positive energy in your life Features ✨ fresh motivational quotes daily 📝 Add and customize your own quotes 🎨 Customize quotes with your fav style 📂 save favorites offline 📤 share quotes with friends & family 🏠 home screen widget (auto-refreshes every 24hrs) 🔔 daily inspiration via notifications

name: WAFRN
short: The social network that respects you
description: Wafrn is a social media app inspired by Tumblr that connects you with your friends all over the world. No matter which platform, wafrn can connect with all fediverse software and also Bluesky. Join us and help us make the internet a better place for everyone.

name: Punch-hole Download Progress
short: Xposed module showing download progress around the camera cutout
description: Xposed module that renders download progress as an animated ring around the camera cutout. Hooks system download notifications and renders them with configurable colors, animations, and haptic feedback. Supports an active download counter, an optional speed label showing how fast the device is receiving data, battery saver-aware rendering, per-rotation (0°/90°/180°/270°) calibration for text and badge offsets, and optional vertical filename text in landscape. Requires Android 9+, LSPosed, and a Pixel/AOSP-based ROM (other ROMs may not work as expected).

name: Fokus Launcher
short: Minimal launcher with clock, weather, fast app search, and gesture navigation.
description: Fokus Launcher is an Android launcher for people who want a simpler, cleaner default experience. It focuses on fast access to time, weather, and core apps with minimal visual noise. Home Screen The home screen is intentionally minimal: a large clock and date, battery status, optional weather, configurable favorite app labels, and a configurable right-side shortcut rail. Tap the clock, date, or weather to open the apps you configure for each in settings. Primary interactions are gesture-based: swipe up to open the app drawer, swipe down to expand the notification shade, and swipe left or right to launch shortcut targets. App Drawer The drawer supports quick search, categories you define in settings, and optional alphabetical or most-opened app order. When only one app matches a search, Fokus can launch it directly. Optional category sidebar mode replaces the inline search bar with a vertical category rail; use the search icon when you need text search. Long-pressing an app offers add to home, rename, hide, and uninstall. Dot search keeps you in that same field for web or in-app search. Type a period, a space, and your query, for example ". cats"; that searches in your browser by default until you change the default under Dot search in settings. For letter shortcuts, type a period, one lowercase letter, a space, and your query, for example ".a coffee" when you assigned the letter "a" there. Dot search settings also list search-capable apps and lets you add HTTPS or deep-link URL templates with a placeholder for the query. Customization Edit home apps, configure right-side shortcuts (including launcher shortcut actions), hide or rename apps, choose a custom font, and manage launcher data from the settings screen. Weather Weather is powered by Open-Meteo. No account or API key is required. Results are cached for 30 minutes. Location permission is optional and only used for local weather. Work Profile Work profile apps are shown alongside personal apps in the drawer when a work profile is active on the device. Private Space (Android 15+) On Android 15 and above (API 35+), Fokus supports Android's Private Space with lock/unlock controls and a separate section in the app drawer for private apps when the space is unlocked. Optional Device Controls These features only work if you turn on accessibility for Fokus in Android settings. Double tap to lock can turn off the screen from empty home space. Return home after long lock can bring Fokus back to the foreground on

name: Wind Bubble
short: See where the wind hits you, on top of your navigation app.
description: Wind Bubble floats a small dial on top of your navigation app and shows where the wind hits you relative to your direction of travel: headwind, crosswind or tailwind. The dial is locked on your heading — the top is always where you are going — and a coloured marker sits on the ring at the angle the wind comes from: red straight in your face, amber across, green pushing you along. Features: * Floating bubble over any app, draggable, tap to expand a short summary * Live wind, gusts and temperature from Open-Meteo (no account, no API key) * Head/tail and crosswind components, with the side it blows from * Speed in km/h, mph, m/s or knots * Adjustable refresh interval, bubble size and opacity * No tracking, no analytics, no advertising Your position never leaves the device except as coordinates rounded to a coarse grid, sent to Open-Meteo to fetch the local wind. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com, licensed under CC BY 4.0.

name: Nora
short: SNS browser. Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, Threads, X and more in a single app.
description: Features Multiple accounts with separate cookie storage Blocklist (EasyList and EasyPrivacy) Download image Download fb/ig reel Usage limits Select text Zoom Remove tracking url query params Supported SNS Bluesky Facebook Instagram LinkedIn Reddit Threads TikTok Tumblr VK X (Twitter) How it works Wrap the SNS websites in Android webview Inject code to block ads

name: News Provider
short: A simple and easy to use RSS aggregator that deliver news to your smartphone
description: A simple and easy to use RSS aggregator that deliver news to your smartphone Easily add new feed using shortcut Support RSS XML Support Atom XML Support background sync Simple interface to add and read your news Support dark mode and light mode Accessibility friendly with one hand mode Accessibility friendly on screen reader (tested with TalkBack)

name: Mullvad VPN: privacy is a universal right
short: Protect your online privacy with a fast, trustworthy, and easy-to-use VPN.
description: Free the internet from data collection with Mullvad VPN – a service that helps keep your online activity, identity, and location private. Only €5/month. Get started 1. Install the app. 2. Create an account. 3. Add time to your account via our website or vouchers. To make sure to block third-party cookies and other tracking technologies – use Mullvad VPN together with Mullvad Browser (free of charge). ANONYMOUS ACCOUNTS – NO ACTIVITY LOGS • Creating an account requires no personal info - not even an email address. • We keep no activity logs. • We offer the possibility to pay anonymously with cash or cryptocurrency. • Bypass geographical restrictions with our global network of VPN servers. • Our app uses WireGuard, a superior VPN protocol that connects fast and doesn’t drain your battery. HOW DOES MULLVAD VPN WORK? With Mullvad VPN, your traffic travels through an encrypted tunnel to one of our VPN servers and then onward to the website you are visiting. In this way, websites will only see our server’s identity instead of yours. Same goes for your ISP (internet service provider); they’ll see that you’re connected to Mullvad, but not your activity. It also means that all the third-party actors with technology integrated into the various websites you visit can’t sniff out your IP address and use it to track you from one site to another. Using a trustworthy VPN is a great first step to reclaim your privacy online. In combination with Mullvad Browser you make sure to block third-party cookies and other tracking technologies. FREE THE INTERNET FROM MASS SURVEILLANCE AND DATA COLLECTION A free and open society is a society where people have the right to privacy. That’s why we fight for a free internet. Free from mass surveillance and censorship. Free from big data markets where your personal information is up for sale. Free from authorities mass monitoring every click you make. Free from an infrastructure mapping your whole life. Mullvad VPN and Mullvad Browser is our contribution to the fight. TELEMETRY AND CRASH REPORTS The app collects a very minimal amount of telemetry, and it does not in any way tie it to an account number, IP or other identifiable information. Account numbers are used for authentication. App logs are never sent automatically but are rather explicitly sent by the user. App version checks are performed every 24 hours to tell the app if there are any upgrades available and if the curre

name: Thunderbird: Free Your Inbox
short: Thunderbird is a 100% open source, privacy focused email app.
description: Thunderbird is a powerful, privacy-focused email app. Effortlessly manage multiple email accounts from one app, with a Unified Inbox option for maximum productivity. Built on open-source technology and supported by a dedicated team of developers alongside a global community of volunteers, Thunderbird never treats your private data as a product. Supported solely by financial contributions from our users, so you never have to see ads mixed in with your emails again. What you can do Ditch multiple apps and webmail. Use one app, with an optional Unified Inbox, to power through your day. Enjoy a privacy-friendly email client that never collects or sells your personal data. We directly connect you to your email provider. That’s it! Take your privacy to the next level by using OpenPGP email encryption (PGP/MIME) with the “OpenKeychain” app, to encrypt and decrypt your messages. Choose to sync your email instantly, at set intervals, or on-demand. However you want to check your email, it’s up to you! Find your important messages using both local and server-side search. Compatibility Thunderbird works with IMAP and POP3 protocols, supporting a wide range of email providers, including Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, iCloud, and more. Why use Thunderbird The trusted name in email for over 20 years - now on Android. Thunderbird is fully funded by voluntary contributions from our users. We don’t mine your personal data. You are never the product. Made by a team that is as efficiency-minded as you are. We want you to spend minimal time using the app while getting maximum in return. With contributors from all over the world, Thunderbird for Android has been translated into more than 20 languages. Supported by MZLA Technologies Corporation, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Mozilla Foundation. Open Source and Community Thunderbird is free and open source, which means its code is available to see, modify, use and share freely. Its license also ensures that it will be free forever. You can think of Thunderbird as a gift from thousands of contributors to you. We develop in the open with regular, transparent updates on our blog and mailing lists. Our user support is powered by our global community. Find the answers you need, or step into the role of a contributor - whether it’s answering questions, translating the app, or telling your friends and family about Thunderbird.

name: StudFinder - Stud Finder for Android
short: Find wall studs with your Android's built-in magnetometer. Free, no ads.
description: StudFinder uses your Android phone's built-in magnetometer (compass sensor) to detect metal screws and nails inside wall studs. No paid subscription, no ads, no tracking — just a tool that works. How it works: Your phone's magnetometer measures the local magnetic field. Wood studs are held in place by metal fasteners (screws or nails) that disrupt the field. StudFinder reads that disruption and shows it on a live LED bar display, letting you sweep along the wall and pinpoint where studs are. How to use: 1. Calibrate by moving a coin slowly around the back of your phone until the LED sequence completes. 2. Hold the phone flat against the wall. 3. Sweep slowly along the wall horizontally. 4. The LEDs light up red when the magnetometer detects a metal fastener inside a stud. 5. Mark the position and repeat to confirm the stud's width. Limitations: The magnetometer detects metal, not wood directly. It works reliably on standard wood-framed walls with metal screws or nails. Concrete walls, steel studs, or plaster-over-metal-lath surfaces give different results — consider a dedicated hardware stud finder for those. Open source and F-Droid: StudFinder is fully open-source (Apache 2.0) and distributed through F-Droid. Zero proprietary dependencies: no AdMob, no Firebase, no Google Play Services. The app requires no INTERNET permission and works entirely offline. Source code: github.com/clankwright/StudFinderAndroid

name: Fossify Calendar
short: Securely plan, schedule, and set reminders with our private calendar app.
description: Tired of cluttered calendars and privacy concerns? Fossify Calendar is here to change that. Your open-source powerhouse for managing life, designed with privacy as its core and packed with powerful features to keep you organized. Here's what makes Fossify Calendar different: 🚫 AD-FREE AND PRIVATE: Your events remain yours. No ads, no tracking, no intrusive permissions. ⏰ FLEXIBLE AND CUSTOMIZABLE: Craft events precisely with times, durations, reminders, and advanced repetition rules. 🔄 SEAMLESS SYNCING: Sync effortlessly with Google Calendar, Outlook, Nextcloud, Exchange, and more. 🎨 PERSONALIZE YOUR PLANNER: Set custom sounds, looping audio streams, vibrations, and themes to match your preferences. 🌈 VIBRANT WIDGETS: Brighten your day with beautiful calendar widgets and themes for your home screen. 📅 EFFORTLESS DAY MANAGEMENT: Plan your day with ease, whether you're a busy professional or a family organizer. 🎉 IMPORT CELEBRATIONS: Never miss a birthday or anniversary! Easily import holidays and special dates. 🔍 FILTER VIEWS: Quickly find what you're looking for with event filters. 📆 MULTIPLE VIEWS: Switch between daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, and event views effortlessly. ✨ MATERIAL DESIGN ELEGANCE: Enjoy an intuitive and user-friendly interface with dynamic themes. Plus, Fossify Calendar is open-source! Join the vibrant community on GitHub, contribute to the project, and make it uniquely yours. Download Fossify Calendar now and experience the power of a private and customizable schedule. Explore more Fossify apps: https://www.fossify.org Open-Source Code: https://www.github.com/FossifyOrg Join the community on Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/Fossify Connect on Telegram: https://t.me/Fossify

name: Yivi
short: Your digital identity in one app.
description: Yivi is an app that lets you easily and securely log in, share data and prove who you are. Without sharing too much about yourself. With Yivi, you take control of your data. You always see what an organisation wants to know about you and you decide whether to share that data. Your data is only stored on your mobile, safely behind a PIN code. No one is watching, not even Yivi. That's how safe it is. Yivi is being developed by Caesar Groep, in close collaboration with the Privacy by Design Foundation, whose original work forms the foundation of the system. Previously known as “IRMA,” the Yivi ID wallet is fully open source and designed with privacy and user-friendliness at its core. Yivi website: www.yivi.app/en/ Technical documentation: https://docs.yivi.app/what-is-yivi Source code: https://github.com/privacybydesign

name: Ethic Notes
short: Private, offline, zero-permission notes application.
description: Ethic Notes is a private, offline, zero-permission notes application for Android. * Zero permissions declared: no internet, no broad storage access, no device tracking. * Privacy Shield: blocks screenshots, recordings, and recent app previews. * Storage Access Framework: export/import clean JSON or plain text files securely. * Auto-save: writes notes continuously in the background without forcing titles or manual saves. * Multi-selection: batch delete notes directly from the main list. * Sovereign Ethic Ecosystem: integrated hub for libre, offline utilities. * Multi-language: Universal English default, native Spanish, and per-app language selection on Android 13+.

name: TigerDuck
short: NTUST campus assistant for courses, assignments, and more
description: TigerDuck is an open-source campus assistant app for National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (NTUST) students. It brings together scattered campus services into a single native Android experience: - Sync assignments from Moodle with deadline notifications and reminders - Course schedule sync from the selection system with an interactive time-machine timeline - Integrated campus calendar combining school events and Moodle deadlines - Customizable themes, notification preferences, and display settings Built by students, for students.

name: Sensors2OSC
short: Send sensor data via Open Sound Control (OSC).
description: Read sensor data from your phone and send them to a receiver via Open Sound Control (OSC). Typical use case is controlling a music application from your phone or tablet.

name: Fechtkarte
short: Warm-up drill card generator using notation credited to Joachim Meyer
description: Fechtkarte generates warm-up and routine drill cards for Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA) practice, using notation credited to the 16th-century fencing master Joachim Meyer. Each card shows a numbered sequence of cuts to work through, with a dot marking a thrust instead of a cut. Card background colour indicates which hand leads, so a drill can alternate sides. Edge choice, guard, footwork and tempo are left to the practitioner — the card only fixes the sequence of openings. Features: * A library of more than 100 classic drill cards, browsable by hand and filterable by action count, thrust count, and technique * Random drill generation with configurable action count, thrust count, and five opt-in shaping rules * Six palettes to choose from per hand, designed and verified for colour-vision-deficiency accessibility * Export a generated card as a high-resolution PNG or a true-vector, print-ready PDF, or share it directly to another app * Works fully offline, with no accounts, no analytics, and no network access required Fechtkarte is free and open-source software (Apache License 2.0), with no proprietary dependencies. See PRIVACY_POLICY.md in the source repository for the full data-handling disclosure.

name: AirLyrics
short: Synced floating lyrics: online search, local imports, and word-by-word support
description: AirLyrics is a lightweight floating lyrics app. Features: • Detect current media and show synced floating lyrics • Search for lyrics online through NetEase Cloud Music or Musixmatch • Import local standard LRC or word-by-word lyrics, display translations, and adjust timing • Customize the floating window and switch between light and dark themes AirLyrics is not a music player and does not include a complete lyrics database. If an online match is inaccurate, you can import local lyrics. Privacy: AirLyrics does not collect or share personal data. Notification access is used only on-device for media detection; online search sends only the song information required to find lyrics.

name: AniSync
short: Offline-first AniList client for anime and manga tracking with widgets
description: AniSync is a native Android client for AniList, the anime and manga tracking platform. It offers an offline-first experience for managing your watchlist, discovering new series, and staying connected with the community, built with modern Material 3 design. AniSync is not affiliated with AniList; it is a third-party client. Highlights * Offline-first library — full read/write access to your tracking data without an internet connection; changes sync when you are back online. * Privacy-focused — credentials are encrypted locally with AES-256-GCM. No trackers, no ads, no analytics. * Material 3 UI — modern design with dynamic theming and smooth animations. * Home-screen widgets — Up Next, Airing Today, Weekly Calendar, and Trending widgets powered by Jetpack Glance. Library & tracking Track anime and manga with full flexibility. Statuses include Watching, Planning, Completed, Dropped, Paused, and Repeating. Score entries, add notes, organize into custom AniList lists. Sort by title, progress, score, airing date, or last updated. Discovery & search Browse trending titles, popular seasonal releases, upcoming premieres, and TBA entries. Advanced search filters by genre, year, season, format (TV, Movie, OVA, ONA, Special, Music), and airing status. Rich media details Every media page shows cover art, descriptions, episode and chapter counts, community scores, characters with voice actors, staff, related media, trailers, reviews, recommendations, and streaming-service links. Character & staff browser Dedicated character and staff pages with parsed biographies, key attributes, media appearances, and voice-actor language filtering. Forum Full AniList forum integration: browse categories, read nested replies, post with Markdown, like, bookmark, and subscribe to threads for notifications. Statistics Time watched, episodes completed, chapters read, mean scores, plus breakdowns by genre, format, score distribution, and release year. Notifications Two-tier airing notifications (12h and 2h before release), planning-list premiere alerts, and optional forum activity notifications (replies, mentions, subscriptions). Source & licensing AniSync is free software released under the GNU General Public License v3.0. The "AniSync" name and brand are reserved — derivative works and unofficial forks must use a different name for any AniList client they distribute.

name: Screen Time
short: Easily track the time you spend on your device and apps.
description: Screen Time is a simple app that lets you easily track the time you spend on your device and apps. Features: - Displays total screen time for your device over the past week or for a chosen day. - Comparative graph showing screen time across different days of the week. - Comparative graph displaying screen time for each hour of the day. - Ability to view screen time and comparative graphs for each individual app. - Comparative list of screen time for each app, sorted from the most used to the least used during the chosen period. - Simple and modern interface. - Home screen widget. - No ads. - No data collection (internet permissions disabled). - Open source. - Developed in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose and Material 3. The source code is available here: https://gitlab.com/Atharok/ScreenTime

name: WebStack
short: Visual bookmark stack and website manager for Android with offline snapshots.
description: WebStack is an open-source visual bookmark manager and website stack built with modern Android engineering, Jetpack Compose, and Material Design 3. Rather than juggling endless open browser tabs or struggling to remember URLs, WebStack provides Android users with a unified visual bookmarking experience. Key Capabilities: * Visual Website Cards: Displays responsive page snapshots (via opt-in Microlink service) or clean local aesthetic cards. * Dual Layout System: Effortlessly toggle between rich visual cards and dense compact row listings. * Fast Filter & Search: Hardware-accelerated search across titles, URLs, and custom tags with smooth 60/120 FPS animations. * Interactive Tag Management: Create, edit, and filter custom category tags with haptic-enabled context sheets. * Offline Storage: Snapshots and metadata are preserved locally on-device in a Room SQLite database. * System Share Sheet Integration: Save links directly from Google Chrome, Firefox, or any app in a single tap. * Smart Clipboard Detection: Auto-detects URLs on the system clipboard for one-tap bookmarking. * 100% Privacy & Zero Trackers: Fully open source with no advertising SDKs, tracking pixels, or remote telemetry. Remote previews are optional and off by default, keeping bookmark data strictly on-device.

name: Rocinante
short: Fast, private, and native client for the BookWyrm literary social network.
description: Rocinante is a native Android client for connecting to any BookWyrm instance, the federated social network for readers. Designed with a focus on privacy and performance, it allows you to manage your reading habits without relying on closed platforms or algorithms. Key features: - Timeline interaction (ActivityPub): post updates, reply, and like. - Library management: organize books in default shelves (To Read, Reading, Read). - Progress tracking: update read pages synchronized with the server. - Local reminders: configurable daily notifications from the device, without network usage, to encourage reading habits. - Community exploration: view reviews, currently reading books, and other users' profiles. - Free and open-source software: transparent code under GPLv3 license, with no trackers or proprietary dependencies.

name: DetoxDroid: Digital Detox by Default
short: Grayscale, doomscrolling breaker, app blocker: a boring phone by default
description: Most digital detox apps want you to sign a contract with yourself: no phone for the next X minutes, no more than Z minutes in app Y. A few of them take your money when you break it. DetoxDroid works the other way round. It strips the attention-grabbing tricks out of the phone, so that a calm phone is what you get when you do nothing at all. Nothing to start, no session to survive. The protection is simply on, and you pause it on purpose when you actually need something. Use your phone. Don't let your phone use you. FEATURES * Make Apps Boring (grayscale, dimmed, blurred). The color drains out of the apps on your list, and on Android 12 and newer they go soft and blurry too: a feed turns into shapes, still navigable and no longer worth scrolling. This runs from the minute you install DetoxDroid. No computer, no root, nothing to grant. True grayscale it is not. An overlay can only ever paint on top of the screen, so it drags color and contrast towards a flat gray instead of taking the color out. A red notification dot stays recognisably red. The screen just looks dead, which is the entire point. For the real thing, see SETUP. * Break Doom Scrolling. Notices when you are stuck in an endless feed (Shorts, Reels and friends) and interrupts you. After the break, that feed stays locked for a cooldown. * Disable Apps. A distracting app can make you wait a few seconds before it opens, sit behind a blocking screen, or be deactivated outright, launcher icon and notifications included. Give it a daily budget and every open costs the wait until the budget is gone. After that, the app locks itself until tomorrow. * Automatic Do Not Disturb. On for as long as DetoxDroid runs. Notifications wait for you. * Pause Button. From Quick Settings, from your assistant, or by holding a hardware button for two seconds. DetoxDroid resumes by itself afterwards, and a minimum gap between pauses keeps "just one more" in check. * Commitment Password. Locks the settings behind a password. Keep it yourself, or hand it to someone who won't give it back the second you ask. SETUP (optional, and worth it) The system color filter is a secure setting: Android hands it only to apps holding WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS, and there is no dialog to tap. Grant it once and the wash turns into real grayscale, with Extra Dim on top, which pushes the screen below the minimum brightness Android normally allows. Three routes: from a computer over adb, on the phone itself through Shizuku (the app walks you through

name: Xime IME
short: A Rime-based Chinese IME for Wubi and Pinyin input
description: Xime (曦码) is a Chinese IME built on the Rime engine for Wubi and Pinyin input, focused on a simple and efficient typing experience. Features: * Multiple input schemes - Wubi 86, Wubi 98, Pinyin, and mixed Wubi/Pinyin * Rime engine - mature and stable Rime input method engine * Speech-to-text - built-in voice recognition (FunAsr and local models) * Emoji plugins - supports extendable emoji plugins * Material Design 3 style with light/dark themes

name: Lplanner
short: Mixed-gas decompression planner: ZHL-16C, VVAL-79 and VPM-B. Works offline.
description: Lplanner is a decompression planner for trained mixed-gas divers. It plans open-circuit and closed-circuit dives on air, nitrox, trimix and heliox, with three decompression models to choose between. THIS SOFTWARE CAN KILL YOU. It is experimental and certainly contains bugs. Never dive a schedule from it without verifying that schedule against tables or software you trust, and never use it without formal mixed-gas decompression training. MODELS * ZHL-16C — the Buhlmann set, with gradient factors or a conservatism percentage, and optional Pyle deep stops. * VVAL-79 — the U.S. Navy Thalmann EL-DCM, exponential uptake and linear elimination, with the published nine-compartment air parameter set. Air, nitrox and oxygen only: the Navy publishes no helium parameters for this model, so a dive carrying helium is refused rather than computed against numbers that do not exist. Use VPM-B or ZHL-16C for trimix. * VPM-B — the Varying Permeability Model of Yount and Hoffman, in Erik Baker's implementation, with conservatism 0 to 4. Checked against Baker's own published output on his 80 msw trimix benchmark: 13 of the 18 stop times match exactly, with the first stop one 3 m increment deeper and four minutes more total stop time, for the reasons set out in the manual. All three share one decompression engine, written in C, which is the same engine the macOS and iOS builds use. Identical input gives an identical schedule on every platform. WHAT IT DOES * Multi-level dives, open or closed circuit, with setpoints and Scamahorn slide. * Automatic deco gas selection by maximum PO2 and maximum END. * Repetitive dives: carries your tissue loading forward, ages it against the real clock while the app is closed, and requires you to state a surface interval before it will plan again. * CNS percentage and OTU tracking, gas consumption per mix, time to fly. * Gas density warning following Anthony and Mitchell. * Configurable stop grid, last stop depth, ascent and descent rate bands, and extended stops on a gas switch. * Plan log, share, and print. PRIVACY The app declares no Android permissions at all, including no internet permission. It cannot transmit anything, and there is no analytics, advertising or tracking of any kind. Your dive, your settings and your saved plans stay in the app's private storage on the device. Free software under the GNU General Public License v3.

name: Gitling
short: Git client built with Jetpack Compose and Material 3 Expressive
description: Gitling is a Git client for Android, built with Jetpack Compose and Material 3 Expressive. It's a fork of MGit (itself a continuation of SGit), modernized with a current Android toolchain, a from-scratch Compose UI, one-tap GitHub sign-in, and a new identity. Features: * Clone, create, and delete local repositories * One-tap Connect with GitHub (OAuth Device Flow) -- no manual token/password handling for GitHub remotes * HTTP/HTTPS/SSH, including SSH with private-key passphrase * Username/password and personal access token authentication for any Git host * Browse files and commit history, git diff between commits * Checkout, create, and merge local/remote branches and tags * git status, staging, git rebase, git cherry-pick, git checkout * Private key generation and management * Import an existing repository from device storage * Light/dark mode that follows the system, with a choice between a fixed brand color or wallpaper-based Material You dynamic color Gitling doesn't include an internal text editor -- to edit files, you'll need an editor app installed that supports opening files via Android's File Provider mechanism (most code/text editor apps do).

name: Booming Music
short: Clean, fast, and Material-driven music player with powerful features
description: Booming Music is a modern and powerful local music player for Android, designed for a smooth, customizable, and visually appealing experience. Built with Material You design and powered by Media3, it combines simplicity with advanced playback features. Enjoy your favorite songs with word-by-word synced lyrics, translated lyric support (TTML/LRC), and a beautiful Now Playing interface featuring enhanced visuals, smooth transitions, and deep customization options. Fine-tune your listening with a built-in equalizer, ReplayGain, Audio Offload, and gapless playback for seamless transitions. Organize your music your way with smart playlists, customizable sorting, and a hierarchical folder view. Main features: * Automatic lyric download and in-app lyric editor * Word-by-word and translated lyrics (TTML, LRC) * Media3-based playback engine with audio offload support * ReplayGain for consistent volume across tracks * Native ALAC decoding * ListenBrainz scrobbling * Adaptive mini player and gesture controls * Custom covers and descriptions for playlists * Tag editor with instant library updates * Smart auto playlists (Recently Played, Most Played, History) * Sleep timer, widgets, and Android Auto support * Material You theming with dark and black modes * Multi-language support * Lightweight, open-source, and ad-free

name: Money Manager Ex
short: Manage your finances on-the-go, encrypted for security, sync via your storage
description: A simple and easy-to-use application to manage personal finances, bank accounts, family budget, and more. The main goal is to provide a mobile implementation for an application we love to use on our desktop, Money Manager EX. Features - Management of single transactions - Account, payee, category, and currency management - Cloud storage-based synchronization, including: - Cloud storage such as Google Drive and Nextcloud - Sync services like Syncthing - Support for SQLCipher encryption - Compatibility with Desktop MMEX - Repeating transactions - Charts for reports

name: Open Notes
short: A minimalist, secure, and fully offline notes app.
description: OpenNotes is a privacy-focused, offline note-taking application designed to keep your thoughts organized without compromising your data. It provides a fast, clean interface packed with powerful formatting tools. All your notes are stored exclusively on your local device. The app does not request internet access and contains no trackers or analytics. Features: Native Markdown rendering for rich text formatting, including headers, checklists, code blocks, and quotes. Seamless image support to embed photos directly alongside your text. Organization tools that allow you to color-code, pin, and sort your notes. Home screen widgets for quick access to your most important notes. Built-in privacy options to lock the app behind biometric authentication and block the Android system from taking screenshots of your data. Personalize the app with dark and light themes, and choose your favorite color for the home screen icon. Full offline backups that let you export and import your complete note library as a single ZIP file. Completely free and open-source with zero invasive permissions.

name: CountAway
short: A lightweight local countdown with home-screen widgets
description: CountAway keeps important dates simple and visible on your home screen. Create multiple local countdowns, choose an event type or custom icon, and add compact or resizable widgets. Widgets can follow one fixed event or automatically show your next upcoming countdown, with independent appearance and background choices. Countdowns can optionally repeat yearly, making recurring dates like birthdays and anniversaries take care of themselves. Optional local reminders can alert you on the event day or 1, 3, or 7 days before. Countdown data can also be exported and restored with a local JSON backup file. Everything stays on your device. No accounts, ads, analytics, cloud synchronization, or Internet permission.

name: Léon – The URL Cleaner
short: Removes tracking & other redundant parameters from web links for sharing
description: Léon - The URL Cleaner removes tracking and other obsolete parameters from a URL before sharing. Its usage is simple, integrating into Android's standard sharing mechanism. Léon runs on Android 5.0 and later, is open source and does not contain any tracking or advertising frameworks. Léon does not collect any data about you. The benefits of removing tracking parameters are: * Protects your and the recipient's privacy * Improves readability of links * Saves characters (in Tweets for example)

name: Gitalchemy
short: Open-source native GitLab client for Android and desktop
description: Gitalchemy is a free and open-source GitLab client for Android and desktop (Linux, macOS, Windows), built with Tauri v2, React, and TypeScript. Manage your entire GitLab workflow from your phone or computer — no browser needed. Features: - Browse and search projects, groups, and repositories - View, create, and comment on issues and merge requests - Monitor CI/CD pipelines and read job logs - Manage todos and notifications - Personal Access Token authentication - Works on Android and desktop (Linux, macOS, Windows) Privacy first: No telemetry. No ads. No tracking. Your data stays yours. Gitalchemy is the only GitLab client available on both Android and desktop as a native app.

name: baresip
short: VoIP and mobile calling and messaging app for Android based on baresip library
description: Baresip is security focused open source communication app for Android that originally only supported SIP based VoIP calling and messaging. Now baresip can also be chosen as Android's default mobile calling and messaging app. In addition, contacts are integrated within the app. Voice conference calls, voicemail indication as well as blind and attended call transfers are available when VoIP is used. Multimedia messaging is not supported yet. In VoIP calls audio can be coded with AMR, Codec2, G.729, G.722, G.722.1, iLBC, opus or PCMU/PCMA codecs. Security is achieved via TLS or WSS SIP signaling transport and ZRTP or (DTLS) SRTP media encapsulation. Baresip app can be installed on Android devices running Android version 9 or later. Mobile calling and messaging needs Android version 10 or later. If you need video calling, you can instead of this app install its sister app baresip+. Source code is available at GitHub , where also issues can be reported.

name: baresip+
short: VoIP and mobile calling and messaging app for Android based on baresip library
description: Baresip+ is security focused open source communication app for Android that originally only supported SIP based voice and video calling and messaging. Now baresip+ can also be chosen as Android's default mobile calling and messaging app. In addition, contacts are integrated within the app. Voice conference calls, voicemail indication as well as blind and attended call transfers are available when VoIP is used. Multimedia messaging is not supported yet. In SIP calls audio can be coded with AMR, Codec2, G.729, G.722, G.722.1, iLBC, opus or PCMU/PCMA codecs. Video can be coded with VP9, VP8, H.265, H.264, or AV1 codecs. Security is achieved via TLS or WSS SIP signaling transport and ZRTP or (DTLS) SRTP media encapsulation. Baresip+ app can be installed on Android devices running Android version 9 or later. Mobile calling and messaging needs Android version 10 or later. If you don't need video calls, you can instead of this app install its lighter weight sister app baresip. Source code is available at GitHub , where also issues can be reported.

name: Bruno's Meditation Timer
short: Meditation and pranayama timer with streak tracking and other statistics.
description: Bruno's Meditation Timer is a simple, offline meditation and pranayama timer. Features: * Meditation timer with custom presets, each with configurable starting, intermediate, and ending bells. * Pranayama timer with auditory and visual guidance and generated breath tones. * Multi-segment pranayama presets and optional Bluetooth remote controls for starting/stopping, adjusting breath lengths, and changing segments at cycle boundaries. Remote control is off by default. * Session logging, CSV import/export, streak tracking with streak repair, and basic statistics. * Local preset import/export, import compatible with Insight Timer. * No account, ads, analytics, tracking, or network service is required for core use. The app was built for personal meditation practice: quiet defaults, minimal visual interruption during sessions, and enough structure to keep track of practice over time. I am happy to receive feature requests at the moment.

name: FeelS
short: Local-first feelings wheel for private emotion check-ins.
description: FeelS is a local-first Android app for naming how you feel. Spin a feelings wheel, log a check-in with intensity and an optional note, and review a 30-day heatmap plus weekly mood widgets. Your check-ins stay on the device in an encrypted database. FeelS does not send emotion data to a server. Features: • Feelings wheel with primary, secondary, and tertiary layers • Optional notes and intensity • History, heatmap, and home-screen widgets • Breathing shortcut and gentle grounding after high-distress logs • Daily reminders you can turn off or reschedule • JSON export and import so you can move logs to another phone FeelS is not medical care, diagnosis, or crisis support. License: GNU General Public License v3 Source: https://github.com/z3itt

name: KFZ-A
short: Offline lookup of Austrian vehicle registration identifiers
description: KFZ-A is a fully offline Android application for looking up Austrian vehicle registration identifiers. The application recognises geographical identifiers, authority identifiers, special identifiers and diplomatic or consular identifiers while you type. Features • Instant lookup while typing • Geographical identifiers • Government and authority identifiers • Diplomatic and consular identifiers • Support for identifiers with multiple meanings • Automatic handling of upper/lower case and spaces • Fully offline • No advertising • No tracking • No user accounts • No Internet connection required The application analyses identifier prefixes only. It does not analyse complete registration numbers and cannot identify vehicle owners. Data status: 08/2026 All information is provided without warranty. Open-source software licensed under the MIT License.
