name: AudioLex
short: Hearing training for word recognition: listen, identify, repeat. Fully offline.
description: AudioLex trains the understanding of spoken words for the case where hearing and understanding come apart: the sound arrives, but it is no longer reliably decoded as speech. That happens after one-sided hearing loss, and a hearing aid alone does not fix it — it makes things louder, not clearer. The path from sound to word has to be practised again. Two modes, both aimed at the same thing: Learning mode — a word is played with its text visible. This builds the link between what arrives and what it means. Exam mode — the word is played, the card stays covered. You rate yourself. That rating decides when the word comes back: after a minute, after ten, after a day, a week or a month. 92 words and sentences are included: 72 in German — 68 from free speech synthesis, four spoken by real voices — and 20 in English. Which language you train is a setting of its own, separate from the language of the interface. Your own recordings can be added: speak a word or sentence, write it down, train it. Several speakers can be kept apart and switched on or off individually — a familiar voice is a different exercise from a stranger's. For harder practice, put a background noise under the speech and set the distance between the two in decibels. Three levels do it in one tap: easy without noise, hard with a clear speech advantage, advanced with the noise above the speech. One noise is included, recorded inside a bus. Your own can be recorded or imported as WAV files. For headphone training there is a channel choice — left, right or both — which helps when only one ear should be trained. Over a Bluetooth hearing aid, stereo is summed to mono; the app detects this and shows the channel choice as ineffective instead of pretending otherwise. What AudioLex does not do: it requests no internet permission, has no account, no trackers, no ads. Vocabulary, ratings and session history stay on the device — not as a promise, but because the app has no technical way to send anything. A backup writes your own recordings, your own noises and the session history to a ZIP file in your documents when you ask it to. What happens to that file afterwards is up to you. AudioLex is a practice tool, not a medical product. It replaces neither an audiologist's advice nor an ENT examination. The app was built for one person with exactly this problem. It shows: it is plain, and it does not explain itself — the short guide inside is where it tries. The interface speaks German or English, switchable on the

name: FOSS Warn
short: Receive emergency alerts worldwide
description: FOSS Warn is an app for receiving global emergency alerts. Whether it's flooding, a tsunami, or bomb disposal, if there's an alert, you'll receive it. FOSS Warn uses the FOSS Public Alert Server to obtain alerts. This aggregates official feeds with alerts from over 100 countries worldwide. A list of supported countries can be found here: https://alerts.kde.org/sources/status Features: - Receive alerts in over 100 countries worldwide - Receive push notifications via UnifiedPush - Display alerts on a map - Material 3 FOSS Warn and the FOSS Public Alert Server are independent and in no way affiliated with any official authority.

name: Argus
short: Natural-language automation compiled by an LLM, run by a deterministic engine.
description: Argus is a Tasker-class automation app where a large language model is the compiler, not the executor. You describe a rule in plain language — "every day at 9 send me the BTC price", "when I leave home turn off Wi-Fi", "if an OTP arrives, copy it to the clipboard". The model compiles your request into a structured, typed rule (trigger, conditions, actions). You review it rendered from the types — never from the model's paraphrase — and approve a byte-stable SHA-256 fingerprint of the executable data. From then on a deterministic engine runs the rule: OS alarms, system receivers, geofences, the notification listener. The model is never in the execution loop, except for actions you explicitly mark as generative. Why this matters: * Predictable — the rule that fires at 3 a.m. is exactly the one you approved, byte for byte. * Auditable — every run is logged locally, without personal content. * Private by design — no Argus-operated backend or account, no telemetry and no analytics. Rules, logs and encrypted API keys stay on your phone; only the provider or self-hosted bridge you explicitly configure receives compile/generative requests. The language-model transport is pluggable: run a self-hosted bridge, or connect directly to a provider you choose. A base tier works with no elevated privileges; for system-level actions Argus can use Shizuku. Note: connecting a proprietary provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) is optional — Argus can instead use a self-hosted bridge together with its on-device deterministic actions. Argus is free software (GPL-3.0). The interface, rule rendering and the agent all follow your system language (English or Italian).

name: Otoscope
short: Ad-free viewer for WiFi otoscope cameras.
description: Otoscope is a clean, ad-free replacement for the proprietary apps shipped with cheap Wi-Fi otoscope cameras. The stock companion apps generally bundle lots of ad and analytics SDKs (AdMob, AppLovin, IronSource, MBridge, Vungle, Pangle, Mintegral, etc.) and in-app tracking. Otoscope reimplements essential connection and viewer functionalities, with nothing else. Features: • Discover the camera over Bluetooth Low Energy or Wi-Fi. • Join the camera's Wi-Fi access point in a one-process scope, so the rest of your traffic isn't affected. • Live video stream, decoded in-app over the camera's protocol (UDP or RTSP). Pure Kotlin, no FFmpeg, no native blobs. • Auto-rotation driven by the camera's on-board accelerometer / gyro. • Horizontal-mirror toggle for self-examination. • Circular mask matching the otoscope lens. • Photo and video capture with a built-in gallery to review, share and delete them. • Optional caption burnt into the corner of each capture to tell what's being recorded. Supported hardware families: • Xylla — SSID `Enjoy-XXXXXX` or `JesHome-XXXX`. • iTiMO — SSID `iTiMO-XXXXXX` or `jetion_XXXX`. • JEGOAT — SSID `softish-XXXXXX`. • EarFairy — SSID `Cooleer_XXXXXX`. Otoscope is GPL-3.0-or-later and contains no third-party trackers, ad SDKs, or proprietary native libraries.

name: Schussel
short: Bluetooth-triggered checklists that remind you of what you forgot.
description: Schussel is German for a scatterbrained, forgetful person: the one who drives off with the lights still on. This app is the antidote. You build a checklist, tie it to a Bluetooth device (typically your car), and when your phone connects, Schussel nags you only if you left something unticked. You keep one or more checklists. Each list is linked to the Bluetooth device(s) that should trigger it. When your phone connects to a linked device: * if everything on that list is ticked, you get silence; * if anything is still unticked, you get a reminder naming exactly what you forgot. It works even when the app is closed, and optionally sounds an alarm that repeats until you dismiss it. Features: * Optional daily reset (per list) — automatically untick everything at a time you choose, with a live "resets in HH:MM" countdown. Lists without a reset time keep their state. * All data stays on your device — no network, no accounts, no analytics. How it works: 1. Tap Add list and add the items you tend to forget. 2. Open the list's ⋮ → Settings and choose the Bluetooth device(s) that should trigger it. Optionally name the list, set a daily reset time, and enable alarm mode. 3. That's it. Next time your phone connects to that device with items left unticked, you get a reminder. Requirements: * Android 10 (API 29) or newer. * A phone with Bluetooth, paired with the device you want to trigger on. Privacy: Schussel stores everything locally and never sends data anywhere — no network, no accounts, no analytics. Note on background reliability: manufacturer battery optimizers (Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, Huawei, …) can delay or drop the connect broadcast; exempting Schussel from battery optimization helps.

Managing, Syncing and Archiving * Organize your media files in albums * Support standard media format plus RAW format, HDR photo, Panorama Photo Sphere, Motion Photo * Run on Android TV for big-screen viewing pleasure * Manage media files in your phone's gallery and auto backup to server, each media folder in your phone has its own backup setting * Integrated with various photo and video editing apps, such as Snapseed, Photoshop Express, ImageToolbox and Open Video Editor * Support adding caption to photo * Synchronization with Nextcloud server and among multiple devices, edit albums on Nextcloud server and on all your mobile devices simultaneously * Support Remote Album, which have all it's media file stored in Nextcloud server only, free up Phone's storage * Search for photos by objects with AI * Search photos by location * Support GPX importing, so that you can easily add GPS location data to pictures shoot on your digital camera * Support Nextcloud's external storage * Beautiful theme inspired by works of Wes Anderson Sharing * Share albums and album slideshow with other Nextcloud users, groups and circles * Unique 'Joint Album' feature, which you and other Nextcloud users can edit together * Export GPX file from album, you can share your adventure with others Privacy focus * Media files and thumbnails are all saved in App's private storage, stop being scanned by malicious apps * Option provided to strip photo's EXIF before sharing to other social networks * Option to hide album both in Phone and on server * Authenticate on your Nextcloud server with your Nextcloud's credential * Opensource Any apps that can do the above is merely a media file manager with a fancy UI. With selected pictures and caption you added, you can share your stories with the world. This project build using the f

name: Suntimes
short: Sunlight and moonlight information (clock, alarms, tiles, and widgets).
description: Tracks sunlight and moonlight times. Features a clock, alarm clock, widget collection, and more. Suntimes displays rising/setting information for the sun and moon. It includes many features commonly associated with a world clock. The times reported by this app are approximate. The app doesn't require network connectivity, GPS is optional. Features: * clock * alarm clock * widgets * tiles Clock * current time (System, Apparent Solar, Local Mean, UTC, or Sidereal time). * time of sunrise, sunset, twilights (civil, nautical, astronomical), and blue/golden hour. * time of moonrise, moonset, apogee/perigee, moon phases and illumination. * time of solstices, equinoxes, and cross-quarter days. * day/night world map, yearly sunlight, and sun altitude graphs. Alarm Clock: * general purpose alarms; full screen alarms, notifications, and quick notifications. * daily repeating alarms for sunrise, sunset, or other reoccurring events. * bedtime alarms with support for sleep cycles and do-not-disturb settings. * gentle alarms that gradually change screen brightness, colors, and volume. * features for heavy sleepers; math problems, NFC tags (requires SuntimesNFC), and snooze limits. * automated actions; user-defined intents when alarms are triggered or dismissed. * other alarms; "roman time" alarms (Natural Hour), midpoint alarms (Interval Midpoints). The app benefits from the following permissions: * ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION is used to obtain the current position (latitude, longitude, altitude). * ACCESS_LOCATION_EXTRA_COMMANDS is used to configure GPS hardware. * ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY is used to change do-not-disturb settings at Bedtime. * BOOT_COMPLETED is used to restore active alarms after a reboot. * FOREGROUND_SERVICE is used to deliver alarms. . * POST_NOTIFICATIONS is used to deliver alarms. . * REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS is used to ensure reliable delivery of alarms. * SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM is used to schedule alarms. . * SET_ALARM is used to interact with the system AlarmClock app. * USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT is used to deliver alarms. . * QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES is used to configure and launch user-defined actions. . * VIBRATE is used by alarm notifications. With older devices: * READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is used to play alarm sounds located on the SD card (api≤=18 only) . * WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is used to backup data to file (places, themes, etc) (api≤=18 only) . Note: The "Calendar Integration" and permissions added in v0.9.0 were removed in v0.10.0. T

name: Jargon
short: Offline reader for the Jargon File, the original hacker culture dictionary
description: Jargon is a fully offline reader for the Jargon File — the hacker culture dictionary that gave the word "hacker" its original meaning, decades before it came to mean "cracker." Compiled by Eric S. Raymond and Guy L. Steele and continued today as a community project, it's the closest thing hacking has to an etymology. Over 2,300 entries, all bundled in the app: * Browse alphabetically with a fast-scroll index * Instant search across terms and definitions, with your recent searches remembered * Tap any cross-referenced term to jump straight to it * Share or copy a definition to paste anywhere * Favorite entries for quick access later * "Surprise me" with a random entry — or long-press the app icon to jump straight to one Zero permissions. Zero network access, ever — the dictionary ships inside the app, favorites stay on your device, nothing is ever sent anywhere. No accounts, no ads, no analytics. Dictionary content is CC BY-SA 4.0 from the Jargon File community edition (github.com/agiacalone/jargonfile). App source is GPL-3.0.

name: Steam Server Browser

Features: * Browse Steam master server results through the Steam Web API. * Query live A2S_INFO, A2S_PLAYER, and A2S_RULES data. * Refresh loaded servers without fetching a new master list. * Save favorites and manually add IP:port entries. * Filter by map, tags, ping, players, countries, and local search text. * Import an optional MMDB database for offline country lookup. The app does not bundle an MMDB database. Geo features stay disabled until the user imports one manually.

name: TourCount
short: A butterfly monitoring app for species-specific registering of butterflies in Eu
description: TourCount supports species-specific and individually GPS-localized registering of butterflies. New in Version 3.8.4: - Code improvements - Entering individuals notes proposed by predefined wordings like "Photo", "Flyby", "Fresh imago", … - Entering species notes proposed by the predefined wordings "New species", "1st in season" and "Not sure" - Cloud %-values rounded to multiples of 10 - More restrictive plausi for input of metadata numbers - "Help" text updated - Docs updated - Bugfix for importing a species list Features: - Data recording is organized for a regional tour with its expected butterfly species. - Databases can be individually created and adapted within the app regarding metadata and expected butterfly species. - The app has an internal pool of many European species and comes with a prepared basic database with the most common species in Europe as a starting point for direct use. - Separate counters for ♂-♀-indeterminate, ♂, ♀, pupa, larva or egg. - You may use an individual species list per region. - Results are prepared for easy readout to transfer them to the science4you entry mask for butterfly registration. - The results can be exported in formatted XLSX or CSV format, as well as in an SQLite database file (e.g. to transfer them to a PC, for easier reading in a spreadsheet program, or for further processing). - Help contains a detailed userguide. - TourCount supports counting in German, English, French, Italian and Spanish language and provides locale species names in these languages. name: time-tracking
short: Keep track of your working hours with precision and ease
description: Effortless Time Tracking: Keep track of your working hours with precision and ease. - Manual Entry: Add, edit, or remove time entries with custom notes. - Visual Overview: Switch between Day, Week, and Month views to analyze your productivity. - Smart Logic: Automatically calculates duration and keeps your records organized. Multi-language Support: Use the app in your preferred language. - Languages: Currently supports English and German. - Auto-detection: Automatically detects your device language settings.

name: Öffi Sounds
short: Podcast app with ARD Sounds, BBC Sounds & public radio integration

It focuses on discovering and listening to content from German public radio via ARD Sounds (formerly ARD Audiothek), while keeping the core AntennaPod podcast management and playback features. Source code: https://github.com/thrillfall/OeffiSounds Translations: https://hosted.weblate.org/projects/antennapod/

name: Hupl
short: Upload files to any HTTP server from Android's share menu.
description: Hupl is a simple file uploader for Android. Share files from any app directly to your configured HTTP upload servers. Features: * Upload files via the Android share menu * Configure multiple upload servers with custom parameters * Import/export server configurations as JSON * Keep a history of uploads and generated links * Optional image resize/compression before upload * Works with most simple filehosts (POST-based uploads) * Preconfigured uploaders for popular services * No tracking, no ads, no accounts All your upload history and host configurations are stored locally on your device. Nothing is sent to third parties except the files you explicitly choose to upload.

name: HeliBoard
short: Customizable open-source keyboard
description: HeliBoard is a privacy-conscious open-source keyboard, based on AOSP / OpenBoard. Does not use internet permission, and thus is 100% offline. Features: Add dictionaries for suggestions and spell check build your own, or get them here , or in the experimental section (quality may vary) additional dictionaries for emojis or scientific symbols can be used to provide suggestions (similar to "emoji search") note that for Korean layouts, suggestions only work using this dictionary , the tools in the dictionary repository are not able to create working dictionaries Customize keyboard themes (style, colors and background image) can follow the system's day/night setting on Android 10+ (and on some versions of Android 9) can follow dynamic colors for Android 12+ Customize keyboard layouts (only available when disabling use system languages ) Customize special layouts, like symbols, number, or functional key layout Multilingual typing Glide typing ( only with closed source library ☹️) library not included in the app, as there is no compatible open source library available can be extracted from GApps packages (" swypelibs "), or downloaded here (click on the file and then "raw" or the tiny download button) Clipboard history One-handed mode Split keyboard (only available if the screen is large enough) Number pad Backup and restore your settings and learned word / history data

name: XiVPN
short: Proxy client based on XRAY
description: XiVPN is a GUI wrapper for Xray that utilizes Android's built-in VPN feature to route internet traffic through the Xray core. It aims to provide an intuitive user interface for all common Xray configurations, allowing non-technical users to take advantage of powerful features without writing complex JSON files. What is Xray? Xray is a high-performance network proxy tool that supports multiple protocols including VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, and more. Unlike traditional VPNs that route all traffic through a single server with standard protocols, Xray offers more flexibility and stealth capabilities. This makes Xray widely used in regions with high internet censorship where traditional VPNs (like WireGuard and openvpn) blocked. What unique does XiVPN offer? - Proxy Chains: Connect multiple proxy servers in sequence to create layered tunnels for better privacy - Proxy Group: Organize servers into groups and easily switch between different servers - Routing Rules: Routes internet traffic to different servers or groups based on IP address, port number, and domain name - Separate process for Xray core: Runs the Xray core as a separate process, preventing memory leaks during restarts and avoiding app-wide crashes caused by core panics

name: Fossify Documents Beta
short: Read PDF, DOCX, text, Markdown, CSV and HTML files privately and offline.
description: Fossify Documents is a private, offline document reader and organizer built for simplicity. Open PDF, DOCX, text, Markdown, CSV, TSV, and HTML files, and keep important documents within easy reach without ads, tracking, or internet access. 📄 READ DOCUMENTS WITH EASE • Open PDF, DOCX, plain text, Markdown, CSV, TSV, and HTML documents. • Navigate PDF pages, zoom in or out, and use a distraction-free full-screen viewer. • Open password-protected PDFs. • Read DOCX files in a clean, mobile-friendly layout. • Browse CSV and TSV files in a dedicated table viewer. • View HTML documents safely and completely offline. • Preview formatted Markdown with headings, lists, tables, links, code, and more. • Print PDFs or open documents in another compatible app. ✍️ CREATE AND EDIT • Create new text and Markdown files anywhere supported by Android. • Edit existing text and Markdown documents. • Edit CSV and TSV files as plain text while keeping the table viewer for reading. • Use convenient Markdown formatting controls for headings, bold text, italics, quotes, lists, and code. • Keep track of word and character counts while editing. 📁 KEEP EVERYTHING ORGANIZED • Add folders and browse their supported documents directly in the app. • Quickly return to recently opened documents. • Mark important documents as favorites. • Search, filter, and sort by name, date, or file size. • Switch between comfortable list and grid layouts. 🔒 PRIVATE BY DESIGN Fossify Documents works completely offline and has no internet permission. Your documents remain on your device and in the storage locations you choose. There are no ads, analytics, or tracking. 🎨 MADE FOR YOU Customize the app with Fossify themes, colors, icons, and fonts. Light and dark themes are fully supported, giving you a document experience that feels at home on your device. Simple. Private. Yours. Explore more Fossify apps: https://www.fossify.org Open-Source Code: https://www.github.com/FossifyOrg Join the community on Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/Fossify Connect on Telegram: https://t.me/Fossify

A bottom bar offers zoom, reset, export, and a menu for **12 formulas** (Mandelbrot, Burning Ship, Tricorn, Julia, Phoenix, and more) and **12 palettes** with preview swatches. Toggle smooth coloring, set fixed / zoom-scaled / adaptive iteration limits, and edit Julia or Phoenix parameters. Your last viewport and choices are restored when you reopen the app. Rendering is progressive and entirely on-device. The fractal draws edge-to-edge under the system bars. name: Pulse

description: A Garmin-only fork of Gadgetbridge with a new look. It pairs with your Garmin watch over Bluetooth and keeps everything on your phone. No account, no vendor app, no cloud. What's in it: * Today screen with a steps ring and swipeable metric tiles * Sleep with a score, stages and a 7-night trend * Fitness and Health tabs you can customise * Intensity minutes with a daily view (Garmin only shows weekly) * Workouts, streaks and shareable cards * Light/dark and accent colours Built on Gadgetbridge's Garmin engine, so your data never leaves the phone (apart from optional weather).

name: Saber
short: The notes app built for handwriting
description: Saber is the notes app built for handwriting. It's designed to be as simple and intuitive as possible, while still delivering unique features that you'll actually use. Additionally, Saber is available across all your devices, large and small, and syncs between them seamlessly. Notably, it can invert your notes when you're in dark mode. This allows you to write with white ink on a black background, which is much easier on the eyes in low-light environments like when the teacher turns off the lights in class. Images and PDFs are also inverted, so you can still use a digital printout or a textbook without the fuss. Saber uses a dual-password system to protect your notes from anyone but you, even if they have complete control over the server. You can safely store your notes on the official Saber server, another server, or even host your own! The app is completely open-source so that anyone can view the source code and see exactly what it's doing and how it handles your data. Many other note-taking apps are closed-source and proprietary, meaning that their inner workings are a mystery to the public. As someone who studies maths, highlighting multi-line equations was always a hassle with other apps, where the highlighter would change color when it overlapped with itself. Another problem I had was that in some apps, the highlighter would render on top of the text, fading it out and making it hard to read. Saber's highlighter has no such issues. It utilizes canvas compositing to render the highlighter in a way that is consistent with/better than traditional paper, where it handles overlaps and maintains color consistency. Saber has everything you need to keep your notes organized. Create folders inside folders inside folders to your heart's content with no limit on the number of nested folders. And even though a note may be buried deep within a nested folder, you can still access it easily with your most recent notes always available on the home screen. Discover a whole new way to capture and organize your thoughts with Saber. Whether you're a student, professional, or creative mind, Saber is your trusted companion for digital handwriting. Download now and let your ideas flow freely!

name: GPSTest
short: An app for testing GPS and GNSS capabilities of a device
description: GPSTest displays real-time information for satellites in view of your device. A vital open-source test tool for platform engineers, developers, and power users, GPSTest can also assist users in understanding why their GPS/GNSS is or isn't working. Supports: * GPS (USA Navstar) * GLONASS (Russia) * QZSS (Japan) * BeiDou/COMPASS (China) * Galileo (European Union) * Various satellite-based augmentation systems SBAS (e.g., GAGAN, Anik F1, Galaxy 15, Inmarsat 3-F2, Inmarsat 4-F3, SES-5) GLONASS satellites are shown as squares on the Sky view, U.S. NAVSTAR satellites are shown as circles, Galileo and QZSS and SBAS satellites are shown as triangles, and BeiDou satellites are shown as pentagons. Menu options: * Inject Time Data - Injects Time assistance data for GPS into the platform, using information from a Network Time Protocol (NTP) server provided by the device OEM using an Android API in AOSP * Inject XTRA Data - Injects XTRA assistance data for GPS into the platform, using information from a XTRA server provided by the device OEM using an Android API in AOSP * Clear Assist Data - Clears all assistance data used for GPS, including NTP and XTRA data provided by the device OEM * Settings - Switch between light and dark themes, change map tile type, auto-start GPS on startup, minimum time and distance between GPS updates, keep screen on.

There are no purchases, ads, or paid unlocks. Portion information is general orientation only. Esca Agnellis is an independent digital implementation, uses no BZfE/BLE artwork, and is not affiliated with, endorsed, supported, or sponsored by BZfE or BLE. The app is not medical, dietary, or individualized nutritional advice. The application code and build scripts are free software under GPL-3.0-only.

name: Materializr
short: Maker 3D CAD — the middle ground between Tinkercad and FreeCAD
description: Materializr is open-source 3D CAD for makers — the middle ground between dead-simple tools like Tinkercad and full professional suites like FreeCAD. Enough genuine solid modeling to make real parts, without a steep learning curve, a subscription, or an account. Sketch on a plane, pull it into a solid (extrude, revolve, loft, sweep), fillet and chamfer, run boolean operations, cut threads, and edit any step of the history later — even after closing and reopening the project. Sketches export to SVG at 1:1 millimeters for laser cutters and 2.5D CNC. It also imports STEP and IGES, and exports STEP, STL, IGES and glTF. The geometry kernel is OpenCASCADE — real B-rep solids, not meshes. The interface is touch-capable on Android, designed for tablets and larger screens (on a small phone the panels and toolbars are cramped). File open/save use the system document picker (Storage Access Framework); no broad storage permission is requested. Young software built quickly, so expect rough edges. Operations validate their results and refuse rather than silently produce garbage, so a failed action leaves your model untouched — but save often, and please report bugs.

name: Aalener Optik-Formelrechner
short: Quick and easy calculate a bunch of optical functions
description: The Aalener Optik-Formelrechner enables a quick and easy option to calculate a bunch of optical functions. At the moment the following features are implemented: - Paraxial raytracing - Exact raytracing for an object on the opitcal axis - Calculation of oblique crossed cylinders with optional sphere - Calculation of refraction index. - Calculation of relative transmission - Calculation of radii for lenses which are free of spherical aberration or coma - Calculation and visualization for error of refraction, astigmatism, distortion, volume, weight and dimensions of spherical toric lenses - Conversion of Back Vertex Distances (eg. glasses to contact lenses) This application was part of a bachelor thesis for the study program opthalmic optics and audiology at Aalen University. It is meant to check calculations and takes part in the interactive lectures. Please be advised that the whole application is in german only. If you are an optician it is highly possible that you will understand most of the functions by their formula symbols.

name: Bugbane Beta
short: Beta channel of Bugbane, a guided forensic self-triage tool for Android
description: This is the beta channel of Bugbane, released ahead of the stable app for early testing. Expect rough edges; it installs alongside the stable app. Bugbane is an open-source Android application designed to help users perform basic forensic self-triage on their own devices. It uses Wireless ADB to collect the same type of data that tools like AndroidQF or MVT would extract, but without requiring external computers, cables, or command-line expertise. Requirements Wireless ADB must be available on your device (Android 11+). A Wi-Fi connection to pair the device locally. Basic understanding that this tool is for self-triage and cannot guarantee detection. Features A step-by-step wizard to guide you through enabling developer options, pairing ADB, and preparing for acquisition. One-click forensic acquisition of relevant device logs and configurations. Encrypted export options through system dialogs, Signal, or email. Ability to delete or rename existing acquisitions locally. Indicators of compromise are periodically updated from mvt-indicators . Ability to keep acquisitions on device, and scan them multiple times using new indicators, to detect past compromises. Security and Privacy Bugbane does not transmit your data automatically. All exports remain on-device until you decide to share them with trusted organizations or analysts. Planned Improvements Streamlined workflows for collaborating organizations. Localization and accessibility enhancements. Automated rescan of past acquisitions after each indicators update. Translations Help us improve translations and documentation by contributing via our GitHub repository . Important Notice Bugbane is intended for individuals who suspect their device may be compromised by stalkerware, spyware, or non-consensual forensics, however no app can confirm if your phone is clean. If you have strong reasons to believe your device is compromised, consider using a separate trusted device and consult with professionals.

name: ConsoleFlow

description: ConsoleFlow is a developer-focused Android browser built on WebView. It automatically injects Eruda — a mobile-friendly JavaScript console — into every page you visit, so you can inspect elements, debug scripts, view network requests, and catch errors directly on your device without needing a desktop. Features: - Automatic Eruda console injection on all pages - Custom JavaScript injection per session - Desktop mode (switches User-Agent to Chrome desktop) - Bookmarks and browsing history - Find in page - Multiple search engines: Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Brave - Dark theme throughout - Download manager integration - No telemetry, no tracking, no ads

Mute audio 2. Local music files 3. Interdimensional Cable from Rick and Morty (discontinued) Browse https://adfree.abertschi.ch for more information.

short: Hides ads, sponsored cards and clickbait in Google Discover
description: Discover Feed Filter cleans up Google Discover, the news feed on the Pixel Launcher -1 screen and inside the Google app. What it removes: - Sponsored cards and ads, dropped before they reach the feed - Clickbait, with your own filters. Hide stories by headline or source, plain text or regex, starting from the built-in clickbait presets - Google's share.google redirect links. Shared articles use their real link instead The dashboard counts the ads and clickbait articles it has hidden. After a Google app update, open the app and rescan, or turn on auto-repair to handle it automatically with root. Prerequisites: the Google app (com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox), and a rooted device (KernelSU, APatch or Magisk) running an Xposed framework manager such as LSPosed or Vector. The module does nothing without both. Also dislike ads in the Google Play Store? Try the sister module playstore-adblock: https://github.com/hxreborn/playstore-adblock

name: rsend
short: Push phone folders to home SSH hosts with rsync over SSH
description: Pushes configured phone folders (DCIM, WhatsApp media, call recordings, and so on) to one or more home SSH hosts using rsync over SSH. One-way push only, on an unmetered network by default, periodic or on demand. rsync and the SSH transport are built from source and shipped inside the APK. The app needs all-files access to read arbitrary backup folders such as OEM call-recording directories. Features: * Multiple named remotes; each folder picks its destination host. * Incremental transfers; large videos resume from a private partial directory. * Per-folder deletion policy: additive backup or mirror. * Runs on an unmetered network, periodically or on demand. * Ed25519 client-key auth with strict, pinned host-key verification.

name: scrcpy
short: Mirror a second Android device over wireless ADB. No root required.
description: This app mirrors a second Android device on your phone or tablet over Wireless ADB, the same way the desktop scrcpy tool does. The device running this app is the source; the target is any Android 11+ device with Wireless Debugging enabled. Video, audio, touch, key input, and clipboard are forwarded between them. No root is required on either side. Features: * Wireless pairing and connection using the target's Wireless Debugging code * Live video mirroring with selectable codec (H.264, H.265, or AV1) * Audio forwarding with selectable codec (raw or Opus) * Multi-touch, soft keys, and two-way clipboard sync * Adjustable max size and bit rate * Automatic reconnection when the link drops The app pushes the scrcpy server, built from Genymobile's scrcpy sources, to the target device and speaks the scrcpy protocol directly. It is written in plain Java with no proprietary dependencies. This is an independent client. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or produced by the scrcpy project or Genymobile; "scrcpy" is used only to say which protocol it speaks. Connections require TLS. Android's Wireless ADB protocol authenticates the client to the target, but its target certificate is process-scoped and cannot be pinned as a stable target identity. Use a trusted private network. To reach a remote target, put both devices on a VPN such as WireGuard rather than exposing the target's wireless-debugging port to the internet.

name: ANeko Reborn
short: A modern remake of Neko—your classic desktop cat pet on Android.
description: Bring the classic desktop cat to life on your Android screen with ANeko Reborn—a modern remake of the original Neko software and its Android ports ANeko and ANeko Plus. Originally popular on early computer systems, Neko was a tiny animated cat that followed your cursor across the screen. ANeko Reborn revives this nostalgic experience for modern Android devices, bringing back the charm of a playful cat companion that moves freely over your interface. ANeko Reborn is built for smooth performance and updated compatibility while staying true to the spirit of the originals. Features: • Enjoy a virtual cat that walks, sits, and sleeps on your screen • Switch between different classic and custom Neko skins • Designed for modern Android versions with improved stability • Based on the legacy of nekoDA, oneko, ANeko, and other similar apps Whether you remember Neko from your desktop days or are just discovering it for the first time, ANeko Reborn is a delightful and nostalgic companion that runs right on your phone. Open-source project: https://github.com/pass-with-high-score/ANeko Learn more about the original software: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neko_(software)

name: SmartScan
short: Turn your images and videos into a personal knowledge base.
description: Turn your images and videos into a personal knowledge base. Search, organise, and rediscover the media you've saved, with automatic collections and concepts that help you find information you might otherwise forget. Search Find images and videos using text or image search Search by tags or tag + text queries Search from other apps using share or intent Paste images directly into the search bar Automatic Collections Automatically group visually similar media into collections Browse related photos and videos without manually organising them Concepts Organise media by meaning, not just appearance Create concepts around topics or ideas and automatically find matching media using descriptions Generate image descriptions automatically or add and edit descriptions yourself Tagging Add tags to your media Use tag autocomplete when searching or tagging Duplicate Management Detect duplicate media Filter your library to include, exclude, or show only duplicates Privacy SmartScan is offline-first Your media, tags, collections, concepts, and generated descriptions are stored and processed on your device Generating image descriptions optionally uses cloud processing and requires an internet connection

name: ToLoShare
short: ToLoShare Location Share via Tox
description: ToLoShare - Share your Location via Tox A way to easily share your Location via Tox. You can share your location live on a map (openstreetmap) with friends and family. Have a look at the desktop version: https://github.com/zoff99/toloshare_material

name: Rubber Ring
short: A looper for practicing song parts.
description: Rubber Ring is a tool for practicing song parts. Pick an audio file, mark a start/stop region on its waveform, and play it back in a seamless, gapless loop. It auto-detects tempo and beats to snap the loop markers to a beat grid, with full manual override. Early-stage release — expect rough edges. Feedback and bug reports welcome via Issues. Features: * Import-and-own library — picked files are copied into app-private storage, so loops never break when the original is moved, renamed, or deleted. * Waveform region selection with gapless looping — drag start/stop handles to mark a section; the loop boundary wraps with zero audible gap or click. * Automatic, hand-editable beat grid — a dependency-free estimator finds BPM and a downbeat, and handles snap to the beat grid. * Chord detection with a hand-editable chord lane — chords are labelled over the waveform; tap to relabel, split or merge. Detection is tuned to the author's own material, so the lane is there to correct by hand, and can be turned off. * Per-track audio normalization — boost a track that was mixed too quietly, by peak or by loudness; your original file is never altered. * Adjustable playback speed — slow a tricky passage down (or speed it up) without changing pitch. * Count-in — long-press Play to start after a metronome counts you in at the track's tempo. * Saved loops and practice arrangements — capture named sections per track and chain them into a sequence, each repeated as many times as you set. * Backup & restore — export your whole library to a file and restore it after a reinstall. * English and German, with optional German note names (H and B) for chords. * Opens audio shared from other apps. No ads, no trackers, no network access.

name: 随机姓名
short: 随机中文姓名生成器
description: 一个简单好用的随机中文姓名生成 App，适合小说作者、游戏玩家、起名爱好者使用。 功能特色： * 按性别选择名字风格：通用 / 男 / 女 * 内置 3500 字原始字库和三份精选字库 * 支持导入自己的名字用字文件（.txt） * 在 App 内直接新建/删除/重命名名字库 * 自动记住上次使用的字库 * 支持导入外部文件 * GPLv3 开源

name: Noor Connect
short: Premium privacy-first Islamic companion: Quran, Qibla, Adhan, & Habit tracking.
description: Noor Connect is a comprehensive, beautifully designed, and strictly privacy-first Islamic digital companion. Built to modern standards, it serves as your premium, tracker-free tool for daily spiritual growth. Key Features & Tools: • Enhanced Quran & Tafsir: Clean Quran reading interface with 25+ global Tafsir editions and multilingual translations instantly accessible offline. Features background audio recitation. • Native Home Screen Widgets: 5 beautiful, lightning-fast native widgets for your home screen (Next Prayer countdown, Daily Ayah, Daily Hadith, Quran Progress, and interactive Tasbeeh Counter). • Premium Qibla Compass: High-precision native sensor integration with an exquisite UI, Kaaba alignment glow effects, and haptic feedback. • Smart Prayer Times & Adhan: Fast, precise offline calculations (Hanafi & Shafi'i) with granular audio toggles for individual prayers and a robust background alarm engine. • Islamic Menstrual Tracker (Noor Cycle): A professional, Fiqh-aware menstrual tracker that intelligently adapts to your phase—automatically silencing obligatory Adhans and halting charts without breaking streaks. • Essential Calculators: Built-in advanced tools to accurately determine annual Zakat obligations and Ramadan Fitrana. • Extensive Islamic Library: Authentic Hisnul Muslim Duas, 99 Names of Allah with animations, gamified Islamic Quizzes, Tibb-e-Nabawi (Islamic Remedies), and complete Eid checklists. • Qaza & Habit Ledgers: Long-term offline ledger for missed prayers (Qaza Tracker), digital Tasbeeh goals, and weekly spiritual habit consistency. • Rich Media: 24/7 Live Makkah/Madinah broadcast streams and an optimized 87K+ Hadith encyclopedia. • Mood-Based Reflections: Tailored Daily Ayahs and Islamic Greetings based on how you feel. Privacy First Principle: Noor Connect strictly enforces Zero Analytics and Zero Trackers. All personal data, charts, and habits are stored purely on your local device with built-in backup and restore functionality. The code is entirely open-source, giving you absolute transparency and peace of mind.

name: LCTerm (Lucky Cat Terminal)
short: Bitcoin and Crypto point of sale payment system for merchants
description: LCTerm is a free and open-source Android Point-of-Sale application designed for merchants to accept and verify cryptocurrency payments. It runs on all android devices but was designed for android point-of-sale devices with a thermal receipt printer. It supports multiple assets, QR code generation, conversion at current market values, local currencies, and receipt printing, to enable point of sale transactions. LCTerm is not a wallet and holds no funds, rather it verifies the customer payments are made to addresses specified by business owners. To use LCTerm a merchant must have an API key available at Vericeive.com. This project is developed by Vermont Secure Computing and is fully open source for transparency and community trust.

name: just open links in a browser
short: Sends links to your real browser instead of an app's built-in one
description: Android apps love opening links in an in-app browser: a bare little window inside the app, with one page, no tabs, no extensions, no history, and nothing left when you close it. This app sends those links to your real browser instead. Set it as your default browser, then open it once to pick which of your installed browsers links should go to. From then on, every link an app hands to the system arrives in the browser you actually use, with your bookmarks, your logins and your content blocker. That is the whole app. There are no settings beyond that one choice. It has no network access of its own, and contains no analytics, no advertising and no tracking. It never loads a page: it passes the link on and gets out of the way. One limit worth knowing about. Some apps do not hand the link to the system at all and draw the page themselves. Facebook and Instagram are the usual examples. Nothing installed on the device can redirect those, this app included. Free software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3 or later.

name: Tella
short: Encrypt and hide files on your device
description: In challenging environments with limited or no internet connectivity or in the face of repression Tella makes it easier and safer to document events, whether that’s violence, human rights violations, corruption, or electoral fraud. ENCRYPTION: All of the content and data stored in Tella are encrypted. This means that unless the app is unlocked, all the data within Tella will remain inaccessible. FILE MANAGEMENT: Take photos, videos, or audio recordings directly in Tella, or import documents from your phone, and easily organize your files in folders. CAMOUFLAGE: Change the app icon and name to a seemingly harmless one, such as a calculator or a camera. QUICK DELETE: In just a few seconds, delete all the sensitive data and files stored in Tella. DATA-COLLECTION: Groups and organizations can collect data through forms and surveys, and received the data directly on their server.

name: Home Medkit
short: Home Medkit — medicine storage and intake reminders.
description: Home Medkit The application provides a simple and convenient way to add and store data about medications taken. Features * Automatically add medications by scanning codes. * Cloud synchronization of the list of medicines. * The ability to manually add medications. * Update the information about the medicine if the scan was performed without an internet connection. * Adding images of medicines. * Sorting of medicines by expiration dates. * Grouping of medicines by categories. * Sound notification of the need to take medicine. * Display of the nearest medication schedule. * Reminder of the expiration date of medicines. * The ability to export and import databases to other devices. The application provides the ability to monitor the expiration dates of medicines, schedule their intake and receive reminders. It is an indispensable assistant that will help you keep abreast of your health.

name: Hail
short: Freeze Android apps
description: Hail is a free-as-in-freedom software to freeze Android apps. Enjoy all features freely! Freeze Freeze is a word to describe the action of forbid apps when they are unnecessary to use device in a better way, cut down the usage of ram and save power. User can unfreeze it to revert. In general, "freeze" means disable, but also Hail can "freeze" apps by hiding and suspending them. Disable Disable apps will not shown in launcher. Enable them to revert. Hide Hidden apps will not shown in launcher and installed app list. Unhide them to revert. Suspend Suspended apps will be shown as grayscale icons in the launcher. Unsuspend them to revert. Working mode Hail can work with Device Owner , Dhizuku , Superuser (Root) and Shizuku (including Sui).

name: SoundPod
short: A minimalist music streaming app
description: SoundPod is a minimalist, open-source music player. Built with Jetpack Compose, it offers a modern interface for streaming media using publicly accessible APIs. Key Features: • Background playback and persistent queue management. • High-quality caching for offline playback. • Comprehensive search for songs, albums, artists, and playlists. • Bookmark your favorite artists and albums for quick access. • Import and manage local and remote playlists. • Fetch, display, and edit synchronized or static lyrics. • Seamlessly opens YouTube and YouTube Music links. • Smart features: Sleep timer, skip silence, and audio normalization. • Ecosystem support: Full Android Auto integration. • Invincible service to ensure uninterrupted background listening.

name: Tilde Friends
short: A Secure Scuttlebutt decentralized social network client
description: Tilde Friends is both a peer-to-peer social network client, participating in Secure Scuttlebutt, as well as a platform for writing and running web applications.

name: Ichaival
short: Mobile client for the LANraragi manga/doujinshi web manager
description: Features * View and search your LANraragi database * View tags * Read archives * Bookmark archives to keep track of your current page * Sort archives by date (requires archives to be tagged with the DateAdded plugin) * View dual pages in landscape mode

name: Vadhod APK Extractor
short: Offline, privacy-first APK extractor with proper split-APK support.
description: Vadhod APK Extractor is a beautiful, privacy-first tool to extract and back up the APK of any app installed on your device — completely offline. Modern apps ship as "split APKs". Vadhod handles them properly: simple apps export as a clean single .apk, while split apps are bundled into one reinstallable .apks archive automatically. Your backups actually reinstall. PRIVATE BY DESIGN * 100% offline — the app has NO internet permission at all. * No tracking, no analytics, no ads, no accounts. * Nothing ever leaves your device. Files are saved only to the folder you choose. EXTRACT & BACK UP * Browse every installed app, split into System and User tabs. * Search and sort by name, size, install date or last update. * Extract a single app, or select many and batch-extract at once. * Save to any folder using Android's Storage Access Framework. SPLIT-APK AWARE * Export the base APK, or bundle base + splits into a reinstallable .apks archive. INSPECT & SHARE * See version, size, min/target SDK, install dates. * View the signing certificate (SHA-256) and the APK's contents. * Share an extracted APK, or export any app's icon as a PNG. BEAUTIFUL * A soft, calm pastel design with light and dark themes. Vadhod APK Extractor is open source and built to respect you: minimal permissions, minimal footprint, zero data collection. Note: The "Query all apps" (QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES) permission is used solely to list the apps installed on your device so you can extract them. This information stays on your device and is never collected or transmitted.

name: NerdCalci
short: Calculator for nerds with variables, syntax highlighting, and file sessions
description: NerdCalci is a powerful calculator designed for nerds and power users who need more than basic arithmetic. Features: - Offline - Works without internet - Variable support - Define variables and reuse them in calculations - Percentage calculations - Natural syntax like "20% of 50000" or "15% off 1000" - Unit conversions - Natural syntax like "10 m in feet" or "100 kmph to mph" - Calendar-aware date and time engine with timezone support - Custom functions - Define your own functions with multi-statement support and scope isolation - Dynamic variables - Quickly compute block sums (`total`) and averages (`avg`) - Syntax highlighting - Color-coded numbers, variables, operators, and comments - Smart error diagnostics - See human-friendly explanation of math or syntax errors - Auto-completion - Smart suggestions for variable names - Comments - Document your calculations with # comments - Multiple files - Organize calculations in separate files with auto-save - Tags - Organize files with custom tags - Pin files - Keep frequently used files at the top - Search - Search your files easily by name or tag - Duplicate files - Create a copy of a file with a new name - Undo/Redo - Up to 30 steps per file - Backups - Automatically or manually backup your files to app storage or a custom folder - Restore from backups - Restore your files from backups - Copy with results - Copy calculations with their results - Export - Share your calculations as a PNG image or a multi-page PDF - Dark/light theme - System, dark, or light mode support - Line numbers - Easy reference and navigation Perfect for: - Quick calculations with reusable values - Budget planning and financial calculations - Unit conversions and formulas - Educational purposes and learning - Any scenario where you need to document and reuse calculation values NerdCalci combines the simplicity of a calculator with the power of a text editor. As a capable alternative to text-based calculators like Numi, Calca, and Soulver, it is ideal for developers, students, accountants, and anyone who frequently works with numbers.

name: Fortune Telling
short: Offline Western astrology, I Ching divination, and Chinese daily almanac
description: Language notice The app interface and all divination content are currently available in Chinese only. Fortune Telling blends Western astrology and traditional Chinese divination into a single, calm, offline companion. Western astrology Enter a birth date, time, and place to calculate your Sun, Moon, and Ascendant (rising) sign using real astronomical position data (via the astronomy-engine library), not a simplified date lookup table. Birth time and location are used only for the calculation on your device and are never sent anywhere. I Ching (Yi Jing) divination Cast one of the 64 hexagrams with a traditional coin-toss style ritual, including changing lines and the resulting transformed hexagram, each paired with interpretive guidance. Daily Chinese almanac (黄历) A daily card showing the lunar date, the day's guardian deity, auspicious and inauspicious activities (宜/忌), directional conflicts (冲煞), lunar mansion (星宿), and a reference table of auspicious hours (吉时参考), computed locally from the lunar calendar. Privacy The app makes no network requests and includes no analytics, advertising, or tracking of any kind. All calculations run entirely on your device. Appearance Two visual themes are included, switchable at any time.

name: Heliodos
short: AR overlay of the sun's and moon's path on your camera
description: Heliodos is an augmented reality (AR) app that overlays the sun's and moon's trajectories onto your live camera feed, so you can see exactly where sunlight will fall at any time of year — right through your phone's viewfinder. Stand in your garden, on a building plot, or any outdoor space, point your camera at the sky, and instantly see the sun's arc for the summer solstice, winter solstice, equinox, and the current date and time, plus the moon's current trajectory — including any obstacles in the sun's path. Features AR sun and moon trajectories : The sun's path for the solstices, the equinox, and the current moment — plus the moon's current trajectory — are drawn directly over the live camera image, with hour tick marks and time labels on the current paths. Customisable paths : Toggle individual paths on or off and pick custom colours for each in the settings. Flexible location : Uses your GPS location automatically, or lets you set any place on Earth manually. Custom time : Simulate the sun's position at any time of day, not just right now. Camera selection : Pinch to zoom to cycle through available back cameras (wide-angle, normal, telephoto). Use cases Gardening : Find out which spots get full sun in summer versus winter before you plant. Real estate : Check how much natural light a room or terrace receives throughout the year. Architecture & construction : Plan shading, windows, and solar panels with real-world sun data. Photography : Scout locations and predict golden-hour angles in advance. Heliodos requires camera and location permissions to function. No data is collected or transmitted.

name: WebSpace
short: Bring your favorite web apps to your phone
description: Organize all your web apps in one streamlined app. Features include cookie isolation for keeping accounts separate and secure, ClearURLs tracking parameter removal, DNS blocklist domain blocking, and LocalCDN resource caching for privacy, proxy support, workspace organization for grouping sites by category, and find-in-page search. Perfect for managing multiple accounts, separating work and personal sites, and accessing web-based tools efficiently.

name: UP-Example
short: Example application using UnifiedPush library
description: This application is a generic application using UnifiedPush. It can be used to test your settings. You need to install an UnifiedPush distributor for this to work. More information at https://unifiedpush.org

name: Nontrinsic
short: Where nonsense lives on.
description: Nontrinsic is an open archive dedicated to preserving nonsense. Browse the archive and contribute your own entries—whether structured or unstructured, intentional or purely accidental. Features Browse the Nontrinsic archive Write and submit entries Persistent drafts (saved automatically until submitted) Full offline access after initial loading View text entries with images, video, and audio Connect to another Nontrinsic instance Material You theming (Android 12+) Switch between galaxy and classic cluster app icons No tracking or analytics Supports Android 5+

name: BitBanana
short: Unleash your Bitcoin Lightning node!
description: ⚡️ Superpowers for you and your Bitcoin Lightning node! Use and manage your node wherever you are. ⚡️ BitBanana is a native Android app for node operators focused on user experience and ease of use. While it is not a wallet on its own, BitBanana works like a remote control, allowing you to use your node as a wallet wherever you go. The app is designed with an educational approach, providing the user with guidance on every aspect of node operation. BitBanana is open source and fully self-custodial, which means you are in full control of your funds. Features: - Manage multiple nodes - On-chain transactions and lightning payments - Channel management - Routing summary - Contacts - Sign/Verify - NFC support - Tor support - 100% open source ... and many other features to explore!

name: Pachli for Mastodon
short: A full-featured Android client for Mastodon and similar servers.
description: Pachli is a full-featured client for Mastodon and similar servers. - Read, reply, filter, post, favourite, and boost posts - Translate posts from other languages - Your timeline is cached locally, so you can read when offline - Draft posts now, to finish them later - Write posts now, schedule them to send later - Read and post from multiple accounts - Multiple themes - Focused on ensuring all functionality is available to people with accessibility needs - Open source, https://github.com/pachli

name: VerveDo
short: A concise to-do app that follows Material 3 Expressive.
description: VerveDo is a concise to-do app that follows Material 3 Expressive. You can use it to keep track of your daily school homeworks or as a memo for everyday life. You can set priorities to each task and sort them, helping you stay organized and in control of your life.

name: Internet Radio
short: Discover and listen to thousands of free internet radio stations worldwide.
description: Internet Radio is a free, open-source application that lets you discover and listen to thousands of radio stations from all around the world. Features: Discover: Browse an extensive list of radio stations powered by the community-driven RadioBrowser API. Global Reach: Easily filter and search for stations by country or language. Favorites: Save your preferred stations for quick and easy access later. History: Return to your recently played stations and previous searches effortlessly. Modern Interface: A clean, intuitive design ensuring a seamless listening experience. Privacy Friendly: Open-source and built with your privacy in mind.

name: Egyptian Writer
short: View, write and export ancient Egyptian texts.
description: Write ancient texts and browse all the avaible hieroglyphs on your tablet or phone. This is a simple Android app for viewing, creating and exporting ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs. This app supports the professional writing of hieroglyphs using the Manuel de Codage. Hieroglyphs can be written in lines or columns, and both from left to right and from right to left. This App is free and Open Source. Check out the Source Code: https://github.com/ThothDroid/Egyptian_Writer Currently, the app supports five basic MdC code concepts : : To align signs vertically * : To align signs horizontally () : To group signs . and .. : To make leave some space between the hieroglyphs ! and !! : To do a line break

name: BurnPony
short: Self-destructing encrypted notes. The recipient just opens a link.
description: Send a secret without making the other person install anything. Write a note, set the self-destruct rules, share one link. The note is encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM before anything is uploaded, and it decrypts only in the recipient's browser. The decryption key travels in the part of the link after the #, which browsers never send to any server — so the server stores ciphertext it cannot read, plus a note ID, a view count, and an expiry. No accounts, no names, no analytics. WHAT YOU CONTROL • Views: burn after 1 reading, or allow up to 100 • Expiry: 5 minutes to 30 days, changeable later, counted from now • Optional passphrase, stretched with PBKDF2 and mixed into the key — send it through a different channel than the link • Auto-hide: the revealed note re-hides after a timer • Read receipts, disclosed to the recipient before they reveal the note — BurnPony does not do silent read tracking • A private label for your own list; it never leaves your device • QR code for in-person handoff: the whole link, key included, transfers with no network at all HONEST LIMITS Whoever has the full link (and passphrase, if set) can read the note. A recipient can always copy or photograph a note while it is visible. Self-destruction limits future access; it does not control the moment of reading. OPEN The app, the server, the viewer, and the wire-format specification are open source (Apache-2.0), with cross-implementation test vectors shared with the iOS app and the web viewer. Self-hosters can point the app at their own server from Settings. Protocol: https://burnpony.app/protocol BurnPony is part of the pony family of privacy tools: encryption you can inspect instead of taking a developer's word for it.

name: Sound Toggle
short: quickly switch the audio mode of your device
description: Sound Toggle provides you with a QuickSettings tile to quickly switch the audio mode of your device between Normal, Vibrate and Silent.

name: Cairn: Health Aggregator
short: Aggregate your health data into open files in your own Nextcloud
description: Cairn reads your health and fitness data from the phone's health store — Apple Health on iOS, Health Connect on Android — and saves it as plain, open-format files (Open mHealth / IEEE 1752.1 JSON) in your own Nextcloud. You stay the sole owner of your data: there is no central server and the developer stores nothing. Requirements: * Android 14 or newer. Cairn reads through Health Connect, which is part of the system only from Android 14; on Android 8-13 it is a separate Google app from the Play Store, which a Play-less device cannot install — so the app would find nothing to read. * A Nextcloud of your own is optional: without one, Cairn still reads and shows your data, it just keeps the files on the phone. Features: * Reads heart rate, steps, body weight, sleep and workouts — read-only. Cairn never writes to your health store. * Syncs the files to your own Nextcloud over WebDAV, with optional background sync. * In-app dashboard with a sleep-stage deep-dive and a BMI computed from your latest weight. * Available in English and German. Privacy: * No advertising, no analytics, no trackers, no third-party services. * Your data lives only on your device and in the Nextcloud you control — never in any developer or third-party cloud. * HTTPS only. The Nextcloud app password is stored in the operating system's secure storage and can be revoked at any time. Cairn is an aggregator and viewer, not a medical device. It makes no diagnostic or treatment claims.

name: Marlin
short: Identify marine species on the spot and keep a personal sightings life list
description: Marlin: Marine Species ID & Life List Ever spotted a fish, ray, or jellyfish while diving or snorkeling and wondered what it was? Marlin helps you identify marine life on the spot, learn more about it, and build your own personal life list of every species you encounter. Spot it, look it up, and add it to your life list — built for everything that lives in the ocean. WHAT YOU CAN DO Identify species near you See which marine species are commonly recorded near your current location, or anywhere you choose, powered by real observation data from the iNaturalist community. Search and learn Look up any marine species by name, or explore by classification, tapping through families and groups to discover related species. Each species page brings together photos, a range map, a seasonality chart, a Wikipedia summary, and IUCN Red List conservation status. Build your life list Log every sighting with notes, photos, and a precise location. Your life list keeps a running record of every species you've encountered, ready to revisit any time. See your sightings on a map "My Map" plots every sighting you've logged, color-coded by group (fish, sharks and rays, mollusks, jellyfish, marine mammals, and more), so you can see where and what you've found at a glance. Make it yours Choose a light, dark, or system theme, and set a manual location for logging sightings from a past trip. PRIVACY BY DESIGN Marlin doesn't ask you to create an account. There is no tracking, no analytics, and no advertising. Your life list, photos, and notes stay on your device, under your control, with manual export/import whenever you want it. Whether you're a diver, snorkeler, beachcomber, or simply curious about what's living in the water near you, Marlin turns every encounter into something you can identify, learn from, and remember.

name: Milki Launcher
short: Android launcher with multi-source search
description: Milki Launcher is a custom Android home screen replacement built from scratch with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It focuses on speed, a clean interface, and powerful search capabilities. Features: Multi-Mode Search: Search apps, contacts, files, the web, and YouTube from a single search bar. Use prefixes to filter results: no prefix for apps, "s " for web search, "c " for contacts. Smart Home Screen: Place apps, shortcuts, folders, and widgets anywhere on a customizable grid. Drag and drop to rearrange items. Pin your most-used apps for instant access. App Drawer: Scroll through all installed apps in an organized grid. File Search: Find documents on your device directly from the launcher. Widget Support: Add and manage home screen widgets with a built-in widget picker. Folder Support: Group apps into folders on your home screen for better organization. Backup and Restore: Export your home screen layout and settings for safekeeping. Permissions: - Read Contacts: Used for contact search (optional) - Manage External Storage: Used for file search features - Device Admin: Used only for the screen lock feature Source code is available on GitHub under the GPL-3.0 license.

name: Auto Shine
short: Automatic screen brightness adjustment
description: Android app for automatic screen brightness adjustment. Replacement for built-in feature. WARNING: This app is not one click solution! It requires some configuration to work properly. It uses 4 pairs of light sensor data and corresponding screen brightness. In-between values calculated as simple linear interpolation of those points. Main intended working mode is "Screen unlock/rotate" - read ambient light data, set brightness once... and do not annoy with backlight beaming anymore. Permissions: - Modify system settings - required to control display brightness - Phone - keep reading light sensor data while phone ringing in pocket - Notifications - to prevent being killed by system - Request ignore battery optimizations - to prevent service suspend - Run background service - it has "special use" type because does not fit in any category - Run at startup - ...

name: Aerial
short: Just radio.
description: Aerial is just radio for Android. Features: - Explore curated radio collections for different moods and activities. - Access the stations you want quickly and easily. - Play live radio with artwork, track details, and Android media controls when available. - Set a sleep timer so playback stops automatically. - No sign-up. You are not the product, just listen to radio. - Keep listening privately with no ads, analytics, tracking SDKs, Firebase, or accounts. Aerial is simple, private, and focused on listening.

name: Package Manager

short: Connect your Zorin OS computer with your device
description: Zorin Connect provides several features to integrate your phone and your computer: * Sync your phone notifications with your computer * Browse photos from your phone * Reply to SMS messages * Share files and links between devices * Use your phone as a remote control for your computer The app seamlessly connects your computer and your mobile device over your local network, securely with RSA encryption. short: Enjoy podcasts with Tsacdop-Fork! A clean, simply beautiful, and friendly app.

Privacy Friendly : As a free and open source application, Tsacdop won't upload your data to any server.
