It was built to track meds that may be taken when needed, but in limited amounts.

name: crocson
short: Easily and securely send things from one computer to another
description: crocson — croc for Android, Windows, Linux, macOS. File transfer from sender to receiver - Via relay without port forwarding - Desktop: drag-and-drop, command line, stdin pipe, queue holds only file and directory references - Android: "Share" and "Open with" from file managers WebDAV — two-way file transfer - Built-in HTTP/HTTPS server - File browsing via browser, streaming audio/video - Tunneling through encrypted tunnel Chat - Web chat with session history - Video calls, video messages, desktop screen sharing - Server-side recording of webcam/microphone/screenshots (WebM/MP4/PNG) with chat publishing Security - End-to-end encryption (PAKE), one-time passwords (TOTP) - Secret from input field or CROC_SECRET - Choice of elliptic curve, relay password not disclosed to the other party QR code and Deep Links - QR code generation/scanning, support for Android scanners - Deep Links for settings and WebDAV Relay profiles - Switching, local management from GUI or CLI - Proxy: SOCKS5 (Tor), HTTP Transfer settings - .gitignore, file overwrite, compression, protection from deletion via WebDAV link - Multiplexing, folder ZIP, speed limit Interface - Themes: system/light/grey/dark/black - Font selection, 5 languages CLI mode - Pipes, text sending, transfer resuming, quiet mode

name: Soul Searching
short: A complete and powerful music player for Android.
description: Soul Searching is a comprehensive, powerful, and customizable music app for listening to your local music. A complete application: - Playlist creation - Support for multiple played lists - Played list management (play mode, adding, deleting, etc.) - Quick access system - Listening statistics (always stored locally only) - Synchronized lyrics (from the audio file or an external source) - Editing albums, artists, and songs (writing to audio file metadata) - Support for multiple artists for the same song - Search and sorting - Folder management - Adjusting the player volume A high-performance application: - Supports a large number of music while remaining fluid - Optimized logic for quickly performing complex tasks An application that reflects your style: - Several default color themes - Option to force a dark or light theme - Dynamic theme, based on the album art color of the song being played - Option to customize the application of the dynamic theme across all screens - Choice of the seed used to generate the dynamic theme - Customization of the player (swipe to change tracks, progress displayed in minimized mode, etc.) - Home page customization (tab to open at startup, visible tabs, display style, etc.)

name: Al-Azkar
short: Imam Al-Hafiz Yahya bin Sharafah Al-Din Al-Nawawi.
description: - Search Titles - Add titles to favorites - Count with app volume keys - Share zikr as image or as text - Control app theme

name: Mood Cairns
short: Private, fully offline mood tracker with tags and charts. No network access. You
description: A private, fully offline Android mood tracker. Log how you're feeling against your own Scales, with your own Tags, in your own time windows, on your own device. Nothing is ever uploaded - backup, if you want it, is done your own way (hint: Syncthing works well on the encrypted backups you save.). Features * Custom Scales. Five built-in scales (Happiness, Anxiety, Stress, Boredom, Pain), each numeric and color-tagged. Add your own; archive the ones you don't want. * Custom Tags. Choose from many built-in Tags for Places, People, Activities, Moods, etc. or add your own to customize your tracking! * Prompt windows. Define time-of-day windows (e.g. morning 08:00-12:00, evening 18:00-20:00). The app fires one notification per window per day. Tap the notification to jump straight to the log entry screen. * History and charts. Browse past entries, see per-scale trends over time. * Encrypted on-disk storage. The mood database is encrypted at rest using SQLCipher. The key lives in memory only while the app is unlocked, and is wiped when you lock it. * PIN + biometric lock. PIN-gated app entry, with optional biometric unlock. PIN is hashed with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600k iterations) before being stored. * Encrypted backups. Manual export writes an AES-GCM-encrypted JSON file to Documents/MoodCairns/. The encryption key is derived from your PIN with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (200k iterations) and a fresh per-backup salt embedded in the envelope, so any install (including a fresh one) can decrypt with the same PIN. Privacy contract The app declares no network permissions . Without internet, the process literally cannot open a socket, which makes phone-home impossible regardless of what any included library tries to do. The build enforces this, so a network permission can never be silently introduced by a dependency update. If you want backups synced off-device, point Syncthing (or any file manager that can sync a folder) at Documents/MoodCairns/. Contact The best way to get in touch for issues, feature requests, etc. is the Issues page on github.com/lcdcode/mood-cairns. I will usually respond within 3 business days. Source Fully open source under GPL-3.0-only. Built on Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room, SQLCipher, and AndroidX.

name: PriceGrab
short: Compare two supermarket prices and find the cheaper one per unit.
description: PriceGrab answers one supermarket question: which of these two products is cheaper per unit? Type the price and quantity of offer A and offer B and the app instantly tells you which is the better deal, by how much you save per unit, and how big the relative discount is. Designed for the aisle, not for the lab • Material Design 3 with full dynamic-color theming on Android 12+ and a hand-tuned WCAG-AA palette on older devices. • Locale-aware decimal input: comma in Spanish, dot in English. No more "is the period a thousands separator?" surprises. • Inputs and result survive screen rotation and language changes. Accessibility-first • Every field has a localized content description that TalkBack reads. • The result card is a polite live region: as soon as both offers parse, the screen reader announces who wins and how much you save. • Non-color cue (a check icon) accompanies the winning offer so the design works in grayscale or for color-vision-deficient users. Privacy by design • 100% offline. The app declares no INTERNET permission. • No analytics, no tracking, no ads, no accounts. • No data ever leaves the device. Open source • MIT licensed. • Reproducible Android build, no proprietary dependencies — F-Droid friendly. • Source code: https://github.com/mablanco/pricegrab

name: PolyAlerts
short: Price & % alerts for Polymarket prediction markets. Unofficial. No account.
description: PolyAlerts is a lightweight, unofficial companion for following prediction markets on Polymarket. Set a target and get a notification the moment a market's price or probability reaches it — so you never have to sit and refresh a chart. PolyAlerts is an information and notification tool. It does not place bets, hold funds, or process any transactions. When you want to act on an alert, one tap opens the official Polymarket website in your browser. WHAT YOU CAN DO * Browse and search live prediction markets across Politics, Sports, Crypto, Economy, Tech, World, Business and Pop Culture. * Set a PRICE / PROBABILITY alert — get notified when an outcome reaches a % you choose (for example: "Yes rises to 60%"). * Set a MOVEMENT alert — get notified when an outcome moves by a chosen amount in either direction (for example: "moves by ±10%"). * See current probabilities and 24h volume at a glance. * Open any market on Polymarket with one tap. PRIVATE BY DESIGN * No account and no sign-up. * No ads, no trackers, no analytics. * Your alerts are stored only on your device. HONEST ABOUT LIMITS Alerts are checked periodically in the background. Delivery timing depends on your phone's battery and power-saving settings, so alerts are near-real-time, not instantaneous. If you rely on them, allow the app to run in the background in your device settings. NOT AFFILIATED WITH POLYMARKET PolyAlerts is an independent project. It is not created by, endorsed by, or affiliated with Polymarket. All market data comes from Polymarket's public API. "Polymarket" is used only to describe what the app tracks. Prediction markets may be restricted or unavailable in your region. PolyAlerts only displays public information and sends reminders; any decision to visit Polymarket and trade is entirely your own.

name: LibreStatus
short: View, save and share statuses from WhatsApp, fully offline.
description: LibreStatus lets you view and keep the photo and video statuses you see in WhatsApp, so a status you liked doesn't disappear after 24 hours. The app works entirely on your device. It has no internet permission, collects no data, contains no ads and no trackers. Features: * Browse the image and video statuses currently available on your device * Swipe between the Images and Videos tabs * Full-screen viewer with video playback and a scrubber * Save any status to your gallery with one tap * Re-share or repost a status to WhatsApp or any other app * "Saved" tab to revisit everything you have downloaded * Direct message a phone number on WhatsApp without saving the contact * Light, dark and system themes * Available in 8 languages (English, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, French, German, Italian, Dutch) How it works: 1. Open WhatsApp and view someone's status. 2. Open LibreStatus. 3. On Android 11 and newer, grant access to the WhatsApp media folder once using the system folder picker. On older versions, grant storage access. 4. Tap any status to view it, then tap download to save it. Privacy: LibreStatus is a third-party app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp. It does not upload anything to any server. All processing happens locally on your phone. Please respect other people's privacy and content rights when saving and sharing statuses.

name: Paperless Go
short: A modern mobile client for your Paperless-ngx document management server.
description: Paperless Go is a mobile client for Paperless-ngx, the popular self-hosted document management system. Manage your documents on the go with a clean, modern interface: • Browse, search, and filter your document library • View document details, thumbnails, and PDF previews • Upload new documents via camera scan or file picker • Receive shared files from other apps for quick upload • Manage tags, correspondents, document types, and storage paths • Edit document metadata and custom fields • Create and manage custom field definitions • Dashboard with library statistics overview • Saved views: create, apply, rename, and delete filter sets • Workflows: view, toggle, and delete automation rules • PDF tools: rotate, split, compress, annotate, and redact • Bulk operations: tag, re-tag, delete, merge, and more • Biometric authentication for secure access • Offline-capable with full SQLite caching • Full-text search with autocomplete Paperless Go connects to your self-hosted Paperless-ngx server using token-based authentication. You need a running Paperless-ngx instance to use this app. Note: The F-Droid build does not include Google ML Kit or the Google Play Services-based camera document scanner (both proprietary). Camera scan is replaced by importing existing images via the file/gallery picker, document deskew uses a pure-Dart algorithm, and OCR-based metadata suggestions are disabled. This app is free and open source software, licensed under AGPL-3.0.

name: Tiny Weather Forecast Germany
short: Weather forecast based on open data from the Deutscher Wetterdienst.
description: Detailed weather forecast for up to 10 days, based on open data of the Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD). Weather warnings from the DWD are also displayed. The weather forecast of the desired weather station is displayed. Stations can be searched by name, by geo-coordinates or by the own location. A weather forecast is available for over 5000 weather stations in Germany and worldwide. The app has a slim design. It optionally supports wearables over Gadgetbridge, so that weather data can be displayed on wearables, too. Moreover, various possibilities exist to adapt the display of weather data to your own needs. The time of sunrise, sunset and twilight can be shown for the chosen location as well. The app also has a list of favorites, which can be used to switch fast beween multiple weather stations. It also offers multiple, differently sized widgets with a weather forecast that can be placed on the home screen and that get updated automatically.

name: AuraOrbit
short: Interactive 3D sphere live wallpaper with Fibonacci app distribution.
description: AuraOrbit is a next-generation Android Live Wallpaper featuring a fully interactive 3D sphere that orbits your favorite apps right on your home screen. Built on the high-performance libGDX game engine, it leverages a golden angle Fibonacci distribution to plot your apps perfectly in a 3D space, supporting true 120 FPS hardware refresh rates! 3D Sphere: Rotate apps with natural quaternion-based momentum at up to 120 FPS. Drag-and-drop sphere positioning — center, top, bottom, or anywhere via a custom editor (which also scales the sphere radius!) Adjustable icon size and rotation speed (sphere maintains full radius regardless of icon size). Background & Blur: Upload a custom background image or use the default gradient. Dual blur controls: independent Blur Radius (area) and Blur Strength (intensity) with real-time preview. Five blur levels from no blur to full-screen blur. Icon Pack Support: Apply third-party icon packs (Nova, Apex, etc.) seamlessly to all your 3D sphere apps. Automatically applies to group widgets, the app picker, and fallback elements. App Groups & Widgets: Create color-coded app groups with 8 presets plus a custom RGB color picker. Individual Group Overrides: Configure unique Sphere Position, Background Image, and Blur settings exclusively for each group. Intuitive Edit Apps popup dialog for seamless bulk-selection. Per-group home screen widgets with live previews and custom logo upload. Toggle transparent background, hide logo, hide text, or use Material You system colors per widget. Pin multiple widgets for different groups simultaneously. Standalone Sphere Mode: Launch AuraOrbit as a fullscreen immersive app from any group widget. Floats seamlessly over your home screen with zero black dimming! Tap apps to launch them; tap outside to return home. FOSS & Privacy First: Entirely open source under GPLv3. Zero unnecessary permissions and no tracking whatsoever.

name: Pantry
short: Manage your pantry and avoid food waste
description: Dispensa helps you manage your pantry simply and efficiently. Features: • Add, edit, and remove items from your pantry • Integration with Open Food Facts to automatically retrieve product information • Receive notifications for expiring products • Customizable locations to better organize your products • Barcode scan to quickly add products • Italian and English language support Avoid food waste and always keep track of what you have in your pantry!

name: Sound Quick Settings
short: A simple Quick Settings Tile to control the sound volume.
description: 1. Add the Tile in the Quick Settings panel. 2. Tap the Tile to show the volume slider. 3. Long press the Tile to open the Sound panel. Note: Don't look for a launcher icon, this app only provides a Quick Settings Tile. Open Source project hosted on GitHub: https://github.com/SimonMarquis/Android-SoundQuickSettings

name: Lector
short: Read any text, PDF, or EPUB aloud — free, private, offline.
description: Lector reads your documents aloud — beautifully, privately, and completely free. Open a TXT, Markdown, EPUB, or PDF — a single file or a whole folder — or paste text, or share to Lector from any app. Lector turns it into a clean, paged reader and reads it to you using your device's own voices, highlighting the current sentence as it goes. Features: * Reads TXT, Markdown, EPUB, PDF, and other text files * A real library: scan a folder and Lector remembers your books * Picks up where you left off in every document * Page view with a slider to move through a whole book * Adjustable speed, sleep timer, and background-friendly controls Private by design: no ads, no accounts, no trackers, no network access, and no permissions at all. Your text never leaves your device. Reading aloud uses the text-to-speech engine already on your phone. Free and open source (GPLv3).

name: CalcYou
short: Privacy Focused Calculator app built with MD3
description: CalcYou is a privacy focused calculator app that is not just a calculator. Solve everyday problems with the intuitive basic calculator, or delve into advanced functions with the powerful scientific calculator. Feeling lost in a sea of units? CalcYou's versatile unit converter can convert lengths, weights, volumes, and more. Need to express complex equations? Access a vast library of symbols, including Greek letters, arrows, superscript, and subscript, all with a few taps. You want to quickly draw a mathematical function to understand its shape? No worries, CalcYou can plot it for you.

name: Backtalk
short: Message yourself to stay organized.
description: A chat-based note-taking tool for messaging yourself.

name: Oscilloscope
short: Audio Oscilloscope and Spectrum
description: An audio oscilloscope and spectrum. * Timebase 0.1 ms - 0.5 sec * Sync control * Single shot * Storage * Index * Spectrum There are toolbar icons to control single step, sync timebase, storage and scrolling. The spectrum display has a display lock function and shows the current dominant frequency and signal level in the toolbar.

name: PocketCheck
short: A working memory app - "Anything to put in your pocket?"
description: You forget to return things to their proper place after using them. You accidentally take home things you borrowed. You leave tasks half-done. And worst of all — you forget to even check your checklist. PocketCheck is a working memory app for people like you. The app periodically asks "Anything to put in your pocket?" You don't have to remember to check yourself. FEATURES Item Management • Register items with name and notes • Quick photo registration - snap a photo to register instantly • Switch toggle to manage task status • Visual distinction for active tasks • Swipe left to delete, swipe right to archive • Drag & drop to reorder items Smart Reminders • Periodic notifications: "Anything to put in your pocket?" • Tap "Yes" to open app, "No" to dismiss • Notifications don't pile up - stays as one • Configurable interval and quiet hours Persistent Status • Always-visible notification when tasks are active • Silent, non-dismissible notification • Shows active tasks Privacy First • Works completely offline • No accounts, no tracking • No Google Services required • Your data stays on your device • Open source (GPL-3.0)

name: LibreTorrent
short: Copylefted libre software torrent client.
description: * Licensed GPLv3+. Use, see, change and share; with all. * BitTorrent 2.0 and WebTorrent support * Select which files to download. * Move files while downloading. * Auto-move downloaded files to another folder or external drive. * Stream files, with sequential downloads. * Android TV. * Material design, dark and black theme, and tablet UI. * Customisable network, battery, and UI settings, etc. * 35+ translations. * Scheduling. * Auto-downloading, with Atom/RSS manager. * Create torrents, with many and big files. * HTTP\S and magnet links. * DHT, PeX, encryption, LSD, UPnP, NAT*PMP, µTP. * IP filtering (eMule dat and PeerGuardian). * Supports proxy for trackers and peers. * Based on libtorrent4j. * And more.

name: SOS Alerter
short: Privacy-focused emergency app with SMS location tracking and silent recording.
description: SOS Alerter is a modern, privacy-focused emergency assistance application designed to keep you safe when it matters most. It operates entirely offline, storing all user credentials, contacts, and captured media locally on your device. Key Features: * Emergency SMS & Call Alerts: Instantly send custom emergency SMS messages with high-accuracy GPS coordinates and auto-dial your designated contact or emergency services. * Continuous GPS Tracking: Keep contacts updated with periodic location sharing. * Discreet Evidence Gathering: Silently capture photos using front and back cameras, and record ambient audio during an active emergency. * Versatile Activation Triggers: Trigger an alert via a triple-press of the power button, shaking the device, voice commands ("Help Me"), or a long press on the main screen button. * Loud Siren & Strobe: Activate a loud siren and strobe light to grab nearby attention. * No Trackers or Ads: Free and open-source under GPLv3, with absolutely no telemetry, analytics, or third-party connections.

name: EasySSHFS
short: Sshfs with ssh client and interface for Android.
description: SSH Filesystem is a filesystem client based on the SSH File Transfer Protocol. Fuse 3.10.5. Sshfs 3.7.1. Ssh client from OpenSSH-portable 8.9p (with OpenSSL 1.1.1n). For using public key authentication add "IdentityFile= " to sshfs options. Password-protected keys are not supported. Rooted device required (/dev/fuse in android is not allow for users except root). Application source code: https://github.com/bobrofon/easysshfs WARNING: If you just want to have access to the files on your PC from your Android phone, then sshfs is a VERY bad solution for that problem. You really need to know some internal details about Android storage implementation to make something useful with sshfs. And EasySSHFS is not intended to hide all these details from its users. Please try to use any implementation of Android document provider for sftp protocol (or any other solution to work with sftp) before trying to use sshfs. NOTE: - If you are using SuperSu to manage root access and have no effect after mounting done, try to disable "mount namespace separation" option in SuperSU. - It is highly recommended to create mount points in /data/media/0 on Android 4.2 and /mnt/runtime/default/emulated/0 on Android 6.0 and above.

name: RemotePointer
short: Digital Laser Pointer and Mouse Control for Presentations
description: With this app you can control your computer's keyboard and mouse (using a touchpad). Furthermore, you can project a digital laser pointer dot on your screen or projector, which is controlled by the movement of your Android device. Advantages: - control your computer from your couch - when your screen output is being recorded on presentations, the laser pointer can also be recorded - the digital laser pointer point is better visible in bright rooms - you can simultaneously flip the slides back and forth on your Android device and control the mouse - you can use the app as barcode/QR code scanner for your computer Please download the free software for your PC (Linux, macOS and Windows) from: https://sieber.systems/s/rp The goal of this project is to provide a complete self-hosted remote control application without dependencies to external servers and without tracking.

name: Pixiv-MultiPlatform
short: Third-party Pixiv client
description: Features Login via built-in browser Recommendation, illustration rank, timeline on homepage Search Illustration details, download original illustration, favorite, like, comment Novel details, read, export, favorite, comment Personal center, profile, favorite, follow, history, download manager Illustration/novel filter (deleted illustration, no permission illustration, R18, R18G, AI) Direct connection with DoH

name: Link Clear
short: Strip tracking parameters from links. Offline, private, no permissions.
description: Link Clear strips tracking parameters from URLs using the bundled ClearURLs ruleset. It works entirely offline by default: paste or share a link, and get back the same link with the tracking noise removed. Three ways to clean a link: * Share target — share a link to Link Clear from any app. You land on a confirmation screen showing the cleaned URL with Copy, Share, and Open actions. With "Automatic action" enabled, the chosen action runs immediately. * Quick Settings tile — add the "Clean clipboard" tile to your Quick Settings panel. One tap cleans whatever is on the clipboard, in place. * In-app editor — open the app for a Paste Clean / Paste Raw editor with a live before/after diff of exactly what was removed. Privacy first: * Offline by default. The cleaning ruleset is bundled, so no network is needed. * No runtime permissions. Link Clear only acts when you explicitly share, tap the tile, or paste — it never watches your clipboard in the background. * Two optional, off-by-default network features: resolving shortened links (t.co, bit.ly, and similar) before cleaning, and manually refreshing the bundled ruleset. Neither runs unless you turn it on. Link Clear is free software licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. URL-cleaning rules come from the ClearURLs project (LGPL-3.0).

name: YAPL — Yet Another Pilot Log
short: Private, offline flight logbook with EASA/BCAA paper-logbook PDF export.
description: YAPL (Yet Another Pilot Log) is a flight logbook for professional and general-aviation pilots who want to keep their hours on their own device — no account, no cloud, no tracking, no network access at all. It records flights in a clean EASA/BCAA-style structure and can print a paper-logbook-ready PDF to keep an official book up to date. Features: * Flight logging — route, block times, aircraft, crew role, day/night landings, IFR and night time. Night time is computed automatically from sunrise/sunset (NOAA solar algorithm) for each leg. * Logbook view — flights grouped by month with running totals and a fast scrollbar for thousands of entries. * Statistics — all-time and rolling 90-day totals (time, night, IFR, landings), seeded by your pre-digital "previous totals". * Hangar — your aircraft types and registrations, kept tidy and reusable. * BCAA / EASA PDF export — generates the official two-page-per-sheet logbook layout with per-page and carried-forward totals. Mark page breaks in the app so the PDF pages line up exactly with your paper book, and export from any date. * Backup and restore — full flights CSV, plus a JSON reference backup of airports, aircraft, settings and previous totals. Import from the legacy Flight Logbook app's JSON export. * Bundled airport database — thousands of airports from OurAirports for offline lookup. Privacy: YAPL declares no Android permissions, has no network code, and bundles no analytics, ads or tracking libraries. Your flight data never leaves your device unless you export it yourself through the system file picker.

name: XrayFA
short: XrayFA is a fast, secure, and user-friendly Android client for Xray-core.
description: XrayFA is a powerful and user-friendly Android client for Xray-core. It provides a secure and fast proxy experience on Android devices, supporting multiple protocols including VLESS, VMESS, Shadowsocks, Trojan, Hysteria2, and Reality. Key Features: - Support for multiple protocols: VLESS, VMESS, Shadowsocks, Trojan, Hysteria2, and Reality. - High performance: Built with the latest Xray-core for low latency and high speed. - Easy to use: Import configurations via QR code or subscription links. - Custom Routing: Flexibly bypass or proxy traffic based on rules. - Modern UI: Simple and clean interface for an effortless user experience. XrayFA ensures your internet privacy and security by encrypting your traffic and bypassing local restrictions. Experience the power of Xray on your Android device with XrayFA!

name: Cheogram
short: Chat on the Jabber network (XMPP protocol); focus on features for gateway users
description: The Cheogram Android app allows you to join a worldwide communication network. It especially focuses on features useful to users who want to contact those on other networks as well, such as SMS-enabled phone numbers. Based on the app Conversations, but with unique features: * Messages with both media and text, including animated media * Unobtrusive display of subject lines, where present * Links to known contacts are shown with their name * Show timestamps for calls * Integrates with gateways' add contact flows * When using a gateway to the phone network, integrate with the native Android Phone app * Address book integration * Tag contacts and channels and browse by tag * Command UI Where to get service: Cheogram Android requires you have an account with a Jabber service. You can run your own service, or use one provided by someone else, for example: https://snikket.org/hosting/ Art in screenshots is from https://www.peppercarrot.com by David Revoy, CC-BY. Artwork has been modified to crop out sections for avatars and photos, and in some cases add transparency. Use of this artwork does not imply endorsement of this project by the artist.

name: Noise Timer
short: Calming white, pink, and brown noise with a sleep timer
description: Noise Timer is a simple, private companion for sleep, focus, and quiet moments. Choose white, pink, or brown noise, adjust the volume, and let the sound play in the background. Set a sleep timer from a quick preset or choose your own duration. An optional fade-out gently lowers the volume during the final 20 seconds. Features: • White, pink, and brown noise generated in real time • Adjustable playback volume • Sleep timer with presets and custom durations • Optional fade-out before the timer ends • Background playback controls in the notification • Remembers your preferred settings Noise Timer has no ads, accounts, trackers, or network access.

name: Peercoin Wallet
short: Your mobile wallet for Peercoin and Peercoin testnet.
description: Send and receive Peercoin, the first Proof-of-Stake cryptocurrency, on your phone. Keep your wallet seed protected. This app comes with absolutely no warranty. Use at own risk. Features: - Based on electrum protocol. - Send and receive peercoin. - Ready to transact after installation (no waiting). - Peercoin and Peercoin testnet wallets. - Address book management. - Import paper wallets. - Import & export private keys (WIF). - Server management. - Multi-language support. - Background notifications. Known limitations can be found in the Github repository.

name: YtReader
short: Read YouTube subtitles with AI-powered text cleaning
description: YtReader turns YouTube into a focused reading experience. Search for videos, follow subtitles with synchronized highlighting, and save the parts that matter. Features Browse and search YouTube videos Read subtitles with synchronized word highlighting AI-powered subtitle text cleaning (OpenAI-compatible API, bring your own key) Organize videos into collections Highlight and annotate text Adjustable font, size, and line height for comfortable reading Light, dark, and system themes Home screen widget for quick access to your library Privacy No account required No tracking or analytics AI features are opt-in and use your own API key All data stored locally on your device Source code YtReader is free and open source software licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. The source code is available on GitHub.

name: Jerboa for Lemmy
short: An app for Lemmy, a federated reddit alternative.
description: Jerboa is an app for Lemmy , a federated reddit alternative. Jerboa is made by Lemmy's developers, and is free, open-source software, meaning no advertising, monetizing, or venture capital, ever. Lemmy is similar to sites like Reddit, Lobste.rs, or Hacker News: you subscribe to forums you're interested in, post links and discussions, then vote, and comment on them. Behind the scenes, it is very different; anyone can easily run a server, and all these servers are federated (think email), and connected to the same universe, called the Fediverse.

name: 1List - Simple Lists for TODO, Shopping, Movies...
short: Simple app to manage several lists from only one screen
description: 1List is a simple app to manage several lists from only one screen. Add items to a list with only one click. Browse, view, organize your lists from only one screen. Features : - User friendly lists management and smooth navigation - Add, delete, edit items in your lists - Move items within your lists - Mark items as done or undone - Add comments on each items - Create an unlimited number of lists - Move, edit, remove your lists ... more to come in the near future

name: Mushotoku
short: A private, fully-offline productivity app for focusing on what matters
description: Mushotoku (無所得) is a Zen term for acting without grasping for a result. It's a deliberately odd name for a productivity app — and that's the point. Most productivity apps want you to optimize every minute and defend every streak. Mushotoku goes the other way: work out the few things that actually matter today, do them, and let the rest go. It's a tool for focusing, not for filling. Everything you write, track, and plan stays on your device. Mushotoku ships with no INTERNET permission at all, so it physically cannot send your data anywhere — the option was never built. Your data is stored encrypted on the device. Features: Plan & organize * Calendar with appointments and an offline holiday layer * Tasks to manage your to-dos * Habits you can build and track Capture & reflect * Notes with markdown editor, a clean read view and a trash with restore * Gratitude journal with a searchable archive * Mood tracking over time Wellbeing * Meditation timer with three bells and Buddhist quotes * Track caffeine intake and see how much caffeine is still active at bedtime Money * Finance tracker with custom categories * Detailed reports and savings potential

name: KC3ICT Ham Study
short: Free offline ham radio exam flashcards — Technician, General, and Extra.
description: Study for all three FCC amateur radio license exams — completely offline, with zero permissions and no account. All three current NCVEC question pools are bundled in the app: • Technician (Element 2), 2026–2030 pool — 409 questions • General (Element 3), 2023–2027 pool — 423 questions • Amateur Extra (Element 4), 2024–2028 pool — 599 questions All pools include every official NCVEC errata (withdrawn questions removed, modified wording applied), and every answer key has been verified against the official pool documents. Schematic and chart figures are included. Features: • Flashcard mode — tap to flip, shuffled, flag tricky questions • Practice exams built the way real VE sessions build them: one random question from each NCVEC question group (35/35/50 questions, 74% to pass) • Topic quizzes and flashcards filtered by subelement (T1A, G9D, E0A, …) • Wrong-answer review pool that shrinks as you improve • Progress saved on your device, with export/import to move between devices — including the companion website at hamstudy.neyhard.com Privacy: the app requests no permissions at all — not even network access. Everything runs from files inside the APK, and your study progress never leaves your device unless you export it yourself. Question pools are public domain, released by the NCVEC Question Pool Committee. This app is not affiliated with the ARRL, NCVEC, or FCC. 73 de KC3ICT

name: Coin Collection
short: Coin Collection helps people organize their U.S. coin collections
description: Coin Collection helps people keep track of the coins they have or are missing for a variety of U.S. coin sets. Many of the more recent U.S. coin sets are supported (see list below), and the app can be used to track quantities, grades, and notes for each coin. Supported U.S. coin sets include: - American Eagle Silver Dollars - American Innovation Dollars - American Women Quarters - Barber Dimes - Barber Half Dollars - Barber Quarters - Buffalo Nickels - Eisenhower Dollars - First Spouse Gold Coins - Franklin Half Dollars - Indian Head Cents - Jefferson Nickels - Kennedy Half-Dollars - Liberty Head Nickels - Lincoln Cents - Mercury Dimes - Morgan Dollars - National Park Quarters - Native American/Sacagawea Dollars - Peace Dollars - Presidential Dollars - Roosevelt Dimes - Standing Liberty Quarters - State Quarters including D.C. and Territories - Susan B. Anthony Dollars - Walking Liberty Half Dollars - Washington Quarters Find us on GitHub to report issue, request features, and to follow progress! This App is not endorsed by the United States Mint United States coin images from the United States Mint. Quarter-dollar coin images from the United States Mint. Indian Head Cent images, Walking Liberty Half Dollar images, Morgan Dollar images, Buffalo Nickel obverse image, Liberty Head Nickel images, Barber Quarter images, and Barber Half Dollar images courtesy of Brandon Grossardt. Standing Liberty Quarter images and Franklin Half Dollar images courtesy of John Baumgart.

name: To Do
short: Create checklists
description: A simple and intuitive To Do list based on the app bundled with Palm Pilot, plus many other features: Entirely offline, requiring few permissions to run. Permission to use external storage is only needed to back up or restore your lists. On Marshmallow (Android 6) and later, it is only requested if you write the file to a public folder. Permission to run on system boot and to post notifications is only needed to check for items which are due and that you have set an alarm for. On Marshmallow (Android 6) and later, notification permissions are only requested if you save a To Do item with an alarm. Permission to vibrate is only needed when notifying you of items which are due and that you have set an alarm for, if you have “Alarm vibrate” enabled in the app settings for Nougat (Android 7) or earlier. On Oreo (Android 8) and later, alarm vibration and sounds is managed in the system settings. The following permissions are added by WorkManager, a Google library used to run the export, import, and password re-encryption operations in the background when initiated by the user. The core app does not use these on its own. Permission to view network connections, used by WorkManager to determine the best time to schedule background tasks. Create any number of categories for different lists. Set alarms for items that are due or nearly due. Configure repeating items which advance their due date when completed. Mark items as private and optionally encrypt them with a password. Export lists to a local XML file. Import lists from either XML or a Palm Pilot data file. Backwards compatible with Android 5 (Lollipop) and up.

name: MonsterMusic
short: A Music Player with Equalizer and more
description: MonsterMusic is a local music player for your Android device. Enjoy all the features without any cost! Features: Advanced Equalizer: Customize your sound experience with our built-in equalizer. Lyrics Support: Dive deeper into the lyrics of your favorite songs. Privacy First: MonsterMusic operates without any network requests, just pure music enjoyment. More features are waiting for your discovery.

name: Truvark
short: A multi-vault file encryption app that respects your privacy.
description: Maybe you're wondering why you should give an underdog file encryption app a chance? Especially when this type of app is all about trust? Compared to many other popular alternatives, Truvark... supports multiple vaults on a single device supports deep folder structures (subfolders) decrypts common media files (images, video, audio) in-app on the fly works completely offline, no internet access/permission required runs without dangerous permissions like full storage/media access contains no advertising, telemetry or other user data collection encrypts all indices and thumbnails allows biometric unlocking (e.g. fingerprint) securely As you can see, there are already plenty of reasons to give Truvark a try!

name: OpenMensa
short: Show meal plans for more than 150 university canteens in Germany.
description: OpenMensa zeigt dir, was es heute in der Mensa Deiner Uni zu essen gibt. Zur Zeit werden rund 150 Mensen im deutschsprachigen Raum unterstützt. Diese App stellt dabei eine Verbindung zur Datenbank auf http://openmensa.org/ her. Features: - Speiseplan und Preise für hunderte Mensen - Vorschau der nächsten Tage - Mehrere bevorzugte Mensen festlegbar - Funktioniert auch, wenn man nicht mit dem Internet verbunden ist - Mensa auf einer Karte, Tippe auf Adresse um zur Mensa zu navigieren Melde Fehler auf https://github.com/domoritz/open-mensa-android/issues. Deine Mensa fehlt? Mit etwas technischem Wissen, sollte es Dir leicht fallen, einen Parser für Deine Mensa zu schreiben. Weitere Informationen auf http://openmensa.org/. Im Moment unterstützt die App Mensen an vielen deutschen Universitäten unter Anderem in Berlin, Hamburg, Aachen, Karlsruhe und München. Außerdem die Mensen an HPI, KIT, LMU, HU und der FU.

name: Extend
short: Extend is an all-purpose display manager for any physical or virtual display.
description: - Launch any application on any external display in full screen - Fully customizable resolution, scaling, DPI, and rotation for any display - Reset any per-display configuration back to system defaults - Built-in on-screen touchpad and keyboard for controlling any display - Touchpad control with support for multi-touch, rotation, digitizer only mode - External input device to display routing per input and display combination - Navigation controls including Back and Home buttons for content on external displays - Turning off built-in screen while keeping external displays active - Managed virtual display mode with customizable on-screen keyboard routing and window behavior Accessibility Service API may be used to support additional features on external displays. With your consent, it can: - Simulate navigation actions for the on-screen touchpad and floating button - Draw the on-screen cursor - Read window details to direct your input to the focused window on the correct display This information is used only on your device and is never collected, stored, or shared.

name: ntfy - PUT/POST to your phone
short: Send notifications to your phone from any script using PUT/POST requests
description: Send notifications to your phone from any Bash or PowerShell script, or from your own app using PUT/POST requests, e.g. via curl on Linux or Invoke-WebRequest. ntfy is an Android client for https://ntfy.sh, a free and open source HTTP-based pub-sub service. You can subscribe to topics in this app, and then publish messages via a simple HTTP API. Uses: * Notify yourself when a long-running process is done * Ping your phone when a backup has failed * Alerts when someone logs into your server Example: $ curl -d "Your backup is done" ntfy.sh/mytopic Find more examples and usage instructions here: * Website: https://ntfy.sh * GitHub (server): https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy * GitHub (Android app): https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy-android

name: Vertretungsplan.io - free substitution plan App

What does vertretungsplan.io not do? - showing the substitution plans of all institutions - creating substitution plans - publishing substitution plans - tracking users Advantage (compared to viewing it directly) - notifications on changes/ background sync so that one does not miss the changes - offline support - the plans are downloaded and can be viewed without connection too - low maintenance - the access data and settings (if required for a school) are saved, it is not necassary to enter them again and again - optimized for small screens - the plan list is optimized for small screens (depending on the school, viewing the plan at a small screen is not comfortable) Freedom Everyone could setup his own server und use it with this App. The App and the backend are Open Source. name: i2pd
short: Full-featured C++ implementation of I2P client
description: I2P (Invisible Internet Protocol) is a universal anonymous network layer. All communications over I2P are anonymous and end-to-end encrypted, participants don't reveal their real IP addresses. I2P client is a software used for building and using anonymous I2P networks. Such networks are commonly used for anonymous peer-to-peer applications (filesharing, cryptocurrencies) and anonymous client-server applications (websites, instant messengers, chat-servers). I2P allows people from all around the world to communicate and share information without restrictions. For more information about I2P , you can read article on Wikipedia .

name: Stutter
short: Speed-reading app that shows one word at a time with adjustable timing

Reading speed and timing are fully adjustable, including delays for long words, punctuation, numbers, and short words so the rhythm feels natural and predictable. Features: - Language-aware tokenization and hyphenation for long words (18 supported languages). - Appearance controls for fonts, size, spacing, and colors. - Optional flankers to preview the next word fragment. - No analytics, no tracking, no data collection, and no reading history.

name: Calisthenics Memory
short: Bodyweight workout tracker - create and customize your own exercises
description: A privacy-focused bodyweight training tracker. Customize everything — exercises, training methods, and workflow — to match your needs. No rigid templates. Adapt the app to your training style. To Do • Plan your workout as a list, tap to jump directly • Schedule repeats by day of week to automate your weekly routine Record Mode • Quickly log your workouts after training Workout Mode • Auto-guided training with built-in timers • Single: Timer-assisted rep counting and isometric hold tracking • Program: Create and run multi-exercise routines in sequence • Interval: Timed work/rest cycles with customizable rounds • Programs and intervals are built by freely combining your own exercises Exercise Creation • Create any exercise with any name, organize into groups • Choose rep-based (dynamic) or time-based (isometric) tracking • Support for unilateral (one-sided) exercises • 10-level progressions to match your method • Optional distance, weight, and assistance tracking • Favorite exercises (★) for quick access • Add optional description notes to each exercise Progress Tracking • Calendar: See your training activity at a glance • List: Browse all sessions chronologically • Graph: Visualize trends with average/max/total stats • Challenge: Color-coded goal achievement tracking • Period filters (1 week, 1 month, 3 months) Data Management • Export/import in JSON/CSV format • Your data stays on your device, no internet required Convict Conditioning, StartBodyweight, RR (Recommended Routine), HIIT, circuit training — whatever your method, this app adapts to you.

name: Exercise Reminders

If none of the known devices are connected to the local network then motion detection will be automatically started as nobody is at home. - Email alerts on motion detection. - Visualize recorded images and videos and download them. - Create timelapses.

name: WallApp
short: Clean & minimal wallpaper app without any ads and paywall.
description: WallApp is a lightweight Android app for browsing wallpapers from https://thewallapp.pages.dev. TheWallApp is my personal wallpaper website, designed to be clean, simple, and free from ads. Features: - Lightweight and fast - No ads - Browse and download wallpapers - Set wallpapers directly from the app WallApp does not collect, store, or share any personal data.

name: Screen Off Timer
short: Clean sleep timer to stop media and lock screen.

Features: - Media Stop: Automatically stops music and media playback when the timer ends. - Auto Lock Screen: Safely locks your device's screen once the countdown reaches zero. - Return to Home: Automatically navigates back to the home screen for a clean state. - Dark Theme Support: Seamlessly adapts to your system's theme for comfortable night-time use. - Accessibility: This app requires the Accessibility Service permission solely to perform the Lock Screen action. - Data Integrity: We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data or usage information through the Accessibility Service.

name: Bluecheese
short: Offline text encryption-fast, local, no trackers.
description: Bluecheese lets you encrypt and decrypt text entirely offline. • Simple, clean UI • No ads, no tracking • 100% open source (GPL-3.0)

name: Closet-Archive
short: Organize clothes, log events, track laundry, and recall last week's outfit.

name: Deepr
short: Simplify link handling. Save, organize, and open links with ease.
description: Do you constantly come across interesting articles, videos, or websites but don't have time to read them right away? Deepr is the essential tool you've been missing! Deepr is the perfect tool for saving and organizing all your links in one place. Stop manually typing long URLs or digging through old notes. With Deepr, you can save any link instantly and read it whenever you're ready. Focus on enjoying the content you saved, not on finding it again. Features: - Save and Organize Links: Easily save and manage a list of all your favorite links in one clean list. - Open Links: Access and open your saved links directly from the app. - Search: Quickly find specific links from your saved list. - Sort: Organize your links by date or how many times you've opened them. - Read Later Counter: Keep track of how many times each link has been opened. - Home Screen Shortcuts: Create shortcuts for your most-used links on your device's home screen for quick access. - Tags: Organize links using tags. - Backups : Take Backups in CSV file or a text file. name: Drill Press Assistant
short: Spindle speed calculator and belt position advisor for drill presses
description: Calculates the spindle speeds of a belt-driven drill press and recommends the optimal belt position for a given drill diameter and material. Describe your machine once — motor speed, pulley stacks, belts — and the app computes every achievable spindle speed, draws the transmission diagram, and tells you which belt position to use for the hole you are about to drill. Features: * Interactive transmission diagram showing the current belt path * Speed advisor: enter a drill diameter and a material, get the best belt position * Complete speed table for all belt combinations * Machine editor with support for multiple machines (create, switch, delete) * Metric and imperial units * Interface in English and French * Fully offline, no permissions, no tracking

name: Rufid
short: Write and recover bootable USB media
description: Rufid turns an Android phone into a practical USB boot-media tool. It writes local ISO/IMG files to attached USB mass-storage devices, streams direct image URLs, creates a small FreeDOS drive, verifies written media, inspects boot records, runs read benchmarks, backs up a USB device to an Android document, extracts ZIP files, and recovers used boot media back into a normal FAT32 or exFAT drive. Windows installer ISOs can be written as a FAT32 UEFI layout, with install.wim split when it exceeds the FAT32 file-size limit, or as an NTFS data volume with an MBR or GPT UEFI:NTFS helper layout. These paths have been booted to the Windows Setup language screen in QEMU/OVMF. Physical USB controllers and PC firmware remain a separate compatibility test surface. The main workflow is phone-first: select a USB device, inspect it, choose an ISO/IMG, URL, or FreeDOS source, review the plan, write, and verify. Direct URL mode includes quick access to official source pages for Windows, Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, Linux Mint, Arch Linux, and openSUSE; it does not bundle those operating system images. Destructive USB actions are guarded by an explicit plan screen and confirmation. Rufid shows the selected USB device, size, and available hardware identifiers before write or recovery operations. It is designed for external USB mass-storage devices, not internal Android storage. Rufid has no ad SDK, analytics SDK, billing SDK, Firebase dependency, cloud account system, or remote crash-reporting SDK. Error reports stay local on the device. The F-Droid build path packages the boot payload set from auditable inputs. FreeDOS is assembled from source-built FreeDOS kernel, FreeCOM, SYS, and boot sector artifacts. UEFI:NTFS, wimlib, NTFS-3G tools, and 7-Zip-JBinding are staged from pinned upstream source paths, and the 7-Zip-JBinding Android build excludes RAR/unRAR native sources. No payload is extracted from an opaque third-party APK. USB recovery is a metadata quick-wipe plus FAT32 or exFAT format flow. It is useful for returning a boot USB to normal storage use, but it is not secure erase and not a full-disk wipe.

name: MobiloSignal
short: Find the best spot for calls and mobile internet by seeing signal strength
description: Mobilosignal shows your Android phone’s real-time cellular signal strength in dBm. The value is always visible in the status bar and in a notification, even while you use other apps. Unlike signal bars, dBm is a precise measurement of radio signal power, allowing you to see actual network conditions instead of a simplified guess. Practical uses of monitoring signal strength in dBm: 📞 Prevent call drops in weak areas If signal falls below about -105 dBm, voice calls become unstable even if bars are still visible. Seeing this in advance lets you move a few steps before dialing instead of losing the call mid-conversation. 🎮 Avoid lag spikes during mobile gaming Online games become unstable below roughly -95 dBm. Monitoring this lets you reposition before starting a match instead of dealing with unpredictable lag or disconnects. 🎥 Stable video uploads and streaming Upload-heavy tasks such as live streaming or sending large videos require stronger signal, typically better than -90 dBm. dBm lets you confirm the connection is sufficient before starting. 🚗 Predict signal loss on daily routes While commuting, you will notice exact dBm values where signal consistently drops below usable levels. This allows planning calls or downloads outside those zones instead of discovering the problem every day. 🏠 Choose the exact spot for hotspot usage When using your phone as a hotspot, performance depends directly on signal strength. Moving from -105 dBm to -85 dBm can multiply speed several times. The app shows exactly where that improvement happens. 🔋 Explain sudden battery drain If your phone sits at -110 dBm for long periods, it continuously boosts transmission power. This is a measurable cause of fast battery drain, not some mysterious background app. 🏢 Find the one place in a building that works In offices, basements, or elevators, signal can change from -75 dBm to -115 dBm within a few meters. The app helps you locate the one usable spot instead of guessing or walking randomly. 📡 Verify signal improvement objectively exists After installing a repeater or moving near a window, you can confirm improvement numerically, for example from -108 dBm to -82 dBm, instead of relying on subjective “feels better”. 📶 Decide when to switch to Wi-Fi If cellular drops below about -100 dBm while Wi-Fi is available, switching avoids slow speeds and packet loss. The decision becomes data-driven instead of reactive. 🔄 Compare network conditions across time Observe how signal varie

name: Anywherelan
short: Peer-to-peer mesh VPN to connect your devices directly, no central servers
description: Anywherelan (awl) is a mesh VPN that lets you connect to any of your devices at the IP level, wherever they are. It works similarly to tinc, direct WireGuard or Tailscale, but fully peer-to-peer — there are no central coordination servers to trust or set up. Your traffic goes directly between your devices. You can also route traffic through a remote device — either per-app as a SOCKS5 proxy, or all of your device's traffic at once as a full-tunnel VPN gateway (exit node). Some use cases Connect to your home or work laptop over RDP/VNC/SSH even when it sits behind NAT, without configuring port forwarding. Reach self-hosted services like Nextcloud, Home Assistant or Bitwarden without exposing them to the internet. Access websites from another country by using a remote device as a SOCKS5 proxy. Route all of your traffic through a remote device as a full-tunnel VPN gateway (exit node), like a classic VPN. Gaming: local multiplayer as if everyone were on the same LAN. Share a development server with a colleague on another device, as an alternative to ngrok. Use an old Android phone remotely with scrcpy to run Android-only apps without an emulator. Features Fully peer-to-peer. No third-party coordination servers — your traffic stays between your devices. Route traffic through a remote device like a SOCKS5 proxy. Full-tunnel VPN gateway: route all of your device's traffic through a remote exit node. Easy to use: install the app, scan the QR code of another device, and you are connected. Built-in NAT traversal. If both devices are behind NAT and direct P2P is not possible, encrypted traffic is relayed through community relays. TLS 1.3 encryption for all transports (QUIC and TCP). ed25519 peer authentication — a peer id is the device's public key. Cross-platform: Android, Windows, Linux, macOS. How it works Awl is built on top of libp2p for peer-to-peer networking and a TUN virtual interface for IP routing. QUIC or TCP with TLS is used as a transport, and a DHT is used to discover peers. On first launch, the app connects to community bootstrap nodes, registers itself, and then looks up the addresses of the peers you want to reach. Source code, desktop builds and more documentation: https://github.com/anywherelan/awl

name: Daily Wallpapers

name: Findroid

name: NodeLook
short: A general website checker for users facing internet restrictions.
description: NodeLook is a general website checker for users facing internet restrictions. It helps users determine whether a service is accessible through their current connection, or whether it is filtered or unavailable.

name: Holos
short: Holos: Mobile-first Fediverse client with your own ActivityPub identity
description: Holos is a mobile-first Fediverse client that gives you your own ActivityPub identity directly on your phone. name: NoteSR - Encrypted Notes
short: Secure offline notes with AES-256 encryption and encrypted file attachments.

short: Apply device settings to your apps.

name: Do The Thing
short: A local-first personal coach that surfaces the right tasks each day.
description: Do The Thing is a personal coaching task manager that acts less like a static checklist and more like an active coach — surfacing what matters today and nudging you toward it. Features: * Seven task types: simple to-dos, deadlines, recurring tasks, randomized-interval tasks, important annual dates, timed goals, and daily habit check-ins. * A two-factor engine that ranks tasks by both urgency (time pressure) and importance (priority), with automatic escalation and a per-task priority ceiling so nothing quietly takes over your list. * Five coach personas, from "Just the Facts" to "Hype Person," each with its own voice across daily briefings, check-ins, and your evening wrap-up. * Adjustable notification intensity and a full daily cadence: morning briefing, midday check-ins, evening wrap-up, and a weekly review. * On-device backup and restore — export a copy yourself or let the app keep a rolling weekly backup automatically. Notifications are scheduled locally and do not use Google Play Services or Firebase.

name: Simple Crypto Widget

name: Capy Reader

name: Lembra
short: Reminders for recurring alerts: insurance, inspections, vaccines and more
description: Lembra is a native, fully offline app to manage cards for recurring alerts and reminders: car and motorbike paperwork, home tasks, pet vaccinations, kids' appointments, documents, licenses and more. Features: * Cards with title, category, start date, optional time and location, repeat interval, number of repetitions and how many days in advance to warn you. * A local notification is fired automatically the chosen number of days before EACH occurrence, not only the last one. * Editable and deletable cards; alerts are cancelled and rescheduled on change. * Categories with filtering: Car, Motorbike, Home, Pets, Kids, Documents, Licenses and Misc. * Light/dark/system theme and configurable primary and accent colors. * Alarms survive a device reboot. * Optionally dump every occurrence as events into your device calendar. name: Health Disconnect

description: Health Disconnect lets you explore your personal health data right on your device — no accounts, no internet, no data collection. Connect to Android Health Connect and instantly visualize 35+ health metrics as interactive charts. Create custom views that combine multiple metrics, configure chart types, aggregation methods, and time windows, then pin them to your home screen as widgets. KEY FEATURES • Browse 35+ Health Connect metrics — steps, heart rate, weight, sleep, blood pressure, nutrition, and more • Interactive charts — line and bar charts with configurable aggregation (sum, average, min, max) • Custom views — combine multiple metrics in a single chart and save for quick access • Flexible time windows — view data by day, week, month, year, or all-time history • Home screen widgets — pin any custom view as a resizable widget with configurable refresh intervals • Export your data — save aggregated values or raw entries as CSV • Share charts — export chart images in light or dark theme • Advanced configuration — logarithmic and normalized Y-axes, data smoothing, bucket sizes, custom units, min/max labels • Theme support — follows your system theme or choose light/dark manually SUPPORTED HEALTH CONNECT DATA Fitness & Activity: Steps, Distance, Speed, Exercise, Floors Climbed, Elevation Gained, Power, Wheelchair Pushes Cardiovascular: Heart Rate, Resting Heart Rate, Heart Rate Variability, Blood Pressure, Oxygen Saturation, VO2 Max Body: Weight, Height, Body Fat, Lean Body Mass, Bone Mass, Body Water Mass, Basal Metabolic Rate Nutrition: Hydration, Nutrition, Active Calories Burned, Total Calories Burned Other: Body Temperature, Basal Body Temperature, Respiratory Rate, Sleep, Menstruation, Cervical Mucus, Ovulation Test, Intermenstrual Bleeding, Sexual Activity PRIVACY FIRST Health Disconnect includes zero network permissions. name: Smouldering Durtles

name: Password Master

Generating, managing and storing passwords with Password Master is fast and easy, just check options and hit a button to generate password and store it in an encrypted database. Features: * Create password groups with icons * Generate and store password with an icon, name, url, user name or a note * Simply choose which characters your password should contain * Passwords are generated by cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generator * No internet and storage permission required, your passwords are never stored anywhere * Generates passwords with 1 - 999 characters * Use custom symbols which password should contain * Use your own seed to generate passwords * Shows password strength and bits of entropy * Automatically clears clipboard * Does not require any permission * Light and dark app themes * App is Open Source * No Ads

name: NotePad
short: Make notes
description: A simple and intuitive notepad based on the app bundled with Palm Pilot. Entirely offline, requiring few permissions to run. Permission to use external storage is only needed to back up or restore your notes on Marshmallow (Android 6) and older. The following permissions are added by WorkManager, a Google library used to run the export, import, and password re-encryption operations in the background when initiated by the user. The core app does not use these on its own. Permission to run a foreground service, added on Pie (Android 9) and later. Permission to view network connections, used by WorkManager to determine the best time to schedule background tasks. Permission to prevent the phone from sleeping, used by WorkManager to keep the processor awake while a background task is running. Permission to run at startup, used by WorkManager to reschedule any pending background task after the phone is rebooted. Create any number of categories for different notes. Mark notes as private and optionally encrypt them with a password. Export notes to a local XML file. Import notes from an XML file. Backwards compatible with Android 5.0 (Lollipop) and up.

name: Quest Log
short: Balance life's Main and Side Quests in a private, offline game-themed to-do app
description: I built Quest Log to help myself, and maybe you, keep a balance between the two kinds of things a life is made of: the important ones it demands of us (Main Quests), and the beautiful ones that make it worth living (Side Quests). The app keeps both in view and helps you pick a few to focus on each day. Every quest can hold objectives, a trail of progress, and a dated journal of what you did, so finishing one feels like finishing a quest rather than ticking a box. Sort quests into your own categories, mark the recurring ones as habits, and build each day from them. It's yours to shape: switch between game-inspired themes, adjust the look, and tune a wide range of settings until the app feels right for you. The playful design is there to bring a little joy to getting things done. It's private by default: no accounts, no network, no telemetry, and it works fully offline. Every quest is a plain Markdown file you can export, back up, and re-import as a ZIP, so your data is always yours. Quest Log is young and changing fast, and your feedback shapes it.

name: Metronome
short: Metronome app for playing repeated rhythms at different speeds.

name: Chronal
short: Clean metronome & tuner with polyrhythms and notation editor.
description: Chronal is a powerful, ad-free metronome and tuner built for musicians of all levels. Practice, rehearse, and perform with precise timing, advanced rhythm tools, and a chromatic tuner, all in one app. 🎵 Metronome Features • Notation editor: Hear the rhythm that you see on the page. • Multiple synchronized metronomes: Layer independent rhythms for polyrhythms and advanced practice. • Beat & subdivision visualization: Clear visual indicators for beats and subdivisions. • Fullscreen mode: Focus on your music with large, easy-to-see visuals from a distance. • Conductor mode: Follow a visual conducting path to internalize timing. • Real-time BPM detection: Detect the tempo of percussion patterns straight from your microphone. 🎸 Tuner Features • Transpose for any instrument: Tune guitar, strings, and wind instruments with precision. • Custom tuning frequency: Adjust the reference pitch (A4) to any frequency you prefer. • Tuner graph: Visualize your pitch stability and accuracy in real time. • Reference tones: Generate reference tones to tune by ear. 🎷 No ads, no interruptions Chronal is completely ad-free and distraction-free. Practice and perform without any distractions or annoying pop-ups. The app is completely open-source and is funded solely by generous donations.

name: Primitive FTPd

Runs without root privileges and is not started when device boots: Control yourself when the server runs. However, while it runs it prevents standby to avoid long uploads and downloads to abort.

name: Notifications for FB

Source code: https://github.com/gsurrel/FacebookNotifications Issue tracker: https://github.com/gsurrel/FacebookNotifications/issues Changelog and release notes: https://github.com/gsurrel/FacebookNotifications#changelog License: MIT Author: gsurrel - https://gregoire.surrel.org/

name: ShoppingList

Core features: * Simple and intuitive to use * Dark and Light user interface mode * No permissions required * No tracking or sharing any data * No ads Languages: * Azerbaijani * Bengali * Czech * English * Finnish * French * Georgian * German * Hebrew * Italian * Lithuanian * Norwegian Bokmal * Polish * Portuguese * Russian * Turkish * Ukrainian

name: BuzzKill
short: Powers off your phone after inactivity, only inside a nightly kill zone.
description: BuzzKill powers your phone off when you stop using it at night, so notifications and the temptation to scroll cannot wake you up at 2am. You set a nightly kill zone (e.g. 23:00 to 07:00). Inside that window, BuzzKill watches for the screen to stay off for a configurable number of minutes, then triggers the system shutdown via an accessibility service. Outside the zone the app does nothing. To come back on in the morning, use your phone's built-in scheduled power-on (e.g. on OnePlus: Settings, Additional settings, Scheduled power on/off). BuzzKill cannot enable this for you, so an onboarding checklist reminds you. Features: - Single-screen, hardware-panel-styled UI. - Configurable kill zone, inactivity timeout, and a first-shutdown confirmation dialog. - Test trigger with a 10-second countdown that runs the shutdown sequence in dry-run mode, so you can verify it works without losing your work. - OEM-aware: power-dialog matching strings live in a per-OEM file, currently tuned for OnePlus (OxygenOS). Required permissions: - Accessibility service (the mechanism used to power off). - Disable battery optimization (otherwise OxygenOS kills the foreground service). - Notification permission (Android 13+, for the persistent kill-zone notification). Primary target device is the OnePlus 11 on OxygenOS. Adding support for other OEMs (Pixel, Samsung, Xiaomi) is a data-only change in app/src/main/kotlin/ca/asmat/buzzkill/oem/. Source code, issue tracker, and contributing guide on GitLab.

name: Randomly/Die
short: Random number generator with fast UI, dice, hex, binary and secrets
description: Randomly/Die is a fast, playful random number generator. Roll dice, flip coins, generate hex or binary values, pick musical notes or decisions, and explore emoji and game modes. Features an extended dice notation console, quick mode buttons, history, and Sparkle Mode.

name: Suspension Setup
short: Track and manage your mountain bike suspension settings and their change history
description: Suspension Setup helps mountain bike riders keep track of their suspension settings and monitor changes over time. Features: * Manage multiple suspension setups * Track fork settings: air pressure, sag, volume spacers, low-speed compression (LSC), high-speed compression (HSC), low-speed rebound (LSR), high-speed rebound (HSR) * Track shock settings with the same parameters * Track front and rear tyre pressures * Enable or disable individual fields per setup to match your specific components * Full change history: every time you save updated settings, the changes are logged with a timestamp * Add or edit comments on history entries to note what prompted each change * Undo history entries to revert your suspension back to a previous state * Record serial numbers and product pages for your fork and shock * No cloud, no account required, no data sent anywhere — everything stays on your device

name: Bondwidth
short: Private, offline phone & contacts app that helps you keep up your bonds
description: Bondwidth is an all-in-one phone, contacts, and relationship app that works entirely on your device. No accounts, no servers, no tracking — and it quietly helps you stay close to the people who matter. Friendship is small attentions, often. Set a check-in cadence for each person and Bondwidth gently flags who's getting too quiet, so you can reach out before silence becomes a habit. Birthdays and anniversaries are remembered for you, and the calls you make are counted automatically. Private by design * No internet permission at all — the app cannot reach the network, and its build pipeline fails if that ever changes. * No accounts, no servers, no cloud. Everything stays in the app's private storage on your device. * No analytics, no ads, no third-party trackers. * Optional encrypted backups (AES-256-GCM) that only you can open. * Optional biometric app lock and a "hide from screenshots" mode. Phone * Default dialer with its own in-call screen, Picture-in-Picture, and per-contact ringtones. * T9 smart dial, speed dial, and dual-SIM call routing. * Block numbers, missed-call notifications, call history and search. * Colour-coded call directions, with optional WhatsApp / Signal shortcuts. Contacts * Browse, create, edit and delete contacts, with group filtering. * Typed phone numbers, emails, postal address, website, organisation, notes and birthday. * Find and merge duplicates; import and export vCard files. Bonds * Per-person check-in cadence with gentle overdue nudges. * Birthday and anniversary reminders, with a "Mark as wished" action. * An interaction timeline and an at-a-glance relationship dashboard. * A home-screen widget for upcoming occasions and who you haven't spoken to lately. Bondwidth is free software (GPL-3.0). Its phone and contacts features are derived from the Fossify Phone and Fossify Contacts projects.

name: 1Key Password Manager
short: Offline password manager. 2FA + notes. No account, no network, no telemetry.
description: 1Key is a local-first password manager for Android. Your vault lives on your device, encrypted with a key only you hold, and never moves unless you export it yourself. There is no account to create, no server to breach, and no network connection of any kind — the INTERNET permission is stripped from the manifest, so the operating system itself enforces the offline guarantee. Security • Vault key derived from your master password with Argon2id (m=64 MiB, t=3, p=1 by default; configurable up to m=256 MiB, t=16) • Every credential field encrypted separately with AES-256-GCM, bound to its row and column via additional authenticated data — an attacker with raw database write access cannot swap ciphertexts between rows • Master-password verifier stored in EncryptedSharedPreferences, itself wrapped by an Android Keystore-bound key (TEE or StrongBox where available), so offline brute-force of a leaked device image is not possible • Optional 128-bit Secret Key mixed into the KDF for defense-in-depth against a compromised master password • Biometric unlock backed by hardware-secure key; requires master-password confirmation to enable • Tiered attempt limiting: 3, 5, and 10 wrong attempts trigger 30-second, 5-minute, and 1-hour cooldowns; counters survive process kills Vault • Store credentials with title, username, password, URL, notes, and custom fields • Tag-based organisation, favourites, full-text search • TOTP / 2FA codes stored in the same entry as the password they protect — no app switching • Live-preview Markdown in notes with a helper bar; disable in Settings if you prefer plain text • Soft-delete recycle bin (toggle off if you prefer immediate deletion) • Credential history preserves previous values on edit Autofill • System-level Autofill Service — fill logins into any app or browser without leaving them • URL-only matching by default (no fuzzy suggestions) to keep phishing risk down • Save prompt on submit; per-action confirmation for cross-host URL saves Backup and import • Encrypted backup as a .1key file (AES-256-GCM with Argon2id key derivation) • Plain CSV / JSON export for interoperability • Direct import from Google Passwords, LastPass, KeePass, 1Password, Dashlane, NordPass, Safari / iCloud Keychain — auto-detects format, no manual column mapping Unlock options • Master password (always available) • 6-digit PIN • Biometric (fingerprint / face) • Background auto-lock: immediate / 30s / 1m / 5m • Inactivity auto-lock: never / 30s / 1m / 5m / 15m •

name: SDAI - Stable Diffusion AI

Features: * SSH terminal sessions * Local Arch Linux shell on-device (Android, arm64) with pacman, running unprivileged through proot - no root, no server; downloads an Arch Linux ARM image on first use * Mosh roaming for unreliable mobile networks * Tmux auto attach/create per host, with start directories, prefix keys, action shortcuts, and scrollback mode * SFTP file browsing and export * Import SSH private keys from a file, or generate an Ed25519 key on device * Optional passphrase encryption for generated keys, with public-key copy and export * OpenSSH FIDO hardware-key authentication, tested with YubiKey, with multiple hardware keys per host tried in turn * External authentication that lets the SSH server authenticate you without saved credentials * USB and NFC support for CTAP-compatible security keys * Saved machine profiles with tags, search, and sorting by last connected, name, or date added * Local credential and trusted host key storage * Trusted host key prompts and key management * App lock with device authentication when supported * Tabbed terminal workspace * Customizable key row with modifier, navigation, and function keys, key repeat, latching modifiers, and your own text and control-key shortcuts * Fullscreen terminal mode * Terminal themes * Background keepalive through a foreground service Conduit does not require a Conduit account and does not use a Conduit sync service.
